article.articleHeadline: 'Leaderless, underfunded, and unprepared': Experts warn US may not be ready for hantavirus and Ebola
article.articleSummary: 41 Americans are being monitored for hantavirus after a cruise-ship outbreak off West Africa; one American has tested positive for Ebola, with six others at high risk linked to a Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak that had 223 deaths as of May 25. As of May 30, 2026, the immediate risk to most Americans remains low. Public health concerns center on a weakened U.S. safety net: no permanent CDC director, staffing potentially down 25–33%, and the U.S. withdrawal from the WHO. Critics warn that leadership gaps and slower information sharing could delay responses even for low-risk events. Policy discussions include renewing the Pandemic and All-Hazards Preparedness Act (authorities lapsed in 2023) and measures on maternal health during crises. Public trust in health information shows partisan divides, complicating readiness for hantavirus and Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 「指導者不在、資金不足、準備不足」：専門家らが、米国はハンタウイルスとエボラに対応できない可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（エボラ223死亡、複数国での発生）と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度（死亡例あり）、管理可能性（米国の対応体制弱化）が該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCでのエボラ感染者223死亡、米国内でのハンタウイルス41名監視、エボラ陽性者1名が確認されている。発生地域リストにはAngola及びUSAも含まれるが、サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ集団発生とそれに関連する米国への影響である。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ列挙した。アンゴラはサマリーで言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ оценила риск распространения Эболы на глобальном уровне
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO assessed the global risk of Ebola transmission.
article.articleSummary: Global risk of Ebola transmission remains low as of 2026-05-30, including within Russia and the European region. The WHO Russian office states risk is extremely high at the national level in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, and high at the regional level in Africa, while remaining low globally. The WHO has designated the Congo and Uganda outbreaks as extraordinary and a threat to other countries. Current figures from the DRC report 221 deaths among suspected Ebola cases; the previous DRC Ebola outbreak ended in October 2025. The coverage underscores concern about virulence and cross-border spread, although no specific imports/exports are cited in the report. The situation remains monitored, with emphasis on containment and international readiness.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラウイルスの世界規模での伝播リスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイク（DRC及びウガンダ）が報告され、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際拡大のリスク」に該当（2/4）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度（死亡事例221件）、流行のしやすさ（国境越境懸念）、管理可能性（WHO国際的対応）が該当し、シグナルとして認識されるべき。
triage.notes: RIA Novosti (ロシアメディア)によるWHO評価の報道。発生地域にはロシアとウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際のエボラアウトブレイクが発生しているのはDRC（221死亡）とウガンダ。ロシアは「リスク低い」と明記されているため verified_locations から除外。2025年10月のDRCアウトブレイク終息後の新規フレアとして報告されており、国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: IKEA Alexandra, Wisma Atria burger joint among new locations visited by COVID-19 cases while infectious
article.articleSummary: New locations added to Singapore's MOH list of places visited by COVID-19 cases while infectious include IKEA Alexandra, an Omakase Burger at Wisma Atria, Ananas Cafe in Choa Chu Kang, a Giant supermarket at Sunshine Place in Choa Chu Kang, and CT Hub in Kallang. Close contacts have been notified; individuals who were at these locations during the specified timings should monitor their health for 14 days from the visit and seek medical attention promptly if they develop acute respiratory symptoms (cough, sore throat, runny nose), fever, or loss of taste or smell, and inform the doctor of exposure. There is no need to avoid places visited by confirmed cases. The National Environment Agency will guide cleaning and disinfection of affected premises. Singapore reported 307 new COVID-19 cases, bringing the total to 52,512; one community case, a 26-year-old Singaporean woman, is unlinked; five imported cases, including a one-year-old boy who had returned from India; the remaining cases are work-permit holders in dormitories.

triage.headline_ja: IKEA Alexandra、Wisma Atria バーガーレストランなど、COVID-19患者が感染性を有する期間に訪問した新たな場所
triage.triage_reason: シンガポール国内の限定的な感染例の報告であり、2026年時点でのCOVID-19は既知の風土病。新規性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、重症度のいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はシンガポール国内の場所曝露リストの更新情報であり、シンガポールは対象国に含まれない。インド関連では、帰国者（1歳男児）が輸入症例として記載されているが、これはシンガポール国内での検出。2026年のCOVID-19は既知のルーチン感染症であり、シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS reporta 906 casos sospechosos de ébola en el Congo (18:00 h)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports 906 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (6:00 p.m.).
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists as of May 30, 2026, with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths under investigation. In the DRC, 125 cases have been confirmed with 17 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and the case-fatality among confirmed patients ranges from 30% to 50%, underscoring the impact of delayed care. There are currently no licensed vaccines or treatments specific to Bundibugyo Ebola; experimental interventions may be used only within clinical trials. WHO is convening experts to evaluate countermeasures and coordinating with Congo and Uganda, alongside Africa CDC, to design ethical trials. Uganda has seven confirmed cases, three imported from the DRC, and one death, with no evidence of community transmission in Ugandan territory.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴにおけるエボラウイルス病疑い患者906例を報告（18:00時点）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する高リスクシグナル。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上最高レベルの脅威であり、国際的拡大の兆候（ウガンダへの越境例）と渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認患者は副次的だが、DRCが主要な発生地域。Bundibugyo Ebola virusは致死率30-50%の重篤な亜種。ワクチン・治療法未承認。WHOが専門家会議を召集し、アフリカCDCと共にDRC・ウガンダと連携している。継続的な国際的対応と詳細情報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il test sulla dottoressa rientrata dal Congo: resta in quarantena allo Spallanzani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the test on the doctor who returned from the Congo is negative; she remains in quarantine at Spallanzani.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, a doctor from Doctors Without Borders who had returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested negative for Ebola; she remains in quarantine at the Spallanzani Institute in Rome, asymptomatic and under observation until 8 June. There are no Ebola cases in Italy. The case occurs amid international attention on the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wrote to EU leaders urging strengthened border coordination and unified rules for arrivals from affected areas; the European Commission confirmed ongoing health-security measures and support to affected countries, with exit screening emphasized. National authorities plan further operational guidance, including risk assessment and management of suspected cases. No additional Italian cases have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴからの帰国医師の検査は陰性、スパランツァーニ研究所で隔離継続
triage.triage_reason: イタリアに帰国した医療従事者の陰性確認であり、イタリア国内でのエボラ症例は現在ない。ただしDRCおよびウガンダでの発生が背景にあり、国際的な関心が高まっており、情報の進展を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリアにおける陰性確認であり、イタリアは対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。背景にあるDRC・ウガンダのBundibugyo株アウトブレイクが言及されており、DRCは対象国のため含める。社会的・政治的関心が高いが、現段階ではイタリア国内での実際の症例がなく、フルRRA判定基準には至らないと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Antallet af mistænkte ebola-smittede runder 1000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola infections is around 1,000.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, DR Congo reports about 1,000 suspected Ebola infections, up from just over 900 the day before; 225 cases are laboratory-confirmed, and the WHO has recorded 223 suspected deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The epicenter is in eastern DR Congo, a mineral-rich region long afflicted by armed conflict. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo variant, which has caused only two prior outbreaks (2007 in Uganda and 2012 in DR Congo); about 30% of those infected die. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this variant. Early symptoms resemble influenza, potentially progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and sometimes internal or external bleeding. Uganda has closed its border with DR Congo to contain spread, with additional cases and a death reported in Uganda. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak began in Guinea, spreading to Sierra Leone and Liberia, totaling over 28,600 cases and 11,325 deaths—the largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: 疑いエボラ感染者数が約1,000人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラアウトブレイクは最高レベルの公衆衛生上の脅威であり、ただちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCで宣言されたエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日）。Bundibugyo variant、疑い患者約1,000人、確定患者225人、死亡223人。ウガンダでも症例・死亡確認あり。治療法・ワクチンなし。武装紛争地域での発生のため対応困難。発生地域リストに含まれるシエラレオネ・リベリア・ウガンダ・ギニアは記事中で歴史的比較例または隣接国として言及されているが、現在の流行地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Aeroméxico, Volaris y Viva: las aerolíneas mexicanas que han restringido vuelos a países africanos afectados por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aeroméxico, Volaris, and Viva: the Mexican airlines that have restricted flights to Ebola-affected African countries.
article.articleSummary: Three Mexican airlines—Aeroméxico, Volaris, and Viva Aerobus—announced flight restrictions for passengers who have recently traveled to African nations with active Ebola outbreaks, effective May 30, 2026. Aeroméxico will deny air entry to travelers who have been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days. Volaris will apply the same policy for an initial 60-day period; Viva Aerobus says the measure follows health and immigration authorities' guidelines. The measures are part of a regional sanitary protocol coordinated by Mexico, the United States, and Canada ahead of the North American World Cup 2026 to reduce cross-border epidemiological risk amid higher mobility. The Ebola outbreak in Central Africa prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026, with 750 suspected cases and at least 177 deaths related to the Bundibugyo strain; authorities emphasize vigilance and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: アエロメヒコ、ボラリス、ビバ：エボラ流行の影響を受けたアフリカ諸国への便を制限したメキシコの航空会社
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）し、WHO PHEICが宣言されている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目が該当する高リスク事象であり、フルのRapid Risk Assessmentが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカのエボラ流行に対応したメキシコ国内の航空規制措置を報道しているもの。実際の流行地はウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンと記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を2026年5月17日に宣言済みであることが確認されており、750疑い事例、177死亡（Bundibugyo株）が報告されている。北米地域での大型イベント（2026 FIFA World Cup North America）との連動による国際的リスク上昇も重要。

article.articleHeadline: قبل كأس العالم.. المكسيك تفرض قيودا على القادمين من "دول إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Before the World Cup... Mexico imposes restrictions on arrivals from Ebola-affected countries.
article.articleSummary: Mexican airlines Aeromexico, Viva Aerobus, and Volaris will bar entry to travelers who visited Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days, for 60 days, in coordination with the United States and Canada ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The policy applies to international flights and aligns with epidemic-surveillance protocols for the tournament. The Democratic Republic of Congo is set to participate in the World Cup, with a 21-day quarantine in a US bubble if the team enters the United States. Congo training is planned in Houston before matches against Portugal (June 17), Colombia (June 23 in Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (June 27 in Atlanta). WHO has declared an International Health Emergency for Ebola in eastern DRC; Africa CDC reports 246 deaths among over 1,000 suspected cases as of Thursday. WHO data to May 24 show 10 confirmed and 223 suspected deaths among over 1,000 cases since mid-May, with one recovery.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ前に...メキシコがエボラウイルス感染症流行国からの入国者に制限を課す
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な拡大リスク、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）。DRCでのWHO保健上の緊急事態宣言により深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が確認され、国際的な対応（複数国による制限措置）が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラウイルス感染症の活発な発生地はDRCの東部であり、DRCはスクリーニング対象国リストに該当。ウガンダと南スーダンも言及されているが、スクリーニング対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めない。2026年FIFAワールドカップという大規模国際イベントを控えた国際的な感染症対応措置として、複数国（メキシコ、米国、カナダ）による渡航制限が実施されている点で、国際的な関心が高い。WHOの国際保健上の緊急事態宣言により、深刻性と国際的拡大リスクの両方が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / Alerta mundial: EE. UU. refuerza controles por el ébola en el aeropuerto JFK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Nación / Global alert: U.S. steps up Ebola screening at JFK Airport.
article.articleSummary: Ebola screening at John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York begins on Thursday, making JFK the fourth U.S. airport to implement Ebola-related health checks since the new outbreak detected in Africa. Inspections target travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda, with heightened evaluations for symptoms or recent exposure. CDC notes JFK already operates protocols from prior international emergencies. Checks could be applied to travelers from affected areas regardless of nationality or immigration status. Washington Dulles, Atlanta Hartsfield-Jackson, and Houston Bush airports are conducting similar screenings. The Ebola virus causes fever, hemorrhagic symptoms, and organ failure, transmitted via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. The WHO underscores rapid response and surveillance. Experts warn a potential Ebola pandemic could devastate health systems and economies, with travel restrictions and global disruption akin to or greater than COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: ラ・ナシオン／世界的警戒：米国、JFK空港でのエボラ熱スクリーニング強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ熱アウトブレイクが複数アフリカ国で発生し、米国が複数空港でスクリーニング開始。パンデミック可能性の専門家警告あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに米国各州が多数含まれるが、サマリーを精読すると実際のエボラ熱アウトブレイクはアフリカ（DRC、南スーダン、ウガンダ）で発生。米国は対応措置（空港スクリーニング）を実施している側。WPRO対象国はDRCのみ該当。ただしこのイベントの国際的重要性は極めて高い（米国を含む複数国での対応開始、パンデミック可能性の警告）。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : 225 cas confirmés d'Ebola, un chiffre jugé plus fiable grâce aux capacités de diagnostic - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: 225 confirmed Ebola cases, a figure deemed more reliable thanks to diagnostic capabilities
article.articleSummary: 225 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, reported from Bunia, the provincial capital, on May 29. Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba announced the figure during a joint press briefing with Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya and Ituri military governor Lt-Gen Johnny Luboya. He said the 225 cases constitute a more reliable estimate thanks to strengthened laboratory diagnostic capacity, with overnight analyses still pending. The enhanced lab data provide a closer, more accurate picture of the epidemic on the ground. Authorities continue contact tracing, patient care, and community sensitization to limit transmission. Ituri remains a key surveillance zone in a coordinated outbreak response led by the government and partners, with ongoing surveillance and rapid screening to refine the outbreak’s scope.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：225人のエボラ確定症例、診断能力の強化により信頼性が向上
triage.triage_reason: エボラは高い致命率を持つ重篤な感染症であり、225人の確定症例が報告されている。DRCでの発生は異常で予想外ではないが、症例数の増加と診断能力の強化は公衆衛生上深刻であり、国際的拡大リスクも存在する。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高レベルの危険性を持つ感染症。DRCイトゥリ州での確定症例225人は、公式な保健相による発表であり信頼性が高い。診断能力の強化により症例数が更新されており、実際の流行規模が明確化している。継続的な接触者追跡、患者ケア、コミュニティ啓発が実施中。地域検証確認：発生地域に示されたDRC（ID:203312）がサマリー上の主題であり、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana activates emergency health protocols over possible Ebola threat
article.articleSummary: Ghana activates national emergency health protocols over a potential Ebola threat after the World Health Organisation declares the Bundibugyo Ebola strain a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh led a May 29 multi-site assessment, inspecting passenger screening at Accra International Airport and monitoring the Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research (NMIMR) and the Ghana Infectious Disease Centre (GIDC). The exercise stresses cross-border surveillance and readiness, with a shift from current checks to advanced digital detection to reduce human error. Public institutions, local authorities, and event organisers were urged to reintroduce strict hygiene measures, and mass gatherings were discouraged. Public cooperation is emphasized as essential to avert an outbreak, with heightened land-border vigilance. NMIMR’s biosafety laboratories are fully resourced for high-speed differential testing of suspected Ebola cases, and WHO Representative Dr. Fiona Braka commended Ghana’s preemptive preparedness despite scientific challenges.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、エボラの可能性のある脅威をめぐり緊急保健プロトコルを発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している点、複数国での脅威、ガーナの能動的対応体制の構築など、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: WHOが既にBundibugyo Ebola株をPHEICとして宣言。ガーナ政府がアクラ国際空港、国境検問所での検査体制強化、NMIMR・GIDC等での検査体制整備を実施中。隣接国との越境監視体制も強化されており、地域全体への波及リスクが懸念される。科学的課題はあるもWHO代表がガーナの先制的準備態勢を評価。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: la "riposte" se met en place, le patron de l'OMS appelle à la solidarité internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the response is being put in place, the WHO chief calls for international solidarity.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Ituri province of the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared two weeks earlier, is being addressed with rapid mobilization. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the DRC on May 28 to support the response and urged international solidarity, stressing that borders should not be closed but funding increased. In Bunia, Health Minister Samuel Kamba said the response is being put in place; awareness campaigns, radio messaging, and handwashing facilities are expanding, schools are adjusting with distancing measures, and no closures are planned. In displacement camps near Bunia (ISP site, about 11,000 residents), water shortages persist; 50 washbasins have been installed, but hygiene remains a challenge and many people still rely on home care or traditional healers. NGOs like Action contre la faim are adapting operations; officials urge neighbors not to hide cases to avoid transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ：対応体制が整備中、WHO事務局長が国際連帯を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生であり、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが全て存在。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と国際連帯の呼びかけから高い政治的関心も明白。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体。Ituri州での宣言から2週間での対応が進行中。変位キャンプでの衛生状況悪化、伝統的治療者への依存など実装上の課題あり。WHO事務局長の現地訪問（5月28日）と国際的支援要請により、国際的な関心・協調体制が既に構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Peru declares state of emergency as measles epidemic exposes crisis of capitalist-run public health
article.articleSummary: Peru has declared a 90-day health emergency for a measles outbreak, with 301 confirmed and 1,403 suspected cases nationwide as of early May 2026. The epicenter is Puno, accounting for 295 confirmed cases; transmission has since spread to Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, Apurímac, and Lima/Callao. Six people are hospitalized (two children, four adults); a pregnant woman is infected. Of 215 confirmed cases analyzed, 37 are aged 5–9, 75 are 10–19, and 60 are 20–29, with additional adults up to 59. The outbreak is linked to mass gatherings (Candelaria, Carnival) and threatens further spread ahead of Inti Raymi. Arequipa reports cross-border linked cases from Juliaca; university classes suspended where coverage is insufficient. Two doses of MMR confer lifelong immunity in 97% of recipients; national vaccination coverage was 82% in 2025, with Puno dropping from 70% in 2025 to 16% in Q1 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ペルーが麻疹流行により90日間の保健非常事態を宣言、資本主義的公衆衛生制度の危機を露呈
triage.triage_reason: ペルーは対象監視国に含まれていない。Bluedot APIが付与した地域はペルー国内および隣接国ブラジルであり、監視対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のうち該当する国がない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはペルーの複数州およびブラジルが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はペルーにおける麻疹流行である。ペルーは監視対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。本イベント自体はIHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当する重要な感染症イベントであるが、地域検証ルールに従い対象外と判定する。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲陸網紅「喉嚨爛光」身亡！被蟲咬感染不治　火速下葬│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old mainland Chinese online influencer dies of throat necrosis after an insect-bite infection; buried swiftly
article.articleSummary: A 39-year-old mainland Chinese internet influencer from Yunnan’s Hani ethnic group died from scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi infection) after an insect bite, having missed the critical treatment window. Last post May 20; death occurred May 27 at 2:00 a.m. The illness presented as severe throat infection amid fever. Scrub typhus is transmitted by chigger mites; symptoms include high fever, headache, back pain, chills, night sweats, lymphadenopathy, eschar at the bite site, followed by a diffuse rash; complications can involve pneumonia or liver dysfunction, with untreated fatality up to ~60%. In Taiwan, scrub typhus peaks in June–July and infections arise from animal hosts; prevention stresses avoiding mite habitat, protective clothing, and prompt decontamination after outdoor activity. Globally distributed, with endemic areas in northern Japan, northern Australia, Pakistan, and Afghanistan.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳の大陸中国のネットインフルエンサー「喉がただれた」状態で死亡！虫刺されによる感染で治らず、火速で埋葬│TVBS新聞網
triage.triage_reason: スクラブチフスの死亡事例であり、予想外の重症転帰、非効果的な治療、明確な疫学的背景（有病地での虫刺され）が存在。社会的関心も高く（インフルエンサー死亡報道）、フルRRA評価を必要とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はユンナン省（雲南）の中国人インフルエンサーのスクラブチフス死亡事例。台湾は流行季やリスク情報の文脈で言及されているが、実際の発生地は中国のみ。パキスタン、アフガニスタン、日本、オーストラリアは地域的背景情報として記載されているが、当該イベントの発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: BBC World Service - The Documentary Podcast, Responding to Ebola
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo draws a warning from the World Health Organization about a 'catastrophic collision' of disease and conflict. Ebola, a virus-caused illness, spreads when transmission occurs from an infected animal to humans and then between people; symptoms are severe and often fatal. The central African region is deeply affected by conflict, and there is no vaccine currently available for this strain. The documentary features two aid workers detailing containment efforts, journalists addressing misinformation, and Harriet in Liberia who contracted Ebola during a previous outbreak. The program highlights the practical realities of outbreak response in volatile settings and the human impact of Ebola as nations contend with health threats amid conflict.

triage.headline_ja: BBC World Service - ドキュメンタリーポッドキャスト『エボラへの対応』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の発生は重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の危険性を持つ異常事象であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生が主題。Liberiaはサマリーに言及されているが、過去の発生歴に関連する背景情報（Harriet in Liberia）であり、現在の発生地域として明記されていない。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOによる「catastrophic collision」警告と紛争地での管理困難性は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué Aerolíneas Mexicanas Están Restringiendo el Ingreso de Pasajeros por Ébola?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Which Mexican Airlines Are Restricting Passenger Entry Due to Ebola?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts travel restrictions by Mexican airlines. As of May 28, 2026, Aeroméxico, Volaris, and Viva Aerobus will not admit passengers who have spent the previous 21 days in Ebola-affected countries: the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan (Mexico notes Ituri province in the DRC due to proximity). The measures run for 60 days and apply with limited exemptions: Mexican passport holders are exempt from Aeroméxico’s restriction; Volaris allows entry for US citizens or foreign nationals only through Washington Dulles and Houston airports; Viva Aerobus will implement a temporary inbound restriction starting at 00:00 on May 28, 2026. WHO records over 200 Ebola deaths in the region, with up-to-date cases confirmed in the DRC and Uganda; South Sudan is included due to border proximity. Canada has announced a similar travel restriction. African Union health authorities anticipate a Bundibugyo strain vaccine by year-end.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに関するメキシコ系航空会社の乗客入国制限について
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な流行により、複数国が旅行制限を実施。IHR基準で異常性（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）、渡航制限（Yes）の3つが該当し、且つWPRO基準で重症度（死亡200名以上）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染）が該当。国際的な対応が進行中のシグナル
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはDRC以外に米国、スーダン、ウガンダ、カナダ、メキシコが含まれているが、記事サマリーによれば実際のエボラ出血熱発生は DRC とウガンダで確認されており、他国は旅行制限対応国。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO による死亡者200名以上の記録、複数の国家による旅行制限実施、ワクチン開発の進行などから、フルRRA進行が推奨される

article.articleHeadline: Aeroméxico, Volaris y Viva restringen vuelos a pasajeros de países africanos afectados por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aeroméxico, Volaris and Viva restrict flights to passengers from African countries affected by Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Aeroméxico, Volaris, and Viva Aerobus will restrict air entry to travelers who have recently visited Ebola-affected African countries—Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan—within the last 21 days. The measure, issued by Mexican health and immigration authorities, is valid for 60 days and applies to international routes operated by these carriers. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the hardest-hit, with nearly 250 deaths and over 1,000 Ebola cases. The World Cup 2026 in North America is driving enhanced health precautions; Congo’s team will participate, with the United States requiring a 21-day isolation before entry. Mexico expects more than five million visitors for the tournament, which includes matches in Houston and Guadalajara. The WHO has warned the Congo outbreak is extremely grave and threatens several African countries; Ebola causes acute, highly contagious hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: アエロメヒコ、ボラリス、ビバがエボラ感染国からの乗客への便を制限
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の実際の感染事例が複数のアフリカ国で確認されており、国際的影響の可能性がある。ただし、記事の主要内容はメキシコの航空会社の渡航制限措置（感染症の一次事例ではなく公衆衛生対応）であり、メキシコはシグナルトリアージの対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCで確認された事例についても詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはグアダラハラ、ヒューストン、メキシコが含まれるが、これらはメキシコの渡航制限措置の文脈（ワールドカップ2026）であり、実際のエボラ感染事例の発生地ではない。記事サマリーから確認される実際の感染事例はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンだが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれる。DRCの情報（250人の死亡、1,000例以上の感染事例）は重要だが、詳細な疫学情報が限定的なため、フルRRA実施前の情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nắng nóng gia tăng chó mèo cắn người, nhiều ca gặp nguy hiểm vì chậm tiêm phòng dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hot weather increases dog and cat bites, with many cases at risk due to delayed rabies vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Hot weather in Hanoi coincides with more dog and cat bites, with the Central Tropical Diseases Hospital reporting over 50 people seeking rabies immunoglobulin and vaccine in two weeks. In one morning, three exposure cases arrived within 30 minutes. Notable cases: N.V.B., 67, from Soc Son, was bitten on the palm and delayed vaccination for two weeks; the dog later died. N.T.A., 23, from Vinh Thanh, was bitten by a two-month-old kitten that died soon after, and vaccination followed only after family urging. By contrast, N.T.H., 65, of Dong Anh, sought care the day after a neighbor’s dog bite. Doctors warn rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear; the virus can persist in animals for months. Immediate wound cleaning (15 minutes with soap and water, then antiseptic) and prompt vaccination are critical; dogs/cats aged 2 months and older should be vaccinated annually. Do not use home remedies.

triage.headline_ja: 猛暑により犬猫に咬まれる人が増加、狂犬病予防接種の遅れにより多くの症例が危機的状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、ヒト-ヒト感染対象外だが動物感染の継続的曝露）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露）。ベトナムの対象国での医療施設への集中患者報告あり。
triage.notes: 記事はハノイでの狂犬病曝露事例の急増を報告。中央熱帯病院が2週間で50人以上の患者を受け入れた。動物由来の継続的な曝露リスク（毎年のワクチン接種推奨）と症状発現後の致死性（ほぼ100%）により、重症度と管理可能性の観点から懸念あり。ただし国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクは現時点では低い。

article.articleHeadline: Some businesses suffer fallout from novel coronavirus
article.articleSummary: Singapore faces sharp economic fallout from the Wuhan coronavirus outbreak. Since outbound restrictions on Jan 23, Chinese tourist arrivals have plummeted by over 80%, with knock-on effects on air traffic through Changi and hotel bookings—occupancy down to about 60% (from typical levels). Transport and tourism sectors are hardest hit: limousine/private-hire drivers report near-zero bookings (e.g., Mohamad Azan; Justin Lim) and are seeking alternative work. The Singapore Airshow (Feb 11–16) yields few walk-in bookings. Hotels report event cancellations and revenue losses; Royal Plaza on Scotts projects about S$700,000 in lost revenue. Royal Dragon restaurant on Havelock Road has shut indefinitely after declines in patrons from China, Taiwan, Thailand, and Cambodia. Government and industry observers urge flexible postponement options for events and targeted support to tide businesses through the downturn in Singapore.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスから企業が経済的な影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2026年のシナリオであり非現実的であり、また主として経済的影響に焦点を当てており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常/予想外の疾患パターンは記述されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は経済的影響に焦点を当てており、感染症そのものの公衆衛生上の脅威に関する情報が不足している。武漢での初期発生地域の言及があるため中国は検証ロケーションに含める。タイ、カンボジア、台湾は記事で言及されているが対象国はタイのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Dokter sarankan vaksinasi untuk cegah penularan flu Singapura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors urge vaccination to prevent the spread of Singapore flu.
article.articleSummary: Vaccination is urged to curb the spread of Singapore flu, i.e., Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) caused primarily by Enterovirus 71 (EV71) in Jakarta, Indonesia. EV71 is a non-enveloped virus that can survive on surfaces for up to a day and transmits via droplets, direct contact, or contaminated objects. HFMD can lead to severe outcomes including dehydration, seizures, aseptic meningitis, and encephalitis with potential cognitive impairment. One infected child can transmit the virus to about 12 others. The EV71 vaccine is recommended for children 6 months to 71 months old, given in two doses one month apart. Adults may also be vaccinated to provide cocoon protection for babies and toddlers. In addition to vaccination, hygiene measures such as handwashing, disinfecting toys, adequate nutrition and hydration, and masking in public spaces are advised. Locations involved: Jakarta; hospitals: Royal Hospital Puri, Mandaya Royal Hospital Puri.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がシンガポール風邪の感染を防ぐためのワクチン接種を勧奨
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病（HFMD）の流行警告であり、インドネシア（ジャカルタ）での感染症イベント。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク、WPRO基準で異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが該当し、医療機関による予防対策の勧奨を伴う社会的関心の高いシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ジャカルタにおけるEnterovirus 71による手足口病（HFMD）の流行警告。EV71は高い伝播性（1人が約12人に感染）、重症化リスク（髄膜炎、脳炎、認知機能障害）を持つ。医療機関による積極的なワクチン接種勧奨と衛生対策の推奨がなされており、地域内での社会的・政治的関心が高い。WPRO地域でのEV71関連イベントとして重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: la "riposte" se met en place, le patron de l'OMS appelle à la solidarité internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the 'response' is taking shape, the WHO Director-General calls for international solidarity.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo are shaping a response. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus met with UN representative James Swan and humanitarian coordinator Bruno Lemarquis, stressing that Congolese people are not alone and urging solidarity and resources. He urged against border closures and for increased resources. In Bunia, Ituri province, Health Minister Samuel Kamba said the response is being organized. Awareness campaigns, radio messages, and handwashing facilities are expanding; schools have distancing measures and disinfection of classrooms, offices, and toilets, with no school closures planned. At the ISP Bunia displacement site (about 11,000 people), water points are scarce though 50 lavatories have been installed. NGOs such as Action Against Hunger are adapting operations in Mongwalu to contain the outbreak while maintaining humanitarian programs. Many cases are treated at home or by traditional healers, underscoring the need for rapid reporting and care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：「対応」が形成されつつあり、WHO事務局長が国際的連帯を呼び掛ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの危険病原体であり、WHO事務局長の介入と国際的連帯呼び掛けが記載されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）で確認。WHO事務局長による直接的な関与、国連代表・人道調整官との会議、保健相による対応表明があり、国際的な支援・連帯の呼び掛けが強調されている。地域での対応体制構築中だが、在宅治療と伝統的治癒者による治療が多く報告されており、迅速な報告と治療体制の強化が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo identifica 1.028 casos sospechosos de ébola, 255 de ellos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo identifies 1,028 suspected Ebola cases, 255 of them confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,028 suspected Ebola cases and 255 laboratory-confirmed infections in an outbreak centered in Ituri province, linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The World Health Organization notes a case fatality rate of roughly 30–50% for Bundibugyo, and states there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Authorities are increasing surveillance and response measures at the origin rather than imposing travel bans; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, in Kinshasa, advised against restricting entry of travelers and plans to visit Bunia, Ituri, to coordinate support with local authorities. The report emphasizes an active outbreak response with cases still under investigation and containment efforts focused at the source.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスの疑い例1,028件を特定、うち確認例255件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による活動的な流行で、1,028疑い例・255確認例、致死率30-50%、国際拡大リスク、WHOによる即応が進行中。
triage.notes: Ituri州を中心とした活動的なエボラ流行。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は高い致死率を持つ。WHO事務局長が現地視察・支援調整を計画中。ワクチン・特異的治療なし。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 洛杉磯縣官員在世界盃前發布衛生防疫警報 | 世界盃足球賽 | 傳染病 | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Los Angeles County officials issue a public health and epidemic-prevention alert ahead of the World Cup | World Cup football tournament | infectious disease | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Los Angeles County public health officials issued a pre-World Cup health and epidemic-prevention alert for the June 12–July 10 influx that could bring more than 150,000 travelers to the region, with Inglewood’s SoFi Stadium hosting eight matches. Clinicians should heighten vigilance for travel-associated illnesses, especially measles, influenza, monkeypox, hepatitis A, dengue, chikungunya, and malaria, along with COVID-19, gastroenteritis, and sexually transmitted infections. The alert notes the Southern Hemisphere flu season typically runs April–September, potentially boosting local transmission. Readiness guidance also covers heat-related illness, dehydration, and substance misuse or overdose during mass gatherings. Ebola is not listed as a World Cup priority in this alert, but a separate trilateral U.S.–Mexico–Canada statement proposes coordinated travel measures for travelers from high-risk Ebola regions in Africa (eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda). FAA drone bans and enhanced immigration enforcement are planned; Los Angeles is a host city among 16 with 48 teams.

triage.headline_ja: ロサンゼルス郡当局がワールドカップ前に公衆衛生および疫病防止警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症に関する多地域警報イベントであるが、主たる発生地域が米国・カナダ・メキシコ（対象国外）であり、検証対象国はアフリカのEbola関連言及のみ。情報の大部分が公開衛生情報・警告段階で、実際の患者発生数や確認事例の記載がなく、国際的リスク判定に不確実性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は米国でのワールドカップ開催に伴う公衆衛生上の準備警告が主体。Ebola関連では、米国・メキシコ・カナダの3国声明がアフリカの高リスク地域（DRC東部およびウガンダのEbola地域）からの渡航者に対する調整措置を提案しているが、これらのアフリカ地域での発生報告ではなく、感染症の流入リスク対策である。対象国リストに該当する国は DRC と Uganda のみ（Ebola関連言及のため）だが、これらでの実際の発生事例記載なし。主流はワールドカップ開催予定地域での予防・警戒体制であり、実際の疾患クラスター発生の報告ではない。情報が不足している段階のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Organización Mundial de la Salud afirma que el brote de ébola "puede detenerse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization says that the Ebola outbreak "can be stopped."
article.articleSummary: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Kinshasa hosting WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus as he urged community engagement to stop transmission. As of the report, the DRC has 125 laboratory-confirmed cases and 17 confirmed deaths, alongside 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, while neighboring Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. The epicenter is Ituri, particularly Bunia, with care centers at Rwampara and Bunia General Hospital seeing improved organization but ongoing arrivals. The outbreak has also reached North and South Kivu provinces, where M23-aligned militias operate. Bundibugyo has no approved treatment or vaccine; a Congo patient recovered and was discharged, with five others potentially recovering. EU and US funding, targeting vaccines and therapies by year-end, accompany security and humanitarian challenges, including attacks on health facilities and displacement. Uganda closed its border with Congo; the WHO chief opposed broad travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ出血熱の流行は「阻止できる」と述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ型）の多国間発生で、複数国での確認病例と死亡、隣接国への拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダとルワンダの地理的言及を含むが、確認された症例はDRCが主体（125確認病例、17死亡）。ウガンダは隣接国で9例報告とあるが、本記事の主題はDRCにおけるブンディブギョ型エボラの発生。WHO事務局長がキンシャサで現地入りし、治療法/ワクチン未承認のため対応の困難性が高い。セキュリティ上の懸念（M23勢力による医療施設への攻撃）と人道的課題も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Director arrives in Congo to assess Ebola outbreak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director arrives in Congo to assess Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, the World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to oversee the Ebola outbreak response in Kinshasa and the east. He noted the situation is complex but pledged to curb the virus. Logistical barriers include critical shortages of equipment and supplies, persistent distrust among local communities, and armed groups in a conflict-torn region that hampers operations. He highlighted that ongoing fighting in the east is a central obstacle, and called for an immediate ceasefire between the Congolese army and rebel factions to enable medical teams to access hardest-hit areas and protect staff. Massive displacement and severe food insecurity further complicate containment, along with limited community understanding of the virus. The visit will include a Saturday trip to Ituri, identified as the outbreak’s zone zero, with planned support for Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴに到着しエボラ出血熱の流行を評価
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多発生地での流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO事務局長の現地視察という国際的対応が展開されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めてリスクの高い感染症。キンシャサ、イトゥーリ、南キブ州での複数の発生地。武装勢力による紛争、物流障害、地域社会の不信が対応を複雑化させている。WHO事務局長による現地視察自体が国際的な危機対応の発動を示唆している。DRCは対象国に含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染疑い１０００人超、拡大に歯止めかからず...死者数２００人超 | ヨミドクター(読売新聞)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,000 suspected Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the spread continues unabated... death toll over 200
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 1,028 suspected Ebola infections, with the death toll exceeding 200, as of 2026-05-30. The figure, released by the Congolese government and cited by Reuters, aligns with WHO estimates of more than 200 fatalities. The outbreak is expanding in the northeastern DRC and in neighboring Uganda, and authorities say it likely began months ago. The circulating strain currently has no effective vaccine or treatment available, and vaccine development is projected to take at least six months. The surge underscores a severe public health crisis with ongoing transmission across borders, challenging containment efforts and highlighting urgent needs for response resources and vaccination strategies once a candidate becomes available.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染疑い１０００人超、拡大に歯止めかからず...死者数２００人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。1000人超の感染疑い例と200人超の死亡が報告され、国境を越えた拡大が確認されており、国際的公衆衛生上の重大脅威である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに「ウガンダでも拡大」と記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持ち、有効なワクチン・治療法が現在ない状況での1000人超の感染疑い例と200人超の死亡は重大な国際的脅威。フルのRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染疑い１０００人超、拡大に歯止めかからず...死者数２００人超
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the outbreak shows no signs of slowing... death toll exceeds 200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 1,028 suspected cases and more than 200 deaths reported as of May 29, 2026. The northeastern DRC and neighboring Uganda are affected, with transmission likely starting several months ago. The circulating strain has no effective vaccine or treatment, and vaccine development would take at least six months. WHO confirms the death toll above 200. The outbreak shows no signs of slowing, underscoring the urgent need for intensified cross-border surveillance, containment, and public health measures in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染疑い１０００人超、拡大に歯止めかからず...死者数２００人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体による大規模発生で、国際的拡大リスク、死亡者多数、治療法・ワクチン不在という深刻な状況
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは「northeastern DRC and neighboring Uganda are affected」と述べられており、主たる発生地域はDRCで、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含まれるため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを検証済み発生地として記載。ワクチン開発に6ヶ月以上を要すること、有効な治療法がないことが状況の重篤性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Sesa realiza vacinação contra o sarampo no Aeroporto Internacional de Fortaleza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesa Conducts Measles Vaccination at Fortaleza International Airport.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination at Fortaleza International Airport, Ceará, Brazil, from June 1–3, 2026 (08:00–17:00). Departures: Level 2; Arrivals: Level 1 (Av. Senador Carlos Jereissati 3000, Serrinha). The Ceará State Health Secretariat (Sesa) vaccinates travelers bound for FIFA World Cup 2026 host countries, and airport staff; tourists arriving from countries with measles cases will also be immunized. Measles is highly contagious and airborne; the World Health Organization notes active outbreaks in host nations, with about 70% of Americas cases in Canada, the United States, and Mexico. In 2025 Brazil reported imported measles cases linked to North American travelers, underscoring vaccination needs. The effort is supported by Fraport Brasil, Anvisa, and Fortaleza SMS. Ceará’s 2025 vaccination coverage reached 92% for first doses and 80% for second doses; no local cases since 2022. Routine schedule: doses at 12 and 15 months for children; two doses up to 29 years; at least one dose 30–59 years. The vaccine is safe, free, and highly effective.

triage.headline_ja: Sesa、フォルタレーザ国際空港で麻疹ワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーン報道。北米での活発なアウトブレイクと輸入症例の背景はあるが、本記事の主題は予防接種活動であり、進行中のアウトブレイク報道ではない。情報をさらに注視する価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事は北米（カナダ、米国、メキシコ）での活発な麻疹アウトブレイク背景を述べているが、これらの国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルのセアラ州での予防接種キャンペーンであり、公衆衛生上の配慮として確認価値がある。2026年のワールドカップ開催に向けた予防措置と位置づけられている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS reporta primer paciente curado de ébola en RD Congo mientras aumentan los casos sospechosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports the first patient cured of Ebola in DR Congo as suspected cases rise.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports the first Ebola patient in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has recovered, marking a milestone in an ongoing outbreak. Simultaneously, authorities report more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases across the region, with over 220 deaths among those under investigation. In Goma, a city under the control of armed group M23, UNICEF volunteers are leading awareness campaigns to inform residents about Ebola risks and to combat skepticism toward the disease. The report underscores persistent transmission and the need for sustained surveillance and response efforts amid security challenges in eastern DRC. Ongoing outreach and investigation efforts may be affected by the security situation.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラウイルス病の初の治癒患者をWHOが報告、疑い例が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：220人以上の死亡、異常・予想外な状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。さらにWPRO基準でも5項目全て該当。対象国DRCで実際に発生しており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRコンゴ東部（北キヴ州、ゴマ）でのエボラ感染事例を述べており、1,000件以上の疑い例と220人以上の死亡を報告している。武装勢力M23支配下にあるゴマでの対応と治安上の課題が言及されている。WHOによる初の治癒患者報告は疫学的マイルストーンであるが、同時に1,000件を超える疑い例と高い死亡数は深刻な拡大局面を示唆している。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進出が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch bệnh Ebola diễn biến phức tạp tại Châu Phi nhưng người dân không nên hoang mang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Africa is becoming more complex, but people should not panic.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is escalating. As of May 27, Congo reports 1,077 suspected cases with 238 suspected deaths and 121 confirmed cases with 17 deaths; Uganda has 7 confirmed cases with 1 death, totaling 128 confirmed cases and 18 deaths. WHO designated the Bundibugyo outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, but not a pandemic, and no vaccine or approved specific treatment exists. WHO assesses Congo risk as very high, regional risk as high due to ongoing community transmission and cross-border movement; global risk remains low. Vietnam’s Health Department is coordinating with WHO and US CDC, strengthening surveillance, lab capacity, contact tracing, and border screening to prevent importation. Public guidance: stay informed via official sources, seek medical care if symptoms after exposure, limit travel to affected areas, and avoid contact with the sick. Importation risk to Vietnam remains low but not zero.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱の流行が複雑化しているが、国民は慌てる必要はない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが5月17日にPublic Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)として宣言済みであり、確認症例128例、死亡18例の実績がある。国際的な対応・サーベイランス強化が進行中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo EbolaアウトブレイクはDRC（コンゴ）およびウガンダで発生。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはベトナムが含まれているが、記事サマリーではベトナムはサーベイランス強化対応国として記載されており、実際のイベント発生地は含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC指定（5月17日）、確認症例128例・死亡18例、コミュニティ感染と越境移動のリスク継続中であり、複数の基準で高い懸念が認識される。

article.articleHeadline: 'The test came back negative': Singaporean with 'coronavirus-like symptoms' dies in Batam
article.articleSummary: 61-year-old Singaporean man AA died in Batam on Feb 22 after fever and shortness of breath and being suspected of infection with the novel coronavirus (Covid-19). He had just returned from Singapore, was first treated at Awal Bros Hospital Batam, then referred to BP Batam Hospital, the coronavirus referral hospital. Batam Health Agency stated the death was due to “another illness,” noting that tests for the virus were negative. He arrived at Awal Bros on Feb 20 at noon, with clinicians escalating him to the coronavirus referral center to mitigate risk. The case reflects an imported-suspected infection with negative COVID-19 testing, and no confirmed Covid-19 diagnosis is reported in Batam in this account.

triage.headline_ja: 「検査結果は陰性だった」：バタムで『コロナウイルス様症状』を呈したシンガポール人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の確定診断なし（検査陰性）。疑い症例の死亡だが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。社会的・政治的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。イベントはバタム（インドネシア）で発生した疑い症例だが、COVID-19検査が陰性で確定診断がないため、シグナル性は低い。記事は個別症例の報告に過ぎず、流行や集団発生の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Medics Fight DRC Ebola Outbreak Without Protective Gear
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province’s Mongbwalu health zone, involving Bundibugyo virus with no licensed vaccines or treatments. Health workers report operating without essential PPE and rapid intervention kits; WHO declared the outbreak on May 15 and a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. By May 22, ~750 suspected cases and ~177 suspected deaths; national risk upgraded to very high, with high regional risk. The WHO has shipped 18 tonnes of emergency supplies, deployed 20 experts, and established mobile laboratories to accelerate testing. The virus has crossed borders to Uganda, with two cases from travelers and one death; Ugandan authorities intensified contact tracing and halted large gatherings to limit spread. The index case was reported April 24, with >300 infections and >90 deaths within three weeks. The situation highlights chronic underfunding, surveillance gaps, and the need for stronger infection control and cross-border preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ感染症流行で医療従事者が個人用防護具なしで対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の多数の患者・死亡、WHO国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)宣言、国際的な国境越え感染確認、および複数のIHR/WPROスクリーニング基準への該当により、フルRRA対象となるシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCのイトゥリ州モンブワル地域の流行。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO PHEIC宣言(5月17日)、18トンの緊急物資出荷、20名の専門家派遣、移動式検査施設の設置により、国際的対応が既に開始。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはレアな型で、ワクチン・治療薬がない点も重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疑似病例逾千 肯尼亚法院暂停美国建隔离中心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo; Kenyan court suspends US-built isolation center.
article.articleSummary: 1,028 suspected Ebola cases reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 225 laboratory-confirmed infections and 246 deaths since the mid-May outbreak. Officials warn that late detection and ongoing eastern DRC armed conflict hinder contact tracing and case surveillance, suggesting actual infections and fatalities are higher. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Separately, Kenya’s High Court temporarily halted a U.S.-built Ebola isolation center planned for a central Kenya Air Force base, to handle exposed or infected individuals. The 50-bed facility would be operated by the U.S. Public Health Service and was slated to open around May 29. Justice Patricia Nyaundi ordered that no admissions occur until the next hearing on June 2; Kenya has not detected Ebola cases, and it remains unclear whether the plan would be opened to all nationalities. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑似患者が1,000人以上；ケニアの裁判所が米国が建設した隔離センターを一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（246人の死亡、225人の確定患者）と国際的拡大リスク（ケニアでの隔離センター準備）が明確に存在し、2つ以上の基準に該当。WPRO基準でも異常性、重症度、流行可能性が全て該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアは隔離センター建設段階であり、確定患者は報告されていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCにおける武力紛争による接触追跡の困難性が実際の感染者数・死亡数が報告数を上回る可能性を示唆しており、状況の深刻性を増幅している。

article.articleHeadline: قبل كأس العالم.. المكسيك تفرض قيوداً على القادمين من دول إفريقية بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of the World Cup, Mexico imposes restrictions on arrivals from African countries due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Mexico imposed temporary air-entry restrictions on travelers who visited Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, or South Sudan within the past 21 days due to an Ebola outbreak ahead of the 2026 World Cup. Aeromexico barred such passengers; Viva Aerobus and Volaris extended the same 60-day policy to international flights. President Claudia Sheinbaum announced epidemiological surveillance protocols for the tournament. The move coincides with the Democratic Republic of Congo national team preparing for World Cup participation; the US White House plans 21-day isolation for DR Congo entrants in a US bubble. The WHO has declared an International Health Emergency over Ebola in eastern DR Congo, with hundreds of deaths and thousands of suspected cases and the first confirmed recovery since the current outbreak began.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ前に、メキシコはエボラのためにアフリカ諸国からの入国者に制限を課す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO緊急宣言済みのエボラ流行であり、複数国での規制導入と国際的な懸念が存在。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを主な発生地として扱い、WHOが東部DRCでのエボラに国際保健緊急事態を宣言している旨が明記されている。メキシコとUSの制限措置はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンへの渡航履歴に基づくもの。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当するため、verified_locationsに含める。メキシコとUSは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 케냐서 미국민 에볼라 격리 시설 운영?...케냐 법원 ''금지 명령''
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Operating an Ebola isolation facility for Americans in Kenya? Kenyan court issues injunction.
article.articleSummary: Kenya High Court issued an injunction blocking a foreign government from operating an Ebola isolation facility in Kenya and prohibiting the admission, reception, or transfer of Ebola patients under any US agreement until the merits hearing on June 2, 2026. The United States had set up a 50-bed Ebola facility at Laikipia Air Base, about 200 km north of Nairobi, and dispatched 30 health workers and equipment to treat Americans diagnosed with or exposed to Ebola from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, rather than returning them home. The Katiba Institute filed suit, arguing the plan poses serious public health risks and lacks transparency and accountability. Kenyan medical unions criticized the move as advancing US interests over Kenyan protections. The US reportedly pledged about $13.5 million for Ebola preparedness in Kenya. As of May 30, 2026, DRC reported over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and more than 220 suspected deaths; Uganda had 9 confirmed cases; no confirmed cases in Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで米国人向けエボラ隔離施設を運営？ケニア高等裁判所が差し止め命令を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で該当。エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体であり、DRCでの流行継続と隣国への拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける米国による隔離施設設置に関する司法問題だが、サマリーに明記されているDRCでの1,000件超の疑い患者と220件超の死亡事例が現存の流行の中核。ウガンダでも9例の確定患者が報告されているが、サマリーではウガンダが流行地として言及されているものの、対象国リストに未含まれるため verified_locations には含めない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが確実な流行地として特定され、重篤度が高く国際的懸念となっている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO tăng tốc tìm vaccine, thuốc điều trị giữa lúc Ebola bùng phát tại Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO accelerates the search for a vaccine and treatments amid an Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, with Uganda reporting regional spillover risk. As of May 28, WHO reports 1,077 suspected cases and 121 confirmed positives, with 246 deaths suspected to be Ebola and 17 confirmed fatalities. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; Africa CDC followed suit. WHO is expediting evaluation of vaccines and treatments. Priority therapeutics include MBP134, Maftivimab, and remdesivir, with combination regimens under review; an oral antiviral, obeldesivir, is considered for post-exposure prophylaxis contingent on contact tracing. Vaccine candidates include rVSV-Bundibugyo by IAVI (potentially 7–9 months to trials) and an Oxford/Serum Institute of India candidate (trial-ready in 2–3 months). Conflict and insecurity impede response; Tedros urged ceasefires. Travel restrictions are not officially recommended, though several countries impose controls during the World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴで急増する中、WHOはワクチンと治療薬の開発を加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO既に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。確認死亡17例、疑い例246例の深刻な大規模outbreak。DRCおよびウガンダでの地域的蔓延リスクあり。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）によるDRCの大規模outbreak。WHOは既に2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際保健上の緊急事態）を宣言。Indiaはワクチン候補開発機関（Oxford/Serum Institute of India）として記事サマリーに登場。Ugandaは地域的spill over riskが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。紛争と不安定性が対応を妨害している点も懸念。複数国による渡航規制措置も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: قبل المونديال، المكسيك تفرض قيود سفر على 3 دول أفريقية بسبب "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Before the World Cup, Mexico imposes travel restrictions on three African countries due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Mexico imposes a 60-day entry ban on air travelers who visited Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days amid an Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC. Aeromexico, Viva Aerobus, and Volaris are applying the same restriction as World Cup preparations co-hosted with the United States and Canada proceed. Health authorities have launched epidemiological surveillance protocols to curb potential risks during the tournament. The Democratic Republic of Congo is sending its national team, which will face a 21-day quarantine in a protective “bubble” if entering the United States, with a training camp in Houston and matches against Portugal (June 17), Colombia (June 23 in Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (June 27 in Atlanta). The WHO has issued an international health emergency over the DRC Ebola outbreak, with about 1,000+ cases and 246 deaths so far; as of May 24, 10 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths, including a first confirmed recovery. Africa CDC notes ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ前、メキシコがエボラの懸念から3つのアフリカ諸国への渡航制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの進行中のエボラ流行に対応した国際的な渡航制限措置であり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限に該当。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済みで国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行の進行中の事態を中心に扱っており、メキシコ・USA・カナダのワールドカップ開催国による対応措置を報告している。DRCが検証対象国に該当する。他のアフリカ国（Uganda、South Sudan）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO緊急事態宣言、1,000症例以上・246死亡という深刻な数字が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 內地39歲網紅異鄉被蟲咬患病亡　喉嚨感染無法進食 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland Chinese 39-year-old influencer dies after falling ill from an insect bite while abroad; throat infection leaves them unable to eat | am730
article.articleSummary: A mainland Chinese influencer, Hani Xiaowei, 39, died after contracting scrub typhus (tsutsugamushi disease) while abroad. Born in 1987 and of Hani ethnicity, she rose as a livestreamer with over 30,000 followers; she grew up in Yunnan and previously worked in Southeast Asia’s Golden Triangle. After returning to Yunnan, doctors diagnosed scrub typhus, but she missed the critical treatment window and died days after hospitalization; a throat infection left her unable to eat in her final days. Scrub typhus is transmitted by chigger mites from rodent reservoirs. Incubation is about 9–12 days; early symptoms include persistent high fever, headache, and lymphadenopathy, followed by a rash and crusting at the bite site. Seasonal peaks occur May–October in southern Asia and in autumn–winter elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: 内陸部39歳ネットインフルエンサーが異国での虫刺されから患病し死亡　咽頭感染により食事ができず
triage.triage_reason: 対象国内での孤発的な死亡事例であり、中国（雲南省）での確認症例が記載されているが、国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻性や異常性の評価には情報不足。スクラブチフスの季節性流行として予想される範囲内である可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事は香港のメディア（am730）による報道。対象者は中国本土出身のインフルエンサーで、雲南省での発症確認後死亡。「異国」での感染の可能性が示唆されているが、確実な感染地は不明。スクラブチフスは東南アジア地域で季節的に流行する既知疾患であり、対象国以外（タイ、米国New Jersey等）の記載があるが、記事の主題は中国での死亡事例である。続報による詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mexico restricting travellers from Central African countries over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: Mexico restricts air entry for travellers who have stayed in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the last 21 days, effective May 29 for 60 days, announced by Aeromexico and shared by Viva and Volaris. The measures respond to the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the DRC, which is co-hosting the World Cup with Canada and the United States. The DRC team has trained in Belgium and will base in Houston during the tournament; the opening match is June 11 in Mexico City between Mexico and South Africa. Since May 15, the WHO reports 125 confirmed Ebola cases and over 900 suspected, with 17 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths in the DRC; no vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、エボラ熱懸念を受け中央アフリカ諸国からの旅客を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。複数国での確認症例、WHO報告、ワールドカップという大規模国際イベント関連。
triage.notes: DRCでBundibugyo株エボラ熱の進行中の流行（125確認症例、900以上疑い症例、17確認死亡）。ワールドカップ開催国DRC関連の国際的リスク（米国カナダとの共催、メキシコでの開幕戦）。メキシコによる渡航制限措置の実施。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: 'Really important': What Canadians need to know about infectious diseases and travel in 2026
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak on the Dutch expedition cruise ship MV Hondius is unprecedented on cruises. Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome typically causes general symptoms followed by severe respiratory distress, with about a 30% mortality rate and no vaccine. The Andes virus, detected in the Hondius cases, is the only hantavirus known to spread person-to-person; other hantaviruses do not. The World Health Organization does not advise against travel, and overall public risk is very low. Before departure, travelers should consult a primary care clinician or travel clinic to tailor destinations and vaccines; some locations require yellow fever, others may need Japanese encephalitis or rabies vaccination. A Vancouver Island traveler contracted Japanese encephalitis in Southeast Asia (Vietnam), resulting in a coma; Japanese encephalitis causes viral encephalitis with roughly 100,000 clinical cases annually in Asia. Cruise ships remain a common setting for Norovirus; post-pandemic protocols persist, with port conditions varying by country.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年のカナダ人が知るべき感染症と旅行に関する重要な情報
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な感染症（ハンタウイルス肺症候群、日本脳炎、黄熱病）が報告されており、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・重症度の観点から該当。特にハンタウイルスの船舶内での人-人感染事例は前例がなく、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行可能性で複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではハンタウイルス船舶内集団発生はオランダ遠征クルーズ船MV Hondiusで発生し、カナダのブリティッシュコロンビア州・バンクーバーアイランドの旅行者が日本脳炎をベトナム含むアジアで感染した事例が報告されている。Bluedotの発生地域フィールドにはカナダが含まれているが、実際の感染症イベントの発生地はベトナム（日本脳炎感染）とオランダ船舶（ハンタウイルス）であり、verified_locationsではサマリーで明示的に記述されている対象国のベトナムのみを含める。複数の致命的感染症が国際旅行を通じた拡大リスクを示しており、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: JFK Airport to screen passengers from certain countries for Ebola
article.articleSummary: JFK International Airport in New York City began screening travelers from Ebola-affected countries at midnight May 30, 2026, guided by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The screenings apply to passengers arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda. Enhanced entry screening is already in place at Dulles International Airport, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, and George Bush Intercontinental Airport in Houston. A new Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus has spread undetected for weeks across eastern Congo into Uganda. The Congolese government reports more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since declaring the outbreak on May 15. Ebola is caused by an infection with an orthoebolavirus and spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids. Symptoms typically appear eight to ten days after exposure and include fever, aches, fatigue, diarrhea, vomiting, and sometimes bleeding; the disease is highly contagious and deadly.

triage.headline_ja: JFK空港、エボラウイルス感染国からの乗客スクリーニングを開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の国際的拡大リスク、複数国での同時多発的な集団発生、渡航制限措置の実施、高い致命率（220/1000+疑い例＝約18-22%）により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に確認されたエボラ集団発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。ウガンダ、南スーダンへの拡大も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（ウガンダはGeoNames ID 226074は対象リストに含まれない）。米国の複数空港での渡航者スクリーニング開始は、国際的な伝播懸念の高さを示唆。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による outbreak は Zaire ebolavirus 以外の稀な株であり、サーベイランス上の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Response Update: May 29, 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The United States, through the Department of State and CDC, has committed over $162 million in direct Ebola assistance, with an additional $350 million to the UN OCHA for the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan as part of a $1.8 billion package announced May 14, plus $50 million to OCHA’s Central Emergency Response Fund to establish up to 50 Ebola clinics. Aligned travel measures with the U.S., Mexico, and Canada aim to protect FIFA World Cup 2026 attendees; Uganda’s status updated to Level 2. Kenya Ebola preparedness receives $13.5 million. PPE and supplies: UNICEF reports 100 tons of WASH/IPC goods in the DRC; IOM deploying border and entry-point screening at Bunia (Ituri) and Beni/Goma; Samaritan’s Purse delivering PPE for a 40-bed center in Bunia; Uganda UNICEF delivering WASH/IPC to 48 health centers. IOM screens at Ituri/Bunia and North Kivu; airports include N’djili, Bunia, Entebbe, Arua, Bujumbura, and Bole. UNICEF deployed 1,300 health workers in the DRC; FHI 360 trained 40 health-zone supervisors and supported safe burials; Uganda UNICEF activities span 15 districts with risk-communication in 10 languages.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応アップデート：2026年5月29日
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行がDRC・ウガンダで報告されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的な支援体制が構築されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明白。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した地域リストに多数の非対象国（Sweden, Canada, US, Mexico, Kenya, Burundi, Sudan, Ethiopia等）を含むが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行」である。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地として記事で言及されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: "อีโบลา" คือโรคไข้เลือดออกธรรมดาและมีอัตราเสียชีวิตต่ำ จริงหรือไม่? : เช็กข่าวชัวร์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola" is an ordinary dengue fever and has a low mortality rate. Is that true? : Fact-check.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is not ordinary dengue fever; the two are distinct viruses and the latter is common in Thailand due to dengue virus transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Ebola is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever with substantially higher fatality. Medical data place Ebola’s average case fatality around 40-80%, varying by viral strain and health-system readiness; without proper care, mortality rises. Several Ebola strains exist; outbreaks have occurred in multiple African countries, including reports of the Bundibugyo strain, which currently has no vaccine specifically approved for its prevention. Transmission occurs through direct contact with infected bodily fluids (blood, saliva, vomit, diarrhea, urine, other secretions) and through contact with infected wildlife reservoirs such as fruit bats and certain primates; it is not spread by mosquitoes. Early symptoms include sudden high fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain, with severe cases involving bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」は普通のデング熱であり、死亡率が低いというのは本当か？：ファクトチェック
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラとデング熱の違いに関する教育的なファクトチェック記事であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを報告したものではない。タイは言及されているのみで、当該国でのエボラ発生は報告されていない。
triage.notes: この記事は既存の感染症（エボラ、デング熱）に関する一般向けのファクトチェック・教育コンテンツであり、新規アウトブレイク、異常事象、または急速な伝播を報告していない。Bluedot APIが「Africa」を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーはアフリカでの現在のエボラ流行を報告しておらず、歴史的事実と医学知識の説明に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: 尼日利亞將首都和9個州列為埃博拉應對高風險地區 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria designates the capital and nine states as high-risk areas for Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Nigeria designates Abuja and nine states as high-risk for Ebola response, per the Nigeria Center for Disease Control, noting no confirmed Ebola cases yet but ongoing cross-border transmission and symptom overlap with Lassa fever keep importation risk high. Nigeria’s risk zones: high-risk areas include Abuja, Lagos, Kano, Borno among nine states with international airports, ports, or border crossings; Ogun, Nasarawa, Kaduna and 12 other states are medium risk; the rest are baseline. Separately, WHO designated Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). As of May 22, WHO assessed DRC’s national risk as very high, regional risk high, global risk low. As of May 26, DR Congo reported 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 238 deaths among suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが首都と9州をエボラ対応の高リスク地域に指定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、DRC/ウガンダでのエボラPHEIC指定と連動し、西アフリカ地域での越境リスク評価が進行中。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の対象国を含む。DRCとウガンダではすでにエボラPHEICが宣言されており（DRC: 1,077疑似症例、238死亡）、ナイジェリアはまだ確認症例なしだが越境感染リスクと高リスク地域の指定により予防的対応中。ラッサ熱との症状オーバーラップも言及されている。WHO評価によるDRCの国家リスク「非常に高い」と地域リスク「高い」は重要なコンテキスト。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 正妹網紅「哈尼小微」突停更...驚傳因1隻小蟲咬感染驟逝 生前喉嚨爛光
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pretty female influencer “Hani Xiaowei” abruptly stops posting... shocking reports say she died suddenly from an infection after being bitten by a single insect, with her throat severely necrotic.
article.articleSummary: May 30, 2026 — A 39-year-old Hani ethnic minority influencer from Yunnan, China, known as Hani Xiaowei, died from a scrub typhus infection after a chigger bite during outdoor work. The illness was concealed for several days, delaying critical treatment. After returning from Southeast Asia to her Yunnan home, she was hospitalized but the infection progressed rapidly. In the final days, she experienced severe throat discomfort, progressing to an inability to swallow, and died in the early hours of May 27, 2026; she was buried that afternoon. Scrub typhus is transmitted by larval mites (chiggers) in grasses, hills, orchards, and outdoor greens. Incubation is about 9–12 days; symptoms include persistent high fever, severe headache, lymphadenopathy, rash, and a distinctive black scab at the bite site. Preventive measures: wear long sleeves and pants, use effective repellents, and report outdoor exposure to physicians promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 正妹網紅「哈尼小微」突停更...驚傳因1隻小蟲咬感染驟逝 生前喉嚨爛光
triage.triage_reason: 恙虫病による個人の死亡事例報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・予想外性には該当するが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当は確認できず、また集団発生や国際拡大の具体的兆候が不足している。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 個別患者の死亡報告であり、現時点では集団発生の規模や継続的な曝露リスクについて具体的な情報が不足している。患者の東南アジアへの渡航歴があり、国際リスクは限定的と評価。ただし恙虫病は流行性疾患であり、ユンナン地域での今後の動向監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Tingkat Kematian Ebola Bundibugyo Bisa Mencapai 50 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Bundibugyo ebolavirus case fatality rate could reach 50 percent.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could yield a case fatality rate up to 50% among confirmed infections, based on past outbreaks (30–50%). Emergency program lead Anais Legand disclosed the figure in Geneva. On May 29, WHO issued guidelines for supportive care and identified vaccine candidates, notably a single-dose recombinant rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative, expected to take 7–9 months to advance. Another candidate, ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford University/Serum Institute of India), could be ready in 2–3 months for evaluation in trials. As of May 28, 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths across 13 health zones in the DRC; cases likely to rise with expanded testing. No travel or trade restrictions for the DRC or Uganda, though travelers should be screened. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urged stronger EU border surveillance coordination.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの致死率は50%に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス感染症の確認症例と死亡事例、国際的な拡大リスク、ワクチン候補の開発状況が報告されている。DRCでの継続的な拡大と高い致死率により、シグナルとしてフルRRA評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月30日付けで、DRCでのブンディブギョエボラウイルス感染症の継続的な流行を報告。5月28日時点で125確認症例、17死亡が報告されており、13の保健地域に広がっている。WHOは複数のワクチン候補を特定し、緊急対応を進めている。イタリア首相がEUの国境監視協調強化を促しており、国際的な関心が高い。発生地域にはGenève（スイス）やイタリア、ウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は明らかにDRCでの流行であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 正妹網紅「哈尼小微」突停更...驚傳因1隻小蟲咬感染驟逝　生前喉嚨爛光
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pretty online influencer "Hani Xiaowei" suddenly stops posting... Shocking reports say she died suddenly from an infection after being bitten by a single insect, with her throat severely necrotic while alive.
article.articleSummary: Hani Xiaowei, a 39-year-old Han Chinese influencer from Yunnan, China, known for sharing Han culture and Southeast Asia experiences to over 30,000 followers, died after a severe infection from a chigger bite. While outdoors, they were bitten by a mite carrying the pathogen for scrub typhus (tsutsugamushi disease). They concealed illness to avoid alarming family, missing the critical window for treatment; after returning to Yunnan for care, they were hospitalized but the infection progressed to a fatal outcome. Death occurred on May 27, 2026, with burial that afternoon. Scrub typhus is transmitted by larval mites in grasslands, hills, orchards, and outdoor greenspaces. Incubation is about 9–12 days, with persistent fever, severe headache, lymphadenopathy, and a distinctive black crust at the bite site. Public health guidance emphasizes protective clothing, use of repellents, and reporting outdoor exposure to clinicians to ensure timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 美しいネット有名人「ハニー・シャオウェイ」が突然更新停止...1匹の小さな虫に噛まれた感染により急死したと報道、生前に喉が完全に壊死
triage.triage_reason: 恙虫病による個別死亡事例であり、IHR基準は2つ以上該当しないが、中国での発生報告およびWPRO基準の重症度（死亡）と異常性に該当。ただし、散発的な個別事例のため、フルRRA前に続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は恙虫病による個別死亡事例（雲南省）であり、散発的感染パターン。ネット有名人の死亡により一定の社会的関心が生じているが、集団発生や広域流行の兆候はない。ただし、恙虫病の流行性（mite vectorborne）と公衆衛生ガイダンスの言及を踏まえ、WATCHレベルでの継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Kes ebola meningkat, ketua WHO bertemu rakan kerjasama kemanusiaan di Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases rising, WHO chief meets humanitarian partners in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo strain; over 1,000 cumulative suspected cases since May 15. Deaths total 18 among confirmed cases in DRC and Uganda, with nine cases reported in Uganda. A U.S. doctor who treated patients in Congo is now receiving treatment in Germany. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus met health and humanitarian partners in Congo to coordinate the response for Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, the most affected regions. Officials warn of challenges including inadequate isolation, security concerns, and gaps in care and referral systems, while emphasizing community engagement via religious groups, business networks, women, radio, and social media to build trust and promote protective measures. A 32-year-old laboratory worker infected with Ebola has recovered and was discharged from Rwampara Hospital in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数が増加、WHO事務局長がコンゴで人道支援パートナーと会談
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な流行である可能性が高く、死亡者を含む複数国での確認、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの9症例とドイツでの1症例が記事に記載されているが、ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれず、ドイツも含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。DRCでの発生が主要な問題である。Bundibugyo株による流行で、1,000件以上の累積疑似症例、確認症例での18名の死亡者が報告されている。WHO事務局長による現地対応調整のため、国際的関心と関与が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果再爆伊波拉疫情，無國界醫生警告：衝突與資金削減恐使疫情更難控制 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another Ebola outbreak erupts in DR Congo, Doctors Without Borders warns that conflict and funding cuts could make the outbreak harder to control | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is caused by Bundibugyo virus and was formally declared on May 15, 2026. The case fatality rate is estimated at 25–40%. The eastern provinces of North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri are affected amid long-running conflict and humanitarian crisis, with over 5 million internally displaced and widespread disruption of health services. Diagnosis capabilities for Bundibugyo virus remain severely limited, delaying confirmation, isolation, and treatment. A recently confirmed infection died on May 23 in Mongwalu as MSF established a 60-bed Ebola Treatment Center and scales up outreach with the health ministry and WHO. The outbreak underscores that community trust is essential for vaccination, testing, and contact tracing; it also calls for renewed international support to restore surveillance and essential services, including malaria, HIV/TB, and measles programs.

triage.headline_ja: 剛果再爆伊波拉疫情，無國界醫生警告：衝突與資金削減恐使疫情更難控制
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Ebola outbreak in DRC with confirmed deaths, CFR 25-40%, international health implications, and potential for international spread amid humanitarian crisis and weak health systems.
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus confirmed in DRC with CFR 25-40%, deaths reported, and active ETC operations by MSF. Multiple concurrent diseases (HIV, TB, Measles, Malaria) mentioned as background public health concerns. Eastern provinces (North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri) affected. Humanitarian crisis and armed conflict significantly impacting response capacity. Article explicitly calls for renewed international support.

article.articleHeadline: Cacing Hati Ditemukan di 493 Hewan Kurban Bantul, Ini Penjelasan DKPP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Liver Flukes Found in 493 Sacrificial Animals in Bantul; Here Is DKPP's Explanation
article.articleSummary: Fasciola hepatica (liver fluke) infection was found in 493 sacrificial animals in Bantul Regency during Eid al-Adha 1447 H. A quick count on May 27–28, 2026 recorded 493 affected animals: 352 cattle, 31 goats, 110 sheep, among 26,963 animals slaughtered from 2,128 cutting points across Bantul. DKPP Bantul assures meat safety: infected livers should be discarded, while the remainder of the meat remains fit for consumption if handling is hygienic. Transmission likely from pasture contaminated with parasite larvae, with small snails acting as carriers. Field officials provide guidance to organizers and segregate infected organs. Preventive measures include routine deworming of livestock. Officials warn the case count could rise as slaughter continues through the Tasyrik days; emphasis is on organ disposal and ongoing education.

triage.headline_ja: バントゥル地区で犠牲動物493頭から肝吸虫が発見、DKPPが説明
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで家畜の肝吸虫症（ファシオラ症）が検出されたが、ヒト感染が直接報告されておらず、食肉の安全性については当局が確保と判断。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 事例は家畜（牛、ヤギ、羊）の肝吸虫感染であり、ヒト感染事例の報告はない。食肉安全性についてはインドネシア当局が確保を断定し、感染した肝臓の廃棄と衛生的処理による対策が講じられている。バントゥル地域で祭礼期間中に複数の動物が検出されており、防虫対策の実施が報告されている。ヒト感染への拡大リスクについては記事に明記されていないため不明。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampión, ébola y calor extremo: las amenazas de salud pública que acechan al Mundial 2026 en EE.UU.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles, Ebola, and Extreme Heat: The Public Health Threats Looming Over the 2026 World Cup in the U.S.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, measles poses the closest threat to World Cup sites; Georgia reports a three-case cluster in Atlanta amid rising activity across the United States, Mexico, and Canada. A fan-driven outbreak could spread with attendees traveling, with experts noting a five-to-seven day window between wastewater signals and emergency presentations. Ebola remains active in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; the WHO has declared a public health emergency, though U.S. risk is low. A DRC-based team in Houston will follow U.S. testing and isolation protocols for returning travelers. Federal screening is in place at Atlanta, Houston, and Dulles airports for travelers from risk zones. Dallas County expands wastewater metagenomic surveillance capable of detecting any pathogen without prior identification; Philadelphia will deploy a mobile lab at Lincoln Financial Field. Extreme heat is highlighted as the tournament’s greatest risk, and FEMA has allocated $625 million to host cities.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹、エボラ、猛暑：2026年米国W杯を脅かす公衆衛生上の脅威
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹はIHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスク・移動制限リスクに該当し、エボラはWHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。W杯という大規模国際イベント開催地での複数感染症同時発生は社会的・政治的関心が極めて高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での麻疹・エボラリスク評価を主題とするが、対象国リストでは DRC のみが該当。麻疹は米国（対象国外）での発生が主要な記事の焦点であるため、既知の流行国としては対象外。エボラの実際の発生地は DRC とウガンダだが、ウガンダも対象国外のため DRC のみ verified_locations に含める。記事の重要性は高いが、W杯開催国（米国）が対象国リストに含まれていないため、本アラートシステムの地理的スコープ外。

article.articleHeadline: 肯亞法院喊卡 美國在當地設伊波拉隔離設施受阻
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court halts; U.S. Ebola isolation facilities there blocked.
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court halted US plans to establish a 50-bed Ebola isolation facility at Laikipia Air Base, about 200 km north of Nairobi, intended to quarantine Americans exposed to Bundibugyo Ebola from the Congo DR/Uganda outbreak; the facility would transfer diagnosed patients to Europe. A Katiba Institute lawsuit led to an injunction blocking cooperation with any foreign government to establish, enable, or operate such a facility and prohibiting entry for individuals who had contact with or were infected by Ebola under the US-Kenya accord. Kenya has had no confirmed Ebola cases. The Congo DR and Uganda outbreak has caused about 250 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases, attributed to Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with no approved therapies or vaccines.
