A June 2 hearing will review the case in full. The dispute touches on ethics of evacuation and treatment of infected US citizens abroad, given existing US treatment capacity.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア法院が阻止 米国がラキピア空軍基地にエボラ隔離施設を設置する計画を差し止め
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴDR/ウガンダの進行中のエボラ流行（約250名の死亡、1,000件以上の疑い症例）に関連し、米国による国際的な患者移送・隔離体制の構築が法的に阻止されている状況は、国際的なバイオセキュリティおよび感染症対応上の懸念を提示する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはケニア、ウガンダ、米国も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は進行中のエボラ流行がコンゴDR/ウガンダで発生していることであり、ケニアでは確認症例なし。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを検証済みロケーションとして列挙。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。この事象は医療施設・隔離体制の国際的配置に関する政治的・法的紛争であり、基礎となるエボラ流行の重篤性と国際的対応の必要性を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala records 28 rabies deaths in five months; Rs 1.2 crore paid as damages since 2023
article.articleSummary: Kerala (India) reports 28 rabies deaths this year amidst around 15 lakh dog-bite cases over five years, including about 3 lakh bites in 2025; 122 rabies deaths in the last five years. Since 2023, the state has settled 279 of 1,522 compensation claims and distributed about Rs 1.26 crore to victims, with roughly Rs 1.2 crore paid in damages. Since January 2026, around Rs 5 lakh has been paid. Authorities are expanding shelter facilities and strengthening Animal Birth Control (ABC) programs, pursuing shelter-based stray-dog management with five local bodies developing shelters, including Thiruvananthapuram, Kochi, Kollam, and Tripunithura. Compensation is being decentralised under the District Legal Services Authority, creating district-level committees from local bodies, health, and animal-husbandry departments to expedite relief. Thiruvananthapuram corporation has begun shelter operations with an NGO, while Tripunithura municipality infrastructure work is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で5ヶ月間に28人の狂犬病死亡；2023年以降1.2千万ルピーの損害賠償金を支払い
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は制御可能な疾患であり、ケララ州は既に補償制度や動物管理プログラムを進めている。死亡数は高いが、年間発生数の報告であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。対象国内での地域的課題として経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は既知の疾患で、インドでの発生は周知の問題。ケララ州は補償制度・動物保護対策を実施中。IHR基準は2つ未満で該当しないため、スクリーニング基準3つ該当するも国際的拡大リスク・外部支援必要性が低く、WATCHレベルの評価。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تعلن أول حالة شفاء من "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية - قناة المنار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization announces the first Ebola recovery in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Al-Manar TV
article.articleSummary: First Ebola recovery reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. A patient discharged from a treatment center after two consecutive negative tests, returning home on May 27, 2026; WHO official Anais Legand confirms this as the first recovery since the current outbreak began. The organization reports 906 suspected cases, 223 deaths still under investigation, and 125 confirmed infections in the DRC, with seven confirmed cases in Uganda, including one death and three infections among people who arrived from the DRC. There are no vaccines or approved treatments specifically for Bundibugyo Ebola yet; early medical care reduces mortality to roughly 30–50%. WHO DG Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits DRC to meet local authorities and focus on containment. Ongoing security deterioration in eastern DRC has displaced about 100,000 people in a month, complicating response, particularly in Ituri province's mining areas.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ初の回復例を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による進行中の流行、複数国への拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、死亡例と確認感染者の報告、セキュリティ悪化による対応の複雑化が確認され、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリーでは DRC からの移入例（7例、うち1死亡、3例は DRC からの到着者）として言及されており、主要な流行地はDRCである。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀なエボラウイルス種であり、ワクチン・治療法未承認でありながら致命率30-50%とされており、医学的・疫学的に高リスク。東DRCのセキュリティ悪化（月間100,000人の避難民）が対応を複雑化させている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問も確認され、国際的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：尽早发现和社区参与是控制埃博拉疫情的关键_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Early detection and community engagement are key to controlling the Ebola outbreak — Beijing News Network.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus drives the outbreak in Central Africa, spreading via close contact. At a May 29 WHO briefing, authorities stressed that early case detection and full community engagement are key to controlling transmission and saving lives. WHO is collaborating with the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to advance evaluation of therapeutics and vaccines, and to expand treatment capacity. Three candidate antiviral therapies and two candidate vaccines have been advanced into further studies. Technical expert Anais Legrand emphasized that alongside these medical countermeasures, rapid expansion of clinical care is essential to ensure all affected patients receive treatment. The update highlights ongoing international efforts to assess new treatments and vaccines while strengthening health systems in affected communities. Source: CCTV News; Published May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ流行制御の鍵は早期発見とコミュニティ参与—北京ニュースネットワーク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当する可能性があり、エボラウイルス感染症という極めて重大な感染症の流行であること、複数国への拡大と国際対応が進行中であることから、フルRRA対象とすべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダとDRCの両国での流行を示唆しているが、記事本文が提供されておらず、サマリーのみの確認では「Central Africa」の広域表現が使用されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため included。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラウイルスはBundibugyo型との記載あり。2026年5月30日発表で、Ebola該当性、医療対策（治療薬・ワクチン候補の進展）が報告されている極めて重大なイベント。

article.articleHeadline: Nations Step Up Border Checks As Ebola Outbreak Triggers Global Health Concerns
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, nations are tightening border controls over the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, centered in the DRC and Uganda with hundreds of suspected cases and deaths reported. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine. Several countries have imposed stringent measures: the United States, Canada, the Bahamas, Bahrain and Jordan have introduced temporary entry bans, enhanced airport screenings and mandatory quarantines for travellers from affected regions; India, Kenya and Thailand have stepped up airport/border surveillance and urged avoidance of non-essential travel. Containment is complicated by conflict, displacement and strained health systems. WHO and Africa CDC caution that travel bans alone are insufficient and that robust outbreak control measures at the source are essential. Transmission is via direct contact with infected bodily fluids rather than airborne, keeping general public risk relatively low when precautions are followed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが世界的な保健上の懸念を引き起こす中、各国が国境検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症で、中部アフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）での多数の患者・死亡報告、ワクチン未承認株（Bundibugyo株）の関与、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施が確認され、複数の対象国を含む広域への波及リスクが明白である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されるアウトブレイク発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみ含まれる。米国・カナダ・ジョーダン・バーレーン・バハマは渡航制限措置を実施する国として言及されるが、発生地ではない。インド・ケニア・タイは監視強化国として言及されており、対象国リストに含まれるインド（1269750）とタイ（1605651）のみを verified_locations に含める。ワクチン未承認株の関与、複数国での渡航制限措置、WHOからの警告が社会的・政治的関心の高さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: المكسيك تفرض قيودًا على القادمين من "دول إيبولا" قبل المونديال
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico imposes restrictions on entrants from Ebola-affected countries ahead of the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Mexico imposes temporary travel restrictions on entrants who recently visited Ebola-affected countries ahead of the 2026 World Cup co-hosted by Mexico, the United States, and Canada. Airlines Aeromexico will bar travelers who have been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, or South Sudan in the prior three weeks; Viva Aerobus and Volaris will apply identical measures on international routes for 60 days. Mexican health authorities are enforcing epidemiological surveillance protocols to mitigate risks during the tournament. The Democratic Republic of Congo’s national team faces a 21-day quarantine in a bubble if traveling to the United States, with a training camp in Houston before matches against Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan in June. The World Health Organization has issued an international health alert over ongoing Ebola outbreaks in eastern DR Congo, reporting over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, with the first confirmed recovery in the current outbreak, as tens of thousands of fans descend for the event.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコがワールドカップ前に「エボラウイルス病流行国」からの入国者に対する制限を課す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外、国際拡大リスク）、WHO国際保健警告発出、東部DRCで1,000件以上の疑い例と246例の死亡が報告され、大規模国際スポーツイベント開催時のエボラウイルス病流行という極度に重篤なシナリオ。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国を列挙しているが、実際のエボラウイルス病流行地はDRC（東部）とウガンダ、南スーダン。ただしサマリーの主題となる流行はDRCであり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。メキシコ・米国・カナダの制限措置は流行国からの入国制御であり、これら国での流行発生ではないため除外。WHOの国際保健警告発出により、シグナル対象として高優先度で取り扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: メキシコ、エボラ懸念で中部アフリカからの渡航者制限 サッカーW杯控え
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico restricts travelers from Central Africa amid Ebola concerns as the FIFA World Cup approaches.
article.articleSummary: Mexico’s three largest airlines—Aeroméxico, Viva Aerobus, and Volaris—announced air-travel restrictions for passengers who have stayed in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the past 21 days, effective for 60 days. The measures come as the FIFA World Cup North and Central America approaches. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO data show 125 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases since May 15, with 17 deaths; suspected cases exceed 900, with 223 deaths. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Congo’s national team, training in Belgium, has qualified for the World Cup and will base in Houston during the tournament, with group-stage matches slated across the United States and Mexico.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、エボラ懸念で中部アフリカからの渡航者制限 サッカーW杯控え
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国家流行（DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン）とFIFAワールドカップを通じた国際的拡大リスク、および複数国の渡航制限措置の実施により、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはメキシコの渡航制限措置とその背景のDRC発のエボラ流行を記述。DRCで確認Ebola症例125例（死亡17例）、疑い例900例超（死亡223例）が報告され、ワクチンなしの高リスク株（Bundibugyo）。DRC代表がHoustonを拠点とするためW杯を通じた国際的なリスク拡大が具体化している。対象国リストではDRCのみが確認。ウガンダ・南スーダン・メキシコ・ベルギー・USはサマリー上で関連地域として言及されるが、実際の感染症イベント発生地（verified_locations）としてはDRCのみを認定。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura ensina prevenção ao mosquito Aedes aegypti para alunos da rede municipal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall teaches prevention of the Aedes aegypti mosquito to students in the municipal school system.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Dourados, Brazil, is teaching prevention and control of Aedes aegypti in municipal schools. Specialists from the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses visited Escola Municipal Franklin Luiz Azambuja (BNH 4º Plano) to educate more than 600 students from pre-school to 5th grade about preventing transmission of chikungunya, dengue, and Zika by the mosquito. The program covers eliminating standing water and explains larval development and the adult vector, a domestic, diurnal, human-biting insect. Emphasis is on year-round vector control and community involvement, with information cascading to staff and families. Practical measures include closing water tanks, clearing gutters, turning containers upside down, draining appliance trays, using sand in plant dishes, and devoting about 10 minutes weekly to remove breeding sites. The initiative aims to foster informed, preventive behavior across urban communities.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所が市立学校の生徒たちにネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）の予防を教える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのドゥラドス市における啓発・教育活動の報告であり、既存の流行への対応における予防キャンペーンである。新規の異常な発生事例ではなく、公衆衛生影響の重症度も低い。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の病原体（チクングニア熱、デング熱、ジカウイルス）に対する地方自治体の定期的な啓発活動であり、新規の流行ニュースではない。ルーチンの予防教育プログラムのため、シグナル値としては低い。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲陸網紅哈尼小微離世！遭蟲咬後感染 親友痛揭：沒能及時就醫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old mainland influencer Hani Xiaowei dies after infection from an insect bite; friends reveal in sorrow: she couldn't get timely medical care.
article.articleSummary: 39-year-old Yunnan influencer Hani Xiaowei died from scrub typhus after an insect bite, reportedly due to delayed medical care. As of May 29, 2026, friends said she died about two days earlier, around 2:00 am on May 27 and was buried that afternoon after a period of illness that included throat infection and loss of appetite following her return from Southeast Asia. Doctors diagnosed scrub typhus but she had missed the gold treatment window (36–48 hours after onset), making treatment ineffective. Scrub typhus is transmitted by chigger mites; symptoms include fever, headache, back pain, chills, night sweats, lymphadenopathy, rash, and a black scab at the bite site. Untreated mortality can reach ~60%; timely treatment lowers mortality to under 5%. Xiaowei, who had about 30,000 followers, previously worked in the Southeast Asian “Golden Triangle.”

triage.headline_ja: 39歳の中国大陸インフルエンサー・ハニ・シャオウェイが虫刺されによる感染で死亡；親友が悲しみの中で明かす：適切な医療を受けられなかった
triage.triage_reason: 散発的な個人の死亡報告であり、流行や感染症発生のシグナルではない。感染症イベントとしては公衆衛生的な深刻性が限定的であり、国際的拡大リスクも不明であるが、つつが虫病の一般的な医療管理の教訓として情報価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はソーシャルメディアインフルエンサーの個人的な死亡事例の報道である。つつが虫病自体は中国南部（雲南省）でよく知られた感染症であり、患者個人の遅延医療による予防可能な死亡であって、感染症の流行や新たな発生ではない。東南アジアでの曝露歴が記載されているが、症状発症は帰国後と推測され、新たな地域への国際的拡大を示す証拠ではない。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला का नया खतरा और दुनिया की पुरानी भूलें -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The New Ebola Threat and the World's Old Mistakes
article.articleSummary: Escalating Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and surrounding regions trigger alerts at all Indian airports and travel advisories for Indians visiting African countries. About 670 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths have been reported, as the Bundibugyo Ebola strain—against which no effective vaccine exists—drives the crisis. Transmission occurs via infected blood and bodily fluids, contaminated objects, and contact with corpses, with symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. Attacks on treatment centers and weak health systems amplify spread, highlighting social and political factors in outbreaks. If uncontrolled, the outbreak could spread beyond Africa to Asia and Europe. India should bolster airport screening, testing, surveillance, resources, and public awareness, and engage in global health cooperation. The episode tests global preparedness and recalls lessons from COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの新たな脅威と世界の過去の過ち
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（670例の疑い患者、160例の死亡）がDRCで発生し、有効なワクチンのないBundibugyo株による重大な公衆衛生上の脅威、アフリカ外への国際的拡大リスク（アジア・ヨーロッパ）、複数国での渡航警告と空港警戒体制の強化により、国際的な対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより：DRCでの大規模エボラ流行が主要な感染症イベント。インドはアフリカからの輸入リスク地域として空港警戒体制を強化。有効ワクチン不在のBundibugyo株であることと、治療施設への攻撃および脆弱な保健システムが拡大を加速させている点が重大。COVID-19との並行言及は歴史的教訓の文脈。

article.articleHeadline: Gavi đầu tư 50 triệu USD cho vaccine và ứng phó dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gavi Invests $50 Million in Vaccines and Ebola Outbreak Response
article.articleSummary: Gavi allocates up to $50 million from the First Response Fund to Ebola outbreaks caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) with spillover into Uganda. Up to $40 million funds urgent vaccine access and manufacturing scale-up; $10 million supports outbreak response activities. The framework may include advance purchase commitments and will be coordinated with CEPI, WHO, Africa CDC, and UNICEF; AVMA will help fast-track African vaccine producers. In the long term, Gavi seeks faster WHO EUL or PQ prequalification to enable emergency use. Separately, $10 million supports vaccination and immunization protection. As of May 27, 2026, the outbreak has 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Gavi’s stockpile of 500,000 Ervebo doses has been used in four DRC campaigns; Sept 2025 saw more than 47,000 vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: Gaviがエボラワクチンおよび感染症対応に5000万ドルを投資
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認症例・死亡事例と疑い例の多数報告、DRCからウガンダへの波及、国際機関による資金動員と対応。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで、エボラ（Bundibugyo virus）の発生地域がDRCの複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）と明示されており、ウガンダへの波及も記載されている。ただし、Bluedot APIの発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダは「波及」の言及に留まり、確認症例の主な報告はDRCに限定されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Gaviの5000万ドル投資、WHO EUL/PQ認可に向けた長期的取り組みが記載されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果再爆伊波拉疫情 衝突與資金削減恐難控制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as conflicts and funding cuts threaten containment.
article.articleSummary: May 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo declared an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, with a case fatality rate of 25–40%. Diagnostic capacity is scarce, reporting is delayed, and international funding cuts have weakened surveillance and response, allowing community spread for weeks before confirmation. MSF warns the crisis reflects ongoing conflict, humanitarian crisis, and aid shortfalls in eastern DRC. More than 5 million people are internally displaced in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri (96% due to armed violence), facing unsafe water and limited basic healthcare, undermining surveillance, contact tracing, and timely treatment. On May 22, a MSF-built field tent at Mongwalu Hospital was burned; on May 23, a newly diagnosed religious leader died, triggering protests. MSF has established a 60-bed Ebola Treatment Center, coordinating with the Ministry of Health and WHO, and emphasizes maintaining routine health services while calling for urgent international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疫情が再び発生 紛争と資金削減が封じ込めを脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性が明確に該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）による認定アウトブレイク、高い致死率（25-40%）、国際的支援の必要性が強い。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に公式に宣言されたBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる認定アウトブレイク。東部DRC（South Kivu、Ituri州）での発生で、紛争、人道危機、国際的資金削減が対応能力を著しく低下させている。診断能力の不足、報告遅延、コミュニティ伝播の継続確認がされており、WHOおよび国際社会への直ちの報告・支援要請が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Coronavirus: 5 S'poreans on Diamond Princess allowed to disembark, will remain in Japan for 14 days before returning
article.articleSummary: Five Singaporeans aboard the Diamond Princess cruise ship in Yokohama, Japan, were allowed to disembark on Feb 21 and will stay in Japan for 14 days before returning to Singapore; if they return within 14 days, they will be quarantined in Singapore under current public health protocol. The Singapore Ministry of Foreign Affairs said the Singapore Embassy in Tokyo will continue to assist and thanked the Japanese government for aid during quarantine. The Diamond Princess has been docked off Japan’s coast since Feb 3, with more than 600 passengers testing positive for Covid-19, making it the largest single cluster outside China. The World Health Organization classifies the ship’s cases as 'cases on an international conveyance' and notes they should not be counted toward Japan’s total.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルス：ダイヤモンド・プリンセス号のシンガポール人5名が下船を許可、日本での14日間の滞在後に帰国へ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の感染症であり、2026年5月の時点で世界的流行は終息段階。ダイヤモンド・プリンセス号のイベントは2020年2月の過去事象であり、現在のシグナルとしての新規性・緊急性がない。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年2月のダイヤモンド・プリンセス号事件に関する過去の出来事を扱っている。配信日時は2026年5月30日だが、これは記事の再配信またはアーカイブ記事である可能性がある。現在のシグナルトリアージ対象としては不適切。対象国のうち、サマリーで明示的に言及されているのはChina（最大クラスターの基準地として言及）のみ。Japan は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: المكسيك تفرض قيود سفر على دول إفريقية بسبب تفشي إيبولا - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico imposes travel restrictions on African countries due to an Ebola outbreak - Al-Watan
article.articleSummary: Mexico imposes 60-day air-entry restrictions on travelers who visited Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the last 21 days, due to an Ebola outbreak in East Democratic Republic of the Congo. The move, coordinated with the United States and Canada ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, affects Aeromexico, Viva Aerobus, and Volaris. The airlines will deny boarding to such travelers on international routes. In parallel, the White House confirmed that the Democratic Republic of the Congo national team would undergo a 21-day quarantine inside a protective bubble if it participates in the tournament, with a schedule in the United States and Mexico. The Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC has resulted in hundreds of deaths and numerous suspected cases, according to the World Health Organization.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、エボラ出血熱流行によるアフリカ諸国への渡航制限を実施 - アルワタン
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスクが高く、複数国による調整された対応、WHOによる確認、および国際的な渡航・貿易制限が実施されている。IHR基準を複数満たし、シグナル認識基準に該当する。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱流行が主要な感染症イベント。メキシコ・米国・カナダによる渡航制限は対応措置であり、実際の発生地はDRC（対象国リストに含まれる）。WHO確認済みで、数百人の死亡者および多数の疑似症例が報告されている。2026年FIFA ワールドカップ開催に伴う国際的な懸念も高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: FAQ: Wuhan coronavirus and its outbreak
article.articleSummary: Wuhan coronavirus outbreak originated in Wuhan, China and was declared at the end of 2019. In China, it has killed more than 200 and infected about 10,000; globally the pathogen has reached more than 20 countries, with Hong Kong, Japan and Thailand reporting high counts. Singapore has 16 confirmed cases, all imported. Symptoms resemble influenza or the common cold; laboratory tests are needed for confirmation. Most patients recover with standard hospital care; no proven specific treatment yet, though drugs are being trialed in China. Mortality is cited as under 3%. The virus appears relatively stable with no confirmed rapid mutation. Transmission through water is uncertain; eye exposure is possible; swimming pools unlikely except with close contact. Pregnant women’s risk remains uncertain. Containment relies on quarantines and public health measures; the weeks following Chinese New Year may be critical. Ultraviolet light can kill respiratory viruses, but weather effects remain unclear.

triage.headline_ja: FAQ: 武漢コロナウイルスとその流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、20カ国以上への国際拡大、渡航制限のリスク）。COVID-19の初期段階での重要なシグナルイベント。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月配信だが、サマリー内容は2019年末の新型コロナウイルス（SARS-CoV-2）の初期流行を記述している。時系列に矛盾がある可能性があるが、イベント内容の重要性に変わりなし。日本はサマリーに「高い数の感染者報告」として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。シンガポール・香港も同様に対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO puts Ebola outbreak death rate at âhugeâ 30-50% as chief arrives in DRC
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri (north‑east) with spillover into North and South Kivu. The WHO revised the case‑fatality rate to 30‑50% based on confirmed cases, implying up to five of 10 patients may die. Since the 15 May outbreak declaration, the WHO records 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola deaths among more than 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases; one patient recovered and was discharged on 27 May after two negative tests—the first confirmed recovery. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headaches and sore throat; progression to vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, rash and impaired kidney/liver function. Transmission is via direct contact with blood or body fluids. For Bundibugyo strain, no approved treatment exists; vaccine and treatment trials have been recommended. Uganda closed its border; Kenya-US quarantine plans faced a court challenge. Aid shipments include 4.6 tonnes at Bunia, with UNICEF pledging 100 tonnes.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の死亡率を「莫大な」30～50％と発表、事務局長がDRCに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、Bundibugyo株は異常、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、ウガンダ・ケニアの国境閉鎖・渡航制限），WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当，高い社会政治的関心。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は承認済み治療法がなく、承認されたワクチンがない高リスク株。ウガンダは国境を閉鎖、ケニア・米国の隔離計画が法的異議に直面。感染確認から回復した初症例がある。1,000件以上の確定・疑い例、223人の疑い死亡、10人の確定死亡。5月15日の アウトブレイク宣言以来の展開。国際的支援（UNICEF 100トンの援助物資誓約）が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital systems pass first test after suspected Ebola case in Melbourne
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-30, Victoria tested its Ebola response after a man who recently returned from near Uganda and the DRC arrived at Monash Medical Centre with Ebola-like symptoms. He was moved to Royal Melbourne Hospital in a negative-pressure ICU room; two tests in a high-containment laboratory at the Doherty Institute were negative, and he was discharged on Wednesday. An Ebola alert was issued to clinicians, urging consideration of Ebola for fevers above 38 C with travel to outbreak areas or contact with a case. WHO reported 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 deaths in the DRC, with Uganda reporting seven confirmed cases. Separately, Victoria launched a diphtheria booster program amid Australia’s worst diphtheria outbreak in decades (over 230 cases, one death), concentrated among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities in NT and WA, with cases in SA and QLD. The booster targets travellers, workers, and those needing a catch-up dose.

triage.headline_ja: メルボルンの疑い例エボラ事例後、病院システムが初の試験に合格
triage.triage_reason: オーストラリアで疑い例報告されたエボラ（国際的に懸念される病原体）、および複数州にわたるジフテリアの大流行（過去数十年で最悪）が報告されている。IHR基準「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。
triage.notes: 疑い例はオーストラリア（対象国外）で報告されたが、DRC及びウガンダからの渡航関連であり、DRCで906疑い例・223死亡の流行が報告されている。ジフテリアはオーストラリア国内の流行であり、対象国では発生していないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのエボラ流行が国際的な懸念の対象となっているため、DRCのみを listed。

article.articleHeadline: อนามัยโลกหวังมีผู้รอดชีวิตจากอีโบลาเพิ่ม หลังพบผู้ป่วยหายดีคนแรก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization Hopes for More Ebola Survivors After First Patient Recovers
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,028 cumulative Ebola cases (confirmed and suspected) of Bundibugyo ebolavirus since May 15, with at least 223 deaths. The outbreak, centered in the DRC and involving cases reported in Kinshasa, has no vaccines or therapeutics approved by WHO for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; patient care remains supportive. The WHO hopes for more survivors after the first patient in this outbreak recovered and was discharged on Thursday, following two consecutive negative tests. This discharge marks the first confirmed recovery, underscoring the ongoing transmission risk and the need for surveillance, infection control, and supportive care in the absence of licensed targeted treatments.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、初の患者回復後のエボラウイルス感染症生存者の増加に期待
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の流行で1,028例・223死亡（DRC、Bundibugyo種）。IHR基準4つ全て該当：公衆衛生への深刻な影響（高い致死率）、異常性（新種の流行）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属の珍しい種）による大規模流行。ワクチン・治療薬がWHO承認なし。初回患者回復は重要な進展だが、継続的な感染リスク存在。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Salud federal eleva alerta por brote de ébola en África; pide evitar viajes no esenciales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal Health raises alert over Ebola outbreak in Africa; urges avoidance of nonessential travel.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is a severe viral infection transmitted by direct contact with blood, secretions, or surfaces contaminated with bodily fluids from infected people or dead animals; airborne transmission is not considered. Mexico’s federal health department raised the sanitary risk level to high for the Ebola outbreak in Africa and advises avoiding nonessential travel to affected areas: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. International mobilization poses a risk due to air connectivity, so epidemiological surveillance and early symptom recognition remain essential public health measures. The incubation period ranges from 2 to 21 days; onset is abrupt with fever, severe weakness, muscle and head pains, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, rashes, and liver or kidney involvement. Mexicans traveling for force majeure should obtain medical services where they go and voluntarily isolate for three weeks after return; report travel history if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行に対してメキシコ連邦保健省が警告レベルを引き上げ、必須でない渡航を避けるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスクと、複数国での同時発生により IHR基準3つ以上該当。メキシコが公式に警告レベルを引き上げており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは Democratic Republic of the Congo、Uganda、South Sudan でのエボラ流行を言及しているが、対象国リスト内では DRC (203312) のみに該当。Uganda と Sudan は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。メキシコは渡航警告の発出国であり、発生地域ではないため除外。エボラは最重症度の感染症であり、複数国での同時発生と国際的な渡航警告により、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに高スコア。フルRRAに進める必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Ostkongo: Engpässe und Gefahren für Helfer verschärfen Krise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Eastern Congo: Shortages and Dangers for Aid Workers Worsen the Crisis
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, due to the Bundibugyo virus variant, is intensifying amid armed conflict and collapsing state capacity. The outbreak is worsened by drastic reductions in international aid, including cuts by the U.S. development agency, leaving response efforts patchy. No licensed vaccines exist for this Bundibugyo strain; diagnostics are unreliable and symptoms resemble flu, delaying confirmation. Weeks of transmission have likely claimed hundreds, perhaps thousands, of lives, with many deaths going unrecorded in poverty and overwhelmed clinics. Mistrust of health facilities—fees and fear of hospital mortality—reduces care-seeking, while frontline teams may unknowingly spread the virus. Doctors Without Borders remains independently funded but feels the impact of cutbacks on outreach and contact tracing. Disinformation, rumors of stolen blood or organ harvesting, and threats to volunteers, plus security deterioration in the past two days, hinder aid delivery; responses to cholera and measles are strained.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が東コンゴで拡大：援助作業者の危険と物資不足が危機を悪化させる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、複数の高リスク因子が存在。Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の急速な伝播、ワクチン欠如、国際的支援喪失、武装紛争下での対応困難という極めて深刻な状況。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱は治療ワクチンが存在せず、診断精度も低い。数百～数千人の死亡推定、多くが未記録。武装紛争と医療インフラ崩壊により対応能力が極度に低下。コレラ・麻疹も同時流行。国際的支援削減により状況が急速に悪化している。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: El director de la Organización Panamericana de la Salud: "Si no trabajamos coordinados, no hay barrera nacional que impida que un virus llegue a un país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Director of the Pan American Health Organization: "If we do not work in a coordinated manner, there is no national barrier that would prevent a virus from reaching a country."
article.articleSummary: Jarbas Barbosa da Silva Jr., head of PAHO since 2023 and a possible future WHO Director-General, stresses coordinated governance amid a hantavirus uptick in the Southern Cone and a cruise-ship outbreak. At Mundo Sano, he announced a partnership to eliminate cervical cancer in the Americas, leveraging an effective HPV vaccine. He cites the hantavirus spike and urges One Health and early detection; the December OPS alert and data sharing under IHR enabled responses by Argentina, Chile, the United States, Canada, and Spain for about a dozen cases, with human-to-human transmission but no rat involvement. He notes vaccines and diagnostics in development, including a phase I hantavirus vaccine. He warns dengue, Zika, chikungunya could become endemic in southern Europe, including Spain, while Latin America struggles with housing-driven mosquito breeding. Ebola in the DRC remains the top global threat.

triage.headline_ja: パンアメリカン保健機構の局長：「調整されて働かなければ、ウイルスが国に到達するのを防ぐ国境の障壁はない」
triage.triage_reason: 複数の指定対象疾患（ハンタウイルス、デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア、エボラ）の多地域での広域発生または警戒情報であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。高位政治家による声明に基づく高い関心。
triage.notes: 記事はハンタウイルスの南米での上昇傾向、デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニアの南欧での風土病化の可能性、およびDRCのエボラを扱う。対象国リストからはDRCのみが該当。米国、カナダ、スペイン、チリ、アルゼンチンはいずれも対象国外。PAHOの高位声明により政治的関心は高い。複数の新興感染症と既知の脅威（エボラ）が同時に言及され、IHR通知基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準の両方を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: 16 pregnant women in Singapore confirmed to have Zika: Health Ministry
article.articleSummary: Singapore’s Ministry of Health confirmed 16 pregnant women with Zika, raising the national total to 387 cases; two additional infections were confirmed on Friday, Sept 23, after the count had doubled from eight cases on Sept 11. Doctors are conducting follow-up and counselling for these patients. Brazil has linked Zika to microcephaly in babies, and MOH is exploring plans for a national surveillance programme to monitor development in babies born to Zika-infected pregnant women. Between Sept 7 and Sept 17, 658 Zika tests were performed, including 197 for pregnant or symptomatic individuals; tests were offered free or subsidised at $60. The article notes that microcephaly is a birth defect marked by small head size that can lead to severe developmental problems.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポールで16人の妊婦がジカウイルス感染を確認：保健省
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスク）。妊婦における確認例の急増、ブラジルとの関連性、小頭症リスク、および公衆衛生上の重大な懸念が存在。
triage.notes: 注：シンガポールは対象国リストに明示されていないが、記事の主要な発生地であり、ブラジルとの関連性が述べられているため、ブラジル（対象国）とともに検証地点として記載。シンガポールでの妊婦感染の急速な増加（9月11日の8例から9月23日には387例に拡大）、小頭症リスクの懸念、および国家レベルでの監視体制構築計画が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola red alert: Health Ministry activates national emergency protocols
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain prompts Ghana to activate national emergency protocols across 16 regions. WHO has declared Bundibugyo Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. On May 29, 2026, Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh led a tour of border surveillance capabilities at Accra International Airport, inspected NMIMR laboratories, and reviewed containment units at the Ghana Infectious Disease Centre. The readiness drive stress-tests port health checks, emphasizes non-contact digital detection to reduce human error, and calls for public cooperation; mass gatherings banned and strict hand hygiene mandated. Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research’s high-containment biosafety labs are resourced for high-speed differential testing for suspected Ebola cases. WHO regional representative Dr. Fiona Braka urged urgent border management and noted scientific challenges of Bundibugyo strain while international partners race to deploy vaccine candidates. No case counts are reported in the article; focus is on readiness and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ緊急警報：保健省が全国的な非常事態プロトコルを発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）がWHOにより国際的懸念となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言され、ガーナが16地域での全国的な非常事態プロトコルを発動している。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株によるWHO PHEIC宣言。記事では具体的な症例数は報告されていないが、国家的レベルでの緊急対応体制の構築が進行中。ワクチン候補の配備準備が国際的なパートナーにより進められている。WPRo対象国ではないが、IHR基準の複数該当およびWHO PHEIC宣言によりPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les États-Unis renforcent leur réponse en RDC et en Ouganda avec 80 millions $
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The United States steps up its response in the DRC and Uganda with $80 million.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda trigger a U.S. response package totaling $80 million to reinforce surveillance, contact tracing, diagnostics, and PPE for health workers, in coordination with the CDC. An additional $50 million to UNICEF/OCHA backs up to 50 Ebola treatment centers, while $300 million mobilizes humanitarian funds to bolster the overall response in both countries. International partners such as UNICEF, IOM, World Vision, and IMA World Health are active on the ground. After first cases were confirmed on May 15, the State Department launched an emergency plan and released $13 million for surveillance, laboratories, risk communication, border control, and case management. Washington has earmarked $1.8 billion for OCHA, including $250 million for DRC and Uganda. As of May 26, WHO Africa counted 121 confirmed Ebola cases and 17 deaths in the DRC (Ituri across 3 provinces and 13 health zones); Uganda reported 7 cases and 1 death.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国、DRCとウガンダでの対応を8000万ドルで強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な高死亡率、複数国への国際的拡大、国際的対応体制の整備が確認される。DRCでの確認症例121件、死亡17件は重大事象である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づきDRCでの確認されたエボラ発生が主題。ウガンダはサマリー内で言及されているが、詳細な発症例や死亡の記述は不十分であり、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。米国と国際機関の支援動員は公衆衛生上の深刻性を示す。5月15日の初確認後、5月26日時点で急速に拡大（121症例、17死亡）。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief meets health, humanitarian partners in DR Congo as Ebola cases mount | New Straits Times
article.articleSummary: 134 confirmed Ebola cases reported across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is centered in eastern DRC—Ituri Province and extending into North Kivu and South Kivu—with Uganda also affected. A 32-year-old laboratory staff member who contracted Ebola was the first patient cured and discharged from Rwampara Hospital in Ituri. Since the outbreak was declared May 15, cumulative suspected cases exceed 1,000. One imported/exported case is noted: a US-trained doctor who treated patients in Congo is now in Germany. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged strengthened coordination and engagement with community networks to communicate risk and trust. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% fatality rate among confirmed cases, underscoring ongoing response challenges, including contact tracing, insecurity, and inadequate isolation and referral systems.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の症例が増加する中、WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国で保健・人道支援パートナーと会談
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の複数国にまたがる確定患者134名・死亡18名、1,000件超の疑似患者、国際的な患者移動、WHO事務局長による直接的な関与。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは Uganda、United States、Germany も発生地域として示唆しているが、記事サマリーの検証：ウガンダは患者が「also affected」と記載されているものの主たる発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri Province, North Kivu, South Kivu）。米国とドイツは国際移送患者（トレーニングを受けた医師が治療に従事し、ドイツに滞在）であり、これらの国での発生地としての記載は不適切。したがって verified_locations は DRC のみとした。ウガンダについても主要な発生地として記載すべき可能性があるが、対象国リスト外のため除外。本イベントはWHO事務局長による直接的関与、確定患者数・死亡数の多さ、Bundibugyo株の高い致死率（30-50%）により極めて優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Punjab sees rise in acute febrile illnesses amid soaring temperatures - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Punjab, India, records a surge in acute febrile illnesses as temperatures exceed 40°C. Over the last four months, 5,840 cases were treated under the Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana, with Rs 1.31 crore released for treatment. Enteric fever led with 1,396 registrations (Rs 30.47 lakh), followed by pneumonia (377 cases, Rs 11.06 lakh) and acute bronchitis (326, Rs 9.24 lakh). Dengue (12 cases, Rs 40,880), chikungunya (6) and malaria (3) were reported; four people were hospitalised for heat stroke. Water-borne and respiratory illnesses are prominent, while NIH notes seasonal outbreaks can shift with rain, mosquito breeding and sanitation. Experts warn extreme heat raises vomiting, diarrhoea, headaches, respiratory infections, and skin/eye allergies; infants and young children are particularly vulnerable. The flagship scheme has delivered Rs 465.36 crore in free treatment within three months of launch, with 42 lakh health cards and 2.77 lakh pre-authorised treatments; orthopaedics show about 4,600 knee replacements.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州で気温上昇に伴う急性発熱疾患の急増 - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（腸チフス、デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）の同時発生が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・流行可能性）で複数該当するが、現段階では散発的な報告で大規模流行の兆候は明確でなく、情報不足のため継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: パンジャブ州における複数の水媒介性・呼吸器系疾患の同時発生。気温40℃超過による環境要因がリスク増加を推奨。4ヶ月で5,840症例が治療対象となり、腸チフス（1,396例）が主体。デング熱12例、チクングニア熱6例、マラリア3例という限定的な蚊媒介疾患数からは、現段階では大規模流行の証拠は弱い。ただし季節変化（降雨・蚊の繁殖・衛生状態）による拡大リスクがある。公開された医療スキーム統計から政府レベルの関心・対応あり。

article.articleHeadline: 盧寵茂指本港面對伊波拉病毒風險仍低　但強調不會掉以輕心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lo Chung-mau says the risk of Ebola in Hong Kong remains low, but stresses that Hong Kong will not lower its guard.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, Ebola outbreaks are currently concentrated in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with risk to Hong Kong remaining low. The Hong Kong government has activated its alert contingency level and will maintain vigilance. Ebola is not airborne and has lower transmissibility than COVID-19, but it carries a high mortality rate. Hong Kong, as an international metropolis with heavy traveler traffic, has implemented preventive measures including Health Department personnel at airports performing temperature screening and health checks for passengers on designated flights. Laboratory testing and quarantine/isolation measures are ready, and authorities emphasize vigilance without panic among residents.

triage.headline_ja: ルー・チュンマオ香港衛生局長がエボラウイルスのリスクは低いと指摘、ただし警戒を緩めないと強調
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスは高い致死率を持ち、DRC・ウガンダで発生、香港への輸入リスクがある。香港政府が警戒レベルを発動し、空港での検査体制を強化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラウイルスの発生はDRC・ウガンダで確認されているが、本記事の主題は香港における公衆衛生対応にあるため、対象国リストに基づきDRC（203312）と香港を含むChina（1814991）のみをverified_locationsに含める。ウガンダ（対象国リストに未含まれ）は除外。エボラウイルスの高い致死率、国際線経由での輸入リスク、既に香港政府による警戒体制が構築されている点から、フルRRA進行の優先度が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: ​肯雅法院喊卡　禁美当地设伊波拉隔离设施 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court halts, bans US from setting up Ebola isolation facilities on Kenyan soil
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court issued a temporary injunction blocking the United States from establishing or operating an Ebola isolation facility at Laikipia Air Base, about 200 km north of Nairobi, with 50 beds to quarantining Americans exposed to Ebola; diagnosed cases would be transferred to Europe. The court bars any cooperation with foreign governments on creating or operating such facilities, pending a June 2 hearing. The Katiba Institute filed the suit, arguing the plan poses serious public health risks and infringes fundamental rights, including life and health, fair administrative process, public participation, and parliamentary oversight. Kenya reports no laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases. The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has caused roughly 250 deaths and over 1,000 suspected infections, attributed to the Bundibugyo strain with no approved treatments or vaccines. U.S. officials say President Ruto approved the plan; the U.K. was discussing shared use.

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: കാഞ്ഞിരപ്പള്ളി കപ്പാട് എച്ച്1എൻ1 ബാധിച്ച് മധ്യവയസ്കൻ മരിച്ച സംഭവത്തിൽ പ്രതിരോധപ്രവര്‍ത്തനങ്ങളുമായി ആരോഗ്യ വകുപ്പ്. നിലവിൽ ആശങ്കപ്പെടേണ്ട സാഹചര്യമില്ലെന്ന് അധികൃതർ. കഴിഞ്ഞ ബുധനാഴ്ച മരിച്ചയാൾക്കാണ് എച്ച്1എൻ1 സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചത്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health department undertakes preventive measures in the death of a middle-aged man infected with H1N1 in Kanjirappally Kappad; authorities say there is currently no cause for concern. H1N1 confirmed in the man who died last Wednesday.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed H1N1 infection in 49-year-old Jason Joseph of Kanjirappilly Kappad, Kottayam, Kerala, who died last Wednesday after fever. The health department has intensified preventive measures and says there is currently no cause for public concern. A 22-person contact list has been prepared, with seven people under active surveillance; none have shown symptoms to date. Funeral arrangements followed the DMO protocol. In Kanjirappilly, health workers visited Ward 1 and Ward 2 to disseminate information; Asha workers and nurses urged the public to report symptoms promptly. H1N1 is an influenza A virus variant; transmission occurs via respiratory droplets, similar to other flu viruses. Typical symptoms: fever, body pains, sore throat, dehydration; some develop cough, fatigue, and shortness of breath. High-risk groups include children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, or asthma. Preventive measures: masks, covering coughs, hand hygiene, avoiding contact with the ill, staying hydrated.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州コッタヤムのカンジラパッリ・カッパドでH1N1に感染した中年男性の死亡事例に関し、保健部門が予防措置を実施。当局は現在懸念材料はないと述べている。先週水曜日に死亡した男性でH1N1が確認された。
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーララ州での1件の確定H1N1死亡例であり、重症度は認められるが、現在のところ複数事例の発生や急速な拡大の兆候はなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単発の確定事例であり、接触者追跡（22人のコンタクトリスト、7人が活動的監視下）が実施されている。当局は現在「懸念材料なし」と評価。H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の疾患であり、予想外の拡大傾向は現在見られない。続報があれば判定を見直す必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mexico restricting travelers from Central Africa over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: Mexico restricted air entry for travelers who have stayed in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the last 21 days, according to Aeromexico, Viva, and Volaris; the measures run for 60 days ahead of the World Cup. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak and is scheduled to play in the United States and Mexico during the tournament. Congolese players have trained in Belgium and plan to base in Houston during the event. The World Health Organization reports 125 confirmed Ebola cases and over 900 suspected cases in the DRC since May 15, with 17 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain responsible for this outbreak. The World Cup opens June 11 in Mexico City.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコがエボラ恐怖症による中央アフリカからの旅行者の制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限実施）。ワールドカップという国際的スポーツイベントを背景に、複数国にまたがるエボラ感染事例と渡航制限措置が報告されており、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRCでのBundibugyo Ebola流行（125確定例、900以上の疑い例）と、ワールドカップ出場予定のコンゴ代表選手がHouston（米国）に滞在予定であることが渡航制限の背景。メキシコ・米国・ベルギーも関連地域として記事に記載されているが、実際の感染イベント発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: El nou brot d'Ebola al Congo desborda la resposta epidemiològica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new Ebola outbreak in the Congo overwhelms the epidemiological response.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO. Reported figures show 1,077 possible cases and 246 deaths, with 129 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, reflecting diagnostic and surveillance challenges amid violence and displacement. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, which carries a 25–40% case-fatality rate and for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. MSF warns the epidemiological picture is unclear and rapidly evolving due to limited diagnostics and underreporting. The virus has crossed borders to Uganda, with eight infections and one death, prompting Uganda to close its borders to limit entry. Africa CDC notes two affected countries and ten high-risk nations. The WHO is considering emergency clinical trials, while UK researchers are developing a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine that could enter trials in 2–3 months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの新たなエボラ流行が疫学的対応を圧倒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国への国際的拡大、高い致命率（25-40%）、国境閉鎖などの厳重な対応が発生している。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認例（8例、死亡1例）が記事サマリーに記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生国。Bundibugyo ebolavirus亜種という治療法・ワクチンがない病原体、WHO PHEC宣言、複数国への拡大、高い致命率、診断・監視の課題が存在することから極めて高い優先度。

article.articleHeadline: El conflicto armado y la falta de recursos minan la respuesta al brote de ébola en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The armed conflict and the lack of resources undermine the response to the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 1,077 probable cases and 246 deaths, the 17th outbreak since the virus’s 1976 discovery. The flare‑up began in Mongbwalu, northeast DRC in Ituri Province, where mining activity, crowded conditions and cross‑border movement with South Sudan and Uganda fueled transmission of the Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The index patient from Mongbwalu presented with fever, diarrhea and bleeding; after his death, the body was returned for a traditional funeral, a known transmission route. Health facilities faced arson and security breaches: at Rwampara Hospital, 18 patients fled and two isolation tents were lit on fire. WHO warns that violence and mistrust hinder surveillance and isolation; Tedros called for an immediate ceasefire to help contain the outbreak. Ongoing conflict in eastern DRC, with groups like M23, and international funding cuts—affecting analysis, testing and notification—further hamper the response, according to Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 武装紛争と資源不足がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行対応を阻害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確定・推定患者1,077人、死亡246人という重大な公衆衛生上の影響、複数国間の越境移動による国際的拡大リスク、武装紛争と資源不足による対応困難が明らかであり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCでのエボラ流行に焦点を当てており、南スーダンとウガンダとの国境を超えた移動が言及されているが、これら両国での実際の症例報告は記事サマリーに明示されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。武装紛争（M23など）による医療施設への攻撃、伝統的葬儀による二次感染、医療現場への不信感など、対応困難要因が複数記述されている。WHOおよびアフリカCDCからの警告も記事に反映されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola watch: Special isolation, quarantine units set up at Gandhi Hospital in Telangana
article.articleSummary: Gandhi Hospital in Hyderabad, Telangana, designated as nodal centre for Ebola preparedness, with a dedicated ward of 10 fully isolated rooms (each with an attached bathroom) and 15 quarantine beds. Nodal Officer Dr Vamsi Krishna said the facility is fully prepared to manage cases if they arise, under guidance from Dr Sunil Kumar and Dr Vani. Healthcare personnel across departments are undergoing safety and patient-handling training. No Ebola cases have been reported; measures are precautionary and Gandhi Hospital is among the first in the region to establish such infrastructure. Health Department data show 58 passengers arrived in the city from Ebola-hit countries, none with symptoms. Special screening and thermal scanning are active at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport for travellers from Africa, including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, with a dedicated monitoring team deployed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒：テランガナ州のガンジー病院に特別隔離・検疫ユニットが設置
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるエボラ対策強化の記事だが、現在のところ確認症例なし。予防的措置の報告であり、IHR基準は2つ以上該当しないものの、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、管理可能性への対応）に該当する可能性があり、情報の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのテランガナ州におけるエボラ対策の整備状況を報告しており、現在の確認症例はない。発生地域フィールドにはDRC、ウガンダ、スーダンなどアフリカ諸国が含まれているが、これらは監視対象国として参考情報として列挙されたものであり、実際の発生地はインド（予防的措置の実施地）である。WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「流行可能性」「管理可能性への対応」に該当し、政府・公衆の関心も高いが、確認症例がないため現段階ではWATCH判定。アフリカ地域でのエボラ流行情報に関連する続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Wie Österreich auf Ebola vorbereitet wäre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Austria Would Be Prepared for Ebola
article.articleSummary: An Ebola suspicion in Austria involved a 19-year-old woman from Upper Austria who had returned from Uganda and sought care at a Linz hospital; she tested negative for Ebola in Vienna on Friday afternoon and remains in stable condition at Klinik Favoriten. The case underscores national preparedness: Klinik Favoriten houses Austria’s only three high-security isolation rooms for highly infectious diseases like Ebola, with multi-stage sluice systems and underpressure; seven additional isolation rooms at the same hospital can be upgraded to the same standard, and the department could be converted to isolation and intensive care for about 60 beds if needed. Transport to Vienna was conducted by High-Infectious-Transport (HIT) teams of the Austrian Red Cross; four teams operate nationwide (Lower Austria, Upper Austria, Styria, Carinthia) and use specialized vehicles and PPE. Disinfection used hydrogen peroxide nebulization at Vienna’s MA15 Hygiene Center. Ebola is notifiable under Austrian law, with tracing and isolation measures handled by local authorities. The episode occurred amid acknowledged Congo Ebola outbreaks mentioned by authorities.

triage.headline_ja: オーストリアはエボラにどの程度備えているか
triage.triage_reason: オーストリアでのエボラ疑似症例は検査陰性であり、実際の感染確認ではないが、DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行との関連があり、国際的な移動に伴う輸入リスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダから帰国した後、オーストリアで検査を受けたが陰性であった。記事の主題はオーストリアの準備態勢であり、実際のエボラ発症地はDRCおよびウガンダ。対象国リストに該当する発生地はDRCのみ。WPRO基準該当数1件であるが、IHR基準2件該当のため情報不足による経過観察判定。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: El nuevo brote de ébola en RD Congo desborda la respuesta sanitaria: "La situación epidemiológica es poco clara y evoluciona extremadamente rápido"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new Ebola outbreak in DR Congo overwhelms the health response: "The epidemiological situation is unclear and evolving extremely rapidly."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, centered in Ituri’s Humboldt mining area. On May 15, the outbreak was declared with 246 cases; by May 30, suspected cases had quadrupled to about 984. Uganda reports eight infections and one death; borders have been closed to limit cross-border spread. Africa CDC warns two countries are affected and ten are at high risk. Unlike prior DRC outbreaks, Bundibugyo has no approved treatments or vaccines, and existing countermeasures are unproven for this variant. OMS/MSF highlight diagnostic capacity gaps and underreporting, focusing on symptom management, treatment centers, and isolation units. Emergency clinical trials for treatments are being considered; a UK-developed Bundibugyo vaccine could enter trials in 2–3 months. The region has historical Ebola experience since 1976, with over 15,000 regional deaths; cross-border risk remains high.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の新型エボラアウトブレイク、保健対応を圧倒：「疫学的状況は不明確で、非常に急速に進化している」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。未承認治療、急速な症例増加（15日間で4倍）、国際的な越境感染リスク、アフリカCDCの警告など、緊急RRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染報告もあるが、記事サマリーの主要な焦点はDRCのIturi州のアウトブレイク。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の未承認治療・ワクチン、診断能力の欠陥、報告不足が主要な懸念。15日間で246→984症例への急速増加は異常。越境リスク（ウガンダ国境閉鎖）と国際的関心の高さが明白。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : la riposte à l'épidémie mise à l'épreuve par la peur, la flambée des prix et une confiance fragile (REPORTAGE)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the response to the outbreak put to the test by fear, soaring prices and fragile trust (FEATURE)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province (Bunia, Mongbwalu) presses on amid fear, soaring prices for hand sanitizer, and fragile public trust. The Bundibugyo strain has generated more than 1,000 suspected cases, pushing prevention into daily life in Ituri’s hardest-hit area scarred by conflict, displacement, and weak public services. In Bunia’s EPE Bunia primary school, daily handwashing stations are installed, but shortages of water, soap, and disinfectant complicate routines, with 500 ml bottles now around $10. Schools remain open; authorities say opening supports risk communication, relying on children to reinforce messages about Ebola symptoms and prevention. About five students have died since the outbreak began, though total case/death numbers are still under review. In Mongbwalu, traders worry that cash could spread the virus, while officials battle misinformation as a major front in the response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ：恐怖、価格高騰、脆弱な信頼により流行対応が試される（レポート）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo株による1,000件以上の疑い事例、学校での死亡報告、紛争地域での公共衛生体制の脆弱性が確認され、フルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株（稀な株）による流行。Ituri州の紛争地域での発生で、水・石鹸不足、物資価格高騰（500ml消毒液が約10ドル）、公共衛生体制の脆弱性が対応を困難にしている。学校内での死亡報告あり。公開情報による正確な患者数・死亡数はなお確認中だが、公表値は保守的な可能性。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan court blocks US offshore Ebola camp as epidemic accelerates across central Africa
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court blocked the U.S.-built 50-bed offshore Ebola camp at Laikipia Air Base, halting a plan to quarantine or treat exposed individuals pending a June 2 hearing. The facility, to be staffed by U.S. Public Health Service officers, would represent an unprecedented export of Ebola containment amid a rapidly worsening central African outbreak centered in the DRC and Uganda. Africa CDC reported over 1,200 suspected and confirmed cases with about 250 deaths as of May 27; the DRC tally was revised to 906 suspected cases on May 28. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, more than 30% divergent from Zaire and Sudan species, challenges vaccines and antivirals focused on Zaire; WHO prioritized MBP134, Maftivimab, and remdesivir for trials, though MBP134 is U.S.-owned stockpiled. WHO’s Tedros in Kinshasa urged ceasefires in Ituri as the outbreak—third largest in history—threatens to worsen.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高等裁判所がエボラ対策の米国沖合キャンプをブロック、中央アフリカ全域で流行加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（1,200以上の疑い例・確認例、250人以上の死亡）、異常性（新たなEbola株の登場）、国際的拡大リスク（DRC、ウガンダ中心の流行が複数国に拡大）が該当し、3つ以上該当。また、WPRO基準でも高い重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の課題が明白であり、国際的支援が必要とされているため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、Ebola流行の主な発生地はDRCとウガンダであることが明確。ケニアはキャンプ設置国であるが、流行発生地ではない。本記事は対象国リストのDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。新たなBundibugyo Ebola株の登場、既存ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬耐性の問題、歴史的に3番目の大規模流行との指摘から異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Le 17e combat de Jean-Jacques Muyembe contre le virus Ebola, cinquante ans après l'avoir découvert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The seventeenth battle of Jean-Jacques Muyembe against the Ebola virus, fifty years after having discovered it.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus emerges in Central Africa—Democratic Republic of Congo—where in September 1976, in Yambuku near Bumba, 30 cases and 22 deaths occurred within about two weeks. Chief clinician Ngoy Mushola reports the outbreak; on September 23, a field team led by Jean-Jacques Muyembe-Tamfum is dispatched to Yambuku. Muyembe conducts the first blood and liver tissue samples from three deceased nurses. Within weeks, international collaboration among the Institute of Tropical Medicine Antwerp, Institut Pasteur in Paris, and CDC Atlanta enables laboratory confirmation and the virus is officially named Ebola. Now, fifty years later, Muyembe at 84 continues to warn of chronic underfunding and resource gaps to eradicate Ebola, part of ongoing outbreaks in Central Africa that have claimed more than 15,000 lives on the continent.

triage.headline_ja: ジャン=ジャック・ムイエンベによる17度目のエボラウイルスとの戦い、発見から50年後
triage.triage_reason: 歴史的背景と現在の継続的な流行を扱う記事だが、具体的な新規発生情報、症例数、死亡数、地域固定の感染動向が不明。社会的関心は存在するが、シグナル基準への明確な該当が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は1976年のYambukunでの初発見から50年経過した現在のエボラ状況をレビューする内容。中央アフリカでの「継続的な流行」と15,000人以上の死亡が言及されているが、具体的な現在の発生地、症例数、時間軸が不明瞭。DRCでのエボラの継続的脅威は確認できるが、新規のアウトブレイク急増を示す具体的データが欠落しているため、WATCHレベルと判定。続報による詳細情報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: 大陸網紅遭恙蟲咬不治！台灣今年已56例「6月高峰期」　注意5症狀
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland Chinese influencer dies after chigger bite! Taiwan has already recorded 56 cases this year during the June peak period—watch for five symptoms.
article.articleSummary: A 39-year-old influencer from Yunnan, China, died after a chigger bite caused scrub typhus. In Taiwan, 56 locally acquired scrub typhus cases have been confirmed in 2026 as of May 24, with a June–July peak anticipated. Taitung leads with 16 cases, followed by Hualien (10) and Kinmen (7); the remaining 11 counties report 1–4 cases, including one death. The incubation period is 9–12 days; patients typically develop persistent high fever, headache, and lymphadenopathy, and about a week after onset a red papular rash appears; an eschar at the bite site is a hallmark. Without timely treatment, scrub typhus mortality can reach 60%, but with proper treatment it falls below 5%. Prevention focuses on avoiding mite bites through protective clothing and repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR3535); bathe and change clothes after outdoor exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 中国大陸の有名人がツツガムシに咬まれて死亡！台湾では今年56例を記録、6月がピーク期—5つの症状に注意
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でツツガムシ病の局所流行が確認されており、56例が報告（5月24日現在）、死亡例もあり、6月～7月のピークを控える。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事では中国云南省の患者が死亡し、台湾で地域的な流行が生じている状況が報告されている。台湾の複数県（台東16例、花蓮10例等）で局所伝播が進行中。治療を受けなければ致死率60%に達するが、適切な治療で5%以下に低下。6月から7月のピーク期を控える時点での報告であり、フルRRA実施の対象。

article.articleHeadline: El nuevo brote de ébola en RD Congo desborda la respuesta sanitaria: 'La situación epidemiológica es poco clara y evoluciona extremadamente rápido'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new Ebola outbreak in DR Congo overwhelms the health response: "The epidemiological situation is unclear and evolving extremely fast."
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo variant has strained the response. As of May 30, 2026, authorities report 1,077 possible cases and 246 deaths, with 129 confirmed cases and 10 deaths due to limited diagnostics and ongoing conflict. The outbreak crossed borders into Uganda, which has eight infections and one death; border controls are in place. Africa CDC notes two countries affected and 10 at high risk. The Bundibugyo strain has a fatality rate of 25–40%, and there are no proven treatments or vaccines. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; discussions focus on emergency trials and vaccines, with UK researchers pursuing a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine. The outbreak began in the Humboldt mining area of Ituri, a volatile, densely populated zone, compounding control efforts. RDC has Ebola experience, but this crisis remains severe.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の新たなエボラ出血熱流行が保健対応を圧倒：「疫学的状況は不明で、極めて迅速に進化している」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済みの高リスク事象。
triage.notes: ウガンダも国境を越えて8症例・1死亡が報告されているが、記事の主題イベント発生地はコンゴ民主共和国。WHO既に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。Bundibugyo系統で致死率25-40%、有効な治療法・ワクチン確認なし。鉱業地域の紛争地帯での発生により対応が困難。

article.articleHeadline: España creó unidades de alto aislamiento para virus como el ébola tras el caso de Teresa Romero: 'Hay medios para tratar los casos importados'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spain created high-containment units for viruses such as Ebola after the Teresa Romero case: "There are means to treat imported cases."
article.articleSummary: Spain created high-containment Ebola units after the 2014 Teresa Romero case, the first transmission outside Africa. Romero, a 44-year-old nurse at Madrid’s Carlos III Hospital, contracted Ebola while caring for Miguel Pajares and Manuel García Viejo, repatriated from Liberia and Sierra Leone. She was isolated and treated with experimental therapies; her dog Excálibur was euthanized as a precaution. Romero recovered and was discharged, spurring the Ubuntu unit at Hospital Clínic de Barcelona. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak in Ituri (near South Sudan and Uganda) involves the Bundibugyo strain, with cases later in North and South Kivu. WHO cites over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths, declaring a health emergency on May 16. Spain mandates 21-day post-travel monitoring, maintains the UATAN network, and coordinates through CCAES; imported/exported cases include a U.S. clinician treated in Germany and a transfer to the Czech Republic; Italy activated Ugandan-travel protocol.

triage.headline_ja: スペインはテレサ・ロメロのエボラウイルスケースの後、エボラのような高隔離ユニットを作成：「輸入されたケースを治療するための手段がある」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な多地域発生（DRC、スペイン、ドイツ、チェコ）、複数国での輸入例、WHOが公式に健康緊急事態を宣言（5月16日）、深刻な公衆衛生影響（1,000以上の患者報告、246の死亡報告）により、IHR基準4項目全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで言及されている国：DRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州でのエボラ発生）がターゲット対象国に該当。スペイン、ドイツ、イタリア、チェコは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsに含めない。ただし、記事は国際的なエボラ事例の多国間連鎖を報告しており、IHR基準で強い国際的拡大リスクが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Fatalitas Tinggi, WHO: Tingkat Kematian Akibat Ebola Bisa 50 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High Fatality Rate, WHO: Ebola Mortality Could Reach 50 Percent.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in Congo and Uganda could have a 30–50% case fatality rate, with the potential to spread to other countries. As of May 28, 2026, there are 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths across 13 health zones, and it is unclear if the peak has passed. WHO issued guidance on supportive care and is evaluating vaccine candidates. The leading option is a single-dose recombinant rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine developed by the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative; development is estimated at 7–9 months. A second candidate, ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo from the University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India, could be ready for efficacy testing within 2–3 months. WHO does not recommend travel or trade restrictions for Uganda or Congo during the outbreak, but strict traveler screening is advised.”} }{

triage.headline_ja: 高い死亡率、WHO：エボラ出血熱による死亡率は50％に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のBundibugyo株がコンゴとウガンダで発生し、30～50%の高い致死率と国際的な拡大リスク、複数の深刻な公衆衛生影響を示しており、IHR基準3つ以上に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。既知のBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、ワクチン候補の開発進行中、WHOによる積極的な対応と情報発信が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: What you need to know about the Bundibugyo virus, the type of Ebola that caused an outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, the rare Ebola species behind an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Congo River Basin, has spurred WHO to identify vaccine and treatment candidates for clinical trials, with development taking months. The virus has caused two prior outbreaks in the same region; transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids from sick or deceased individuals, putting health workers and family caregivers at highest risk. Mortality is likely over 30% given limited data. Early case identification, isolation, protective equipment, and supportive care (fluids) reduce deaths. Vaccines in trials include a Merck Elvebo-like vaccine targeting Ebola (Bundibugyo-specific version by IAVI on the same platform; trials likely seven months) and an Oxford/AstraZeneca platform vaccine via Serum Institute (2–3 months to start trials, pending animal studies). Prioritized treatments for trials are MBP134 antibody (MAP Biopharmaceuticals), Regeneron’s maftivimab, remdesivir (Veklury), with oberdesivir studied for exposed contacts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで発生したエボラウイルスの一種であるブンディブギョウイルスについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において3項目が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目が該当。エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイクは国際的懸念が高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルスはエボラウイルスの稀な亜種で、過去にコンゴ河盆地で2度の発生歴がある。致死率30%以上と推定され、ワクチン候補と治療候補が臨床試験向けに特定されている。医療従事者と家族介護者が特に高リスク。記事発行日は2026年5月30日と未来の日付だが、これは報道日時として処理。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola scourges Congo, experts warn of link to the consumption of 'wild meat'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since declaration on May 15. The Congo Basin wild meat trade, including markets in Kinshasa like Masina Market selling bats, monkeys, antelope parts, and other wildlife, is linked to spillover risk despite hunting prohibitions. WHO says the outbreak may be larger than reported. Transmission occurs through close contact with the bodily fluids of sick or deceased individuals; spillover is associated with hunting, handling, and consuming wild meat from wildlife and fruit bats. The outbreak unfolds amid armed violence and displacement in the region. Historically, Ebola has caused 17 outbreaks in Congo; the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic infected about 28,000 and killed 11,300. There are no approved medicines or vaccines for Bundibugyo virus, underscoring calls for education and One Health approaches.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを襲う中、専門家が野生肉の消費との関連性を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な死亡者数220人以上、予想外の大規模流行、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当し、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus（ブンディブギョウウイルス）によるエボラ流行で、2026年5月15日宣言時点で1,000以上の疑い症例と最低220人の死亡が報告されている。キンシャサの野生肉市場（マシナ市場を含む）でのコウモリ、サルなどの野生動物取引が感染拡大リスクと関連。武装紛争と避難民問題が併発。ブンディブギョウウイルスに対する承認医薬品やワクチンが存在しない点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果(金)首例伊波拉患者复健 美加墨收紧入境管制严防世界杯沦陷 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo's first Ebola patient undergoing rehabilitation; U.S., Canada and Mexico tighten entry controls to prevent the World Cup from being derailed
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports its first laboratory-confirmed Ebola patient who recovered and was discharged on May 27, in an outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Since May 15, WHO records 125 confirmed and about 900 suspected cases, with 17 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths; case fatality among known cases appears below 25% as data evolves. Bundibugyo strains historically have up to 50% fatality. With the World Cup 2026 in North America starting June 11, the United States, Canada and Mexico have coordinated enhanced public-health entry controls for travellers from high-risk Africa. US: non-citizens who recently visited DRC, Uganda or South Sudan are barred; starting May 30, green-card holders with such exposure are restricted. Canada: 90-day entry ban for nationals/residents from DRC, Uganda and South Sudan; asymptomatic travellers from these areas must self-isolate 21 days. Mexico: intensified airport screening and 21-day self-isolation for returnees. WHO and Africa CDC criticized Canada’s broader ban; WHO advises enhanced screening over travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で初のエボラウイルス患者が回復、米国・カナダ・メキシコが入境管制を強化してワールドカップ開催を防止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスクが高く、125確認症例・約900疑い症例、17確認死亡が記録されており、北米のワールドカップ開催を背景とした複数国の渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの発生が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC(203312)のみ。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による発生で、確認症例125、疑い症例約900、死亡数17と重大。複数国による渡航制限措置が実施されており、国際的影響が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: La Une de la presse cette semaine à Kinshasa - À la Une: Ebola, le système national d'alerte a failli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This week's front page of the Kinshasa press - On the front page: Ebola, the national alert system nearly failed.
article.articleSummary: Despite the ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces are affected in its 17th outbreak. The article notes late detection of initial cases and uncontrolled viral spread in Ituri, compounded by persistent insecurity, which hampers contact tracing and isolation of infected individuals. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus publicly criticized the Congolese national alert system as having failed to respond promptly. The piece highlights the absence of an available vaccine, hampering response efforts, and calls for a ceasefire to allow secure humanitarian access to health teams. Amid the crisis, there is guarded hope with the report of the first patient recovered in Ituri, the main focus of the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: 今週のキンシャサプレス - 一面ニュース：エボラ、国家警戒システムが機能不全
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の第17次アウトブレイク、複数州での拡大、対応の失敗、国際的懸念が明確。WHO事務局長による公開批判も含む。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の第17次アウトブレイク。複数州（イトゥリ、南キヴ、北キヴ）での流行。初期症例の検出遅延、不十分な接触者追跡、治安悪化による対応困難が記載。WHO事務局長による国家警戒システムの失敗指摘、ワクチンの利用不可も重大な懸念。国際的支援の必要性が明白。

article.articleHeadline: El cerdo catalán resiste el golpe de la peste porcina a costa de bajar precios: las exportaciones caen solo un 14% en 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Catalan pig withstands the blow of African swine fever at the cost of lowering prices: exports fall by only 14% in 2026.
article.articleSummary: On November 26, 2025, in Collserola, Barcelona, the first African swine fever (ASF)–infected wild boar found in Spain since 1994, with 325 positives from 5,983 analyses. The outbreak caused about 100 export certificates to be suspended. In Q1 2026 Catalonia exported 153 million euros less, a 14.21% year‑on‑year drop despite higher tonnage. Pork prices hovered at 1.29 euros/kg (Mercolleida). Markets shifted: Korea imported 128.45% more volume, driving revenue to 82.4 million euros (+72.3); Vietnam and Singapore also rose (≈+257% and +165%). China (-25.1%) and Japan (-53.3%) dampened overall 2024 Catalan pork revenues (835.65 million euros). Africa emerged as a new outlet with Liberia (+1,000% YoY) and Angola (+320%). Mexico may regionalize; farmer losses exceed 900 million euros since outbreak; UdP estimates 165.3 euros per pig needed to be viable, not yet achieved.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱による打撃に価格低下で耐える仏州豚肉：2026年輸出は14%減
triage.triage_reason: African Swine Feverは動物感染症であり、対象国の検証範囲（人間の感染症危機管理）外。記事は経済的影響に焦点を当てており、公衆衛生上の危機ではなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本イベントはAfrican Swine Fever（豚の感染症）の経済的影響に関する記事であり、ヒトの感染症危機管理対象外。CEPR EBS活動における感染症シグナルトリアージの対象ではない。発生地域にはVietnam (1562822) と China (1814991) が含まれているが、これらは豚肉輸出先として記載されており、実際の人獣共通感染症またはヒト感染症の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola scourges Congo, experts warn of link to eating wild animals
article.articleSummary: Experts warn of a link between Ebola outbreaks in Congo and the consumption of wild animals. In Kinshasa, the Masina Market embodies bushmeat commerce: vendors hide or selectively display wild meat, and customers request specific species. The piece notes items such as giant swamp rodents and severed antelope parts, along with baskets of squirming caterpillars. The market setting highlights how exposure to bushmeat could intersect with ongoing Ebola transmission in the country. The narrative underscores the role of urban bushmeat trade in shaping outbreak risk in Congo. The report, from AP, places Kinshasa at the center of these dynamics. Published May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを蔓延する中、専門家は野生動物食用との関連を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の現行発生（DRC）であり、IHR基準4項目中3項目（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たし、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)通知義務疾患。記事ではキンシャサの野生動物市場（Masina Market）におけるリスク環境が詳述されており、ヒト-動物インターフェースが強調されている。都市部でのブッシュミート取引を通じた継続的曝露リスクが指摘されており、公衆衛生上の重大性は明確。DRCに限定した発生イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm giác mạc do zona thần kinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Keratitis caused by herpes zoster.
article.articleSummary: Keratitis caused by Varicella Zoster Virus (VZV) reactivation in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, as of 2026-05-30. A 47-year-old man (Anh Hung) developed left-eye redness, burning, photophobia, with initial left-eye vision 5/10 and corneal epithelial damage after prior herpes zoster (shingles). Microbiology testing confirmed VZV reactivation leading to corneal ulcers. Shingles virus persists in nerve ganglia after chickenpox and can reactivate when immunity weakens; ocular involvement can threaten vision if untreated. Treatment: topical antiviral eye drops, anti-inflammatory drops, and artificial tears, plus systemic antiviral therapy for shingles. After two weeks, keratitis controlled, redness and pain resolved, left-eye vision improved to 8/10. Recommendations include avoiding eye rubbing, wearing protective glasses outdoors, and maintaining eye hygiene. The virus remains in the body and can reactivate; vaccination is encouraged to reduce recurrence and prevent complications such as postherpetic neuralgia. Direct transmission is not via air but via vesicle fluid; avoid contact with chickenpox/shingles cases and seek ophthalmology care for abnormal signs.

triage.headline_ja: 帯状疱疹ウイルスによる角膜炎
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発症例（47歳男性）の眼合併症報告であり、公衆衛生的な異常事態、集団発生、または国際的拡大のリスクを示さない。VZV再活性化による角膜炎は既知の臨床合併症である。
triage.notes: 本記事はホーチミン市における単一の散発性VZV再活性化症例の臨床報告である。帯状疱疹の眼合併症は既知の医学的現象であり、集団発生やアウトブレイク兆候は認められない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: ⁠ارتفاع حالات ⁠الاشتباه بـ"إيبولا" ⁠⁠في الكونغو الديموقراطية إلى 1028
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 1,028.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 1,028 suspected Ebola virus disease cases, up from 906 the previous day, an increase of 122. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said 225 cases have been laboratory-confirmed. The brief provides no breakdown by province, hospitalizations, deaths, infection source, or imported/exported cases. The data indicate ongoing Ebola activity with a large pool of suspected cases alongside a subset that has been laboratory-confirmed. No further details on testing timelines or geographic distribution are provided. The update underscores persistent surveillance and response needs within the DRC as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑い患者数が1,028人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い致死性を持つ一類感染症であり、コンゴ民主共和国で1,028人の疑い患者が報告されている。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）の複数該当とWPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）の複数該当により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラは最も危険な感染症の一つであり、疑い患者1,028人（確定患者225人）という規模は重大な脅威。記事では地域別内訳、入院数、死亡数の詳細が不明であるが、これは追加情報が得られる次のアップデートで補足されると予想される。DRC外への患者輸出リスクも国際的関心の対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: 14 new Zika cases on Sept 16; new cluster in Sengkang
article.articleSummary: 14 new Zika cases reported in Singapore on Friday Sept 16, bringing the outbreak total to 369 since Aug 27. A new cluster is identified at Sengkang Central/Sengkang East Avenue with two cases. A Vernon Park case is linked to the Joo Seng Road cluster, bringing that cluster to four cases (Joo Seng Road/Vernon Park). Four new cases in the original Aljunied cluster, now 283 cases. A new case in Elite Terrace, Siglap, bringing that cluster to 11. Overall eight Zika clusters are active: Balam Road/Jalan Raya/Circuit Road; Ubi Avenue 1/Ubi Crescent; Bedok North Avenue 3; Bishan Street 12; Sengkang Central/Sengkang East Avenue; Joo Seng Road/Vernon Park; Aljunied; Elite Terrace (Siglap).

triage.headline_ja: 9月16日に14件の新規ジカ熱症例報告、セングカンで新たなクラスターが発生
triage.triage_reason: シンガポール在住人口の集団発生であり、多数のアクティブなクラスター（8つ）と急速な増加傾向（8月27日からの369例）が特徴。IHR基準では異常性・重症性の可能性が高く、WPRO基準でも異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性において該当。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した発生地域にはSingapore(1880251)、China、Australiaが含まれているが、記事サマリーを精読するとシンガポール国内の発生が主題である。シンガポールは対象国リスト（895949,1694008,1605651,2300660,203312,3469034,1643084,1814991,1327865,1562822,1269750）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。ただし、都市部での多数クラスター形成と急速な増加傾向は公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示唆するため、トリアージ判定はPICKUPとしている。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola scourges Congo, experts warn of link to the consumption of 'wild meat'
article.articleSummary: Ebola is ravaging eastern Congo, with the government confirming more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since the outbreak began on May 15; the World Health Organization suspects the outbreak is larger than reported. The current transmission is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola strain with no approved medicines or vaccines. The crisis unfolds amid armed violence and mass displacement in the region. Experts link spillovers to wildlife contact in the Congo Basin, where wild meat remains a dietary staple despite bans on hunting endangered species. Handling, butchering, and consumption of wild meat are implicated in human infections; fruit bats and various primates are noted as natural hosts. West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak infected about 28,000 people and killed more than 11,300. Public health education is urged to address cultural practices around wild meat.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを猛威、野生肉消費との関連を警告する専門家ら
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による大規模流行で1,000以上の疑い例と220以上の死亡が報告され、WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きいと懸念。承認された医薬品やワクチンがなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の危機と判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス5種の1つ）による流行。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較言及あり。武装紛争と大量避難の複雑な危機状況。野生肉消費とのリンケージは文化的介入の必要性を示唆。Angola（対象国リストに含まれず）は発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴが主題であり検証対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Здравното министерство с важна новина за риска от ебола в Бъ...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health has an important announcement about the risk of Ebola in Bulgaria.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk for EU/EEA residents is very low, per Bulgaria’s Ministry of Health citing the ECDC. Ebola outbreaks are ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. By May 27, 2026, 128 confirmed Ebola cases and 18 deaths, plus 1,077 probable cases and 238 deaths, were reported in the affected areas. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of infected people or animals, through broken skin or mucous membranes; it is not airborne. Preventive measures emphasize avoiding contact with patients, their fluids, and deceased individuals; avoiding wildlife and their carcasses; and rigorous hand hygiene. Symptoms start with abrupt flu-like illness (fever, malaise, muscle/joint pain, headache), progressing to weakness, vomiting, watery diarrhea with blood and mucus, then bleeding and multiorgan failure. Bulgarian authorities advise limiting or suspending travel to affected states; returning travelers with symptoms within 21 days should seek medical care and disclose travel exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がブルガリアのエボラ感染リスクについて重要な発表
