triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言済みの進行中のエボラアウトブレークであり、複数国での確認患者・死亡報告が存在し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているDRC及びウガンダでの進行中のエボラアウトブレーク（確認患者128名、死亡18名、疑い患者1,077名、死亡238名）。ブルガリアはEU/EEA域内での対応報道であり、実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダ。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。WPROスクリーニング基準は対象地域外であるが、IHR基準が全該当かつ国際的公衆衛生緊急事態であるため、フルRRAに進める価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola scourges Congo, experts warn of link to the consumption of 'wild meat' | WBBM Newsradio 780 AM & 105.9 FM
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Congo — Ebola outbreaks in eastern Congo, now linked to wild-meat consumption, continue as authorities report 1,000+ suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since May 15; WHO cautions the tally is likely larger. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola strain with no approved medicines or vaccines. Historically, Congo has experienced 17 Ebola outbreaks; the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic infected about 28,000 and killed over 11,300. Transmission involves zoonotic spillover from animals—often via hunting, butchering, and processing wild meat—followed by human-to-human spread through bodily fluids. Kinshasa’s Masina Market illustrates ongoing wild-meat demand; the Congo Basin sustains roughly 4.5 million tons of wild meat annually. The outbreak unfolds amid armed conflict and displacement, underscoring the need for education and one-health public health measures to reduce contact with unknown meat sources.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを襲う中、専門家が野生肉消費との関連を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴで1,000件以上の疑い患者と220人以上の死亡が報告されており、稀なBundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイクであり、国際感染拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は稀なエボラ株で承認された医薬品やワクチンがない。キンシャサの野生肉市場での継続的な消費が重要なリスク要因。武装紛争と避難民の存在が対応を複雑化させている。Angolは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主にDRCでのアウトブレイクが主題であり、Angolaでの確認は記載されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief lands in Congo, saying Ebola outbreak 'can be stopped'
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General arrives in Kinshasa to bolster Congo’s response to a rare Ebola virus outbreak in Ituri province. A medical team wearing PPE is setting up a treatment center in Rwampara outside Bunia as the WHO coordinates with local communities to stop transmission. As of 30 May 2026, Congo reports 125 confirmed Ebola cases with 17 confirmed deaths, alongside 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. The visit underscores international solidarity and the emphasis on rapid detection, isolation, and community engagement to halt spread of this rare Ebola lineage within the country.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴに到着、エボラ出血熱の流行は「阻止可能」と言及
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確認患者125名・死亡17名が発生しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。フルのリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダ（Kigali Province）も発生地域として挙げられているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴのIturi州での発生であり、ルワンダでの発生は明記されていないため、DRCのみを検証済み地域として列挙。WHO事務局長の直接訪問および医療チームの治療センター設営により、国際的な対応が既に展開されている。稀なエボラ系統という特殊性も注目に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Tiệm bánh mì gây ngộ độc cho 62 người bị phạt 80 triệu đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Banh Mi Shop Caused Food Poisoning in 62 People and Was Fined 80 Million Dong
article.articleSummary: Salmonella-lined food poisoning outbreak in Nghệ An Province, Vietnam, linked to Quỳnh Bánh mì shops in Diễn Châu. On 17 April, the two outlets sold dozens of baguettes; within hours, illnesses emerged, totaling 62 hospitalisations. On 30 May 2026, Nghệ An Provincial People’s Committee fined owner Nguyen Thi Quỳnh, 31, 80 million VND for preparing, supplying, and selling food not meeting safety standards, causing poisoning affecting at least five people, and ordered a 3‑month suspension of operations at Block 4 and Trung Hong Hamlet outlets. Quỳnh will cover all costs for outbreak management, patient treatment, and decontamination. Laboratory tests found Salmonella in 5 of 7 samples from foods including pate, grilled meat, sausage, meat floss, and radish; two samples (pork loaf and tomato sauce) were negative. Source likely pate and grilled meat with possible cross-contamination. Salmonella incubation is 16–48 hours with diarrhoea, fever, and abdominal pain; most recover in 4–7 days. Recent southern outbreaks linked to bánh mì include 79 cases in Vũng Tàu (3–4 March), 22 in Ho Chi Minh City, and over 70 at Hồng Ngọc 12 in Đồng Tháp.

triage.headline_ja: バインミー店が62人に食中毒を引き起こし、8000万ドン罰金を科された
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるサルモネラによる集団食中毒事例だが、既に当局が対応・罰則を実施済みの過去イベント（4月17日発生、5月30日罰金確定）であり、進行中の拡大リスクは記事から明確ではない。ただし、社会的関心および複数地域での関連事例報告の背景があるため経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月30日の罰金決定を報じており、事象は2026年4月17日に発生した過去イベント。当局による迅速な対応（営業停止、罰金、患者治療、除染）が実施済み。ただしサルモネラはヒト-ヒト感染はまれだが食中毒として集団発生の可能性がある。南部での関連バインミー事例（ヴンタウ79件、ホーチミン22件、ドンタップ70件以上）が複数報告されているため、広域食品衛生リスクとしての経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Espanya té unitats d'alt aïllament per a virus perillosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spain has high-containment units for dangerous viruses.
article.articleSummary: Teresa Romero, a nurse at Madrid Carlos III Hospital, became the first Ebola transmission outside Africa in 2014. She cared for Pajares and Viejo, infected after repatriation from Liberia and Sierra Leone; both died soon after arriving in Madrid. Romero developed symptoms Sept 29, 2014; Ebola was confirmed Oct 6; she was isolated and treated with experimental therapies. Her dog Excálibur was sacrificed, a step now no longer in Spanish protocol. Romero recovered and was discharged on Nov 5. The case sparked a crisis and led Spain to establish containment units, including Ubuntu at Hospital Clínic de Barcelona, with staff trained every two months. The WHO cites Ebola fatality historically 25–90% (about 50% on average). Epidemiologists warn of potential imported cases from Congo outbreak in Ituri near South Sudan and Uganda, with Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu affected, or travelers from Uganda; Italy has activated Ebola protocol for Ugandan travelers to Milan.

triage.headline_ja: スペインは危険なウイルス向けの高度隔離ユニットを有している
triage.triage_reason: 歴史的なエボラ事例（2014年）と現在のコンゴ民主共和国でのアウトブレイク言及があり、スペイン・イタリアが対策を講じている。しかし記事主体は過去事例の振り返りと準備態勢であり、確認症例が欧州にないため現時点ではWATCHが適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはスペイン・イタリアでの過去事例と準備態勢を中心に述べており、これらの国は評価対象外。DRCのIturi、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu地域での現在のアウトブレイク言及に基づきDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。欧州でのEbola確認症例は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Experts Link Congo's Ebola Surge to Consumption of Wild Animals
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, eastern Congo faces an Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain with no approved medicines or vaccines. The Congolese government confirms more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since declaring the outbreak on May 15, with the World Health Organization suspecting the true scale is larger. The outbreak occurs amid armed conflict and mass displacement in the region. Ebola spillovers are linked to hunting, handling, and processing wild meat from wildlife in the Congo Basin—where annual wild meat extraction is about 4.5 million tons—though transmission occurs mainly via close contact with the bodily fluids of the sick or deceased. Fruit bats are considered natural hosts, and bush meat remains a deeply rooted dietary staple. Public education and one-health approaches are urged to curb transmission, alongside hunting restrictions on endangered wildlife.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ急増を野生動物の消費に関連付ける専門家
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、深刻な公衆衛生への影響（1,000件以上の疑似症例、220人以上の死亡）、異常性（承認医薬品・ワクチンなし）、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクの全4基準に該当。またWPRO基準でも重症度（多数の死亡）、流行可能性（ヒト-ヒト感染）、管理可能性（国際支援必要）が該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus（ブンディブギョウイルス）は承認医薬品・ワクチンがない希少株。武装紛争と大量避難民の存在により公衆衛生対応が複雑化。動物媒介性疾患（One-Health課題）であり、野生肉消費文化との関連性が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Eight lion cubs die of infection
article.articleSummary: Eight lion cubs died in Gujarat's Gir Somnath and Amreli districts due to suspected Babesia infection, reported on 2026-05-30 by forest minister Arjun Modhwadia. The eight cub deaths are linked to Babesia, a tick-borne parasitic disease that can cause weakness, coughing and nasal discharge in affected lions. To prevent potential spread, authorities have isolated wildlife within a 10-km radius of the outbreak areas. The cases are described as suspected Babesia-related; no laboratory confirmation details are provided. Babesia is transmitted via ticks, and authorities are monitoring the situation in the two districts.

triage.headline_ja: ライオンの子ども8頭が感染症で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 動物における疑い事例であり、ヒト公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は明確でない。ただしバベシア症は人獣共通感染症であり、病原体の性質と国際的関心から継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は野生動物（ライオン）に限定された報告であり、ヒト症例は記述されていない。バベシア症は人獣共通感染症であり、野生動物における拡大流行は潜在的な公衆衛生リスクとなる可能性があるが、現段階では確定診断がなく情報が限定的。ギル森林地域のライオン個体群の減少リスクも懸念事項。継続的な確定診断と疫学調査の結果待ちで判定を再評価する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola scourges Congo, experts warn of link to eating wild animals
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Since May 15, the Congolese government has confirmed more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths, with WHO suggesting the outbreak is larger than reported. The region is plagued by armed violence and mass displacement, complicating response efforts. Transmission is linked to handling, hunting, and processing wild meat from the Congo Basin, where zoonotic spillover can occur; Ebola generally spreads via close contact with the bodily fluids of sick or deceased individuals, and fruit bats are noted as natural hosts. No approved medicines or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo virus. Kinshasa’s Masina Market illustrates persistent demand for bushmeat, while wild meat remains a major protein source for many in the region, with an estimated 4.5 million tons extracted annually. Public health education on how Ebola starts and spreads is urged within affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを襲う中、専門家は野生動物摂取との関連性を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。既に1,000件以上の疑似患者、220名以上の死亡が確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行性・管理可能性すべてに該当。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Ebola Bundibugyo）による東コンゴでのアウトブレイク。2026年5月15日以降、1,000件以上の疑似患者と220名以上の死亡確認。武装勢力による暴力と大量避難が対応を複雑化。ジビエ処理時のヒト-ヒト感染リスク高い。Bundibugyo型用の認可医薬品・ワクチンなし。WHOは報告数より実際の流行規模が大きい可能性を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: 赴港旅客別錯買！香港兩款礦泉水驗出腸道鏈球菌 已全面下架
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong-bound travelers, don't buy the wrong one! Two mineral water brands in Hong Kong tested positive for enterococci and have been pulled from shelves.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, Hong Kong’s Centre for Food Safety announced two bottled mineral waters tested positive for Enterococcus, prompting recalls. Still Scottish Mountain Water, 750 ml, and ICIS Natural Mineral Water 8.0, 2 L, each showed 1 colony-forming unit per 250 ml sample. Both products were withdrawn from shelves; Hong Kong authorities deemed the levels low but took precautionary action. Enterococcus is a gut-associated bacterium used as a hygiene indicator; some strains can cause GI symptoms or fever, but no other tests (E. coli, total coliforms, sulfite-reducing anaerobes, Pseudomonas aeruginosa) were positive. Taiwan’s FDA reported no import records for these products and stated no domestic impact. Travelers to Hong Kong are advised to avoid purchasing these waters, and businesses should verify recall status and suspend sales as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 香港行き旅行客は注意！香港の2銘柄のミネラルウォーターから腸球菌が検出、全面下架
triage.triage_reason: 食品汚染イベント（腸球菌検出）だが、検出レベルは低く、他の病原体は陰性で、患者発生や死亡の報告がない。異常性と管理可能性に関する情報が不足しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は香港のミネラルウォーター汚染イベントを扱っており、香港は中国に含められる。患者発生報告がなく、検出レベルは低く、他の病原体は陰性であることから、公衆衛生への深刻度は限定的と考えられる。ただしリコール対象の食品が複数国で販売されている可能性があり、台湾でも確認されているため、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Primer paciente curado de ébola en la epidemia que ya supera los 1.000 casos sospechosos en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First patient cured of Ebola in the outbreak that has already surpassed 1,000 suspected cases in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: WHO confirms the first patient cured as the outbreak tally reaches 1,004 suspected cases and 223 deaths under investigation. The cured patient, a resident of the affected area, was treated at a MSF-managed isolation center. The outbreak remains concentrated in North Kivu, notably in Goma, a region controlled by armed group M23, where UNICEF volunteers are leading door-to-door risk communication. The WHO highlights surveillance challenges and urges neighboring countries to maintain vigilance, with no international public health emergency declared. Vaccination efforts have intensified in districts with new cases, and the circulating strain is similar to the 2018 outbreak, for which vaccines exist. More than 200 people have voluntarily sought testing at health centers, signaling community engagement but underscoring the need for strengthened contact tracing and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: RDCでエボラ出血熱患者1,000件以上の流行の中で初の治癒患者が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。北キブ州ゴマでの大規模エボラ流行による死亡者223名以上、疑い症例1,004件超は明らかなシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月配信だが、内容は進行中の大規模エボラ流行を描写。ゴマ市（武装勢力M23支配地域）が中心で監視困難性が指摘されている。隣接国への拡大リスク警告あり。MSFとUNICEFが対応に従事。ワクチン（2018年株類似）が存在し接種進行中。国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言なしとされるが、実態は深刻。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Điện Biên chỉ đạo không được che giấu tình trạng dịch bệnh cúm A(H5N1) trên địa bàn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Điện Biên directs that the A(H5N1) avian influenza outbreak in the province must not be concealed.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A(H5N1) outbreak in Dien Bien Province, Vietnam, centered in Thanh Yen Commune. In response, authorities culled 5,000 poultry (ducks and chickens) totaling 4,508 kg after samples from poultry near the affected area were confirmed positive for the virus. Sampling of ducks near affected households occurred on 29 May, with health authorities and the Thanh Yen Commune Health Station tracking people who had close contact with poultry. Public guidance emphasizes five rules: recognize signs of disease in poultry and infection risk to humans; implement avian influenza prevention and biosecurity, including environmental hygiene and use of protective gear; consume only well-cooked poultry and avoid sick, dead, or unknown-origin birds; do not slaughter, trade, transport, or consume diseased poultry and report violations; do not discard poultry carcasses and promptly report suspected cases to authorities for timely response. Surveillance aims to prevent spread within Thanh Yen and across Dien Bien.

triage.headline_ja: ディエンビエン省：A(H5N1)鳥インフルエンザの発生状況を隠ぺいしないよう指導
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで確認されたH5N1人獣共通感染症であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクを満たし、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行性・管理体制が懸念される。確認的な疫学調査と濃厚接触者追跡が実施されており、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: H5N1は人獣共通感染症として重大な懸念。記事はディエンビエン省タインイェン地区での発生を報告し、5,000羽の家禽を殺処分。濃厚接触者の追跡調査が進行中。省当局による公開的な対応と市民向けガイダンス発出は管理可能性の一定程度を示すが、H5N1の人への感染リスクは常に存在。

article.articleHeadline: Former CDC director believes US will likely see Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC has spread into Uganda; Congo reports more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since declared May 15. Uganda has seven cases with one death. The outbreak is the third-largest in history, and the World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern; there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Dr. Robert Redfield told NewsNation he would not be surprised if one to three sporadic Ebola cases occur in the United States. White House plans to send Americans exposed to Ebola to a quarantine and treatment facility in Kenya, but a Kenyan court blocked permitting it. JFK Airport will screen passengers from countries for Ebola. Public health officers are poised to deploy to the region; one infected American doctor was evacuated to Germany, another exposed doctor to Prague. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said protecting Americans is the priority.

triage.headline_ja: 前CDC所長は米国がエボラ症例を見る可能性が高いと信じている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模国際的な感染拡大であり、複数国への波及、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、米国への流入リスク、国際的な旅行・貿易制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事のBluedot API地域抽出に誤りあり。Bundibugyo（DRC領内）、Western Region（ウガンダ）はいずれもアフリカ内の発生地。Prague、New York、Germanyは医療搬送先または検査実施地点であり、実際の発生地ではない。WPRO地域外（アフリカ地域）だが、IHR基準による国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威、WHOのPHEIC宣言により、高優先度でシグナルピックアップすべき。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola scourges Congo, experts warn of link to the consumption of 'wild meat'
article.articleSummary: Ebola is currently ravaging eastern Congo, with authorities reporting more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with no approved medicines or vaccines. The outbreak highlights the link between wild meat (viande de brousse) consumption in the Congo Basin and zoonotic spillover, as hunting, butchering, and processing meat can seed human infections when contact occurs with infected wildlife or bat reservoirs. Annual wild meat extraction from the Congo Basin is about 4.5 million tons, sustaining demand despite outbreaks. Kinshasa's Masina Market and other bushmeat venues illustrate persistent demand. The Congo Basin’s Ebola history totals 17 outbreaks; the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic infected about 28,000 people and killed more than 11,000. Public health campaigns promote One Health education to discourage eating meat from unknown or dead animals; illegal wildlife trade persists.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを猛威する中、野生肉消費との関連を専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,000件以上の疑い例・220人以上の死亡、異常性：稀なBundibugyo株、国際的拡大リスク：ザンビアと隣接する東部コンゴ）。スクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCキンシャサでの活動中の大規模エボラ発生。稀なBundibugyo株で承認医療がない。動物・ヒト両面で影響カテゴリ指定。西アフリカ2014-2016流行（28,000人感染、11,000人以上死亡）の前例あり。野生肉消費との関連から長期曝露リスク高い。ザンビア国境に近接しており、隣国への国際的拡大可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: दल्लीराजहरा में चमगादड़ों की रहस्यमयी मौत : रोज मिल रहे 50 से 70 मृत चमगादड़, जांच के लिए भोपाल भेजे गए सैंपल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious deaths of bats in Dalli-Rajhara: 50 to 70 dead bats found daily, samples sent to Bhopal for investigation.
article.articleSummary: In Dalli-Rajhara, Balod district, Chhattisgarh, bat mortality continues with 50–70 dead bats found daily, triggering public health concern. As of May 30, 2026, a joint Forest and Veterinary team collected carcasses and forwarded samples to Bhopal for laboratory analysis. Divisional Forest Officer Abhishek Agarwal inspected the site and ordered a rapid investigation. Authorities are considering extreme heat or an infectious disease as possible causes, with the final determination pending laboratory results. Experts are examining whether a virus or other serious illness could be involved. Meanwhile, the administration urges the public not to handle dead or sick bats and to report any findings to the relevant department. The investigation report is awaited, with the situation under close watch by forest and health agencies.

triage.headline_ja: ダリ・ラジハラにおけるコウモリの謎の大量死：1日50～70頭の死亡コウモリが発見、検査のためボーパルに送付されたサンプル
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illnessとしての疾患特定が不十分だが、コウモリの異常な大量死イベント（50-70頭/日）が報告され、感染性疾患の可能性が指摘されている。検査結果待ちの段階であり、情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: コウモリの大量死は人獣共通感染症（zoonotic pathogen）の警戒信号となり得る。ウイルス性疾患の可能性が専門家により検討されている。ただし、疾患名が『Unknown Illness』であり、検査結果が未確定の段階。サンプル検査結果の速報に注視が必要。社会的関心と行政対応は現在進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: Strict screening for Ebola at Tirupati
article.articleSummary: Strict surveillance to prevent Ebola entry into Tirupati district was discussed as DMHO Dr Balakrishna Naik and health officials met the Airport Director. Officials outlined Ebola’s seriousness, transmission modes, and the importance of hygiene and infection-control measures, briefing airport authorities on Government of India precautionary guidelines. With Tirupati International Airport currently operating flights only from Air India and IndiGo, officials planned to deploy a dedicated medical screening team at the airport to identify and monitor high-risk passengers. The meeting emphasizes preventive screening and coordination between health authorities and airport operations to mitigate the risk of importation of Ebola, aligned with public health measures as of 30 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ティルパティでのエボラに関する厳格なスクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは極めて重大な感染症であり、国際的な広がりのリスクは高いが、本記事は予防的な準備・スクリーニング措置の実施に関するもので、実際の患者確認やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。情報が限定的であり、実際の感染症イベント発生の有無が不明。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのティルパティ地域で実施されている予防的なエボラスクリーニング措置の報告である。実際の患者発生やアウトブレイク確認は記述されていない。エボラの重大性から引き続き注視が必要だが、現段階では実感染症イベントとしての確証がないため、WATCHの判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mondiali 2026, allerta Ebola: il Messico introduce restrizioni sui voli da Paesi considerati a rischio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026, Ebola alert: Mexico imposes flight restrictions from countries deemed at risk.
article.articleSummary: World Cup 2026 Ebola alert leads Mexico to temporarily restrict air entry for travellers who in the previous 21 days stayed in Ebola-affected Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan. The restrictions, coordinated with national health and migration authorities, will stay in place for 60 days and affect Aeroméxico, Viva, and Volaris. The Democratic Republic of the Congo national team remains under health surveillance amid an outbreak that has caused around 250 deaths in the country; the United States has added measures including a 21-day isolation of the Congolese squad before the tournament. The team is due to play Colombia in Guadalajara, reinforcing entry checks. With an estimated five million visitors, Mexican authorities will deploy advanced epidemiological surveillance at airports and major access routes to ensure safety during the global event, per the Health Ministry."} }  {

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ、エボラ警戒：メキシコが危険とみなされた国からの便を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で『異常/予想外』『国際拡大リスク』『渡航制限リスク』の3項目に該当し、WPRO基準でも『異常/予想外』『流行感染性』『長期曝露』に該当。エボラ出血熱は重大感染症であり、大規模国際イベント時の公衆衛生措置として国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年ワールドカップを背景としたメキシコのエボラ対策を報じている。DRCで現在進行中のエボラ流行（約250名の死亡報告）が主要なトリガーであり、DRCが対象国リストに該当。ウガンダ、南スーダンも言及されているが対象国外のため除外。本件は国際的スポーツイベント時の感染症リスク管理として高い政策関心を有する。

article.articleHeadline: Trop c'est trop: catastrophe en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Too much is too much: catastrophe in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Documentary Trop c'est trop by Elisé Sawasawa compiles years of footage from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, illustrating how decades of war and resource exploitation have shaped humanitarian catastrophe. The article notes that the DRC, formerly Zaïre, is now the epicenter of an Ebola outbreak, underscoring how conflict and displacement amplify infectious disease risk. Eastern Congo hosts about 120 armed groups amid a broader mining economy — cobalt, coltan, copper and diamonds — with smuggling and opaque supply chains complicating monitoring. Goma in North Kivu fell to the M23 on January 27, symbolizing the violence feeding vulnerability to outbreaks. The film juxtaposes fear, poverty, and resilience, including mentions of famine and disease as lived realities, and witnesses two women in camps. The piece emphasizes global neglect and the extractive economy's role in sustaining suffering.

triage.headline_ja: 多すぎる：コンゴ民主共和国の大惨事
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常/予想外性」と「国際拡大リスク」が該当。紛争・変位により感染症リスクが増幅される環境が確認され、WPROスクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」と「管理可能性」も満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は紛争・変位・採掘経済がエボラ発生リスクを増幅する環境を描写。ゴマはM23の支配下にあり、北キブ州の120以上の武装勢力が存在することで、感染症管理と国際支援の課題が顕在化。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 國際醫療快訊：伊波拉疫情升溫、新冠疫苗更新與癌症新藥突破 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International Medical News Flash: Ebola Outbreak Intensifies, COVID-19 Vaccine Updates, and Breakthroughs in New Cancer Drugs - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies with suspected cases exceeding 1,000 as WHO tests experimental drugs and vaccines to curb spread. The Trump administration plans quarantine facilities at a Kenya Air Force Base to isolate Americans who had contact with Ebola patients to prevent domestic entry. For COVID-19, FDA and EMA agree vaccines for 2026-2027 should target the current dominant XFG variant, with an executive order to update vaccination guidance for children and adolescents. In oncology, Bristol Myers Squibb reports a multiple myeloma drug candidate reducing progression risk by 52% in trials; Pfizer and Innovent Biologics strike a $10.5 billion deal to co-develop cancer therapies. FDA approves MannKind’s inhaled insulin for children. Separately, 23andMe faces a California lawsuit over a 6.9 million data breach; UnitedHealth is sued for over $100 million in Massachusetts Medicaid fraud; USDA warns screwworm fly near the US-Mexico border threatens livestock.

triage.headline_ja: 国際医療速報：エボラ疫情が加温、新型コロナウイルスワクチン更新とがん新薬のブレークスルー
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重症度、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス疾患の症例数1,000件超が確認され、DRCでの急速な感染拡大とケニアでの隔離施設設置による国際対応が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事にはCOVID-19、エボラウイルス疾患、Screwworm myiasisが挙げられているが、対象国内での検証イベントはDRCのエボラアウトブレイク（疑い症例1,000件超）のみ。ケニア（非対象国）での隔離施設設置、米国カリフォルニア・マサチューセッツ州での法的問題（非感染症イベント）は対象外。Screwworm myiasisについては記事上で米国‐メキシコ国境での家畜への脅威として言及されているが、人感染の実績なし。WPRO基準は対象地域外のため参考値。

article.articleHeadline: Broj sumnjivih slučajeva ebole u Kongu porastao na 1028, umrlo 225 osoba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola cases in the Congo has risen to 1,028; 225 people have died.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,028 people under investigation for Ebola, up from 906 the day before, with 225 laboratory-confirmed cases. The World Health Organization notes that since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths, indicating the virus may have circulated undetected for some time. In neighboring Uganda, authorities report one Ebola death and nine infections linked to travelers from Congo, prompting Uganda to temporarily close its border with Congo to curb transmission. The WHO has declared international health emergency status for the Ebola outbreaks in Congo and Uganda, highlighting the potential for broader spread given cross-border movement and under-detection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ疑似症例数が1,028件に増加、225人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大、複数国での死亡確認、WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言がなされており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）でも死亡1例と感染9例が報告されているが、主な発生地はコンゴであり verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、国境閉鎖措置が取られるなど社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。未検出期間の存在と越境移動による拡大リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola, el regreso de un viejo enemigo mortal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the return of an old mortal enemy.
article.articleSummary: Ebola reemerged in May 2026 with Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The index case was identified on May 15, 2026; eight of 13 samples tested positive, five conclusively. By May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, with more than 240 deaths and about 1,000 suspected cases in under a month. Historical context recalls 1976 outbreaks in Zaire (DRC) and the devastating 2014 West Africa epidemic affecting Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone; these show that rising case numbers increase mutation risk. Reservoirs remain uncertain, though fruit bats are suspected. Experimental Bundibugyo vaccines exist but are untested in humans and would require months for clinical trials. Aid response is hampered by PPE shortages and funding cuts to US, WHO, and partners, underscoring the need for rapid vaccination and humanitarian support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、古い致命的な敵の復活
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響、予想外の再興、国際的拡大、WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo）の新規発生で、高い社会的・政治的関心あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される実際の発生地域はDRC（Ituri）とウガンダです。発生地域フィールドに含まれるシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアは歴史的参考例として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOによる国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）があり、240人以上の死亡、約1,000人の疑い例という深刻な状況。ワクチン開発遅延とリソース不足が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Krig, kris och ebola - barnen drabbas värst
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: War, Crisis, and Ebola — Children Are the Hardest Hit
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is accelerating, with the virus spreading rapidly and many deaths among children. More than 250 suspected Ebola deaths have occurred, though only a minority are laboratory-confirmed. Up to about a million people are housed in crowded camps in Ituri, where hunger and water shortages hinder response and raise transmission risk, especially within camps. An Italian surgeon who treated Ebola patients in Ituri is quarantined in Rome after contact, underscoring cross-border exposure concerns. The response, led by Save the Children’s Babou Rukengeza, emphasizes protecting children in schools, promoting handwashing (even with sand due to water scarcity), and rapid detection across 14 districts. Ongoing crises include cholera and measles, and many children face orphanhood as the outbreak continues.

triage.headline_ja: 戦争、危機、エボラ — 子どもたちが最も被害を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、多くの死亡、国際的なヒト-ヒト感染リスク、および国境を越えた曝露（イタリアの医療従事者の隔離）が確認された。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主体はコンゴ民主共和国Ituri州でのエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大である。イタリアの医療従事者の隔離は国際的な波及リスク（cross-border exposure）を示唆するが、イタリアは対象国ではないため verified_locations に含めない。複数の病原体（コレラ、麻疹）が同時流行しており、難民キャンプでの衛生環境悪化が感染拡大リスクを増加させている。

article.articleHeadline: Во Конго можеби има над 900 лица заразени со ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo there may be more than 900 people infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, the World Health Organization reports 906 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 223 suspected deaths under investigation, amid continuing unfoldment of Bundibugyo virus infections. A total of 125 confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded in Congo, with 17 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In Uganda, seven confirmed cases have been documented, three of which were imported from Congo; one death has occurred, and there is currently no evidence of community transmission. The estimated case fatality rate among confirmed cases ranges from 30% to 50%. WHO cautions that data remain preliminary and further investigations are needed, though timely medical intervention can substantially reduce mortality. There is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo virus at this time, underscoring the need for control measures and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで900人以上がエボラに感染している可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生上極めて深刻で、致死率30～50%、複数国での発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの発生が記事に記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの906例の疑似症例と125例の確定症例、17例の死亡が報告されている。Bundibugyo virus（エボラウイルス属）という稀な種類の関与も特徴。WHOからの公式レポートに基づく情報。

article.articleHeadline: 網紅被蟲咬1口感染身亡 台灣也有這種蟲！疾管署示警：死亡率60％
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influencer dies after infection from a single insect bite; Taiwan also has this type of insect! Taiwan CDC warns: 60% mortality rate.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan CDC reports a fatal scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) infection from a single mite bite, after outdoor work by a 39-year-old Chinese influencer 'Hani Xiaowei.' Scrub typhus is a rickettsial disease endemic to the Asia–Pacific region, within the tsutsugamushi triangle (Japan, Australia, Pakistan/Afghanistan) and commonly seen in Taiwan, Korea, China, Japan, the Philippines, and Southeast Asia. In Taiwan, cases occur year-round with peaks in June–July and September–October; mortality can reach 60% without effective treatment. Transmission is via mite vectors (Leptotrombidium deliense); humans are not directly contagious. Incubation is 6–21 days (typically 9–12). Symptoms: high fever, headache, back pain, chills, sweats, lymphadenopathy, and a painless eschar at the bite site; pneumonia or liver dysfunction may occur. Prevention focuses on protective clothing, repellents, bathing after exposure, environmental control, weed removal, and rodent management.

triage.headline_ja: ネット有名人が虫刺されで1口感染して死亡　台湾にもこの虫がいる！疾病管制署が警告：死亡率60％
triage.triage_reason: つつが虫病は既知の風土病であり、個別の死亡事例は報告されているが、異常な流行兆候や国際的蔓延の明確な証拠がない。ただしアジア太平洋地域で広く認識される懸念疾患のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されているつつが虫病の風土地域はアジア太平洋圏（日本、オーストラリア、パキスタン・アフガニスタン）および台湾、韓国、中国、日本、フィリピン、東南アジア。Bluedot APIの発生地域には台湾が含まれていないが、記事は台湾での患者報告と疾病管制署の警告が主要テーマ。ただし対象国リストに台湾は含まれていないため、verified_locationsは中国とフィリピンのみとする。個別死亡事例は報告されているが流行兆候の明確な記述はなく、既知の風土病としての継続的監視が該当。

article.articleHeadline: Targetkan Juni-Juli 2026, Bali Siap Distribusikan 50 Ribu Vaksin ASF ke Peternak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Targeting June–July 2026, Bali Ready to Distribute 50 Thousand ASF Vaccines to Pig Farmers
article.articleSummary: ASF vaccines: Bali Province plans to distribute 50,000 ASF doses and 20,360 Classical Swine Fever (CSF) doses in 2026, supported by the central government. Central procurement is under way and targeted to be completed by June 2026, with distribution to districts in July 2026. Vaccination priority goes to breeding boars and sows; fattening pigs are not prioritized due to shorter production cycles. Bali's Agriculture and Food Security Department head Wayan Sunada stresses that ASF spread is rapid and fatal, necessitating vigilant animal-health surveillance, large-scale farmer education, and strict biosecurity to interrupt transmission, in addition to vaccination. The program emphasizes an integrated approach combining vaccination with biosecurity, aligning with nationwide ASF prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年6月～7月を目標に、バリ州が豚農家へ5万剤のASFワクチンの配布準備を整える
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）でのASFおよび古典的豚熱の対策ワクチン配布計画は、動物衛生上の重要な取り組みを示しているが、新規の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、既知の疾病に対する予防プログラムの発表である。情報は整備されているが、緊急シグナルとしての即座のRRA必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はASFおよびCSFの既知流行に対する予防ワクチン配布計画の報道であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。バリ州での継続的な動物衛生上の課題（ASFの迅速な蔓延と致死性）が記述されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（長期曝露と流行易感染性）に部分的に該当する。政府レベルでの対応が確認でき、社会的関心も存在するが、緊急のフルRRA発動までには至らず、今後の配布実施状況の経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 陸網紅遭恙蟲叮咬過世！台灣也有「今年已56例」 1情況死亡率60％
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland influencer dies after tick bite! Taiwan also reports '56 cases this year' — one case with a 60% mortality rate.
article.articleSummary: China's Yunnan influencer died after a tick bite causing scrub typhus, highlighting a disease also present in Taiwan. Taiwan reports 56 locally acquired scrub typhus cases this year (as of May 24), including 1 death; mortality without proper treatment can reach 60%, but falls below 5% with appropriate therapy. In Taiwan, the most affected counties are Taitung 16, Hualien 10, and Kinmen 7; other jurisdictions report 1–4 cases. Scrub typhus is transmitted by chigger mites carrying rickettsiae in grass and brush areas. The incubation period is about 9–12 days; symptoms include sustained high fever, headache, back pain, chills, night sweats, lymphadenopathy, a painless eschar at the bite site, and a red maculopapular rash about a week later. Prevention emphasizes avoiding mite habitats, protective clothing, DEET, and promptly bathing and changing clothes after outdoor exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土のネットインフルエンサーがダニ咬傷による恙虫病で死亡！台湾でも『今年56例』——1つのケースで死亡率60%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目が該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、中国での死亡例を含む恙虫病の地域的拡大が確認されている。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、長期曝露）。
triage.notes: 台湾はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。中国（雲南省）での死亡例と台湾での56例の報告は、恙虫病の地域的な流行パターンを示す。恙虫病は治療なしで最大60%の死亡率を有し、不十分な医療体制下での重症化リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-vészhelyzet: lehet-e globális járvány? - Dr. Rusvai Miklós válaszol!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola emergency: could there be a global pandemic? - Dr. Miklós Rusvai answers!
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The World Health Organization has issued a warning, rating regional risk as very high, with the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control monitoring developments. There is currently no vaccine or targeted antiviral for this variant, and while researchers are pursuing treatments, broad availability is unlikely for months; containment hinges on quarantine and public health measures. Ongoing armed conflict and collapsing health systems in the affected areas likely mask a larger number of infections than official counts. European health authorities are advised to pay special attention to travelers returning from the affected regions to prevent exportation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ緊急事態：世界的パンデミックの可能性があるか？ - ミクロス・ルスヴァイ博士が答える！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目中4項目該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）が複数国で急速に拡大しており、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで拡大していることを述べているが、対象国リストはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のみを含む。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO及びECDCが警告を発出、ワクチン・治療薬なし、紛争地帯での感染制御困難という重大な懸念。欧州の渡航者監視強化が勧告されている。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ анализирует эффективность новых вакцин и лекарств от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO analyzes the effectiveness of new vaccines and medicines against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) with cross-border Ugandan cases. WHO convened experts to evaluate treatments and vaccines for a rare Ebola strain. In trials, MBP-134 and mafitivimab monoclonal antibodies, and remdesivir are selected; obeldesivir is considered for post-exposure prophylaxis in contacts. Two candidate vaccines are identified for further assessment. Two weeks after outbreak detection, WHO reports 906 probable infections and 223 deaths possibly linked to the virus; as of May 28, 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths in DRC, with ongoing review of suspected cases. Uganda has seven cases, including one death; three imported from Congo, others linked to contacts; no community transmission detected in Uganda. WHO advises exposed individuals to avoid travel; no international travel or trade restrictions with DRC or Uganda at present. Case fatality historically 30–50%; early diagnosis and intensive care improve outcomes; a Congo patient recovered.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の新ワクチンと医薬品の効果を分析
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な影響、異常な珍しい株、複数国での拡大、国際的な対応）。アクティブなエボラ流行で高い死亡率、国境を越えた症例、WHO専門家による緊急対応が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で発生していることが明確。ウガンダにも7例（1死亡）があるが、発生地域リストにはUgandaが含まれているものの、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。珍しいエボラ株の流行、急速な感染拡大（906の推定感染例）、23%の死亡率、複数の治療法・ワクチン候補の開発、WHOによる緊急対応が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccine và thuốc điều trị Ebola chủng Bundibugyo tiến triển đến đâu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How far has progress been made on vaccines and treatments for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo involves about 906 cases and 223 suspected deaths, with a case fatality around 40%; no approved vaccines or therapies for BDBV yet. WHO warns mortality could rise. Vaccine candidates prioritized: IAVI's rVSV Bundibugyo (rVSVΔG-BDBV-GP) shows preclinical survival benefits; 7–9 months to readiness for clinical trials; manufacturing preparations underway. ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo from Oxford University/Serum Institute also promising; first doses could be ready in 2–3 months for trials, with single-dose regimens for close contacts and two-dose regimens for healthcare workers. CEPI coordinating to accelerate development and manufacturing. Antibody therapies: MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceutical) recommended for trials; safe and broadly active in preclinical work; BARDA-supported. Regeneron’s maftivimab under evaluation; 500 Inmazeb doses donated to WHO for potential use if effective against BDBV. Survivor-derived antibodies like BDBV289-N show strong protection in animal studies. Antivirals: obeldesivir for post-exposure prophylaxis under study; remdesivir shows preclinical activity against BDBV; WHO considering remdesivir–monoclonal combinations. Diagnostics: limited testing capacity with deployed BioFire panels for BDBV detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス(ブンディブギョ株)のワクチン及び治療薬の開発状況はどこまで進んでいるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の新規株、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのブンディブギョエボラ患者906名、死亡223名、致命率40%という深刻な事態であり、承認済みワクチン/治療薬なしの緊急事態。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラ(BDBV)は2022年以降出現した新規株であり、承認済みワクチン/治療薬が存在しない。WHO警告での死亡率上昇リスク、複数の候補ワクチン/抗体療法の急速開発、CEPI/BARDA等による国際的支援体制が確立されている点で高い優先度。

article.articleHeadline: México, Canadá y EE.UU. refuerzan controles sanitarios por ébola de cara al Mundial 2026 - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico, Canada and the United States strengthen health checks due to Ebola ahead of the 2026 World Cup
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan triggers health checks by Mexico, Canada, and the United States ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup (June 11). Mexico imposes a 60-day entry ban for travelers who have recently been in Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days. Canada suspends visas for residents of these countries; the United States bars entry from them. WHO does not advise travel bans on DRC or Uganda, while Italy seeks EU border surveillance for Bundibugyo Ebola variant. The DRC reports 129 confirmed cases with 18 deaths; 1,077 suspected infections and 246 suspected deaths; Uganda adds two new confirmed cases, nine total. Uganda–DRC border closure accompanies broader controls. AU allocates $319M to active zones; global funding nears $460M. The outbreak is potentially the second-largest by speed, with 11 other nations at high risk after Somalia’s addition.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、カナダ、米国が2026年ワールドカップを前にエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間感染事例であり、国際的な移動制限、渡航制限が既に実施されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明白である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されているDRCの感染事例（129確認症例、18死亡、1,077疑い例）が主体。ウガンダ（2確認症例）、南スーダンも言及されているが、提供対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。メキシコ、カナダ、米国の対応は二次的な措置であり、イタリアのEU内境界監視要求も含まれているが、これらは対象国ではない。エボラウイルス病による大規模国際的関心事案として確実なピックアップケース。

article.articleHeadline: Krig, kris och ebola - barnen drabbas värst
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: War, Crisis and Ebola — Children Are Hit Hardest.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Ituri province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is escalating, with most confirmed deaths among children and up to 14 districts now reporting transmission. An Italian surgeon who treated Ebola patients in Ituri is in quarantine in Rome after contact with the cases, amid concerns that the grenade-wounded child he operated on may have been infected. Save the Children’s Babou Rukengeza warns the outbreak is spreading faster than in past episodes, worsened by the protracted conflict and humanitarian collapse. About a million people are living in dense camps in Ituri, with hunger and water shortages; authorities have advised handwashing with sand. While more than 250 suspected Ebola deaths have occurred, only a minority are confirmed. Efforts focus on protecting children in schools and mitigating fear; cholera and measles outbreaks are also ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 戦争、危機、そしてエボラ — 子どもたちが最も被害を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、複数地域での確認、国際的なヒト移動による感染リスクが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）イトゥリ州でのエボラウイルス病の急速な拡大を報道。イタリアの医師が感染患者と接触後ローマで隔離されていることから国際的な懸念が存在。複数の疾患（エボラ、コレラ、麻疹）が同時発生。人口密集キャンプでの衛生状態の悪化が影響を増幅。紛争と人道的崩壊が管理を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Nashik NMC Anti Dengue Campaign | डेंग्यूमुक्त नाशिकसाठी मनपाची 62 पथके
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nashik NMC Anti-Dengue Campaign | 62 squads of the Municipal Corporation for a dengue-free Nashik
article.articleSummary: On 30 May 2026, Nashik Municipal Corporation's health department launched a robust anti-dengue and anti-malaria campaign across the city ahead of the monsoon. Under Municipal Commissioner Manisha Khatri, 62 squads are mobilized to implement targeted vector-control measures in dengue-sensitive areas, in clusters where cases were previously reported, and in neighborhoods prone to water stagnation. The initiative emphasizes intensive surveillance, source-reduction, and community awareness to curb transmission of dengue and malaria in Nashik city. The campaign focuses on preventing outbreaks during rainfall season, with no specific case or death counts provided in the report. The effort aims to deliver a dengue-free Nashik through proactive public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ナシク市民公社のデング熱対策キャンペーン | デング熱撲滅に向けた市民公社の62チーム
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防的キャンペーン活動の報道であり、実際の患者発生や流行の報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも明確には満たさず、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事は計画中の予防キャンペーンの公表であり、実際の患者発生数、死亡数、または流行の拡大の報告ではない。モンスーン前の先制的対策の実施を示すものであり、感染症イベントの顕在化ではないと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: International aid cuts complicate Congo's Ebola epidemic
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) exceeds 900 suspected cases with 220 deaths. WHO warns the epidemic will worsen and seeks rapid deployment of equipment and experts, but funding gaps persist after the US withdrawal. Germany, a major donor, has cut contributions and reduced the BMZ budget, impacting health programs and voluntary WHO funding. Aid groups like CARE and Caritas urge increased investment and education; in Goma only about 30% of demand can be met amid destroyed hospitals and scarce equipment. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain dominates eastern DRC, with no vaccine or cure; urgent needs include rapid testing kits and laboratory capacity. A vaccine for this strain would take at least nine months to develop, per experts. BMZ plans to dispatch or establish an expert group to train aid workers, while overall funding remains uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: 国際援助削減がコンゴのエボラ流行を複雑化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、深刻な死亡率（900疑い例中220死亡）と国際的な資金不足による管理困難が明確。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性全て該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strainはワクチン未開発であり、9ヶ月以上の開発期間が必要。米国の援助撤退とドイツを含む主要ドナー国の資金削減により、検査キット・ラボ能力等の緊急需要に対応できない状況。Goma市の医療施設崩壊により30%の需要充足率に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Deal or ordeal: Nursing of foreign Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, Uganda backs plans to treat US nationals infected with Ebola in Ugandan facilities, citing its extensive Ebola experience from West Africa (2014) and ongoing capacity building. The move follows a December MoU with the United States for a $2.3 billion health-funding package (Shs8.64 trillion) for 2026–2030, with the US committing up to $1.7 billion toward HIV/AIDS, TB, malaria, maternal/child health, polio eradication, disease surveillance, and emergency preparedness; Uganda will raise domestic health spending by more than $500 million (Shs1.87 trillion) as US support tapers. Ugandan officials, including Dr Joseph Nyanzi and Dr Diana Atwine, say Ugandan hospitals can handle foreign Ebola patients and that collaboration will benefit health security. President Museveni supports establishing a continental Ebola Incident Management Coordination Centre in Kampala, and Africa CDC envisions a regional centre for Ebola in Kampala; Uganda reiterates it will not export Ebola but support neighbors like DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 対外的課題：外国人エボラ患者の看護
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病を含む複数の重大疾患が言及されており、国際協力による保健体制強化の動きが報告されている。ただし、新規発生事例の報告ではなく、既存の技術協力・施設対応に関する内容であり、即時のリスク上昇を示す具体的な臨床事例が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は主にウガンダの医療施設がエボラ患者受入れ能力を有することと、米国との保健協力MoUについて述べている。複数の重大疾患（HIV、マラリア、結核、ポリオ、エボラ）が言及されているが、新規の流行報告ではなく制度的・協力的な動きである。DRコンゴは隣国支援の文脈で言及されている。USA（対象国外）の患者については「計画中」であり、現実の流行状況ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la détection précoce est essentielle, alors que des vaccins sont évalués
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Early detection is essential, as vaccines are being evaluated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda are under close watch. As of Thursday May 28, the WHO reports 906 suspected cases in the DRC with 223 suspected deaths; 125 confirmed cases across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with 17 confirmed deaths. Uganda has seven confirmed cases, including one death, all linked to the DRC outbreak, with no evidence of sustained community transmission. In Geneva, WHO's Anaïs Legand noted transmission mainly occurs through caregiving, stressing the critical role of community engagement. Countermeasures are being evaluated: two candidate vaccines will be tested once doses are available; therapeutics prioritized for trials include monoclonal antibodies MBP-134 and maftivimab, plus remdesivir, while obeldesivir is studied for post-exposure prophylaxis. Case fatality from past outbreaks ranges 30-50%. Ongoing humanitarian challenges and a call by Tedros for a ceasefire to enable access.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：早期検出が重要、ワクチンが評価されている中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。DRCとウガンダでエボラが確認、複数国への拡大、高い致死率（30-50%）を示す確認済み事例。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生が主題だが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダはDRCアウトブレイクに関連した確定症例だが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ジュネーブ（スイス）の言及はWHOの発表場所であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 中國網紅被恙蟲咬不幸猝逝 疾管署：台灣6月是高峰期
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese influencer dies suddenly after being bitten by a chigger; Taiwan CDC: June is the peak season.
article.articleSummary: 39-year-old Chinese influencer from Yunnan died after scrub typhus infection from a chigger bite, underscoring rising risk in Taiwan where peak season is June–July. As of May 24, Taiwan reports 56 domestically confirmed scrub typhus cases, including 1 death, with Taitung 16, Hualien 10, and Kinmen 7. Scrub typhus in Taiwan is a Category 4 notifiable infectious disease; cases rise from April–May and peak in June–July, with a second wave in September–October, affecting eastern counties and offshore islands most. Transmission occurs via larval chiggers that bite in grasslands; no human-to-human spread. Incubation is typically 9–12 days, presenting with abrupt high fever, severe headache, chills, lymphadenopathy; after about a week, a red maculopapular rash and a painless black eschar at the bite site may appear, sometimes with pneumonia or liver dysfunction. Preventive measures include protective clothing, DEET/Picaridin repellents, quick bathing, and rodent-control at home; advise clinicians of exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のインフルエンサーが恙虫に咬まれて急死 台湾CDC：6月がピークシーズン
triage.triage_reason: 恙虫病は対象国（中国・台湾）で季節性の既知疾患であり、台湾での症例数（56例、死亡1例）は限定的。個々の死亡事例は注目されるが、IHR基準2つ以上の達成や国際的拡大の明確なリスクは認められない。ただし季節的ピークシーズンを迎える時期の情報として続報の監視が有用。
triage.notes: 恙虫病は台湾では既知の季節性感染症（Category 4届出疾患）で、毎年4月～10月に症例が発生する。2026年5月末時点での56例は累積数として管理可能範囲と判断。個々の死亡事例（インフルエンサー）は社会的関心が高いが、流行の拡大傾向を示す証拠は記事中に認められない。ただし6月のピークシーズン突入を控えた時期であり、症例数の推移を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: International Aid Cuts Complicate Congo's Ebola Epidemic | 🔬 LatestLY
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to surge in Ituri and North Kivu in eastern DRC, with more than 900 suspected cases and 220 deaths reported. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is neither vaccine nor cure, dominates the outbreak, and rapid testing kits and laboratory capacity are severely lacking. WHO warns the virus could keep spreading; it seeks to deploy equipment and clinical staff, but agency funds are constrained after the United States withdrew from the WHO. Germany’s BMZ has reduced contributions, with about €160 million earmarked for 2026–2027, and overall prevention funding trimmed, leaving only about 30% of demand met in the field. Advocates including Brot für die Welt, CARE, and Caritas urge a major funding boost; BMZ pledges expert deployment to eastern DRC, while acknowledging the need for vaccines and more robust health systems to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 国際援助の削減がコンゴのエボラ流行を複雑化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス疾患は最高リスク感染症であり、進行中の流行で死亡者200名以上、ワクチン不在の株の拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（Ituri及びNorth Kivu州）での進行中のエボラ流行に焦点を当てている。Bundibugyo株（ワクチン及び治療法なし）が優勢で、900件以上の疑似症例と220名の死亡が報告されている。米国のWHO離脱及びドイツの援助削減により、資金制約が深刻化し、現地での需要の30%しか満たされていない状況。国際的な支援及び注目が必要な案件である。

article.articleHeadline: OPASNOST Europa žarište čikungunja, virusa kojeg prenose komarci. Kina uvodi mjere slične Covidu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DANGER: Europe is a Chikungunya hotspot, a virus transmitted by mosquitoes. China introduces COVID-like measures.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is expanding beyond tropical regions as climate change extends mosquito ranges into Europe, North America, and East Asia. A Chinese-led study in Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology projects Northern and Central Europe, North America, and East Asia as future CHIKV hotspots, with 139 countries or regions at risk (about 21.3% of the world’s land area). In 2025, the Pan American Health Organization reported 502,264 chikungunya cases and 186 deaths across 41 countries or territories. CHIKV is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; first identified in Tanzania in 1952. Incubation 3–7 days; symptoms include high fever (>39°C), severe joint pain (hands, wrists, ankles), headache, rash, myalgia, fatigue, and joint swelling. Warmer temperatures accelerate viral development in mosquitoes; at 18–28°C, transmission may rise four to fivefold. China has implemented COVID-like measures; advised actions include vector surveillance, trained health workers, vector control, and rapid outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 危険：ヨーロッパはチクングニア熱の焦点、蚊によって感染するウイルス。中国はCOVID様の対策を導入
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアウイルスの大規模な地理的拡大予測（139カ国が危険にさらされている）、気候変動による蚊の生息域拡大、中国が新型コロナと同様の対策を導入する状況から、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが確認でき、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニアウイルスの世界的拡大予測を扱っており、中国が具体的な対策を導入している点が確認される。タンザニアは発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーではタンザニアはウイルスの原産地として歴史的に言及されるのみで、現在の発生地として主題になっていないため、検証対象地域から除外。139カ国が危険にさらされるという広範なリスク評価が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kenijski sud suspendovao američki plan za karantin oboljelih od ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court suspended the American plan to quarantine Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court in Nairobi suspended any agreement to establish an Ebola quarantine facility for Americans exposed to Bundibugyo virus in northeastern Congo, pending petitions against the plan. The United States planned to relocate exposed Americans to a Kenyan facility rather than repatriate them, but the exact location and Kenyan approval remained unclear. Kenya said it was discussing Ebola preparedness with the U.S. but declined to confirm a quarantine site. Washington proposed $13.5 million to support Kenya’s Ebola readiness, per Secretary of State Marco Rubio. The court’s halt followed petitions by Katiba Institute and the Kenyan Law Society citing public health risks and lack of public involvement. The Kenyan Medical Association warned of a strike if the plan proceeds, while ordinary Kenyans criticized hosting infected individuals. In Congo’s northeast, Bundibugyo virus has >1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15, with spread to Uganda (7 cases, 1 death). WHO suspects broader, under-reported spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの高等裁判所、エボラ患者の隔離に関するアメリカの計画を中止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）の国際的流行（コンゴで1,000以上の疑い例、220人以上の死亡、ウガンダへの拡大）が IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）の3項目に該当し、重症度とヒト-ヒト感染可能性が高く、管理可能性にも懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は DRC（コンゴ）のエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo virus）であり、ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。ケニアは感染地ではなく、隔離施設の提案に関する政治的対応が述べられているため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Einreiseverbot wegen Ebola: "Schutz der Bürger hat Priorität" - WM-Gastgeber ergreifen drastische Maßnahmen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Entry ban due to Ebola: "Protecting citizens takes priority" - World Cup hosts take drastic measures.
article.articleSummary: Ahead of the June 11 World Cup opening in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, authorities impose Ebola-related travel bans to protect public health. The United States (CDC) issues a 30-day entry ban for foreign travelers who have been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days. In Mexico, authorities implement similar restrictions; regulations set travel bans for 60 days, extending past the tournament's end. Mexican carriers Aeroméxico and Viva announce compatible measures. The bans target regions with the highest Ebola risk in Central Africa. The article notes the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Central Africa but provides no case counts or infection details. No explicit mention of imported/exported cases beyond the travel restrictions. The measures reflect a joint precaution by the three host nations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策の入国禁止：「市民保護が優先」 - ワールドカップ開催国が厳格措置を実行
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の中央アフリカでの流行が背景にあり、複数のスクリーニング基準に該当する可能性があるが、記事の主要内容は予防的な入国規制であり、具体的な感染者数や症例情報が不明なため、さらなる情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカでのエボラ流行を背景としつつ、主眼は米国・カナダ・メキシコの三国による予防的入国制限措置である。DRCおよびウガンダで流行が確認されているが、具体的な現在の症例数、死亡者数、流行状況については記事に明記されていない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。スーダン南部（South Sudan）についても対象国リストに含まれていない。中央アフリカは地理的大域であり、具体的な国家ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola scourges Congo, experts warn of link to eating wild animals - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, eastern Congo's Ebola outbreak linked to wild meat consumption has surpassed 1,000 suspected cases with at least 220 deaths since it was declared on May 15. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola species with no approved medicines or vaccines. Transmission is thought to begin with spillover from infected animals—often fruit bats—and to spread through close contact with the bodily fluids of sick or deceased patients, including during hunting, butchering, and processing wild meat. Public health experts urge intensified education on how Ebola starts and is transmitted, noting persistent demand for wild meat in the Congo Basin and the cultural role of wild game. The World Health Organization suspects the outbreak is larger than reported. Highlighted risks include wildlife trade, armed conflict, and displacement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを襲う中、専門家は野生動物の食肉消費との関連を警告 - CNBC TV18
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ東部でエボラアウトブレイク（1,000例以上、220死亡）が発生し、稀なBundibugyo種による深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が認識される。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは東コンゴでのエボラアウトブレイク発生が明確。Bundibugyo種（ワクチン・治療薬未承認）による感染、武装紛争・住民移動による拡大リスク、野生肉消費の文化的要因が指摘されている。WHOは報告症例数よりも実際の規模が大きいと推定。国境越え拡大のリスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo: la conexión con el consumo de carne silvestre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: The Link to Bushmeat Consumption
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is linked to ongoing bushmeat hunting and handling in Central Africa. In Kinshasa’s Masina market, vendors sell wild-caught meat, including antelope, rodents, and snakes, while some vendors still trade primate meat; wildlife consumption remains culturally entrenched, despite a deadly outbreak in the eastern DRC. Since May 15, government sources report more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 220 deaths; WHO estimates the true toll is higher. The current outbreak in eastern DRC is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved treatments or vaccines. Transmission from animals to humans occurs via hunting/processing of infected wildlife; human-to-human spread follows contact with bodily fluids. The response is hampered by armed conflict and displacement. Health authorities urge education about risk and a One Health approach to reduce interfaces between humans, wildlife, and the environment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：野生肉消費との関連性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常/予想外・国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行（1,000件以上の疑似症例、220人以上の死亡）で、スクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀な株で承認済みの治療法やワクチンがない。武力紛争と住民避難が対応を複雑化させている。One Health アプローチの必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, quando sarà pronto il vaccino contro il virus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: When will the Bundibugyo virus vaccine be ready?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with confirmed and suspected cases rising and Uganda reporting two additional infections, prompting cross-border controls and vaccination efforts. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya said a vaccine and drug are expected by the end of 2026, though no approvals yet; a Russian vaccine candidate targeting the Zaire Ebola strain is under review for potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). As of May 26, DR Congo reports 1,077 suspected cases (121 confirmed, 110 in Ituri) and 238 suspected deaths (17 confirmed); first recovery in DRC noted by WHO. Monitoring spans Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu across 3 provinces and 13 health zones. Uganda confirms two new cases (total 9 infections, 1 death); borders closed, 21-day quarantines for entrants from DRC. Nigeria identifies 21 of 36 states as high/moderate risk for importation; heightened surveillance at Lagos/Abuja airports and land borders, no confirmed cases yet.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ブンディブギョウイルスワクチンはいつ準備ができるのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。複数国での確認症例・死亡例、クロスボーダー感染、国境閉鎖措置が実施中。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはNigeria、Uganda等も含まれているが、記事サマリー上の実際の確認症例はDRCとUgandaのみ。Nigeriaは高・中程度のリスク評価と監視強化のみで、確認症例なし。評価対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、DRCで121確認症例、238疑似症例、17確認死亡が記録されている極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Darurat Ebola, Relawan Kesehatan Gencarkan Edukasi Pencegahan |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Emergency in Kongo, Health Volunteers Ramp Up Prevention Education | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: Health volunteers in Goma, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, distributed Ebola prevention education at markets and public places on May 29, 2026, aiming to raise awareness of Ebola risks and early protective actions. The World Health Organization has stated that the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. No case or death toll is given in the report, amid the ongoing outbreak in the region. The effort underscores international attention and ongoing public health messaging to reduce transmission while awaiting further outbreak data. Focus remains on community engagement and rapid reporting of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ緊急事態、保健ボランティアが予防教育を強化｜Republika Online
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHOが国際懸念公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCのゴマ・北キブ州でのエボラ予防教育活動について述べられており、WHOがBundibugyo virusによるエボラアウトブレイクをPHEICとして宣言している。ウガンダも発生地域として列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCであり、ウガンダでの具体的な事例は記載されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。WHO PHEIC宣言の存在により、即座にフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）へ進むべき高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: НИЈЕ ДОБРО: Број особа за које се сумња да су заражене еболом сваким даном расте
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not good: The number of people suspected of being infected with Ebola is increasing daily.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo involves 1,028 suspected cases, with 225 laboratory-confirmed infections; 906 suspected cases were reported on Thursday. Since the outbreak began on 15 May, the World Health Organization records 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths, warning that the true scale may be larger due to undetected circulation. In neighboring Uganda, one death and nine infections have been reported, tied to travelers from Congo; Uganda has temporarily closed its border with Congo to curb spread. The affected Ebola strain is rare and currently has no vaccine or specific therapy. The WHO has declared an international health emergency over the Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 良くない状況：エボラ感染が疑われる人数が毎日増加している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み、確認感染225件、死亡10件確認、10日間で急速に拡大、隣国ウガンダへの越境感染確認、国境閉鎖措置実施。緊急対応が必要な高リスクシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事サマリーでウガンダでの二次感染確認が明記されており、国際的拡大の懸念は極めて高い。エボラウイルス病は現行ワクチン・特異的治療なしとの記載あり。WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言により、最優先度でのフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: NIJE DOBRO: Broj osoba za koje se sumnja da su zaražene ebolom svakim danom raste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: NOT GOOD: The number of people suspected of being infected with Ebola is increasing daily.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows 1,028 suspected cases, with 225 laboratory-confirmed infections. The previous day reported 906 suspected cases. Since the outbreak’s May 15 start, the World Health Organization notes 10 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths, acknowledging the true scale may be higher due to undetected transmission. In neighboring Uganda, nine infections and one death have been reported, linked to travelers from Congo; Uganda has temporarily closed the border to curb spread. The Ebola strain is rare and currently lacks a vaccine or specific therapy. The WHO has declared an international health emergency for the Congo-Uganda outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 良くない状況：エボラウイルス感染が疑われる人の数が毎日増加している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラアウトブレイクは確認病例と死亡が発生し、国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの越境）、WHOの国際保健緊急事態宣言があり、渡航制限（ウガンダの国境閉鎖）も実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国での主要なアウトブレイクが主題であり、ウガンダへの越境感染も言及されているが、ウガンダ（対象国リストにない）のみでの独立したイベントではなく、コンゴからの関連イベントとして記述されている。したがって verified_locations はコンゴ民主共和国のみとする。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、致命率の高さ、ワクチン・特異的治療法の欠如が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: ดีอี ยัน โควิด NB.1.8.1 ระบาดในไทย ผู้ติดเชื้อ 70% มีอาการเจ็บคอรุนแรง แค่ข่าวบิดเบือน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DEI confirms COVID-19 NB.1.8.1 is spreading in Thailand; 70% of those infected have severe sore throats; it's just misinformation.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Department of Digital Economy and Society (DEI) confirms the COVID-19 variant NB.1.8.1 is circulating in Thailand but rejects the claim that over 70% of infections cause severe sore throat as misinformation. Analysis from Jan 1, 2025 to Apr 23, 2026 shows NB.1.8.1 was the dominant lineage, comprising 50.95% of samples. The variant carries multiple spike-protein mutations relative to JN.1, linked to higher transmissibility and immune evasion, though there is no evidence of greater disease severity. During May 10–16, 2026, Thailand reported 12,700 new COVID-19 cases, with hospital admissions averaging 73 per day, and NB.1.8.1 detected in more than half of tested cases. AFNC had previously flagged the 70% severe-throat claim as misinformation; DEI emphasizes vigilance against tech-fraud and misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: タイのDEI、COVID-19亜種NB.1.8.1がタイで流行していることを確認；感染者の70%が重度の咽頭痛を有するという主張は虚偽情報である
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19 NB.1.8.1亜種がタイで流行しており、IHR基準の異常性と国際的拡大のリスクに該当する可能性があるが、タイの公衆衛生当局が『重度の症状に関する情報は虚偽』と明確に否定しており、情報の信頼性と実際の脅威レベルに不明確性がある。継続的な情報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はタイの公式な感染症予防管理機関（DEI）による否定的声明が中心となっている。NB.1.8.1亜種は実際に流行しており、伝播性は高いが、重症度についての虚偽情報が拡散していることが主要な懸念である。実際の流行規模（5月10-16日の12,700例/週、入院73例/日）は検討の対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Η κλιματική αλλαγή απειλεί την Ευρώπη με επιδημία του τροπικού ιού chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change threatens Europe with an outbreak of the tropical chikungunya virus.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus, historically confined to tropical and subtropical regions (Central and South America, the Caribbean, Indian Ocean islands, South and Southeast Asia, and Africa), threatens Europe and North America due to climate-driven mosquito expansion. Zhejiang University of Medicine researchers report warming favors Aedes aegypti (yellow fever mosquito) and Aedes albopictus (Asian tiger mosquito), with the latter driving more than 70% of projected spread. Early establishment of suitable vectors could enable local transmission; the virus, while rarely fatal, can cause prolonged joint pain and disability. First documented in 1952, chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and accompanies dengue, yellow fever, and Zika. About 33,000 cases have been reported so far this year. The WHO notes chikungunya as a neglected tropical disease; models predict risk expanding to north-central Europe, northeastern North America, and eastern Asia by 2100. Preparedness—vector control, clinician education, surveillance, and rapid response plans—could mitigate large epidemics.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がヨーロッパをチクングニア熱の流行で脅かす
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の国際的拡大リスク（ヨーロッパ・北米への拡大予測）、異常性（従来の熱帯地域からの地理的拡大）、媒介蚊の確立による継続的曝露リスクが複合的に存在し、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。また、気候変動との関連性から社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチクングニア熱のヨーロッパ・北米への拡大リスクに関するもので、Zhejiang大学の研究結果の引用が含まれている。ただし、実際の発生地域として記事で明確に述べられているのはChina（浙江省の研究機関）のみ。Africaは媒介蚊の発生地として言及されているが、新たな発生イベントではなく背景情報として位置付けられている。今年33,000例の報告があるとされているが、具体的な国の症例数や発生地の詳細は記事サマリーに記載されていない。2100年までの予測モデルに基づくリスク評価であるため、実時間の流行発生ではなく将来予測シナリオの提示という性質が強い。

article.articleHeadline: España creó unidades de alto aislamiento para virus como el ébola tras el caso de Teresa Romero: 'Hay medios para tratar los casos importados'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spain created high-containment units for viruses such as Ebola after the Teresa Romero case: 'There are means to treat imported cases'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has prompted renewed emphasis on high-containment capacity. The current outbreak, centered in Ituri with spillovers to North and South Kivu near Uganda, involves Bundibugyo lineage; vaccines for other strains offer limited cross-protection. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 16. More than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 suspected deaths have been reported. Spain’s experience dates to 2014 when Teresa Romero, a nurse at Madrid’s Carlos III Hospital, became the first Ebola transmission outside Africa, triggering the creation of high-containment units such as Ubuntu in Barcelona and the national UATAN network to handle imported or repatriated cases. Italy activated its Ebola protocol for two travelers from Uganda in Milan; Spain requires 21 days of health monitoring for returnees and urges contact via 112 if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: スペイン、テレサ・ロメロ事件後にエボラなどのウイルスに対する高度隔離施設を構築：『輸入症例を治療する手段がある』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,000+疑い例、246+死亡；異常：DRCでのアウトブレイク；国際的拡大リスク：複数国への感染警戒態勢；渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度：高い死亡率、多数の入院；流行しやすさ：ヒト-ヒト感染、対策不十分な地域）。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言（5月16日）により社会的・政治的関心が高い。対象国DRCでの実際の発生を確認。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としており、スペイン・イタリアの施設整備・プロトコル対応は二次的な背景情報。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに含まれるスペイン・イタリア・ウガンダは、記事上では対象国外であるため verified_locations には含めず、DRC（Ituri、South Kivu省での実発生確認）のみを検証地域として列挙した。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月16日）により、国際的な懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- La ONU confirma 18 muertos y 134 casos del brote de ébola...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo - The UN confirms 18 dead and 134 cases of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo accelerates: as of May 29, 2026, 18 deaths and 134 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 223 deaths and 906 suspected infections under investigation. Originating in northern DR Congo, Ituri Province is the epicenter (88% of confirmed cases, 110), with Bunia (37), Rwampara (33), Mongbwalu (20) and Nyankunde (10) the hardest-hit localities. Among 17 confirmed DR Congo deaths, 10 are men (9 aged >15, 1 <15) and 7 are women (5 aged >15, 2 <15). Since May 21, 49 new cases and 8 new deaths have been confirmed; 160 suspected cases and 47 possible deaths added in the past week. One confirmed U.S. case treated in DR Congo is now in Germany. By May 27, 2,635 contacts were identified in Ituri and North Kivu. Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases (7 new since May 21) and 1 death, with 436 contacts; cross-border transmission continues amid security challenges in Ituri, including about 150 civilian deaths recently.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo - 国連がエボラ出血熱の流行で18人の死亡と134件の確定症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、米国、ドイツ）、重篤な死亡率、確定症例の急速な増加、IHR基準3つ以上該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地であることが明確。ウガンダ、米国、ドイツへの拡大も記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。セキュリティ上の課題により対応困難。連続的なヒト-ヒト感染と国境を越えた伝播が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, in Italia obbligo dichiarazione per chi proviene da Congo e Uganda - Notizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, in Italy mandatory declaration for those arriving from Congo and Uganda - News.
article.articleSummary: Italy enforces a mandatory declaration and reporting obligation for anyone arriving directly or indirectly from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda, or who has been in those areas within 21 days prior to entering the country, in relation to Ebola risk. The measure is formalized in an ordinance published in the Gazzetta Ufficiale and officially signed by Health Minister Orazio Schillaci. The Health Ministry has also issued an implementing circular detailing how the rules are to be applied. The move represents a precautionary surveillance step aimed at preventing Ebola importation and transmission, enabling rapid notification and monitoring of potentially exposed travelers. The report notes no case counts or confirmed transmissions; the focus is on travel-related health declarations and public health oversight.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：イタリアではコンゴとウガンダからの入国者に申告義務が課される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱は国際的な公衆衛生の脅威であり、イタリアが渡航制限的な措置（申告義務）を導入しており、IHR基準3つ以上該当。DRC/ウガンダからの輸出リスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にイタリアとウガンダが含まれるが、記事の主題は『DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行に対するイタリアの入国制限措置』であり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、イタリアも対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないが、エボラの国際的脅威の深刻性とIHR基準の複数該当によりPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, in Italia obbligo dichiarazione per chi proviene da Congo e Uganda - Ultima ora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, mandatory declaration in Italy for those arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda — Breaking News.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak risk prompts Italy to require mandatory declaration and reporting for travelers arriving directly or indirectly from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, or who have been in those areas within 21 days before entering Italy. The obligation is established by an ordinance published in the Gazzetta Ufficiale and signed by Health Minister Orazio Schillaci; the Health Ministry has issued an implementing circular detailing compliance. The measure aims to bolster border surveillance for potential Ebola exposure, imposing duties to declare and communicate health information to authorities upon arrival. No case counts or outbreak data are provided in the article, which focuses on the legal framework governing entry screening and reporting for at-risk travelers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、イタリアがコンゴとウガンダからの入国者に申告義務を課す——速報
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国際的リスクを受けた渡航規制（申告義務）が発令されており、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当。複数国での流行兆候とイタリアでの公式対応により公衆衛生対策が発動されている。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアの行政措置（申告義務）について報じているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国外であるため除外。記事には具体的な症例数や死亡例が記載されていないため、発生地での状況は不明だが、イタリア当局が公式措置を講じた事実は重要。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Chef richtet emotionalen Appell, während er zum Epizentrum des Ebola-Ausbruchs aufbricht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief makes an emotional appeal as he heads to the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain) with no vaccines or treatments. As of May 29, at least 246 deaths among about 1,200 suspected cases, with Ituri accounting for roughly 90% of cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus travels to the epicenter, publishing an open letter on X in English and Lingala to regain trust and lead frontline efforts. Attacks on treatment centers and a blaze at an MSF facility hinder response; Ituri Governor Johnny Luboya Nkashama bans motorcycle transport of corpses and certain funeral practices to curb spread. Tedros urges a temporary ceasefire among armed groups to allow health workers access, calls on residents to seek care, and promises safe, dignified burials. The message is signed with 'Paluku'—Ituri for 'first-born son'—and underscores the outbreak as one of the largest and most challenging in recent history.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱の震源地に向かう中、感情的な訴えを発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模アウトブレイク、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。また、WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイコラウイルス株）の大規模アウトブレイクで、約1,200例の疑似患者と246人以上の死亡が報告されている。治療施設への攻撃やMSF施設の火災により対応が阻害されている状況。WHO事務局長自らが現地入りし緊急対応を指揮していることが、国際的な関心度の高さを示している。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Niente vaccinazione preventiva per una variante del virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No prophylactic vaccination for an Ebola virus variant.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda involves tens of deaths, with more than 500 suspected or probable infections and about 130 fatalities. On 16 May 2026, the WHO Director‑General declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, triggering international alerts and a coordinated response. Bundibugyo, an Orthoebolavirus, is zoonotic, with fruit bats suspected as the natural reservoir; human infection occurs via close contact with blood or secretions of infected animals, and spread between people through direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other fluids, including contaminated surfaces. Italy’s Ministry of Health issued a circular to activate health surveillance for all personnel returning from affected zones, with mandatory landing at Rome Fiumicino or Milan Malpensa for flights carrying suspected cases. There is currently no vaccine for this variant; production would take at least two months to yield a theoretical vaccine. The Mediterraneo Foundation advocates avoiding preventive vaccination due to limited spread risk in Italy.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス変異体に対する予防接種なし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。PHEIC宣言済みのBundibugyo Ebola（多数の死亡と500以上の感染者）であり、イタリアでの監視体制確立。フルRRAに進む必要あり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola変異体の発生。サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。イタリアへの導入リスク言及あり。2026年5月16日にWHO PHeIC宣言済み。死亡者約130名、疑い例を含む感染者500以上。当面ワクチンなし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Tingkat Kematian Ebola Bundibugyo Sampai 50 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Bundibugyo Ebola case fatality rate up to 50%
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda shows a case fatality rate up to 50%. WHO emergency program official Anais Legand said on May 29, 2026 that historically fatality among lab-confirmed Bundibugyo cases ranges 30–50%. As of May 28, 2026, 125 laboratory-confirmed cases and 17 deaths have been reported across 13 health zones in the DRC; WHO cautions cases will rise with expanded testing. Worldwide, 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 deaths have been recorded.
