Despite bans, illegal wildlife trade and bushmeat consumption persist, with Congo Basin bushmeat exports estimated at about 4.5 million tonnes annually.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家がコンゴのエボラ流行とブッシュミート消費の潜在的な関連性について警告 - ショルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,000件以上の疑似患者、220人以上の死亡；予想外：Bundibugyo ebolavirus株；国際的拡大リスク；渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。ザンビアは記事の直接主題ではなく対象外。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Ebola第5種）は稀な株であり、承認されたワクチンまたは治療法がない。東部DRCの暴力と住民の移動により対応が複雑化。ブッシュミート消費に関連した人獣共通感染症の警告として重要。Bluedot APIに'United States'が含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCのみであり、米国のCDCコメントは参考情報に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, obbligo di dichiarazione per chi arriva da Congo o Uganda: l'ordinanza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, mandatory declaration for those arriving from Congo or Uganda: the ordinance.
article.articleSummary: Italy imposes a mandatory 24-hour declaration for anyone entering from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda, or who has recently been in those areas (within 21 days), amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus (Bvd) within the Ebolavirus genus. The Health Ministry ordinance, published in the Official Journal, entered into force on May 29, 2026 and is valid for 120 days. Arriving travelers must complete, sign, and submit the declaration to the local ASL Prevention Department within 24 hours. Carriers—airlines, shipping lines, airport operators, and port authorities—must provide the declaration forms to passengers from Congo/Uganda before entry. The measure also outlines prevention steps and medical-epidemiological risk assessment criteria, with regional authorities responsible for disseminating transmission modalities and related forms. WHO has designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) for this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴまたはウガンダからの入国者に申告義務 - イタリアの指令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHOがPHEIC指定済み。フルRRAに進む必要あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ発生地はコンゴとウガンダと明記されています。しかし対象国リストには DRC（203312）のみが含まれるため、verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙します。イタリアはシグナルトリアージの対象国に含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEIC指定済みの高優先度イベント。Bundibugyo virus（Bvd）系統の記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Five things to do during disease outbreak
article.articleSummary: May 2026: WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighbouring Uganda a global public health emergency after hundreds of suspected cases and deaths. The article outlines five key actions during disease outbreaks: strict personal hygiene with regular handwashing; avoid self-medication to prevent masking symptoms and misdiagnosis; isolate infected individuals to interrupt transmission chains; take vaccines to strengthen immunity and lessen illness severity; and cooperate with health guidelines such as wearing masks, maintaining physical distancing, and early symptom reporting. It notes that CDC and WHO emphasize urgent investigations, surveillance, and coordinated responses, and that public awareness and trust are essential to limit spread and reduce social and economic disruption during outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病流行時にすべきこと5つ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO が世界的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ発生で、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC とUgandaの両国でのエボラ発生が言及されているが、対象国リストには DRC（203312）のみ含まれる。Uganda（226074）は対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。WHO 宣言による世界的公衆衛生上の緊急事態の確立により、緊急度最高。

article.articleHeadline: زامبيا تعزز إجراءاتها بعد استبعاد حالتي اشتباه بالإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zambia steps up its measures after ruling out two suspected cases of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Zambia announced that laboratory tests ruled out two suspected Ebola cases after initial reports, as authorities bolster border controls to prevent cross-border transmission amid regional concerns. The country says the risk of importation remains high and has deployed specialized testing tools at all entry points and heightened nationwide surveillance for suspected cases. Regional alarm centers on the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola currently flaring in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where suspected cases have risen to 1,028, with Uganda reporting infections as well. The Bundibugyo lineage, first identified in Uganda about two decades ago, raises concerns due to its tendency to spread in densely populated areas before detection, complicating contact tracing and containment. According to the World Health Organization, Ebola begins with influenza-like symptoms—fever, fatigue, muscle pains, sore throat—potentially progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、エボラ疑い例2件を除外した後に対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、管理可能性）。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の地域的流行に対する多国間の対応事例として、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはザンビアでの疑い例除外を主題としつつ、DRC および Uganda における Bundibugyo エボラの流行拡大に焦点を当てている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事言語はアラビア語で、地域メディア（sawtbeirut.com）からの報道であり、中東地域の感染症監視ネットワークでの関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Public Health Officials in Tarrant County Are Monitoring Travelers Arriving From Ebola-Affected Countries
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo is prompting monitoring in Tarrant County, Texas, as public health officials track travelers arriving from Ebola-affected countries. In Kampala, Uganda, Ugandan Red Cross workers wearing protective suits evacuated the body of a suspected Ebola victim and are assisting with transport to treatment centers and safe, dignified burials following confirmed positive results. Three additional Ebola Bundibugyo cases have been laboratory-confirmed, bringing the Uganda-linked total to five in people who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). In the DRC outbreak, 119 deaths have been reported among 904 suspected cases. The World Health Organization has classified the outbreak in both the DRC and Uganda as a public health emergency of international concern. This situation is current as of May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: タラント郡の公衆衛生当局がエボラウイルス感染国からの渡航者の監視を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）の国際的拡大が確認され、IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべて該当。DRC、ウガンダでの確定患者と死亡事例、WHO による国際公衆衛生上の重大事象宣言（PHEIC）がある。テキサス州での監視体制構築は国際的な懸念を反映している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでの確定患者と死亡事例、WHO による PHEIC 宣言を明示しており、テキサス州での監視はこの国際的拡大への対応。米国内での患者発症報告は記事サマリーに記載されていないため、テキサスは verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Во Конго има 1.028 сомнителни случаи на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, there are 1,028 suspected cases of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 1,028 suspected Ebola cases, up from 906 the previous day, with 225 laboratory-confirmed infections, Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15 in the DRC, the World Health Organization (WHO) notes 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths, warning the outbreak could be larger as the virus circulated undetected for some time. In neighboring Uganda, authorities report one Ebola death and nine infections, with cases officially confirmed as of May 15; these were linked to travelers from the DRC, leading Uganda to temporarily close its border with the DRC to curb cross-border transmission. The WHO has declared an International Health Emergency over the Ebola situation in both the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1,028件のエボラ疑似症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済みのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク。確定例・死亡例の増加、国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、境界閉鎖による貿易影響が顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダ（Uganda）も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。ウガンダの事例は DRC からの輸入症例として記述されており、主要アウトブレイク地はDRC。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: في كينيا.. المحكمة توقف خطة أمريكية لإنشاء منشأة حجر صحي لإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, the court halts a U.S. plan to establish a quarantine facility for Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court temporarily blocked the U.S. plan to establish an Ebola quarantine and treatment facility in Kenya for Americans potentially exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The proposed Laikipia Air Base site, about 201 km north of Nairobi, would start with 50 beds and later add isolation capacity for care and monitoring. The injunction follows a pledge by U.S. officials that the United States would not allow Ebola cases on its soil. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, involves the Bundibugyo strain, with at least 238 deaths and more than 1,000 suspected infections; Uganda reports one death and seven confirmed cases. Kenyan authorities are barred from operating any Ebola facility under agreements with the United States or other foreign governments until the legal challenge is resolved, with a hearing set for June 2. Kenyan doctors’ and lawyers’ unions warn of potential importation and call for transparency.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラ隔離施設についての米国計画を裁判所が停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの現在の流行）と、複数国間の医療対応に関する重大な公開討論があり、IHR基準とWPRO基準の複数項目で該当。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの法的措置を主題としているが、感染症イベント自体はDRCとウガンダで発生している現在進行中のエボラ流行である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。国際的な感染症対応の複雑さと法的障壁が注目されており、シグナルとして優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO urges vigilance as Ghana steps up Ebola surveillance
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola driving a regional outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with cases extending into Uganda; on 16 May the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. As of 29 May, the region reports more than 1,260 suspected and confirmed cases and over 240 deaths. Ghana has recorded no cases but is urged to stay vigilant as it strengthens surveillance at entry points and health facilities in line with WHO guidelines. Authorities have intensified readiness at Kotoka International Airport, Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research, and the Ghana Infectious Disease Centre to prepare for any imported case. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms including fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhoea, and bleeding in severe cases. Emphasis on prevention and early reporting.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがガーナのエボラ出血熱監視強化を促す中、警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴで進行中のBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1,260例以上、240死亡以上）が地域的に拡大し、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。国際的拡大リスクが高く、複数国での対応が進行中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolaは承認ワクチン・特異的治療がなく、体液との直接接触で感染。DRCで進行中のアウトブレイクがウガンダへ拡大し、ガーナは予防的警戒態勢を強化。PHEICは2026年5月16日に宣言済み。公衆衛生上の最高レベルの懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri: la riposte contre Ebola freinée par les croyances communautaires, selon le ministre de la santé | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: the Ebola response slowed by community beliefs, according to the Minister of Health | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, hampers response due to community beliefs and low adherence to health measures, Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba said in Bunia on May 29. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain and has seen several suspected deaths not promptly reported, complicating surveillance and patient management. Some families prefer traditional remedies, suspecting poisoning rather than Ebola infection. Psychological distress followed the funeral of the first patient on April 27, with coffin use fueling distrust of response teams. Authorities urge closer collaboration with communities as risk communication, surveillance, and contact tracing continue. Cross-border movement with neighboring countries raises regional concerns. The DRC currently reports 225 confirmed Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | イトゥリ：エボラ対応が地域社会の信念によって阻害されている（保健大臣発表）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の確定患者225名が報告されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 2026年5月30日時点の報告。イトゥリ州での確定患者225名、Bundibugyo株。地域社会の信念による対応の遅延、死亡報告の遅れ、国境を越えた移動による地域的懸念が報告されている。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: बालोद में चमगादड़ों की रहस्यमयी मौत, दल्लीराजहरा में रोज 50-70 मृत, जांच के लिए सैंपल भोपाल भेजे
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious bat deaths in Balod, 50-70 die daily in Dalli Rajhara, samples sent to Bhopal for investigation.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, in Balod district's Dalli Rajhara area of Chhattisgarh, India, daily bat deaths have reached 50-70, prompting a joint investigation by the Forest Department and Veterinary Department. Samples from deceased bats have been sent to a laboratory in Bhopal for detailed testing. Initial considerations point to extreme heat and possible infection; definitive cause awaits laboratory results. Affected authorities, including DFO Abhishek Agarwal, are monitoring the situation. The public is advised not to touch dead or sick bats and to report sightings. The investigation aims to identify the infection source and assess any human health risk; no conclusions yet.

triage.headline_ja: バロード地域のコウモリの不可解な死亡、ダッリラジハラで1日50～70頭が死亡、調査のためサンプルがボパール送付
triage.triage_reason: 未知の疾患による動物死亡イベント（コウモリ）で、感染と熱波の可能性が指摘されている。人的影響との関連性が不明であり、病原体特定前段階のため、追加情報と検査結果の報告を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は動物（コウモリ）の大量死亡イベントであり、未知疾患の原因が特定されていない。感染と熱波の可能性が初期段階で検討されているが、人間への直接的な健康リスクはまだ評価されていない。サンプル検査結果とさらなる情報開示を待つ必要がある。森林局と獣医局が合同調査を実施中。公開情報からは病原体の種類と人間への伝播リスクが不明である。

article.articleHeadline: Fußball-WM: Wegen des Ebola-Virus gelten Einreisebeschränkungen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA World Cup: Entry restrictions apply due to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, Ebola outbreaks are reported in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and parts of Uganda, with DR Congo recording over 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths; Uganda’s numbers are lower. In response, the United States, Canada and Mexico announced coordinated entry restrictions for the FIFA World Cup, including a 30-day ban for travelers who have been in Uganda, DR Congo or South Sudan in the previous 21 days (CDC). Mexico enforces 60-day restrictions after the tournament; Canadian measures were part of the tri-nation plan. The Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus has no vaccine or specific therapy. Historical outbreaks include West Africa (2014–2015, over 11,000 deaths) and eastern DR Congo (2018–2020, about 2,300 deaths). DR Congo's World Cup squad will train in Houston; group K opens June 17 vs Portugal, with Guadalajara (vs Colombia) and Atlanta (vs Uzbekistan) to follow. A US entry would require a three-week bubble quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: サッカーW杯：エボラウイルスのため入国制限が適用される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数国での同時発生、国際的な渡航制限が発生している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載されるウガンダ及び南スーダンは対象国外のため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRC（対象国ID 203312）での活動に基づく国際的な渡航制限が主要な焦点である。2026年5月30日現在、DRCで1,000件以上の疑い症例と約250死亡が報告されており、ワクチンや特異的療法が存在しない危険性の高い病原体。

article.articleHeadline: ONU confirma 18 mortos e 134 casos em surto de ébola na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN confirms 18 dead and 134 cases in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to evolve rapidly with cross-border transmission to Uganda. The World Health Organization reports 18 deaths and 134 confirmed cases, while 223 deaths and 906 suspected cases remain under investigation. Since the May 21 update, 49 new cases and eight more deaths were confirmed; 160 suspected cases and 47 deaths possibly attributable to the virus were added in the past week. One additional confirmed case is a United States citizen who treated patients in DRC and is now receiving care in Germany. Ituri remains the epicenter (88% of confirmed cases, 110), with Bunia (37), Rwampara (33), Mongbwalu (20), Nyankunde (10) most affected. Of 17 confirmed deaths in DRC, 10 are men and 7 women. By 27 May, 2,635 contacts in Ituri and North Kivu. In Uganda, nine confirmed cases (including one death) and 436 contacts identified by 26 May.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で18人の死亡と134例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予期しない国際的拡大、複数国への越境感染、渡航制限のリスク）。複数国での確認例と死亡報告があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、ルワンダ、米国、ドイツが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主体はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ流行。ウガンダは越境感染が確認されているが対象国リストに無いため除外。米国・ドイツは患者の治療国（二次的）であり発生地ではないため除外。Ituri州がエピセンター（確認例の88%）で、ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されている。WHO公式情報に基づいた報告で信頼度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, 5 livelli di rischio per chi arriva da Congo e Uganda. Ecco cosa fare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: five levels of risk for those arriving from the Congo and Uganda. Here's what to do.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk guidance for travelers entering Italy from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda outlines five risk levels with 21‑day monitoring. High‑risk exposures include close, unprotected contact with a symptomatic person; unprotected sex with a case up to three months after recovery; contact with fluids or contaminated materials from a probable or confirmed case; percutaneous or mucous‑membrane exposure; funeral rites with direct exposure to remains; and contact with bats, rodents, non‑human primates, or wild animal meat. Casual contact with a feverish but ambulant person is not considered high risk. The levels are: very low (asymptomatic, no area of attention exposure in 21 days); low (asymptomatic, no area exposure but non‑high‑risk exposures); moderate (asymptomatic, in an area of attention within 21 days but no exposures); high (asymptomatic, in an area of attention with non‑high‑risk exposure); very high (asymptomatic with high‑risk exposure). Measures include ASL contact, daily symptom monitoring, quarantine when required, and biocontainment transport for very high risk, all within 21 days of leaving the affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴとウガンダから到着する人々のための5つのリスクレベル。対応方法は以下の通りです
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症であり、DRC及びウガンダでの発生が報告されており、国際的な旅行制限やスクリーニング措置の実施が開始されている。IHR基準3つ以上及びWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリアへの入国者に対するリスク評価ガイダンスについて述べており、実際の発生地域はDRC及びウガンダである。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。イタリアは発生地ではなく、旅行制限や監視を実施する国であるため含めない。エボラ出血熱は致命率の高い重篤な感染症であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当する明らかなシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, in Italia scattano le misure ai confini: dichiarazione obbligatoria per chi arriva da Congo e Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: border controls take effect at Italy's borders; mandatory declaration for travelers arriving from Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, Italy imposes border controls and a mandatory declaration for travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda due to an Ebola outbreak in those countries. The Ministry of Health states that transmission risk from the Bundibugyo strain to Italy remains low, but the government has enacted precautionary measures. The ordinance, published in the Official Journal, is grounded in the principle of maximum precaution and is accompanied by a circular detailing operational procedures to prevent potential health emergencies on Italian soil. The measures target entrants from DRC and Uganda where the outbreak is ongoing, outlining steps for monitoring and response in the event of suspected importations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：イタリアの境界線で対策が発動。コンゴとウガンダから到着した旅行者のための義務的な申告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（高リスク病原体）の発生がDRC及びウガンダで確認されており、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。イタリアの強制的な国境対策発令は国際的な懸念を反映しており、シグナルとして識別する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ発生の主体はDRC及びウガンダであることが明記されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加した。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。イタリアはオブザーバー国として記載されているが、発生地ではなく対応国であり、対象国ではないため除外した。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ発生という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Kepala daerah se-Tanah Papua fokus percepat eliminasi TBC di Sorong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regional heads across the Land of Papua focus on accelerating TB elimination in Sorong.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) elimination efforts in Tanah Papua gain momentum as regional heads sign the Sorong Declaration in Sorong on May 30, 2026. The seven commitments aim to accelerate elimination through community-based sanitation, cross-sector collaboration, and enhanced hygiene in the Free Nutritious Meals (Makanan Bergizi Gratis) program. Key measures include developing community-based environmental monitoring, expanding capacity of environmental health workers, adopting health development models rooted in Papuan local wisdom, and strengthening community roles in maintaining a healthy environment. Beyond TB, officials emphasize food safety standards and sanitation from processing to serving meals. In Sorong City, 2025 TB case finding reached 1,003 (about 95% of target) with a 71% treatment success rate; January–April 2026 saw 410 cases found and managed. The declaration highlights sanitation, water access, ventilation, and behavior change as critical to reducing transmission and achieving regional TB elimination.

triage.headline_ja: パプア地域の地域首長がソロン市におけるTB（結核）排除の加速に焦点を当てる
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核排除の公式宣言と地域の取り組みが報告されているが、新規の感染症危機や急速な悪化を示す証拠が記事サマリーに明記されていない。予防・対策強化の政策イベントと解釈される。
triage.notes: 記事は結核患者の継続的曝露（長期流行性）を指摘しており、WPRO基準の「長期曝露」に該当。一方、新規クラスターや急速な増加ではなく、既存の地域流行に対する公式な排除宣言・対策強化の政策イベントである。2025年の症例数が目標の約95%達成、2026年1-4月に410例が報告されており、安定的な報告と管理が行われている。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、緊急性は低い。続報で新規の懸念が出現すれば再評価の対象。
