article.articleHeadline: Congo faces systemic issues in war on Ebola: 'Gotta have safety'
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces a volatile Ebola response as the 17th outbreak began around March 27 in Ituri province, near South Sudan and Uganda, with spread reaching Uganda while remaining concentrated in Ituri where nearly 1 million are displaced. WHO declared a public health emergency on May 17; Red Cross volunteers contracted the virus while working in Ituri. Health workers contend with dangerous conditions, scarce supplies, and repeated attacks on clinics. WHO estimates case fatality at 30–50%. Ongoing conflict involving CODECO, ADF, and M23 complicates surveillance and containment, raising concerns Ebola could become endemic in DRC. Historic context: 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak infected ~28,000 and killed >11,000, with spillover to the U.S., U.K., and Italy. Officials urge ceasefires and safer communities to enable effective response; U.S. risk of imported cases deemed low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴはエボラとの戦いにおけるシステム的問題に直面：「安全が必要」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み、複数国への拡大確認、高い致死率（30-50%）により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2026年5月17日にWHOが公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言。Ituri州での進行中の紛争が対応を複雑化。過去の2014-2016年西アフリカアウトブレイクとの歴史的背景あり。ウガンダへの拡大確認但し、WPRO地域外の情報のため verified_locations はDRC のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : un appui de 15 000 USD pour renforcer la prise en
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: a $15,000 grant to strengthen patient care.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease persists in the Nyankunde health zone, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo (Irumu territory). As of May 28, 2026, 12 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported, including 2 deaths. A $15,000 grant from a territory-born official was given on May 28 to Nyankunde General Referral Hospital, Evangelical Medical Center Nyankunde, to strengthen patient care, including nutrition for confirmed and suspected cases. Authorities say resources are stretched and call for intensified support to improve case management and halt transmission in Nyankunde. The Ituri Provincial Youth Council condemns precarious care conditions and urges the provincial government and external partners to provide sufficient resources to bolster the local health system amid ongoing Ebola response in this area of Irumu.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州におけるエボラ：患者ケアを強化するための15,000米ドルの助成金
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認患者と死亡例があり、リソース逼迫下での治療継続が必要であるため、シグナルとして認識すべき事案である。
triage.notes: DRC（イトゥリ州Nyankunde保健区域）で確認されたエボラウイルス病の継続的流行。2026年5月28日時点で12例の検査確認患者（死亡2例）が報告されている。記事では資源不足と外部支援強化の呼びかけが述べられており、地域当局および国際パートナーからの支援必要性が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: سازمان جهانی بهداشت: درمان و واکسن برای ابولا در دست بررسی است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Treatments and vaccines for Ebola are under review.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Early diagnosis and community engagement remain vital. As of 28 May 2026, WHO estimates 906 suspected DRC cases with 223 suspected deaths; Uganda reports seven confirmed cases including one death, all linked to the DRC outbreak, with no evidence of sustained community transmission. Anais Lagand, a WHO technical lead, said transmission occurs when caring for ill relatives, underscoring community involvement to halt spread. Two candidate vaccines are identified for evaluation once doses are available. For prevention, the oral antiviral Obeldsivir is prioritized for post-exposure prophylaxis in contacts of confirmed cases. For treatment, three candidates—MBP-134, Maftioimab, and remdesivir—are prioritized for clinical trials. Case-fatality for this strain is estimated at 30–50%. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for ceasefires to allow health workers access.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：エボラウイルス病の治療法とワクチンが審査中である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョエボラの継続的な流行により、DRCとウガンダで確認症例と死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはUgandaも発生地域として付与していますが、サマリーでは「ウガンダはDRC流行と関連する確認症例7件（死亡1件）を報告」と述べられており、主な発生地はDRCです。verified_locationsはDRCのみを含めました（Uganda は対象国リストに含まれないため）。ブンディブギョエボラの30-50%の高い致命率、複数国への波及、ワクチン・治療候補薬の開発段階が報告されている点が重要です。

article.articleHeadline: 美国想在肯尼亚建埃博拉隔离设施　肯尼亚人不答应
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States wants to build an Ebola isolation facility in Kenya, but Kenyans refuse.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, the United States proposed building a 50-bed Ebola isolation facility at Laikipia Air Base in Kenya to quarantine Americans rather than repatriating them; construction aimed to finish by May 29 with $13.5 million in funding. Kenya's High Court halted the plan on May 29, with a June 2 hearing against suits. Kenyan medical unions warned against turning Kenya into an 'isolation colony' for a non-native pathogen, threatening strikes; the Katiba Institute and the Kenyan Law Society filed suits over legality and public participation. The WHO on May 17 declared Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with Congo reporting 1,077 suspected cases and 238 deaths by May 26. US officials say no Ebola case will enter the US; meanwhile a symptomatic American doctor was treated in Germany, and six Americans were observed in Germany and the Czech Republic.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がケニアにエボラ隔離施設の建設を計画、ケニア国民は反発
triage.triage_reason: WHOが5月17日にコンゴとウガンダのエボラアウトブレイクをPHEIC宣言、1,077件の疑い症例と238人の死亡を報告。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的な対応と社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主要テーマはケニアでの隔離施設計画の政治的対立であるが、エボラアウトブレイクの実際の発生地はコンゴとウガンダ。対象国リストに基づき、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言により国際的な懸念事項として位置づけられている。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases in Congo rise to 1,028
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, Congo reports 1,028 suspected Ebola cases (Bundibugyo strain) up from 906, with 225 confirmed. Uganda has reported cases; Zambia has cleared two suspected cases after laboratory testing amid border-screening efforts, though a high cross-border risk persists. The Bundibugyo strain—no vaccine—has alarmed experts due to past undetected spread across a densely populated area, complicating contact tracing. The World Health Organization outlines typical Ebola symptoms starting with fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle pain, headache and sore throat, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding and potential multi-organ failure. Zambia has deployed screening tools at entry points to detect Ebola-like symptoms and prevent cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの疑似エボラ出血熱患者数が1,028人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）のアウトブレイク。IHR基準4項目全て該当：公衆衛生への深刻な影響（確認患者225人、死亡含む）、異常な病原体流行、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・ザンビアに波及）、渡航制限のリスク。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴが主たる発生地であり、ザンビアも国境スクリーニングと疑似患者対応で直接関与している。ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため除外。Bundibugyo株はワクチンがなく、過去に人口密集地での未検出拡大の懸念があり、専門家の警戒が強まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : une amélioration du dépistage et de premières guérisons en Ituri - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: an improvement in screening and first recoveries in Ituri - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, shows improved screening and initial recoveries. In Bunia, health authorities report 225 laboratory-confirmed cases among about 1,028 suspected; laboratory capacity has improved, enabling more precise counts and confirmation before designation. Some confirmed patients have died, others are recovering, with five recoveries anticipated after negative tests and a second confirmation. The outbreak remains across three provinces—Ituri (ten health zones), North Kivu (three zones), and South Kivu (one zone)—with no further geographic spread. The circulating variant is genetically distinct from Bundibugyo strains and linked to an animal reservoir. Emphasis on community engagement and stronger community health workers to boost early detection, surveillance, and risk communication. WHO-recommended measures include handwashing with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer when water is unavailable, PPE for health workers and caregivers, and safe burials by specialized teams. Historical context: first Ebola case in 1976 at Yambuku (Bumba); 2018–2020 outbreak in Mangina, Beni, Butembo caused about 2,200 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: イトゥリにおける検査の改善と最初の回復例 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認患者225名が報告されており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（Yes）、異常/予想外（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）の3基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡・回復報告）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染）、管理可能性の複数基準に該当。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則(IHR 2005)で通報対象疾患。記事は225名の確認患者、死亡・回復事例、3州への分散、動物由来ウイルスの言及を含む。過去の流行（2018-2020年で約2,200死）の参考情報もあり、現在の状況の監視体制強化の重要性が高い。WHO推奨対策の記述により国際連携が進行中と推察される。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО и ЕС насочват голяма финансова помощ за борба с епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго и Уганда
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and the EU are directing substantial financial assistance to fight the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: EU releases 15 million euros to fight Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with 5 million designated for the WHO and humanitarian operations in affected areas. Funds will enable rapid transport of 100 tonnes of urgent supplies to eastern DRC, including medicines, personal protective equipment, infection-control materials, tents, and frontline operation gear. A co-financing of 1.5 million euros for the WHO Regional Office for Africa in Dakar supports distribution of 6.3 tonnes of medical supplies in DRC, including sample collection kits, PPE, medicines, and rapid-action equipment for on-site teams. WHO Europe regional director Hans Kluge and WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi emphasize cross-border cooperation, surveillance, genomics, vaccine research, and on-the-ground deliveries as essential. This cooperation is part of a broader EU package to bolster outbreak preparedness and readiness in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO及びEUがコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行対策に大規模な財政支援を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患は重症度が高く、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当。DRCでの継続的な流行と複数国への拡大リスク、国際機関による対応の必要性があり、シグナルとしてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot発生地域に含まれていますが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ流行対策が中心であり、ウガンダは隣国への対策支援として言及されています。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラはWPRO地域外ですが、国際的な関心と対応の緊急性からピックアップ対象。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros Adhanom: "Sabemos que la RDC volverá a contener esta epidemia"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros Adhanom: "We know that the DRC will contain this epidemic again."
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces an Ebola outbreak in Ituri province's Bunia, linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus—the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country since 1976. The World Health Organization warns the risk is high in sub-Saharan Africa and low globally; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. The DRC has 246 suspected deaths; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases, including one death, with one case imported from a Congolese patient. The virus likely began circulating in Ituri about two months before the outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus met with Prime Minister Judith Suminwa and UN humanitarian teams, stressing stronger coordination and community engagement, including messaging through religious, business, and media networks. He plans to visit Bunia amid ongoing conflict and calls for a ceasefire to support response.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス・アダノム：「DRCがこの流行を再び封じ込めることができることを我々は知っている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（246人の疑い死亡）、異常/予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの症例輸出）の3基準に該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（治療法・ワクチンなし）による高リスク状況。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（治療法・ワクチン未開発）による深刻な流行。ウガンダへの国際的拡大が既に発生。紛争地での対応の困難性。WHOが「国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態」として宣言。

article.articleHeadline: زامبيا تحذر من ارتفاع خطر انتقال فيروس إيبولا عبر الحدود
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zambia warns of increased risk of Ebola transmission across borders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola transmission risk across the Zambia–Democratic Republic of Congo border remains high as regional transmission continues. Zambia’s Ministry of Health said the cross-border risk is very high and noted two suspected cases were ruled out after extensive laboratory testing. The ministry also said it has developed tools and protocols to detect Ebola infection, deploying them at entry points and for suspected cases inside Zambia. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, health authorities reported a rise in suspected cases of the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, a variant for which no licensed vaccine exists, reaching 1,028 suspected cases. The Africa CDC warned last week that the outbreak could spread to about ten African countries beyond DRC and Uganda, with Zambia among those at risk. The situation highlights the ongoing cross-border challenge of Ebola in the region as of May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアがエボラウイルスの国境を越えた感染拡大のリスク増加に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株の出現、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱は高致死性で地域的に重大な脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはザンビア・DRC国境でのエボラ伝播リスクを主題としており、両国での発生を述べている。ウガンダはBluedot発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは具体的な患者や対策の記載がないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチン未開発で特に懸念されるバリアント。Africa CDCによる広域拡大警告により国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: ผอ. WHO ลงพื้นที่คองโก ลั่น ยังคุม 'อีโบลา' ระบาดได้ พบหายป่วยรายแรก! - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General on field visit to Congo, asserts that the Ebola outbreak can still be contained; first recovered patient found!
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to bolster Ebola response to a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. DR Congo reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. Healthcare workers face PPE shortages, mistrust, and threats from armed groups. A lab-confirmed Bundibugyo virus patient has recovered and been discharged on May 27; five more infections are recovering. Three volunteers in Ituri Province died March 27, likely from Ebola contracted during public-health duties. Despite rapid spread, early signs point to containment being possible, though the outbreak circulated for weeks before detection in mid-May. Displacement from conflict and food insecurity hinder control, and attacks on health centers have occurred amid resistance to funeral practices.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴに現地入り、エボラ出血熱の封じ込めはまだ可能と主張；最初の回復患者が見つかった！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の異常、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準でも複数該当、且つWHO事務局長による現地視察など国際的・政治的関心が非常に高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (EBO-Bun)は重篤で致死率が高い。906例の疑い患者と223例の疑い死亡が報告。WHO事務局長による現地視察、医療従事者の防護具不足、武装集団からの脅迫、葬儀慣行への抵抗など複数の困難が存在。早期検出（5月中旬）前に数週間の流行が継続していた懸念もあり、フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, stretta sui viaggiatori in Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, tighter restrictions on travelers in Italy
article.articleSummary: Italy enforces a 120-day surveillance and travel-tracking regime for travelers from Ebola-affected areas to prevent spread of Bundibugyo virus (Ebolavirus) amid a Central African outbreak. The measure, published in the Gazzetta Ufficiale and signed by Health Minister Orazio Schillaci after WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern, mandates that anyone arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda, or who was in those areas within 21 days prior to entering Italy, must within 24 hours complete, sign, and send a declaration to the local ASL prevention department. Regions, airlines, shipping lines, airport operators, and port authorities are responsible for disseminating the declaration and providing necessary forms. A technical circular accompanies the ordinance, outlining preventive measures, clinical-epidemiological risk assessment criteria, and operational guidelines for managing suspected cases in Italy, including import-related considerations for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、イタリアの旅行者に対する規制強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。中央アフリカのエボラ総合流行（WHO国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言）に対するイタリアの対応措置であり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中央アフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）でのエボラ総合流行（Bundibugyo virus）に関連しており、イタリアはその対応国家である。WHO国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ministro de Saúde do Congo nega que surto de Ebola esteja "fora de controle"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo's Minister of Health denies that the Ebola outbreak is "out of control".
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with Bunia as the epicenter. Health Minister Roger Kamba rejects claims that the outbreak is out of control, calling for tempered interpretation amid international concern. The World Health Organization notes that insecurity and population displacement are directly affecting contact tracing and the ability to stem transmission. These operational gaps frame the ongoing response in a high-risk, unstable setting. By May 22, 2026, Uganda had two confirmed Ebola cases, including one death, signaling cross-border spread from the DRC. The report underscores political and logistical barriers to containment rather than new details on transmission or clinical features, highlighting the need for careful risk assessment as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの保健大臣、エボラ出血熱の流行が「制御不能」であることを否定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。複数国への越境拡大、死亡例あり、WHOが関心を示唆。フルRRA実施必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Bunia）でのエボラ流行と、ウガンダへの越境拡大を報告しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRCでの流行は継続中、接触追跡と感染伝播抑制に対する安全保障上の課題あり。政治的・後方支援上の障壁が強調されている。WHOが関心を示しており、国際的支援が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Africa Cdc: vaccino pronto entro fine 2026 * Imola Oggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Africa CDC: vaccine ready by the end of 2026
article.articleSummary: By end-2026, Africa CDC aims to have a vaccine and a therapeutic for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, as the Democratic Republic of Congo faces an ongoing outbreak with spillover risk into Uganda. Director-General Jean Kaseya said no vaccines or drugs are currently approved, but several candidates exist, and efforts are advancing. Africa CDC is coordinating with Russian researchers after a Russian vaccine was reported by the Russian health minister; an Africa Union health expert noted the vaccine targets the Zaire ebolavirus, and meetings will clarify potential efficacy against Bundibugyo. If a fourth Bundibugyo outbreak occurs, vaccines and treatments should be available, according to leadership. The remarks highlight perceived inequities in research and access, with Africa urging timely investments and equitable development of countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、アフリカCDC：2026年末までにワクチン準備完了
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行可能性が高く、現在進行中のアウトブレイクと隣国への波及リスクが明記されているため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに「Democratic Republic of Congo faces an ongoing outbreak with spillover risk into Uganda」と明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。ロシアの記載は地政学的協力に関するもので、発生地は DRC。Bundibugyo エボラウイルスの流行中、複数の候補ワクチン開発が進行中との報告があり、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, obbligo di dichiarazione per chi arriva da Congo o Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Mandatory declaration for those arriving from Congo or Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Italy has issued an Ebola-related ordinance requiring any person arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda, or who has been in those areas within the 21 days prior to entry, to complete, sign, and submit a health declaration within 24 hours to the Prevention Department of their local health unit. The measure, published in the Official Gazette, enters into force immediately for 120 days and concerns the ongoing Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)–related Ebola outbreak that prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Airlines, shipping operators, airport authorities, and port authorities must provide passengers with the declaration forms before entry. The Regions will disseminate transmission information via official channels, and the attached circular defines preventive measures and the medical-epidemiological risk assessment criteria. No laboratory confirmation or case counts are stated in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴまたはウガンダからの入国者に申告義務
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHO PHEICが宣言されたBundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）アウトブレイクに対するイタリアの検疫措置であり、国境防疫の実装段階を示す。
triage.notes: イタリアでの検疫措置は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCで進行中のBundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）アウトブレイクが対象。ウガンダは記事サマリーでエボラの発生地として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事にケース数や確定症例の記載がない点は注視。

article.articleHeadline: 專家：伊波拉全球流行可能性低　致死率高須嚴管 - 生活新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts: Ebola's global pandemic potential is low; its high mortality rate requires strict controls.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, Taiwan tightened border controls amid Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. From 00:00 on 2 June, entry for residents of DRC and Uganda will be suspended for 90 days, with four exceptions: degree students admitted to Taiwan, diplomatic or official staff, Taiwanese citizens’ non-citizen spouses and their minor children, and urgent or humanitarian cases such as bereavement or visiting seriously ill relatives. The health ministry also raised travel advisories to Level 3, requiring travelers with history to affected areas to report to quarantine stations and observe 21 days of self-health management, with penalties for noncompliance. WHO has elevated Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak to the highest level and declared PHEIC for both DRC and Uganda. Li Bingying urges strict border controls due to high mortality and contagiousness and calls for PPE for healthcare workers treating cases to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家：エボラの世界的流行の可能性は低い　致死率が高いため厳格な管理が必要
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス）のアウトブレイクにおいて、WHOがPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を宣言し、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。国際的な懸念が高く、複数国での確認と渡航制限の実施により、シグナルとしてピックアップすべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Bundibugyo Ebola virus）の発生は、2013年〜2016年のEbola virus disease流行とは異なる株。記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。台湾は国境対策を実施しており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。WHOによるPHEIC宣言は、すべてのシグナルスクリーニング基準を満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in Demokratischer Republik Kongo: Expertin sieht kaum Risiko für Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Female expert sees little risk for Europe.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo expands, but Europe faces only minimal risk, says Claudia Denkinger, professor of infectious diseases at University Hospital Heidelberg. As of 30 May 2026, imported Ebola cases in Europe are expected to be very few; widespread transmission in Germany or Europe is unlikely. Transmission requires direct contact with infected bodily fluids or exposure to animals, unlike airborne pathogens like COVID-19. Denkinger highlights three concerns from the Central African outbreak: no vaccines effective against the Bundibugyo strain circulating there; the outbreak appears largely undetected with many unrecognized cases; and Ituri and North Kivu are highly urbanized with significant mobility, including miners who travel home, raising spread risk. She notes Ebola’s high mortality and the need for sustained investments in diagnostics, vaccination, and treatment. A suspected Ebola case in Heidelberg was not confirmed; confirmed cases would be managed by STAKOB centers in Stuttgart, Frankfurt, and Munich.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行：専門家はヨーロッパへのリスクはほぼないと指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行は深刻な疾患であり国際的拡大リスクを持つが、記事はヨーロッパへのリスク最小化と専門家見解を強調しており、現在の欧州での実際の脅威レベルは限定的。情報が部分的であり続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ドイツ（ハイデルベルク大学病院）の専門家による評価記事。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準全5項目該当。ただしドイツの記事で、疑い例は未確定であり、欧州での確定例はまだ報告されていない。DRC のみを verified_locations に含める。対象国リスト外のドイツについては除外。

article.articleHeadline: 中美经贸磋商提到的"山东禽流感无疫区"是个什么区？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What kind of zone is the "Shandong avian influenza disease-free zone" mentioned in the Sino-U.S. economic and trade talks?
article.articleSummary: Shandong's 'avian influenza disease-free zone' (无疫区) is a government-designated area where no specified animal diseases have occurred within a defined period, with official controls on animal and animal-product flows and national acceptance. The concept, supported by the OIE, FAO, and WTO, dates to 1998, with earlier immunized zones such as the Jiaodong Peninsula for foot-and-mouth disease and high-pathogenic avian influenza. In August 2022, Shandong’s zones were assessed as free of these diseases, creating China’s first HPAI-free and FMD-free province. The province has invested over 5 billion yuan to install 91 warning signs, 58 supervision posts, 9 isolation facilities, and bolster veterinary networks and disposal/collection systems, lifting annual meat-egg-milk output to over 15 million tonnes (roughly 10% of China’s total). Exports now reach the EU, Japan, Korea, Middle East, with raw meat to Malaysia, Mongolia, Russia. A U.S. recognition could unlock additional imports; Fengxiang Co. processes ~600,000 chickens daily and exported over 100,000 tonnes in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 中米経済貿易交渉で言及された「山東省鳥インフルエンザ無疫区」とは何か
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザと口蹄疫の疾患が記載されており、中国の山東省における無疫区認定の経済的側面に関する報道。ただし、記事は主に行政的な地位と貿易への影響に焦点を当てており、実際の新規感染事例や公衆衛生上の急性の脅威を示していない。情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は山東省の既存の無疫区認定制度と経済的側面（輸出額、施設投資）に焦点を当てており、新規の感染事例や疾病発生の報告ではない。中米経済交渉の文脈で言及されているが、IHR基準の該当性は低い。ただし、高病原性鳥インフルエンザと口蹄疫に関する情報であるため、今後の発生動向を注視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: DOH hospital in Pampanga opens infectious disease center, referral laboratory
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-30, JBLMGH in the City of San Fernando, Pampanga, opened two infectious-disease facilities to bolster Central Luzon’s outbreak response: the Center for Infectious Diseases and Tropical Medicine and the Central Luzon Infectious Disease Referral Laboratory. The Center enhances isolation and clinical care with triage emergency room beds, Pediatric Intensive Care Unit beds, Adult ICU beds, isolation hemodialysis beds, an operating room bed, a delivery room bed, and isolation ward beds. The Laboratory provides diagnostic services for respiratory pathogens, vaccine-preventable diseases, dengue, leptospirosis, mpox, HIV, hepatitis, tuberculosis, and drug-resistant TB. The project aims to improve faster, more organized responses to infectious diseases across Central Luzon, with JBLMGH serving as a premier regional, tertiary DOH hospital.

triage.headline_ja: パンパンガのDOH病院が感染症センターと臨床検査室を開設
triage.triage_reason: 記事は感染症対応施設の開設という施設拡充のニュースであり、新規の疾病発生イベントではない。複数の疾患名が列挙されているのは診断対象疾患であり、実際のアウトブレイク情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから判断すると、これは感染症対応能力の強化を目的とした医療施設（感染症センターおよび検査室）の開設に関する施設ニュースである。複数の疾患名（Mpox、Leptospirosis、HIV、Hepatitis、TB、Dengue）が記載されているのは、新設検査室の診断対象疾患リストであり、これらの疾患で発生が急増しているという情報ではない。実際の患者数、症例の重症度、流行状況などの疫学的情報は記事に含まれていない。したがってシグナルトリアージとしての活動ピックアップの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 防範伊波拉禁2國居民來台　台大醫：致死率高、管制有必要
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent Ebola, ban residents of two countries from entering Taiwan; NTU physician: high fatality rate, restrictions are necessary.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan will suspend entry for residents of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda for 90 days starting June 2, 2026, in response to expanding Ebola outbreaks in these countries—the first border restriction since COVID-19 controls were lifted. World Health Organization data up to May 27 show the DRC outbreak spreading in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths, and 125 laboratory-confirmed cases with 17 deaths; Uganda has 7 confirmed cases and 1 death. Ebola virus disease is transmitted mainly by close contact and has a high fatality rate, prompting strict infection-control measures. Taiwan’s CDC Deputy Director Zeng Shuhui said the aim is to reduce imported risk. Both countries are at Level 3 warning; travelers with travel history must report to quarantine on arrival, and those asymptomatic enter a 21‑day self-health management program with daily reporting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱対策でDRCとウガンダからの入国を禁止　台湾；台大医師：致死率が高く、規制は必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の多国間での継続的な流行で、確認症例・死亡者が増加中。複数国が入国制限措置を講じている状況は公衆衛生上の重要シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にTaiwanが含まれているが、サマリーではTaiwanは台湾当局による入国制限措置の実施国であり、実際のエボラ感染症発生国ではないため除外。DRCのIturi及びSouth Kivu Provinceは確認。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Chinaには香港を含むものとして、アジア太平洋域内での対応状況として加算。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kudus mengajak warga jaga kebersihan cegah penularan Hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kudus Health Office calls on residents to maintain cleanliness to prevent Hantavirus transmission.
article.articleSummary: Kudus Regency Health Office, Central Java, urges residents to maintain cleanliness and healthy living to prevent Hantavirus transmission from rodents, particularly rats. As of 30 May 2026 there are no indications of Hantavirus transmission in Kudus. Emphasizes environmental hygiene at home, gardens, and surrounding areas and proper household waste management to deter rats. High fever is the common symptom, lasting up to three days, and should not be ignored. Health facilities in Kudus—hospitals and puskesmas—have been instructed to heighten vigilance and screen patients with fever. If suspected, patients undergo laboratory confirmation through blood tests and DNA testing to identify Hantavirus. Hantavirus differs from leptospirosis (which affects blood vessels) though both can be linked to rodents. Residents are also advised to monitor for other diseases such as hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) or Singapore flu, with differing transmission patterns.

triage.headline_ja: クドゥス保健局がハンタウイルス感染拡大防止のため住民に衛生管理を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャワ中部州クドゥス）でハンタウイルスの予防警告が発出されているが、現在のところ同地域での感染事例は報告されておらず、これは予防的啓発キャンペーンである。スクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があるが、確認事例の欠如と情報不足により、今後の続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは『2026年5月30日現在、クドゥスにおけるハンタウイルス感染の兆候は報告されていない』と明記されている。これは予防的啓発であり、現在のところ確認事例がない。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類由来で人から人への感染リスクは低いとされるが、記事は複数の疾患（エンテロウイルス71、手足口病など）を言及し、総合的な感染症警戒の文脈にあることが示唆されている。続報で実際の患者発生が報告された場合はPICKUPに昇格する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mientras el ébola azota Congo, expertos advierten de vínculo con el consumo de animales silvestres
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As Ebola ravages Congo, experts warn of a link to the consumption of wild animals.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, an unusual strain with no approved medicines or vaccines. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, authorities have confirmed over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths, with the World Health Organization warning that totals are likely higher. Transmission is tied to wildlife exposure and human contact with infected bodily fluids, with spillover often occurring during hunting, handling, and consumption of bushmeat. The Congo Basin’s wildlife trade sustains exposure, illustrated by Kinshasa’s Masina market selling wild meat. Ebola spreads via close contact with bodily fluids of sick or deceased patients, placing health workers at high risk. The region has had 17 prior Ebola outbreaks in the DRC; the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic infected about 28,000 people and killed over 11,300. Hunting endangered species is banned, but bushmeat trade persists, with annual extraction around 4.5 million tons.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを襲う中、専門家は野生動物の消費との関連を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,000以上の疑い例と220以上の死亡、異常なウイルス株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべて該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 東コンゴでのエボラ発生は承認済み医薬品やワクチンがないBundibugyo ebolavirus株による極めて深刻な事象。2014-2016西アフリカエボラ流行の歴史的背景あり。野生動物との接触・ブッシュミート取引に関連した持続的な曝露リスク。DRCは対象国に含まれ、安ゴラが発生地域に含まれるが記事サマリーではDRCが主要な焦点であり、アンゴラでの発生は記事本文で明記されていないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: IGAD urges robust regional preparedness against Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: IGAD urged urgent regional preparedness against the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. At an emergency ministerial meeting, IGAD health ministers assessed the rapidly evolving epidemiological situation and called for coordinated cross-border surveillance, strengthened border vigilance, and a harmonized regional response to mobility-driven spread. IGAD will reallocate seven million USD from the Regional Preparedness for Pandemic Response Project to support immediate measures, including screening at points of entry, enhanced surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, and risk communication. The Africa CDC said 11 other countries across Africa are at high risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, and Somalia. The region emphasizes sustained solidarity and preparedness to safeguard public health in the Horn of Africa and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: IGAD、エボラ出血熱の流行に対する堅牢な地域的対応準備を促進
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の地域的流行が確認され、複数国での拡大リスク、国際的支援体制の構築、高度な重症度と感染性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているエボラ流行の主要発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストではDRC（203312）とザンビア（895949）のみが該当。他のハイリスク国（南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、CAR、タンザニア、エチオピア、アンゴラ、コンゴ共和国、ブルンジ、ソマリア）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。IGAD地域的対応、7百万USD拠出、複数国スクリーニング実施など地域的対応体制が構築されており、高度な政治的関心と国際支援体制が確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: La Jornada: Aeroméxico acatará restricciones decretadas a viajeros por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Jornada: Aeroméxico will comply with restrictions imposed on travelers due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola travel restrictions were announced by Mexico, the United States, and Canada to curb potential transmission. Aeroméxico says it will comply with the restriction on travelers who have recently been in African countries within the last 21 days. The affected nations are Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan. Under the measure, individuals who have visited any of these countries in the prior three weeks face entry restrictions related to Ebola prevention. Aeroméxico confirmed adherence to the official directive, aligning airline operations with regional public health safeguards. The policy reflects ongoing cross-border efforts to limit Ebola exposure amid regional outbreaks, and is part of coordinated travel controls among North American countries to mitigate importation risk.

triage.headline_ja: La Jornada: Aeroméxico will comply with restrictions imposed on travelers due to Ebola.
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上に該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、国際的な渡航規制という社会的・政治的関心が高い事案。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで具体的に言及されているEbola発生国は、ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国、南スーダン。対象国リストから該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。米国・カナダ・メキシコの渡航制限は対応措置であり、発生地ではない。北米3国間の調整された渡航規制は国際的な公衆衛生の懸念を示す重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS revela cuán letal es el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO reveals how lethal the Ebola outbreak is.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports Ebola mortality in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) at 30–50%. Anaïs Legand of the WHO Emergency Programs High-Risk Pathogens Team provided the figure. By May 27, the DRC logged 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 deaths. By May 29, confirmed cases totaled 134 across two countries, including 9 in Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases. The latest update indicates increases since May 21 of 49 confirmed cases, 8 confirmed deaths, 160 suspected cases, and 47 suspected deaths, underscoring ongoing transmission in the DRC with cross-border involvement in Uganda and the need for continued surveillance and containment."}{

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行がいかに致命的であるかを明らかにする
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率（30-50%）を示す深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCとウガンダにおける確認症例と死亡の継続的な増加、国境を越えた拡大、そして高い致命性により国際的懸念となっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの継続的な伝播とウガンダへの国境越え拡大を述べている。ウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれていない）での事例は確認されているが、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。エボラ出血熱の高い死亡率（30-50%）、確認症例の増加傾向（5月21日以降49例増加）、国際的拡大リスク、および対応能力に関する懸念から、フルのRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Еболата се шири: Над 1.000 сомнителни случаи во Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading: Over 1,000 suspected cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 1,028 suspected cases, up from 906 the previous day, according to Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba. To date, 225 infections have been laboratory-confirmed. The World Health Organization notes that since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been 10 laboratory-confirmed cases and 223 suspected deaths linked to Ebola; the true scale could be much larger due to undetected circulation. In neighboring Uganda, authorities have confirmed 9 infected individuals and 1 death, all tied to travellers from Congo. Uganda has temporarily closed its border with Congo and imposed additional health measures. The WHO has declared an international health emergency related to the Ebola outbreak in both Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが拡大：コンゴで1,000件以上の疑い事例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダの9例・1死亡はコンゴからの渡航者関連であるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの1,028疑い例・225確認例・223疑い死亡は深刻な状況。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済みで社会政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il test sull'italiana. Allarme di Meloni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Test on Italian woman negative. Meloni warns.
article.articleSummary: Test at Rome’s Spallanzani Institute for Infectious Diseases on an Italian doctor with Doctors Without Borders who had returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo was negative for Ebola. The surgeon, asymptomatic, will remain in isolation at the Rome hospital for 21 days after exposure to Ebola-positive patients. Italy’s Health Ministry said there is no Ebola alarm domestically, though monitoring continues. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wrote to EU leaders, including Ursula von der Leyen, urging strengthened border surveillance with common rules for direct and indirect arrivals from affected areas. Maria Rosaria Campitiello, head of the Prevention, Research and Health Emergencies department, announced an ordinance and a circular to clarify risk assessment and guide health workers and regions on how to handle cases. Separately, the WHO reported the first recovery in the Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：イタリア人女性の検査は陰性。メローニが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク継続中を背景に、イタリアでの曝露事例が発生したが、当該患者の検査は陰性。国際的な警戒と国境監視強化の政治的関心は高いが、イタリア国内での実際の感染確認がないため、現段階ではWATCHレベルの経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: イタリアでの疑い患者は検査陰性であり、実際の感染例ではない。DRCでのアウトブレイクが背景にあり、イタリア政府による国境警戒強化の提案がなされている。今後の情報フローの継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trump focuses on keeping Ebola out of US over fighting outbreak abroad
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda (Bundibugyo strain) exceeds 1,000 suspected cases with about 250 suspected deaths, per WHO, and was declared a public health emergency of international concern. The Bundibugyo virus has no proven vaccines or treatments, with roughly 50% fatality. The United States has mobilized over $100 million in assistance, including $80 million for PPE, and CDC testing plus State Department deployments to Congo and Uganda. U.S. travel bans extended to green-card holders; earlier noncitizen restrictions cover Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Plans to quarantine potentially exposed Americans for 21 days in Kenya faced a Kenyan high court injunction. Seven Americans exposed to Ebola in Congo were flown to Europe (one doctor with confirmed infection; another to Prague). Critics warn ongoing U.S. distancing from affected regions may hinder international outbreak response; the White House and USAID restructuring cited.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権、海外の感染症流行との戦いよりも米国へのエボラ流入を防ぐことに焦点を当てる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで1,000以上の疑い患者、約250人の死亡を記録し、国際保健上の懸念事項として宣言されている。高い致命率（約50%）と治療法・ワクチン不在により深刻な公衆衛生上の影響がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ感染者がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで報告されていますが、評価対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが含まれるため verified_locations はDRCのみとしました。プラハ、米国、スーダン、ケニア、ウガンダへの言及は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外しました。本シグナルはIHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の両方で最高点を記録する重大なイベントです。

article.articleHeadline: SAD traže rješenje nakon što je Kenija blokirala centar za izolaciju oboljelih od ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States seeks a solution after Kenya blocked the Ebola isolation center.
article.articleSummary: Ebola isolation center project in Kenya was blocked by the Kenyan High Court, which issued a temporary injunction after a human rights group challenged the plan. Judge Patricia Nyaundi ordered the facility’s establishment or operation halted until a constitutional petition is decided. The United States, through Deputy Assistant Secretary Jeremy P. Lewin, said Washington is coordinating with Kenyan authorities and optimistic the concerns can be resolved, marking the first public U.S. response since the court’s order. Critics question the purpose of the site amid discussions of U.S. plans to manage Americans possibly exposed to Ebola during the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Kenya’s Ministry of Health stated that international cooperation will follow domestic law and biosafety standards, with tightened border, airport, and laboratory surveillance. Over 55,000 travelers have been screened, with all suspicious cases negative for Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラ患者隔離施設をブロックした後、米国は解決策を模索
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（重篤な感染症）の国際的対応に関する政治的紛争であり、IHR基準で複数該当（異常性・国際的関心・渡航制限のリスク）。米国とケニアの政府間協議が進行中で国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行が主要な文脈であり、ケニアは隔離施設計画の法廷闘争の舞台。ケニア自体のエボラ症例報告はなく、記事はDRCの流行対応とケニアの施設建設計画を主題としている。米国の直接的な対応と国際的な政治的関心が高い。スクリーニング実績（55,000人以上、全て陰性）は感染拡大リスクが現在は低いことを示唆するが、シグナル判定は国際的なエボラ対応の枠組みにおける重要なニュースとして維持。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola expert names five things Brits should do to avoid catching deadly disease
article.articleSummary: Britain should monitor the Central Africa Ebola outbreak and follow five precautions: defer non-essential travel to affected areas (DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan); avoid high‑risk activities such as funerals and direct contact with the deceased; avoid hospitals treating suspected Ebola cases; minimize contact with sick people and contaminated objects; do not travel if sick, since screening and quarantine may apply. As of 2026-05-30, no cases linked to this outbreak have been detected in the UK or Europe; an infected aid worker and a high-risk contact have been transported from DRC to Germany and the Czech Republic for treatment or monitoring. A US citizen diagnosed with Ebola has been moved to Germany; others with high-risk exposure have been relocated. The Bundibugyo strain likely began with animal-to-human transmission; there is no specific treatment, only early supportive care; the UK risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの専門家がイギリス人が感染を避けるためにすべき5つのことを名指しする
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの中央アフリカでの発生により、IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）と複数のWPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当。複数国での症例確認と国際的な患者輸送により国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカのエボラ発生（主にDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンが記載）に関するもの。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に入れた。ウガンダ、南スーダンは対象国に含まれていない。患者の国際輸送（ドイツ、チェコ共和国）が記載されているが、これらの国での発症地ではなく治療地であるため verified_locations に含めない。記事は2026年という未来日付であるが、現実のイベント分析として処理。

article.articleHeadline: La Jornada: Llega el titular de la OMS a Congo para encabezar el combate al virus del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Jornada: The WHO chief arrives in Congo to lead the fight against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to lead the response to the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. The outbreak has registered 906 probable cases and 223 suspected deaths, amid insecurity, attacks on health facilities, and widespread displacement. The virus, lacking a licensed vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo, is spreading rapidly as humanitarian conditions deteriorate. In Bunia, Ituri Province, the epicenter, a camp housing about 10,000 displaced people has only a single handwashing point and an infrared thermometer; those with soap are rare, and others rely on oats or sand for hygiene. Community trust and safe isolation are hampered by conflict, making contact tracing extremely challenging and complicating containment efforts, as bombs continue to fall.

triage.headline_ja: ラ・ホルナーダ：WHO事務局長がコンゴに到着、エボラウイルスとの戦いを主導
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。906例の患者、223例の死亡疑い例、急速な拡大、紛争地帯での感染制御困難、国際的対応（WHO事務局長派遣）から、直ちにフルRRAに進む必要があります。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolaはワクチンや承認治療がない。紛争による医療施設への攻撃、約10,000人の避難民キャンプでの衛生環境劣悪、コミュニティ信頼喪失により制御困難。WHO事務局長の現地派遣は国際的な危機認識の高さを示唆。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Научниците ја алармираат Европа: Опасен вирус што се пренесува преку комарци се шири кон континентот
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists warn Europe: A dangerous mosquito-borne virus is spreading across the continent.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya is a growing global threat as climate warming expands mosquito habitats. A study by Chinese researchers in Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology shows 139 countries and regions—about 21.3% of the Earth's land area—are in risk for chikungunya, with potential spread north into northeastern North America, central Europe, and eastern Asia by 2100 under 16 IPCC climate scenarios. Although historically transmitted by Aedes aegypti, better adaptation to Aedes albopictus and warmer temperatures could enable local transmission in new areas. Viral development in mosquitoes accelerates at 18–28°C, making outbreaks more likely (4–5x faster). Local transmission already occurs in 114 countries; Europe and North America remain non-endemic, with most cases travel-associated. In 2025 PAHO reports over 502,000 chikungunya cases and 186 deaths in 41 countries. Public health measures include vector surveillance, healthcare worker training, rapid outbreak response, and investing in at-risk countries (Britain, Germany, USA, China, Japan) before 2040.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者がヨーロッパに警告：蚊を媒介とする危険なウイルスが大陸全体に広がっている
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアの潜在的な国際的拡大リスクと予想外の地理的拡大が示唆されているが、現在のヨーロッパ・北米での発生は確認されておらず、将来予測に基づくモデリング研究である。対象国内での実際の発生確認情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動に伴うチクングニアの地理的拡大リスクに関する中国研究者による予測モデル研究を報道している。現在のところ、対象国リスト内でのアクティブな発生確認は記述されておらず、China は研究機関の所在地として含める。アメリカ、ドイツ、日本、イギリスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。実際の発生確認や症例報告がないため WATCH 判定とした。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Kepala Daerah se-Tanah Papua Deklarasikan Komitmen Percepatan Eliminasi TBC di Sorong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regional Heads Across Papua Declare Commitment to Accelerate TB Elimination in Sorong.
article.articleSummary: In Sorong on May 30, 2026, regional heads across the Papua region signed the Sorong Declaration, committing to accelerate tuberculosis elimination through community-based sanitation and strengthened environmental health in Tanah Papua. The seven commitments emphasize rapid TB elimination, cross-sector collaboration, and hygiene improvements within the Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program, plus community-based environmental surveillance, capacity building for environmental health workers, and a health-development model rooted in Papua’s indigenous wisdom. Officials acknowledge TB control requires more than medicine; high housing density, poor ventilation, and limited access to clean water elevate transmission, demanding sanitation, education, and broad public engagement. Sorong City data show 2025 TB cases at 1,003 (about 95% of the target for case finding) with a 71% treatment success rate; January–April 2026 recorded 410 cases identified and treated. Statements from Mayor Septinus Lobat, Akkopsi chair Dadang Supriatna, and Hakli chair Agung Sumantri underpin the coalition.

triage.headline_ja: パプア地域の地域首長がソロンでTB排除加速への公約を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 結核排除に向けた地域的な政策宣言であり、既知の公衆衛生課題への行政対応を示すもの。即座のアウトブレイク警報ではなく、進行中の対策状況の報告であるため、情報不足の中で経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアのソロン市における結核対策の宣言であり、新規アウトブレイク事象ではなく既知課題への政策対応。2025年の症例報告（1,003件）と2026年1月～4月の継続的な感染者報告はあるが、急増や予期しない事象の報告ではない。パプア地域の高密度住宅、換気不良、清潔な水へのアクセス限定という構造的リスク要因が認識されている。シグナルとしてはWATCH段階で、今後の実装状況と効果測定を注視することが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Здравните власти: Рискът от Ебола за ЕС е много нисък, но има пре...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities: The risk of Ebola to the EU is very low, but there are obstacles.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk to the EU/EEA remains very low, despite ongoing outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of May 27, 2026, 128 cases and 18 deaths are confirmed in affected countries; probable cases total 1,077 with 238 deaths. WHO declared an international public health emergency on May 17, 2026. Health authorities warn that the overall EU/EEA risk stays very low for residents and travelers who follow preventive measures and avoid contact with infected individuals or animals; health workers and humanitarian staff face higher exposure. Returning travelers should seek medical care within 21 days if symptoms develop and inform clinicians of travel and contacts. Transmission is through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids and contaminated objects; airborne spread is not typical. Guidelines recommend avoiding contact with the ill, bodily fluids, corpses, wildlife, and bushmeat, along with regular hand hygiene and disinfection. Bulgarian authorities urge limiting or suspending travel to affected states and will issue updates.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局：EU域内のエボラリスクは非常に低いが、いくつかの課題がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言されており、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで確認された流行は国際的拡大のリスクが高く、複数国での対応が必要となっている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダとブルガリアも含まれているが、記事サマリーによればエボラウイルス病の確認症例が実際に発生しているのはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはコンゴ民主共和国のみを列挙した。ブルガリアについては、リスク評価と勧告の発信地であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外した。なお、ウガンダは対象国でないため含めない。WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）が2026年5月17日に発出されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, chi arriva da RD Congo e Uganda deve compilare una dichiarazione entro 24 ore: il ministro Schillaci firma l'ordinanza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: those arriving from the DRC and Uganda must fill out a declaration within 24 hours; Minister Schillaci signs the ordinance.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus (BVD)–linked Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda triggers Italian health decree. On 29 May 2026, Italy's Health Minister Schillaci signed an ordinance, published in the Official Journal, enforcing a 120-day measure in response to the Bundibugyo outbreak associated with Ebola. The WHO has declared a PHEIC. The ordinance requires anyone arriving directly or indirectly from the DRC or Uganda, or who has been in those areas up to 21 days before entering Italy, to fill out and send a declaration within 24 hours to the local ASL Prevention Department. Airlines, shipping lines, airport authorities, and port authorities must provide passengers with the declaration forms before entry. A circular accompanying the ordinance outlines prevention measures and medical-epidemiological risk criteria. The decree takes effect May 29, 2026, lasting 120 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダから到着した者は24時間以内に届出書を提出する必要がある；シキラッチ保健相が命令に署名
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WHOがPHEIC宣言した確認済みのエボラアウトブレイク。イタリアも含む国際的対応が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo virus関連エボラアウトブレイク。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。イタリアが渡航制限措置（24時間申告義務、120日間）を実施。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。イタリアも対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 「伊波拉」警報！台灣禁「剛果、烏干達」居民入境　李秉穎曝對台影響
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alert! Taiwan bans entry for residents from the Congo and Uganda; Li Bingying reveals the impact on Taiwan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert prompts Taiwan to suspend entry for residents of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda for 90 days starting 2026-06-02, announced by the Ministry of Health and Welfare’s Centers for Disease Control. Visa issuance to DRC and Uganda residents is halted; those with already issued visas will be denied entry during the 90-day period. Exemptions include: degree-seeking students with admission, diplomatic staff, Taiwanese citizens’ non-national spouses and minor children, and emergency/humanitarian cases such as bereavement or visiting gravely ill relatives. The restrictions follow ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreaks in DRC (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) and Uganda. WHO data through 2026-05-27 report DRC with 906 cases (223 deaths) and 125 confirmed (17 deaths); Uganda with 7 confirmed (1 death). Experts caution high transmissibility via close contact and surfaces; strict PPE and quarantine are essential, but overall risk of global spread to Taiwan is not seen as likely.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報！台湾がコンゴ、ウガンダからの住民入境を禁止　李秉穎が台湾への影響を明かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラは高リスク病原体であり、複数国での継続的な流行と国家レベルの公式対応が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは台湾（対象国でない）の公式対応が主題となっているが、実際の流行地はDRC（South Kivu、Ituri等）に限定される。Ugandaはサマリーに記載があるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて重篤で、DRCでの継続流行（906例、223死亡）は国際的に重大な懸念事項である。

article.articleHeadline: Inside the Ebola Epicenter, the Virus Rages With Little to Stop It
article.articleSummary: A Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak centers in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo. The Congolese Health Ministry declared it on May 15. As of late May 2026, about 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths nationwide, with more than 300 cases in Mongbwalu, a 150,000-person gold-mining town near rebel-held territory. There is no approved vaccine or treatment. Test kits are scarce; results from the regional capital about 50 miles away take four days, hindering triage and isolation. Hospitals are overwhelmed; a 5-year-old boy bled severely in a ward, and a 21-year-old woman, Christiane Bahati, died, while at least seven hospital workers have died. MSF is erecting isolation tents and disinfection stations as distrust and fear complicate the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の震源地内部：ウイルスが蔓延し、これを止めるものは何もない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。確認された死亡例、医療体制の崩壊、検査体制の不足により対応が急務。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV)の発生。2026年5月15日にコンゴ保健省が公式宣言。感染疑い例1,077例、死亡疑い246例という急速な増加。医療従事者7名以上の死亡を含む。検査結果の遅延（4日要要）、ワクチン・治療薬の不存在、金採掘町での感染拡大リスクなど複数の深刻な懸念要因あり。国際的支援（MSF活動）が既に展開されており、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Virus zombie che si liberano dal permafrost, cosa ci deve preoccupare davvero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zombie viruses released from permafrost: what should we really worry about?
article.articleSummary: Virus emergence requires vigilance; Ebola in Congo ongoing; avian influenza is globally widespread; measles reemergence due to incomplete vaccination coverage; Disease X denotes the next potential pandemic; despite vaccines and antivirals, precautionary principles are essential. The piece warns against complacency, citing Hantavirus errors on cruise ships. Regarding 'zombie viruses' from thawing permafrost, these are ancient giant viruses, bacteria and antibiotic-resistance genes released as ice melts. They confirm permafrost as a vast biological/climatic archive rather than immediate threats, while offering routes to study the Arctic microbiome and climate–ecology–health interactions. The main risks of thaw are climate-related: release of CO2 and methane and soil instability; in Alaska, metals released from ground turn rivers orange, degrading water quality in over 200 Arctic basins. The article urges stronger environmental surveillance and preparedness across the One Health framework, leveraging Italian expertise like Spallanzani and ISS.

triage.headline_ja: 永久凍土から解放されるゾンビウイルス：本当に心配すべきことは何か
triage.triage_reason: 複数の既知感染症（エボラ、麻疹、鳥インフルエンザ）が言及されているが、記事の主題は永久凍土の融解による古代ウイルス解放であり、直近の具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、理論的リスク評価である。コンゴのエボラ継続や鳥インフルエンザの世界的蔓延は言及されるが、記事の焦点は気候・環境変化との相互作用にある。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は永久凍土からの古代ウイルス解放を主題とした科学・環境観点の解説記事である。コンゴのエボラは継続中として言及されているが、北極圏の環境リスク（CO2・メタン放出、水質汚濁）が記事の主要懸念。具体的な新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、潜在的リスク警告である。Alaskaは対象国リストに含まれておらず、DRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, la circolare del ministero stabilisce 5 livelli di rischio per chi arriva da Congo e Uganda | L'Espresso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the ministry's circular establishes five levels of risk for those arriving from Congo and Uganda | L'Espresso.
article.articleSummary: Italy's Health Ministry issued a 120-day ordinance establishing five risk levels for travelers arriving from Ebola-affected areas—DR Congo and Uganda—or those with recent stays there (past 21 days). Following the WHO’s public health emergency declaration for the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, the measures mandate uniform epidemiological assessment, health monitoring, and management of suspected cases. Within 24 hours of entry, travelers must submit a declaration to the local Prevention Department. Although Italy-facing overall risk is deemed 'low,' the policy emphasizes precautionary containment. Suspected-symptom passengers may only land at Rome’s Fiumicino Airport. The ordinance aims to standardize screening, monitoring, and potential biocontainment or quarantine as needed, reflecting enhanced border controls in response to the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、保健省の通達がコンゴ・ウガンダからの入国者に対する5段階のリスクレベルを確立
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）、かつWPRO基準も複数該当。WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言が出ているBundibugyo株エボラアウトブレイクに対する各国の防疫体制強化を示す重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にイタリア（対象国外）が含まれているが、本イベントの主題はDRC・ウガンダで発生しているエボラアウトブレイク自体であり、イタリアは防疫応答国として記載されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO緊急事態宣言が出ているBundibugyo株による中央アフリカでのアウトブレイクであり、国際的な懸念が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Cómo el hantavirus se convirtió en una preocupación mundial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How the hantavirus became a global concern
article.articleSummary: Andes hantavirus, unique for person-to-person transmission, drew global attention after identification in the MV Hondius cruise outbreak that caused three deaths and a high-mortality cardiorespiratory syndrome. In Chile, Andes hantavirus circulates from Atacama to Magallanes, with 1,461 cases and 458 deaths since 1996. The natural reservoir is the long-tailed mouse; environmental exposure is the main infection source, with about 75% occupational and 25% recreational cases, and only a small fraction due to direct person-to-person spread. The Dutch couple Leo Schilperoord (70) and Mirjam Huisman (69) were among the first fatalities related to the voyage. International concern grew as the WHO reported 13 infections on the ship and Spain confirmed a 13th case, involving passengers from 7 nations among 23 nationalities aboard. Chilean/Argentine hantavirus researchers, including Pablo Vial and Marcela Ferrés, with Brazil collaborators, have contributed to a Lancet 2023 study; UK/OMS emergency science meeting is shaping a global research roadmap.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスが世界的な懸念となった経緯
triage.triage_reason: Andes hantavirus（人-人感染が可能）の異常な病原性、国際的な船舶での多国籍乗客への感染拡大、高い致死率（心呼吸器症候群）、及びWHOと国際的な研究体制の構築がIHR基準とスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドには複数国が列挙されているが、サマリーの主題の感染症イベント（Andes hantavirus）は南米（チリ、アルゼンチン、コロンビア）および国際的なクルーズ船での発生である。対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazilのみであり、チリ、アルゼンチン、コロンビア、スペイン、英国は対象国外のため除外した。ただしBrazilはチリ・アルゼンチンの研究者との協力研究に記載されているため検証地域に含める。本イベントは対象国内での直接的な広範な発生を示しておらず、主に南米（対象国外）の地理的発生であるが、国際的な影響と研究体制の構築により高いリスク評価となる。

article.articleHeadline: 「伊波拉」警報！台灣禁「剛果、烏干達」居民入境　李秉穎曝對台影響 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alert! Taiwan Bans Entry of Residents from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; Li Bingying Reveals the Impact on Taiwan
article.articleSummary: An Ebola alert prompts Taiwan's CDC to suspend entry of residents from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda for 90 days, effective 00:00 on June 2, 2026. Visa issuance will be paused; existing visas cannot enter during the period. Four exemptions apply: degree students with admission, diplomats, Taiwanese citizens' non-national spouses and minor children, and emergency/humanitarian cases such as funerals or visiting gravely ill relatives. WHO data as of May 27, 2026 show the DRC outbreak expanding in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 906 cases and 223 deaths; 125 confirmed cases (17 deaths). Uganda has 7 confirmed cases and 1 death. Health expert Li Bingying supports stricter border measures due to Ebola's high person-to-person transmissibility, but notes Taiwan-wide spread is unlikely given limited travel to these nations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報！台湾がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダからの住民入国を禁止 李秉穎が台湾への影響を明かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。複数の対象国での確認例、死亡事例あり、WHOが監視中の新興感染症。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国における進行中の流行（South Kivu、Ituri地域で906症例、223死亡）が主題。ウガンダも記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。台湾での検疫措置は対象国ではないため除外。DRCはWPRO スクリーニング全5基準を満たし、IHR基準も4項目全て該当。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Mientras el ébola azota Congo, expertos advierten de vínculo con el consumo de animales silvestres
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: While Ebola is ravaging the Congo, experts warn of a link to bushmeat consumption.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is ravaging the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with experts warning that hunting and handling infected wildlife can raise the risk of new zoonotic disease outbreaks. In Kinshasa’s Masina market, the wild-meat trade highlights this danger: some vendors conceal their products, requiring customers to request items such as a giant swamp rat or severed antelope parts, while others display goods openly; baskets also feature writhing caterpillars. The article underscores how close contact with wildlife during hunting, processing, and sale can drive spillover to humans, contributing to public-health concerns in the capital amid ongoing Ebola activity. It emphasizes the challenge of monitoring markets to prevent zoonotic transmission and the broader link between bushmeat consumption and emerging disease threats in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを襲う中、野生動物の消費との関連を専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がDRCで報告されており、IHR基準の公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性に懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月配信の将来日付を含むため情報信頼性に注意が必要。ただしDRCでのエボラ流行と野生動物市場での人獣共通感染症リスクが主題であり、公衆衛生上の懸念は極めて高い。継続的な監視と詳細なRRAが必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola science is moving fast. It might not be enough
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is approaching 1,100 suspected cases and about 240 suspected deaths as of May 30, 2026. No authorised vaccines or treatments exist specifically for Bundibugyo; past two-decade outbreaks were small. Rapid scientific mobilization has identified potential tools: remdesivir (with prior Zaire-ebola data) as a good fit, and an oral prodrug obeldesivir showing protective results in monkeys; both require human evaluation. An antibody cocktail from Mapp Biopharmaceutical is being prioritized for testing, with the DRC having formally requested access. The Zaire vaccine, though available, offers uncertain protection against Bundibugyo, prompting development of Bundibugyo-specific glycoprotein vaccines. Glycoprotein similarity between Bundibugyo and Zaire (~70%) fuels cautious optimism for cross-protection. Trials designed to quickly assess efficacy are underway, but on-the-ground challenges—conflict, attacks on aid workers, misinformation, and contact-tracing difficulties—threaten containment and may worsen the outbreak before improving.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の科学は急速に進展している。それで十分ではないかもしれない
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの大規模アウトブレイク（疑い例1,100件、疑い死亡240件）がDRCで進行中であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性（新しい病原体系統）、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性を満たす。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラは新興の病原体系統であり、既存のザイールエボラワクチンの有効性が不確実なため、急速なワクチン開発と治療法評価が進行中。記事は紛争、医療従事者への攻撃、誤情報など現地での制御困難性を指摘しており、アウトブレイク悪化のリスクが高い。DRCは正式に医療支援（抗体カクテル等）へのアクセスを要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Mexican airlines restrict Central Africa travellers over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain; the World Health Organization reports 125 confirmed and more than 900 suspected cases, with deaths in the hundreds. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for this strain. As of May 30, 2026, three Mexican airlines—Aeromexico, Viva and Volaris—bar passengers who have been in Uganda, the DRC or South Sudan within the previous 21 days from flying into Mexico, with Viva and Volaris extending the ban for 60 days. The measures accompany aligned health steps by host nations co-hosting the FIFA World Cup, opening June 11 in Mexico City, and a U.S. restriction on recent travelers from affected countries. The Congolese football team has qualified and will play in the United States and Mexico, training in Belgium and planning to base itself in Houston during the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の中央アフリカ流行に対応し、メキシコ系航空会社が中央アフリカからの旅客を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行リスク、管理可能性）し、国際的な渡航制限措置と社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRC以外の国（スーダン、ウガンダ、ベルギー、メキシコ、米国）はBluedotが付与したが、記事サマリーの主題の発生地はDRCのみであり、他国は渡航制限の対象国または開催国・経由地として言及されているにすぎない。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行、致死性の高さ、ワクチン・治療法の不在、FIFA World Cupという国際的なイベント直前での発生、複数国による渡航制限、アスリート（コンゴ代表）の国際移動を伴うリスクなど、多角的にリスク要因が存在。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, obbligo di dichiarazione per chi arriva da Congo e Uganda e nuove regole per i voli: cosa prevede l'ordinanza del ministero della Salute
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, mandatory declaration for those arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, and new flight rules: what the Ministry of Health's ordinance provides.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, is the focus of an Italian Health Ministry ordinance; Italy regards national risk as low. Arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda must complete and sign a declaration within 24 hours of arrival, submitted by email or in person to the local preventive department. Regions must relay declarations to Directorate within 24 hours. Airlines and ships must warn passengers and collect the forms, forwarding them to airport and port authorities, which send them to USMAF and health authorities. If a passenger or crew member from an outbreak country shows symptoms, landing is permitted only at Fiumicino Airport for procedures. There are five exposure-risk levels; high risk includes close contact with a symptomatic case, unprotected sex with a case up to 3 months post-recovery, contact with contaminated materials, needle-stick or mucous-membrane exposure, and contact with wildlife or bushmeat; casual contact is not high risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴとウガンダからの到着者に申告義務、飛行機の新規則：保健省の命令が定めるもの
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPRO基準でも複数項目該当。イタリアが公式に予防措置を実施しており、ブンディブギョ株エボラの国際的な懸念が示唆されている。
triage.notes: イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に除外。記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ流行に対する、イタリアの公式対応措置を報道。ブンディブギョ株の確認およびフライト制限・申告義務が示す高い社会政治的関心。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia says 2 suspected Ebola cases test negative
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Zambia tested negative after laboratory tests, per the Ministry of Health on May 30, 2026. The ministry says a whole-of-government and whole-of-society approach is in place to prevent Ebola entry, including screening tools and protocols at points of entry. Facilities have been identified and assessed to house individuals suspected of infection, with capacity to detect or diagnose Ebola via mobile laboratories and at Lusaka's highest referral hospital. Zambia is collaborating with WHO and the Africa CDC to boost diagnostics, supportive treatment, and personal protective equipment. The measures come as Zambia borders the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak has recently been reported, prompting heightened preventive actions.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、エボラの2件の疑い例が陰性と発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高危険病原体だが、本イベントは疑い例が陰性確認された報告であり、確定例の発生ではない。ただし隣接するDRCでの流行により地域的緊張が高く、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はザンビアの疑い例が陰性だった報告だが、隣接するDRCでの進行中のエボラ流行があるため、越境感染リスクおよび地域的なアラート体制が存在する。疑い例陰性確認だけではピックアップに至らないが、DRC流行の継続状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bunia, DR Congo, May 30, 2026 (AFP) - WHO chief arrives at epicentre of DRC's Ebola outbreak: AFP
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, in Bunia, DR Congo, the World Health Organization chief arrived at the epicentre of the country’s Ebola outbreak, according to AFP. The visit underscores heightened international attention as authorities confront ongoing transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The report emphasizes the Ebola outbreak and the epicentre’s location, noting the role of global health leadership in the public health response at the site. The article does not provide current case or death counts, nor details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or suspected infection sources. It frames the situation within the broader international response to Ebola in DR Congo during late May 2026, highlighting the significance of the leader’s presence at the outbreak site.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア、コンゴ民主共和国、2026年5月30日（AFP） - WHO事務局長がDRCのエボラ流行中心地に到着：AFP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行がDRCで進行中であり、IHR基準で重篤な公衆衛生影響と国際的な関心（WHO事務局長の訪問）が明確に認識される。WPRO基準では異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが該当し、社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の流行が継続中であることが明示されており、WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的な高レベルの関心が確認される。記事ではケース数や死亡数の詳細が不明だが、「ongoing transmission（継続中の感染伝播）」の表現から、進行中の流行が確実である。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: إيطاليا تدعو الاتحاد الأوروبي إلى تشديد الرقابة على الحدود بسبب تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy urges the European Union to tighten border controls due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni to urge the European Union to tighten border controls. In a letter to EU leaders, she calls for border-management to be on the agenda of the European Council meeting scheduled for June 18–19, 2026. The proposal seeks to strengthen European coordination of border surveillance by adopting shared rules for movements of people entering from virus-affected areas. Meloni also asked for a videoconference of EU health ministers as soon as possible to discuss developments. Italy has already activated health surveillance protocols for travelers from DRC and Uganda and has deployed a team of infectious disease experts to Kinshasa to provide technical support and medical assistance.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア、エボラ流行を理由にEUに国境管理強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の発生に対するEUレベルでの国境管理強化要請は、国際的対応が進行中であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事主題はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生に対するイタリア・EU対応。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。イタリアは対象国外だが、イタリアがKinsasaに感染症専門家チームを派遣し、技術支援と医療支援を実施している点が重要。ウガンダも記事で言及されているが対象国リストに未含。

article.articleHeadline: VM-arrangørene iverksetter ebolatiltak - deler ingen detaljer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup organizers implement Ebola measures - share no details
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and parts of Uganda face an Ebola outbreak, with DRC reporting over 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths; Uganda has a markedly lower case count. In response to the Central African outbreak ahead of the World Cup hosted in North America, the United States, Canada and Mexico announce coordinated travel-health measures intended to safeguard residents, millions of visitors, fans, athletes and tourists, while keeping cross-border travel and trade open. Details of the measures were not disclosed, including whether entry bans or quarantines will be used. Ebola is a highly contagious, life-threatening viral infection transmitted through direct contact and contact with bodily fluids. The statement was issued by the U.S. government on behalf of the three organizers.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ主催者がエボラ対策を実施 - 詳細は非公開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の懸念が明確。アクティブなエボラアウトブレイクと複数国における調整対応が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。米国・カナダ・メキシコはワールドカップ開催国であり対策実施国であるが、エボラの実際の発生地ではないため除外。DRCで1,000件以上の疑い患者と約250人の死亡が報告されており、高い公衆衛生危機を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: سباق مع الزمن لمواجهة إيبولا... لقاح تجريبي جديد يدخل مرحلة الاختبارات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A race against time to combat Ebola... a new experimental vaccine enters the testing phase.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths reported; the World Health Organization has classified the situation as a high health-risk. Oxford University researchers are developing a rapid experimental Ebola vaccine based on the ChAdOx1 platform—the same viral vector used for the AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. The vaccine aims to prime the immune system to target Ebola, with animal studies already underway and production planning in collaboration with the Serum Institute of India. If early results are favorable, clinical trials could begin in two to three months. Officials caution that vaccine efficacy remains unproven and will depend on forthcoming preclinical and clinical data, as the Congo outbreak continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとの時間との戦い...新しい実験的ワクチンが試験段階に入る
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）がDRCで約750疑い例・177死亡という重大なアウトブレイク中であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。WHO が高リスク状況に分類し、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株、~750疑い例、177死亡）が主要テーマ。Oxford大学による新規実験的ワクチン開発（ChAdOx1プラットフォーム）の進捗が副次テーマ。インドの血清研究所がワクチン製造に協力予定。WHO が高リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ感染疑い米国人の隔離施設をケニアで設置計画、ケニアの裁判所が一時停止命令...人権団体反発受け | ヨミドクター(読売新聞)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya plans to establish a quarantine facility for an American suspected of Ebola infection; Kenyan court issues a temporary injunction amid opposition from human rights groups.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists with 125 confirmed cases and 906 suspected as of May 29, 2026, per WHO; no confirmed cases in Kenya. The United States plans to relocate an American with suspected Ebola to Kenya and operate a quarantine facility there starting May 29, to isolate the individual. A Kenyan court issued a temporary injunction halting the plan amid opposition from human rights groups who described the process as unilateral and secretive. Kenyan authorities have not reported any Ebola cases in the current outbreak, while the DRC outbreak continues to spread. Key locations: Kenya, Democratic Republic of Congo; invasion source: Ebola virus disease outbreak in DRC; actions: planned quarantine facility and court injunction.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染疑い米国人の隔離施設をケニアで設置計画、ケニアの裁判所が一時停止命令...人権団体反発受け
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な患者移送計画で、IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大・渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準でも複数該当。高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: サマリーが明確に示すのはDRC（進行中の125確定患者・906疑い患者のアウトブレイク）およびケニア（現在疑い患者1名、将来的な隔離施設計画）でのイベント。米国は患者の国籍国であり、イベント発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。国際的な患者移送・隔離施設計画による政治的紛争と人権懸念があり、社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cộng hòa Dân chủ Congo ghi nhận 1.028 trường hợp nghi nhiễm Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,028 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,028 suspected Ebola cases and 225 confirmed as of May 30, 2026, amid a Bundibugyo virus outbreak centered in Ituri Province, a conflict-affected region hindering response. Authorities say 142 patients are in health facilities. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; control relies on surveillance and containment. WHO warns the true case load may be higher due to limited surveillance in conflict zones, with the virus having spread silently for weeks before detection. The outbreak threatens neighboring and regional countries, including Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya, South Sudan, Tanzania, Zambia, Angola, and Burundi. Uganda has halted public transport to Congo; Rwanda requires quarantine for entrants who passed through Congo; the United States has expanded entry restrictions to people who visited the outbreak region in the prior 21 days. Kenya has approved a U.S. plan to open an Ebola isolation facility.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ疑い患者1,028例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、紛争地帯での流行により国際的拡大リスクが高く、既に隣国による入国制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: India はサマリーに記載なし。verified_locations は対象国リストに基づき DRC と Zambia のみ列挙すべき。サマリーで言及されている Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Burundi, Angola, South Sudan は対象国外であるため除外。米国も対象国リストに含まれない。紛争地帯での隠匿流行の可能性、ワクチン・治療法の不在、隣国への拡大リスク（既に入国制限発動）が評価を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief lands in eastern Congo's Ituri province, epicenter of Ebola, as outbreak outpaces response
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-30, the WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri province, eastern Congo, amid an outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare Ebola strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. Bunia is the epicenter as the virus continues to spread faster than the response, even as health facilities improve and new aid arrives. Authorities report 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths to date. Tedros is expected to visit a treatment center and meet local authorities, health workers, and affected families to strengthen support and accelerate containment. The report notes no licensed therapies or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo Ebola, underscoring the need for rapid public health measures, case finding, and community engagement to curb transmission in the outbreak's focal region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ東部イトゥリ州のエボラウイルス震源地ブニアに到着、アウトブレイクが対応を上回る中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。希少なBundibugyo Ebola株、有効な治療法・ワクチンなし、906症例223死亡、WHO事務局長が現地視察するなど国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株は希少で致死率が高く、承認された治療法やワクチンが存在しない。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心が極めて高い。対象国リスト外のアフリカ各国への拡大リスクも存在するが、検証ロケーションはDRCのみ。
