article.articleHeadline: المركزية | سباق مع الزمن لمواجهة إيبولا... لقاح تجريبي جديد يدخل مرحلة الاختبارات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Al-Markazia | A race against time to combat Ebola... a new experimental vaccine enters the testing phase.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) linked to the Bundibugyo strain has reached about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths, prompting the World Health Organization to classify the situation as a high health risk. Oxford researchers are developing an experimental rapid vaccine using the ChAdOx1 platform—the same approach as the AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. The candidate vaccine is moving toward clinical testing after initial animal studies, with production preparations underway in collaboration with the Serum Institute of India. Officials expect first clinical trials within two to three months, but emphasize that vaccine effectiveness is unproven and will depend on early studies and forthcoming human trials. Ongoing outbreak response and vaccine development are being pursued as of May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アル・マルカジア｜エボラ対抗への時間との競争...新しい試験的ワクチンが試験段階に突入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのエボラウイルス病大規模流行（750疑似症例、177死亡）であり、WHOが高リスク分類を適用している。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で複数該当。

article.articleHeadline: Congo ghi nhận 1.028 trường hợp nghi nhiễm Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports 1,028 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,028 suspected Ebola cases and 225 confirmed infections, centered in Ituri province. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo lineage, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. Health authorities say improved testing could yield more cases; 142 patients are receiving care. WHO warns the virus has circulated quietly for weeks before detection. Cross-border movement and insecurity in eastern Congo fuel spread; regional risk now extends to at least 10 countries, including Angola, Burundi, Rwanda, Kenya, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia, alongside Congo and Uganda. Uganda has halted transport to Congo; Rwanda requires quarantine for entrants who travelled through Congo. The United States expands entry restrictions to those who visited the outbreak region within 21 days. Kenya agrees to the U.S. plan to open an Ebola isolation facility for Americans exposed or infected in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが1,028件のエボラ疑い感染を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4/4全て該当。ザンビアを含む対象国での地域的拡大リスク、国際的渡航制限実施、死亡を含む重症事例、及び社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）を中心とした大規模エボラ流行を報告。対象国ではザンビアが地域的リスク国として明記される。アンゴラ、ブルンジ、ルワンダ、南スーダン、タンザニア、ウガンダも関連国として記載されているが、対象国リストにはアンゴラのみ含まれ、他は記事内で地域的拡大の文脈でのみ言及。米国、ウガンダ、ルワンダが渡航制限・隔離措置を実施。希少なBundibugyo系統でワクチンなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le patron de l'OMS est arrivé en Ituri, épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the WHO Director-General has arrived in Ituri, epicentre of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 30 May 2026, the Director-General of the World Health Organization arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, epicentre of a grave Ebola outbreak that is progressing in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), AFP reported. An AFP journalist witnessed the arrival. The report identifies Ituri as the epicentre and notes the disease's ongoing progression in the eastern DRC. This marks another moment in the ongoing Ebola threat in the DRC's east. The article provides limited detail on case counts or containment actions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：WHO事務局長がイトゥリの流行中心地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱は極度に深刻な公衆衛生脅威であり、DRCで現在も進行中の大規模流行は異常・予想外である。国際的拡大リスク高く、国際支援（WHO事務局長の現地訪問）が既に動員されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最も危険度の高い感染症の一つであり、DRCでの進行中の流行は国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態である。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的関心と支援の必要性を示す。ケース数と対策の詳細情報は限定的だが、症例数が不明でも流行継続という情報だけで判定基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 8 tuổi nôn giun sống: Thủ phạm từ nhà tắm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8-year-old girl vomits up live worms: The culprit from the bathroom.
article.articleSummary: An 8-year-old girl in Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, presented with a month-long history of vomiting live worms, sometimes up to five at a time. A cup of larvae collected at the clinic revealed they were drain fly larvae (moth flies), not typical helminths. Laboratory confirmation by Yangzhou CDC established the diagnosis; standard deworming drugs were ineffective. The infection likely arose from bathroom exposure where drain fly larvae develop; transmission is favored in rainy, humid conditions (humidity >70%), with larvae contaminating toothbrushes, mouthwash cups, or surfaces when flushing drains, later ingested during brushing or rinsing. Treatment requires a specific antiparasitic regimen. Preventive measures include cleaning drainage pipes with salt and baking soda and hot water or diluted bleach, sealing drains, keeping bathrooms dry, and controlling adult drain flies with low-tox insecticides or electrical traps. Parents are advised to collect abnormal specimens in alcohol for lab ID.

triage.headline_ja: 8歳の女の子が生きたウジを吐く：犯人はバスルームから
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生的な重大性、国際的拡大リスク、異常性いずれも認められない。drain fly larva感染は既知の局所的寄生虫症であり、シグナル基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国江蘇省揚州市における個別の小児患者のドレインフライ幼虫感染症例を報じたものである。既知の感染症であり、集団発生や異常な疫学パターンの報告がない。医学的には興味深いが、感染症危機管理の観点からはシグナルとして識別しない。

article.articleHeadline: L'IGAD appelle à une solide préparation régionale face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IGAD calls for robust regional preparedness in the face of the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: IGAD, the East Africa regional bloc, urged urgent regional preparedness as Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In a virtual emergency ministerial meeting led by IGAD Executive Secretary Workneh Gebeyehu, ministers called for coordinated cross-border action, strengthened surveillance, and collective preparedness, noting porous borders and high mobility from trade, migration, refugees, and pastoral movements. IGAD plans to reallocate seven million dollars from the Regional Pandemic Preparedness Project to support urgent measures across member states, including entry-point screening, enhanced surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, and risk communication. Africa CDC also warns that eleven additional countries are at high risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, and Somalia. The situation remains dynamic in DRC and Uganda as authorities monitor the outbreak. Published May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: IGAD、エボラ流行に対する強固な地域的備え態勢を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（IHR基準3つ該当）と、複数アフリカ地域での重症感染症の流行対応。地域機関による緊急対応とアフリカCDCの警告から、社会政治的関心および国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC およびウガンダでのエボラ流行が主題であり、11の高リスク国（アフリカCDC警告）のうち対象国リストに該当する 11 カ国すべてが verified_locations に含められました。IGAD による700万ドルの資金再配分、国境警備の強化、サーベイランス強化が計画されており、公式な地域間対応が進行中です。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: le patron de l'OMS est arrivé en Ituri, épicentre de l'épidémie en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the head of the WHO has arrived in Ituri, epicentre of the outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, the epicenter of a severe Ebola outbreak advancing in eastern DR Congo. The visit signals heightened international attention as authorities respond to an outbreak rooted in eastern DR Congo, with Ituri identified as the focal area. The article notes Ebola is spreading in the region, but does not provide case or death tolls in the excerpt. The arrival underscores ongoing global concern and the need for coordinated public health efforts to control transmission and support local response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOの事務局長がイトゥリ（東部コンゴ民主共和国の流行の中心地）に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の東部DRC流行、WHO事務局長の現地訪問により、国際的関心と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRCのイトゥリ州での深刻なエボラ流行を報道。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な対応への関心の高さを示唆。死亡者・症例数の詳細は提供されていないが、「severe outbreak」との記述あり。フルRRA実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief lands in eastern Congo's Ituri province, epicenter of Ebola, as outbreak outpaces response
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Bunia, Ituri province, eastern Congo, continues to outpace the response. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia on Saturday to visit a treatment center and meet local authorities, health workers, and affected families. The World Health Organization said 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths have been reported as of Friday. The Bundibugyo virus, the current Ebola variant driving this outbreak, has no approved treatment or vaccine. Despite better-organized health facilities and new aid arrivals, transmission persists faster than the response. Tedros told reporters late Friday that the best approach is to provide all the necessary support to fight the disease at its epicenter and to continue offering every assistance needed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ東部イトゥリ州に到着、エボラ出血熱の流行の中心地で、発生が対応を上回る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当、高度の重症度と継続的な伝播。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株による流行であり、承認された治療法やワクチンが存在しない。WHO事務局長が直接現地視察に赴いており、国際的な関心と対応の必要性が極めて高い。906件の疑い患者と223件の死亡が報告されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief lands in eastern Congo's Ituri province, epicenter of Ebola, as outbreak outpaces response | WBBM Newsradio 780 AM & 105.9 FM
article.articleSummary: Ituri province, Bunia, Congo, is facing an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths reported. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to inspect a treatment center and meet authorities, health workers, and affected families, aiming to bolster response as the outbreak outpaces resources. Bundibugyo Ebola virus is described as a rare form with no approved treatment or vaccine. The report notes improved facilities and new aid, yet transmission continues at the epicenter, underscoring the urgent need for enhanced public health measures and support. The article cites suspected cases without confirmed laboratory results and provides no details on infection source or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラの中心地であるコンゴ東部イトゥリ州に到着、アウトブレイクが対応を上回る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。WHO事務局長自らが現地入りする重大なエボラ拡大事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）による大規模アウトブレイク。疑い例906件、疑い死亡223件という相当数の患者発生。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な関心の高さと対応の深刻さを示唆。治療法およびワクチンが存在しないという点が重症度を増す。ただしサマリーでは疑い例であり確認検査結果が記載されていない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉傳染性太強！感染科權威：很多醫護也生病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is highly contagious! An infectious-disease expert warns that many healthcare workers have fallen ill.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are worsening. Taiwan’s Central Epidemic Command Center will suspend entry for residents from these two countries for 90 days starting June 2, with four exemptions including spouses of Taiwanese citizens and minor children. An infectious-disease authority, Li Bingying (李秉穎), says Ebola is a localized outbreak not a global pandemic, but prevention must be extremely cautious. Healthcare workers have a much higher risk of infection when caring for Ebola patients, underscoring the need for strict infection control and full personal protective equipment, without direct skin-to-skin contact. He cautions against global panic, noting the virus’s spread depends on local conditions. When a country reports cases, stringent quarantine measures are essential to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは感染性が非常に強い！感染症の権威：多くの医療従事者も病気になっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、実際の流行地での患者発生と医療従事者の感染報告がある。社会的・政治的関心も高い（台湾の入国制限措置）。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行が悪化中。医療従事者の感染例が報告されている。台湾がDRCおよびウガンダからの入国者に対して90日間の入国制限を実施。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストにないため検証対象から除外。台湾はChina領域として含める。

article.articleHeadline: Kanungu Tightens Uganda-DRC Border as Ebola Cases Rise
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, Uganda tightens border controls at the Uganda-DRC frontier as Ebola cases rise in DRC. Following National Task Force on Ebola Response decisions chaired by the Vice President, Kanungu District authorities convened an emergency session on 28 May 2026 led by RDC Àmbrose Mwesigye Àmanyire to prevent cross-border transmission. All border points in Kanungu, including Ishasha and Kyeshero crossings, are closed to general traffic; cargo, registered refugees, and security personnel only, with strict screening. Weekly markets, bars, discos closed; daily markets and public transport operate under surveillance with mandatory handwashing and health checks. Burials require supervised protocols; public gatherings require temperature screening and sanitation facilities. Uganda has seven confirmed Ebola cases and one related death in the 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak, with no new cases since 25 May; Kanungu remains a critical high-risk buffer district on the Uganda-DRC frontier.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ患者増加に伴いカヌング地区でウガンダ・DRC国境を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ以上満たす（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。活発な国家レベルの対応とウガンダでの確定症例が認められ、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダの地理的位置（対象国リストに該当しない）で症例と対応が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ増加とウガンダ国境での対応であり、DRCが主要な発生地。ウガンダは対象国（WPRO対象国）ではないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため計上。ウガンダでの7例の確定症例と死亡報告があるが、ウガンダは対象国ではないため、DRCのみの判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue deaths rise as heat risks increase
article.articleSummary: Central Visayas DOH 7 reports 2,425 dengue cases and 18 deaths from January to the second week of May 2026, an 80% rise in fatalities versus the same period last year. The region also notes a surge in non-communicable diseases during the hot season, with heat stroke and heat exhaustion expected; extreme heat worsens hypertension and diabetes. Rabies exposures remain notable, with about 11,000 animal bite incidents in Q1 amid vaccine hesitancy. Dengue transmission is driven by unstable water supplies prompting households to store water; inadequately covered containers—including small ones like plant pots and vases—become mosquito habitats. Dengue demographics are shifting toward early–mid adulthood, with fewer cases among schoolchildren due to campaigns. Prevention centers on the 4Ts: Taob, Taktak, Tuyo ug Takip—emptying, cleaning, covering water containers; replace stored water at least every seven days. Travel to areas with limited water control in rural communities increases risk.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱による死亡が増加し、熱リスクが高まる
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン（Western Visayas）でデング熱の重症化傾向が明確であり、IHR基準で重大な公衆衛生影響と異常性が認められ、国内での感染拡大リスクが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで言及されているRabiesは副次的な内容であり、主題はDengueである。Central Visayas DOH 7による公式報告での80%の死亡率上昇、前年比での顕著な増加、および不十分な水供給インフラがウイルス媒介蚊の増殖を促進している点が重要。デモグラフィックシフト（成人層への拡大）と予防方法の周知施策がある一方、ワクチン躊躇が課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Fast-Tracks Vaccines, Drugs Against Deadly Ebola Bundibugyo Strain
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda, with fatality estimated at 30-50% and symptoms consistent with Ebola such as severe bleeding and organ failure. No approved vaccines or treatments exist specifically for Bundibugyo. WHO has convened experts to fast track vaccine and drug candidates, aiming to move promising options into clinical testing rapidly as cases rise and detection lag allowed spread. Leading vaccine candidates include the single dose rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by IAVI, potentially ready for large scale trials after 7–9 months, and the ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo vaccine from Oxford and Serum Institute, with testing doses available in 2–3 months after animal studies. Ervebo remains unlikely effective for Bundibugyo. Experimental therapies MBP134 and Maftivimab, and antivirals remdesivir and obeldesivir are under evaluation. Outbreak context includes conflict and contact tracing challenges.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、致命的なエボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンと医薬品を迅速承認化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。ブンディブギョ株エボラの複数国での流行は高リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの発生が明示されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ブンディブギョ株は致死率30-50%と高く、既承認ワクチンが存在せず、紛争地域での接触者追跡の困難さが記載されている点でリスク高。WHO専門家会合開催による迅速なワクチン・治療薬開発推進は国際的な関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية يصل إلى بؤرة تفشي إيبولا بشرق الكونغو الديمقراطية - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director of Global Health arrives at the Ebola outbreak epicenter in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of an Ebola outbreak, as transmission continues beyond the capacity of local response. The visit follows improvements in health-facility organization and the arrival of new aid. He is expected to tour a treatment center in Bunia and meet with local authorities, health workers, and affected families. The report notes ongoing containment challenges and provides no specific case counts, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources. The engagement underscores international leadership and coordinated support to strengthen care, surveillance, and community outreach amid the eastern DRC Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ出血熱流行の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当。エボラ出血熱の確認流行で、地域の対応能力を超えた継続的な感染、国際的支援の必要性が明示されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致命率と国際的重要性を持つ。WHO事務局長の直接的な訪問は国際的な関心と支援体制の必要性を強く示唆。地域対応能力の限界が明記されているため、フルRRA実施は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Bunia, DR Congo, May 30, 2026 (AFP) - WHO chief arrives at epicentre of DRC's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: May 30, 2026, Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo — the World Health Organization chief arrived at the epicentre of an Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The AFP report frames the visit as part of ongoing response efforts to control Ebola transmission in eastern Congo, though no case counts, fatalities, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or details on imported/exported cases are provided in the excerpt. The piece underscores international attention to containment, surveillance, and strengthening response coordination at the outbreak’s focal point, with Bunia identified as the central location of concern.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア、コンゴ民主共和国、2026年5月30日（AFP）- WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認されたアウトブレイクでIHR基準を複数該当（異常性・国際的関心・深刻な公衆衛生影響の可能性）。WHO事務局長による現地視察という国際的対応が示す高い懸念レベル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーには具体的な患者数、死亡数、ラボ確認情報が記載されていないが、WHO事務局長の現地視察という国際的対応の明確な記述から、アクティブで深刻なアウトブレイク状況が推測される。東コンゴ地域（Bunia）での発生が確認され、国際的な監視・対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات تنصح مواطنيها بعدم السفر إلى 3 دول بسبب فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE advises its citizens not to travel to three countries due to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-30, the United Arab Emirates’ Ministry of Foreign Affairs urged citizens not to travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, or South Sudan, except when absolutely necessary, amid Ebola virus disease (EVD) developments. The ministry emphasized adherence to health and safety guidance issued by authorities and said it is monitoring the situation for UAE nationals in the affected countries. Citizens abroad were advised to exercise maximum caution, follow local health directives, and register in the Tawajudi service to facilitate contact and assistance. They were also urged to contact the UAE’s emergency line for nationals abroad at +97180024, with the government indicating ongoing monitoring and measures to safeguard citizens’ safety.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦がエボラウイルスを理由に3カ国への渡航をしないよう国民に勧告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への影響が深刻で、複数国での発生確認により国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準に2つ以上該当。対象国（DRC）での実際の発生が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ、南スーダン、DRCでのエボラ発生を言及しているが、対象国リストはDRCのみ該当。UgandaとSudanは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。UAE（対象国外）からの渡航勧告であり、マスメディア（中東メディア）による報道で社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Quênia autoriza instalação para monitoramento de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya authorizes installation for Ebola surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Kenya approved a U.S.-run Ebola quarantine facility in Laikipia to house American citizens exposed to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The 50-bed unit, operated by the U.S. Public Health Service, is to begin on Friday, May 30, 2026. The Congo outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with Ituri province identified as the epicenter; the World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern, and authorities report over 1,000 suspected cases and hundreds of deaths, though real totals may be higher. Global response faces funding shortfalls (down from about $500 million to roughly $290 million), as well as flight restrictions and attacks on health facilities that hinder logistics. Kenya’s decision has drawn criticism over sovereignty and concerns that strict isolation policies may deter health workers. In eastern Congo, armed groups such as M23 complicate humanitarian operations, while bureaucratic delays hinder exemptions for aid flights carrying medicines.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱の監視施設の設置を承認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラアウトブレイク、1000件以上の疑い患者と数百人の死亡を報告。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州を震源地とするエボラアウトブレイクが主題。ケニアについては米国が運営する隔離施設を承認した国として言及されているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCのみ。Kenya（対象国外）は検出されたがサマリーの主題となるエボラの感染地ではないため除外。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項として宣言、資金不足と人道支援の障害が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: JKIA Gate 16 designated for high-risk Ebola arrivals - PS Muthoni
article.articleSummary: Kenya designates Gate 16 at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) for travellers from Ebola-high-risk countries, specifically the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, as part of enhanced surveillance. A port-health isolation centre and dedicated isolation points at Gate 16 enable rapid response to suspected cases; six international arrival gates are under heightened surveillance. All arrivals must complete online self-check forms detailing travel history and health status. Genomic sequencing is deployed for ongoing surveillance, and port health authorities collect and test waste samples from all arriving aircraft at national laboratories; samples are stored at the port health clinic. Kenya reports no Ebola cases to date and emphasizes containment and reliance on Ministry of Health information. Suspected or severe cases are referred to Kenyatta National Hospital, with quarantine facilities in place and a multi-agency border-safeguards approach. Airlines and affected countries are coordinated for passenger health data and exit screening reports; travelers are advised to avoid travel to affected countries until the situation stabilizes.

triage.headline_ja: JKIA Gate 16はエボラ出血熱の高リスク到着者向けに指定 - PS Muthoni
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（DRC、ウガンダでの発生）が認識されており、ケニアが国際空港で強化サーベイランスと検疫体制を実施する予防的対応を取っている。IHR基準では異常性と国際的拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では流行しやすさと管理可能性の項目が該当する。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生が背景にあり、ケニアの検疫体制強化はこれらの地域での活動性を示唆している。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事は予防的対応を述べており、ケニア国内でのエボラ確認例は報告されていないが、近隣国での発生が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ο διευθυντής του ΠΟΥ επισκέφθηκε το ιτούρι εν μέσω έξαρσης Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO director visited Ituri amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia in Ituri Province amid an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with the WHO declaring a global health emergency. The Ituri region accounts for the vast majority of reported Ebola cases, as authorities warn that real numbers may be higher due to limited testing and weakened health services in rural areas. Ghebreyesus arrived May 30, 2026, for a two-day visit to meet provincial leadership and support containment efforts. The DRC, one of the world’s poorest countries with about 100 million residents, declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15. Historical context notes Ebola has killed about 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years; the deadliest recent outbreak in DRC (2018–2020) caused 2,300 deaths across 3,500 confirmed cases. Ongoing challenges include insecurity and restricted access hindering laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ流行に対応すべくイトゥーリを訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、新規アウトブレイク、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当。WHOが世界保健緊急事態を宣言し、アウトブレイク規模・管理可能性に懸念がある。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に新規アウトブレイク宣言。イトゥーリ地域が報告例の大多数を占める。検査能力の限界と脆弱な保健サービスにより実数がさらに高い可能性。不安定性と限定的なアクセスが確認作業を阻害している。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Į KDR Ebolos protrūkio epicentrą atvyko PSO vadovas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General arrives at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak. The visit, announced as he sought to 'help' and 'listen' to people bearing the heaviest consequences, was reported by AFP. Ituri Province is described as the most affected by the severe Ebola outbreak in the country. The mission focuses on engaging with communities, assessing urgent needs, and supporting the response in a region still facing transmission. The article does not provide case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information about imported or exported cases. No further operational specifics are given, but the trip underscores international concern and the ongoing public health effort to curb Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ流行の震源地にWHO事務局長が到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当（3基準）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、WHO事務局長の視察派遣により国際的関心が明確。
triage.notes: 記事は現在進行中のエボラ流行の状況詳細（症例数、死亡数、検査確認、感染源）を記載していないが、WHO事務局長による現地視察という高レベルの国際対応が進行中であることが明らかに。Ituri州Bunia市が流行の震源地として特定されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: "Υπάρχουν πρωτόκολλα και θα ακολουθηθούν σε περίπτωση που υπάρξει ύποπτο περιστατικό έμπολα στην Κύπρο"-Πως μπορεί να γίνει η μετάδοση του ιού
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are protocols and they will be followed in the event of a suspected Ebola case in Cyprus — How the virus can be transmitted
article.articleSummary: Cyprus relies on existing Ebola protocols activated previously; in case of a suspected case, isolation and biosafety measures will be applied to protect clinicians and the public. Transmission occurs only through very close contact with infected bodily fluids (saliva, tears, urine, feces, blood). In late stages, microhemorrhages and hemorrhagic fever are typical. Outside Central Africa, any case would be imported—travellers from the DRC or Uganda—requiring thorough travel exposure investigations. The current outbreak strain appears more severe than prior ones, and there is no vaccine or antiviral treatment for this strain (vaccines exist for other strains). Management depends on symptoms. Prevention and public awareness are emphasized in DRC and Uganda, along with single-use personal protective equipment for doctors and nurses to avoid further spread.

triage.headline_ja: キプロスでエボラの疑わしい症例が出た場合のプロトコルが存在し、それに従う—ウイルスの伝播方法
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱に関する記事だが、記事サマリーはキプロスでの仮定的なシナリオに言及し、実際の発生事例ではなく、DRC・ウガンダでの流行の背景情報を提供している。IHR基準の充足状況が不明確であり、情報不足による経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は、キプロスにおけるエボラ対応プロトコルについての仮定的なシナリオ記事であり、キプロスでの実際の症例発生を報告していない。DRCとウガンダでの流行の背景情報が含まれているが、これらの国での具体的な症例数や拡大状況の記述が不足している。キプロスは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Le directeur général de l'OMS arrive dans la province d'Ituri, épicentre de l'Ebola | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General arrives in Ituri Province, Ebola's epicenter | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, at the epicenter of an Ebola outbreak involving the rare Bundibugyo strain. Authorities report 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. The outbreak is characterized by rapid spread, with transmission outpacing containment measures. There is currently no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola. Tedros plans to visit a treatment center and meet local authorities, health professionals, and affected families to reinforce support and response efforts. The visit underscores the urgent need for intensified public health actions to curb transmission and protect communities in the epicenter area.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラの震源地であるイトゥリ州に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：906疑い例223死亡、異常性：希少なブンディブギョ株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、シグナル識別基準を満たす。WHO事務局長の現地視察により国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラは希少であり、治療法・ワクチンがない。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的関心の高さを示している。疑い例906件、疑い死亡223件という高い疾病負荷。DRCは対象国リストに含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Επίσκεψη του επικεφαλής του ΠΟΥ στο επίκεντρο της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Visit of the WHO Director-General to the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province with Bunia as the capital and epicenter. On May 15, the WHO declared a global health emergency. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia for a two-day visit to support authorities and hear concerns, as Ituri concentrates the majority of confirmed cases amid a 100-million-strong national population. The DR Congo faces governance gaps in rural areas and armed groups that kill civilians, hindering access for health teams; the true scale is believed to be undercounted due to limited laboratory capacity. The Ebola virus has killed about 15,000 Africans over 50 years; the worst DRC outbreak occurred 2018–2020 with 2,300 deaths and 3,500 confirmed cases. Despite complexities, Tedros expressed optimism that the outbreak can be stopped through strengthened health infrastructure and international cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：WHO事務局長が流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で発生し、WHO事務局長が現地を訪問する国際的に重大な事象。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な懸念が明確。
triage.notes: エボラ熱は高い致死率を伴う第1種感染症。コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州での流行は、2018-2020年の大規模流行以来の重要な発生。WHO事務局長の緊急訪問、5月15日の国際保健上の緊急事態宣言が社会政治的関心の高さを示唆。地域的な治安問題と医療アクセス制限が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: सावध व्हा! इबोलाच्या नव्या स्ट्रेनचा कहर, ९०० रुग्ण, २२३ जणांचा मृत्यू; जाणून घ्या, किती धोकादायक?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stay alert! Devastating new Ebola strain wreaks havoc; 900 patients, 223 deaths — find out how dangerous it is.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) and Uganda with the Bundibugyo strain, as the WHO declares an international public health emergency. By May 30, 2026, over 900 suspected cases have been reported and more than 100 confirmed, with at least 223 deaths. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus is described as highly transmissible through direct contact with blood, sweat, saliva, or other body fluids of an infected person; it is not airborne, so sustained human-to-human spread is less rapid than respiratory viruses. No fully approved vaccine or specific treatment exists yet. India currently has no cases, but has heightened travel advisories, airport screening, and quarantine for travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Preventive measures include avoiding contact with infected individuals, regular hand hygiene, and seeking prompt medical care for fever or bleeding symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！エボラの新しい株の被害、900人の患者、223人の死亡；どのくらい危険か知りましょう。
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な健康被害、予想外の高病原性株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で主要な発生が確認され、Ugandaでも感染例が報告されている。Indiaは現在症例なしだが、旅行警告と空港スクリーニングが実施されており、国際的な関心の対象となっているため verified_locations に含める。Sudanは地域的な懸念として挙げられているが、記事の主要な発生地はDRCとUganda。対象国リストではDRCとIndiaのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: 陸網紅染恙蟲病猝逝！台灣今年已56例 疾管署示警：死亡率達60％
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland Chinese influencer dies suddenly after contracting scrub typhus! Taiwan has already reported 56 cases this year; Taiwan CDC warns that the mortality rate reaches 60%.
article.articleSummary: A 39-year-old mainland Chinese influencer from Yunnan province, identified as 'Hani Xiaowei', died after contracting scrub typhus. Scrub typhus is transmitted by chigger mites in grasslands and farms and occurs across Asia-Pacific, including Taiwan, mainland China, Japan, South Korea, and the Philippines. In Taiwan, as of May 24, 2026, there are 56 indigenous scrub typhus cases and 1 death, with higher counts in Taitung, Hualien, and Kinmen. The disease has an incubation of 9–12 days; early symptoms include high fever, headache, and lymphadenopathy, followed by rash about a week later; a characteristic black eschar at the bite site. Without treatment, mortality can reach 60%, but early antibiotics cut mortality to under 5%. Taiwan CDC notes seasonal peaks in April–May, June–July, and September–October. Preventive measures include long clothing, protective footwear, and repellents containing DEET, Picaridin, or IR3535, and showering after outdoor activity.

triage.headline_ja: 大陸のネット有名人が恙虫病で急死！台湾では今年56例報告 疾病管制署が警告：死亡率は60％に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性（予想外の高死亡率と複数国での流行）と国際的拡大リスク（中国・台湾・日本・韓国・フィリピンでの発生）が該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度（死亡例あり、未治療時60%の死亡率）、流行しやすさ（ベクター媒介で広域分布）、管理可能性の懸念が顕著。社会的関心も高い（有名人死亡報道）。
triage.notes: 恙虫病はアジア太平洋地域で広く流行するベクター媒介疾患。未治療時の死亡率60%と高く、台湾では今年既に56例の地域内伝播例を報告。有名人の死亡が報道され社会的関心が高い。複数国間での流行リスクとWHO通知の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Titular de la OMS llega al epicentro de brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General arrives at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, the World Health Organization Director-General arrived in Bunia, in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of an outbreak of a rare form of Ebola. The report notes that the virus still outpaces the response, despite health facilities in the area being better organized and new aid having arrived. The article does not provide figures for infections or deaths. The visit signals continued international attention to this Bunia-centered Ebola outbreak and the challenges of containing a rare Ebola strain in the region. This visit occurs amid continuing international concern over the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱の流行の中心地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響を持ち、DRCでの流行は異常で国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限の対象となる。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的関心を示す。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率の高い稀有な病原体であり、DRCでの流行は継続中。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的対応の継続を示唆している。記事では具体的な感染者数・死亡数の記載がないが、「ウイルスが対応をしのいでいる」との記述から進行中の流行が示唆される。Bunia（ブニア）はDRC東部の地点。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: le patron de l'OMS est arrivé en Ituri, épicentre de l'épidémie en RDC : Actualités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO head has arrived in Ituri, epicenter of the outbreak in the DRC: News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Ituri province as the epicenter and Bunia as the main entry point. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to engage communities and bolster the response; Bunia airport is closed to commercial flights. Declared May 15, the epidemic has triggered a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In DRC, 225 cases have been laboratory-confirmed, more than 1,000 suspected, and 246 deaths reported; 142 patients are in treatment centers. Uganda has nine confirmed cases, with two new ones announced on Friday. Ituri accounts for the majority of confirmed cases; access to healthcare is hampered by limited services and armed conflict. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, which lacks specific treatment or vaccine, unlike Zaïre Ebola, for which a vaccine exists. Trials for vaccines and therapeutics are planned; nearby-country risk is elevated but global risk remains low. One patient reportedly recovered.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO事務局長がイツリ州に到着、DRCの流行の震源地：ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、既に国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）が宣言されており、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言済みの確立した流行。DRC内での225確定例、1,000以上の疑い例、246死亡例。ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo ウイルス型でワクチン未入手。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は対応強化を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief meets DR Congo partners as Ebola cases mount
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths across DR Congo and neighboring Uganda as of May 30, 2026. Nine cases are in Uganda; a US doctor who treated patients in Congo was transferred to Germany for care. Congo authorities report more than 1,000 suspected cases since declaring the outbreak on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain, with a 30-50% fatality rate, concentrates in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived May 29 and led talks with health and humanitarian partners to strengthen coordination and community engagement in Ituri Province, promoting trusted messaging via religious, business, and women’s groups, plus radio and social media. A 32-year-old laboratory staff member contracted Ebola and was discharged as the first recovered patient from Rwampara Hospital in Ituri. Challenges include contact tracing, insecurity, and gaps in isolation and referral systems.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数増加に伴いWHO事務局長がDRコンゴのパートナーと会談
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Ebola outbreakの確認症例134例、死亡18例、国際的拡大（ウガンダ・ドイツ）、高い致死率（30-50%）、及びスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性も明らかに該当。
triage.notes: Kigali Province (Rwanda), South Kivu Province (DRC), Ituri (DRC) は対象国リストの標準表記に合わせて DRC として統一。ウガンダ（226074）は記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。ドイツの医師は医療者の移送であり発生地ではない。非常に高いリスク案件であり、即座にフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: زامبيا تستبعد إصابة حالتين بـ"إيبولا" وتكثف إجراءات الفحص
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zambia rules out two suspected Ebola cases and intensifies screening measures.
article.articleSummary: Zambia ruled out two suspected Ebola cases after laboratory tests, as it tightens border screening amid a regional outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus near the Democratic Republic of Congo. As of May 29, 2026, Congolese authorities reported 1,028 suspected Bundibugyo cases, with infections also detected in Uganda; there is no vaccine for this rare strain. Zambia warned cross-border transmission risk is high and has deployed entry-point screening tools and protocols for suspected cases. Ebola symptoms begin with fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain, potentially progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and multi-organ failure (per WHO). The Bundibugyo strain, named after a district in Uganda identified about two decades ago, remains challenging for contact tracing due to spread in densely populated areas.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、エボラ疑い例2件を除外し検査措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による地域的流行が進行中で、DRC で1,028件の疑い例が報告されており、ウガンダでも感染が確認されている。ザンビアは疑い例を除外したが、地域的な国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR 基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）複数に該当し、WPRO 基準（長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）も複数該当する。
triage.notes: Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事の主要な焦点はザンビアの対応と DRC での活動的な流行。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は希少株であり、ワクチンが利用できない点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα / Σε εγρήγορση για τον ιό η Κύπρος - "Πιο σοβαρή η έξαρση από προηγούμενες φορές" | OmegaLive
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola / Cyprus on alert for the virus - "The outbreak is more severe than in previous times" | OmegaLive.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Central Africa is reportedly more severe than prior waves. Cyprus has active protocols to handle suspected cases, with the Health Ministry potentially updating them; emphasis on absolute isolation and biosafety to protect healthcare workers and the public. Transmission occurs only through close contact with infected bodily fluids (saliva, tears, urine, stool, blood). In late stages, microhemorrhages cause hemorrhagic fever. Any case in Cyprus would be imported from Central Africa, with thorough questioning of travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda to determine exposure. The outbreak is linked to a more aggressive strain that has caused one or two earlier outbreaks; there is no vaccine or antiviral drugs available for this strain; management is symptomatic. Prevention-focused measures include informing residents in DRC and Uganda and using single-use PPE (suits, gloves, masks) in healthcare settings.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱 / キプロスがウイルスに警戒態勢 - 「今回の流行は過去より深刻」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（IHR報告対象疾患）が中央アフリカで報告され、過去より深刻な株であると報告されている。DRCおよびウガンダでの流行は異常かつ重症度が高く、国際的な拡大リスク（キプロスの警戒態勢）があり、IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: キプロスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主題はDRCおよびウガンダにおけるエボラウイルス病の流行であり、キプロスはあくまで輸入症例への準備状況として言及されている。過去より深刻な株の報告、ワクチンと抗ウイルス薬が利用できない点が重要な管理可能性の課題。

article.articleHeadline: UAE issues Ebola travel warning for Uganda, DR Congo and South Sudan
article.articleSummary: UAE travel advisory warns Emirati citizens against non-essential travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and South Sudan due to ongoing Ebola virus disease (EVD) developments in East and Central Africa as of 2026-05-30. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs urged nationals to monitor official guidance and exercise the highest levels of caution during visits or stays in the three countries. Emiratis currently in Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan were advised to follow local health and safety instructions and stay vigilant regarding Ebola developments, with the option to register with the Twajudi service to receive consular assistance. For urgent situations, citizens should contact the ministry via its dedicated emergency hotline. The advisory reflects intensified monitoring and containment efforts by health authorities to prevent Ebola transmission and safeguard citizens abroad.

triage.headline_ja: UAEがウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンに対するエボラ渡航警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の東・中央アフリカでの継続的な発生に対する公式渡航警告であり、IHR基準の国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、および異常/予想外性が確認される。対象国DRCが含まれ、複数国での同時イベント検出。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が述べられており、複数国での地域的流行を示唆。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。UAE発出の渡航警告であることから国際的関心と政策対応が高い。2026年5月30日配信で最新情報。

article.articleHeadline: Emiratis urged against travel to three African countries over Ebola virus risk | The National
article.articleSummary: UAE warns Emiratis against travel to Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan amid Ebola outbreak centered on the Bundibugyo strain. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs urges avoidance unless absolutely necessary, cautions travelers to follow local health guidance, and to register in the Twajudi service, contacting the ministry in emergencies. In DR Congo, as of Friday there are 906 suspected Ebola cases with 223 deaths under investigation; the death rate among confirmed cases ranges from 30 to 50 percent. The Bundibugyo strain has also spread to Uganda, with nine confirmed cases reported on Friday. There is currently no vaccine for Bundibugyo. The outbreak has been declared a public health emergency of international concern by the WHO, and some Gulf states have restricted travel from DR Congo, Uganda, and nearby South Sudan, reflecting ongoing spread in densely populated areas.

triage.headline_ja: エミラート国民に対しエボラウイルスのリスクを理由にアフリカの3つの国への渡航を控えるよう勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、国際的な渡航制限実施、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）宣言による高いリスク
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される実際の感染発生国はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンだが、対象国リスト内で該当するのはDRCのみ。UgandaはGeoNames ID 226074で対象国リストに含まれていない。ウガンダとの確認境界は国境を接する北東部であり、現在の国境における初期拡大段階と推定される。DRCではBundibugyo株による大規模流行（906疑い例、223死亡）が進行中、確認例の致命率30～50%。ワクチン未開発。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。複数の湾岸諸国が既に渡航制限を実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: "الخارجية" تحث مواطني الدولة على عدم السفر إلى 3 دول أفريقية بسبب "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Foreign Ministry urges citizens of the country not to travel to three African countries because of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Foreign Ministry advises citizens not to travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or the Republic of South Sudan due to Ebola virus disease (EVD), except when essential. The ministry also urges those already in these countries to exercise heightened caution, follow local health and safety directives, register in the Tawajudi service, and contact the ministry in emergencies. The alert underscores personal vigilance and compliance with authorities to mitigate Ebola-related risks. The notice centers on travel restrictions and citizen safety, with no further outbreak details or case figures provided. The communication emphasizes preparedness and responsiveness by authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 外務省、国民に対してエボラの為にウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国、南スーダンの3つのアフリカ諸国への渡航を控えるよう勧告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国への拡大が示唆され、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が認められ、政府レベルの関心が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラは高い致死率を持つ病原体で、複数国での同時発生は国際的な懸念事項であり、フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Ο γενικός διευθυντής του ΠΟΥ στο ιτούρι, επίκεντρο της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The WHO Director-General in Ituri, epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province with Bunia as capital, where the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived for a two-day visit. The DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15, triggering a WHO global health emergency. Ituri accounts for the majority of cases; access to rural areas is hampered by absent state health services and armed groups that kill civilians. International health authorities warn that the outbreak’s true scale is unknown and official counts likely understate the situation, partly due to limited laboratory capacity to confirm cases. Tedros urged decisive action, saying it is stoppable. Ebola has killed about 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years; the most lethal DRC outbreak (2018-2020) caused about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 confirmed cases. As of May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: WHO事務局長がイトゥリの流行中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の新規流行が確認されている。DRCでの新規宣言（2026年5月15日）による公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限リスクがWHO全体警報レベルの判定対象となる。
triage.notes: DRCでの新規エボラ流行（2026年5月15日宣言）。イトゥリ州ブニアが流行中心地。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により高い国際的関心を反映。真の感染規模は不明とされており、検査室能力の限界により公式統計は過小評価の可能性がある。武装勢力による治安悪化が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات تنصح مواطنيها بعدم السفر الى أوغندا والكونغو وجنوب السودان بسبب "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE advises its citizens not to travel to Uganda, the Congo, and South Sudan because of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) developments prompt the United Arab Emirates to advise its citizens not to travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan, except when travel is absolutely necessary. The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation urges residents currently in these countries to exercise the utmost caution, adhere to local health and safety guidelines, and stay informed of evolving conditions. Citizens are also urged to register in the Tawajudi service and to contact the Ministry promptly in emergencies. The advisory reflects ongoing health concerns linked to Ebola and emphasizes precaution for travelers and residents amid regional outbreaks. No details on confirmed cases or fatalities are provided in the statement.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦、エボラウイルス病の流行を理由にウガンダ、コンゴ、南スーダンへの渡航を自国民に対して勧告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準（重大な影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）の複数に該当。また、複数国への渡航勧告が発出されている点からWPRO基準（重大度、流行しやすさ）も該当し、社会的・政治的関心が存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、エボラウイルス病の流行がウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国、南スーダンで報告されており、これらの国への渡航勧告が発出されている。対象国リストの中で検証可能な発生地は DRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事は具体的な症例数や死亡数を提供していない（不明）が、複数国にわたる流行の警告は IHR および WPRO スクリーニング基準を十分に満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Argirita intensifica alerta e reforça combate à dengue no município
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Argirita steps up the dengue alert and reinforces the fight against dengue in the municipality.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-30, the Municipal Health Secretariat of Argirita, Brazil, issued an alert after confirmed dengue cases, urging aggressive prevention against the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Preventive actions focus on households: keep water storage tanks and drums tightly closed; clean gutters and water-holding containers; place sand in plant saucers; dispose of tires and bottles properly; maintain clean yards and surroundings. Citizens should monitor for dengue symptoms—high fever, body and joint pains, pain behind the eyes, red skin spots, and fatigue—and seek the nearest health facility promptly if dengue is suspected, avoiding self-medication. The administration emphasizes that prevention is the main weapon against dengue and that small, consistent actions can significantly protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: アルジリタ市がデング熱警報を強化し、市内でのデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのアルジリタ市でデング熱の確定症例が報告され、自治体が予防警報と対策を強化している。ただし、症例数、重症度、国際的な拡大リスクなどの具体的な情報が不足しており、スクリーニング基準の複数該当の確認ができない。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国外だが、対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に記載。デング熱は蚊媒介感染症で流行しやすく、予防対策の強化は自治体の懸念を示唆するが、具体的な症例数や重症度の情報が記事に記載されていない。続報での確定症例数および重症度情報の入手を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief arrives at epicentre of DRC's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak intensifies in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province with Bunia as a focal point. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been 1,077 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC and 246 deaths; across the border, Uganda has reported 9 confirmed infections, including 1 death. The highly contagious haemorrhagic fever is present in three eastern DRC provinces and in neighbouring Uganda, highlighting cross-border spread. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia on 30 May 2026 to help and listen to affected communities and strengthen response efforts. The true scope is likely wider than reported, as the DRC struggles with limited laboratory capacity to confirm cases, and the outbreak is thought to have circulated before detection.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国家展開、高い死亡率、ヒト-ヒト感染性の高さ、および国際的な支援対応（WHO事務局長の現地訪問）が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれていますが、記事サマリーではDRCが主な発生地でありウガンダは確認例の報告に限定されています。WPRO対象国にウガンダが含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めました。エボラウイルス病は極めて高リスク疾患であり、国境を越えた拡大、高い致死率（約23%）、実験室確認能力の限界から、実際の感染規模はさらに大きい可能性があります。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo: Lieferung notwendiger Hilfsgüter nach Ebola-Ausbruch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Delivery of essential relief supplies after the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF delivered over 100 tons of urgently needed relief supplies to the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo to help contain the Ebola virus outbreak. Air shipments, supported by the European Commission's Directorate-General for European Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations (ECHO), include personal protective equipment for health workers, medicines, hygiene items, and other medical supplies from UNICEF’s Copenhagen logistics hub. The relief aims to benefit about 100,000 people, including children and families affected by displacement, conflict, and limited access to life-saving services. UNICEF Representative in the DRC, John Agbor, emphasized the urgency of protecting frontline responders and communities. Coordinated risk education and community engagement—with local leaders, religious groups, women’s and youth organizations, and health personnel—are central to outbreak containment. UNICEF has activated its highest emergency level and mobilized $6.5 million of internal funding to scale up aid across multiple provinces in the northeast.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ流行後の必要な救援物資の配送
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス流行が確認され、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際支援の需要）に該当。DRCは対象国であり、複数州での急速な支援拡大と高レベルの緊急対応が進行中。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはDenmark（Copenhagen）も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC北東部のエボラ流行であり、Denmarkは支援提供国（UNICEF物流ハブ所在地）に過ぎないため、verified_locationsから除外した。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため、シグナル化の基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: El director de la OMS visita el epicentro del brote de ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General visits the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths reported; Uganda confirms 9 cases and 1 death. No approved treatment or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits Bunia to view a treatment center and meet local authorities, health workers, and affected families, stressing the need to provide full support to bring the outbreak under control. EU aid has arrived in Ituri, with more shipments expected over the next eight days; the United States announces an additional $80 million in assistance, bringing total U.S. support to over $112 million. Response at Rwampara and Bunia General Hospitals is more organized with extra staff, PPE, and supplies, but patients continue arriving at all hours.

triage.headline_ja: WHOのテドロス事務局長がコンゴのエボラ流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（承認された治療法やワクチンなし）による大規模流行で、DRCで906例の疑似症例と223死亡、ウガンダでも9例と1死亡を報告。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的拡大リスク、重症度、長期曝露、管理困難性が明確であり、国際支援（EU、米国の援助）も実施中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）は5種類の既知のエボラウイルスのうち最も致命率が低いとされるが、承認された治療法やワクチンが存在しない点が懸念される。ウガンダでの確認例があるが、サマリーに基づき実際の流行の中心はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため検証地域には含めない。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、EU・米国の大規模支援表明など、国際的な対応レベルが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Στο Ιτούρι του Κονγκό ο Αντανόμ Γκεμπρεγέσους
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus in Ituri, Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province with Bunia as the capital, where WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived for a two‑day visit to support local authorities. Congo declared a new Ebola epidemic on May 15, 2026, threatening about 100 million people; WHO has issued a global health emergency. Ituri hosts the majority of reported hemorrhagic fever cases. State services are absent in rural areas, and armed groups hindering civilians profoundly obstruct access. International health authorities warn the outbreak’s scale is not yet known, with published tallies likely underestimating reality due to limited laboratory confirmation capacity. The Ebola outbreak has caused 15,000 deaths in Africa over the last 50 years. The most deadly DRC outbreak killed 2,300 people among about 3,500 confirmed cases in 2018–2020.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴのイトゥーリ州でテドロス・アダノム・ゲブレイエスス WHO事務局長が訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な新規発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、グローバルヘルス上の緊急事態宣言、約100万人に対する脅威という重大な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に新規エボラ流行を宣言。イトゥーリ州の武装勢力による医療アクセス阻害、農村部での国家サービス欠落により管理が困難。実際の患者数はラボ確認能力不足により過少報告の可能性あり。WHO事務局長の緊急訪問は国際的関心の高さを反映。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en République démocratique du Congo : le patron de l'OMS est arrivé en Ituri, épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the WHO chief has arrived in Ituri, the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centered in Ituri province, with Bunia—the provincial capital—as the focus of a high-level response. On May 15, 2026, the DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak across multiple provinces, and the WHO has triggered an international health alert. By May 30, 2026, the DRC reported over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths; neighboring Uganda confirmed nine cases after two new infections. The Ituri province accounts for the majority of confirmed cases, with access impeded by limited state services in rural areas and ongoing armed-group violence. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to meet authorities and press for action. A patient in the DRC recovered and was discharged on Friday. Authorities indicate the outbreak’s full scale is uncertain due to limited laboratory testing; past regional outbreaks in Africa have caused substantial fatalities (e.g., 2018–2020).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱：WHO事務局長がイツリ州（流行の中心地）に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つ全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラ熱の多国家流行で1,000件以上の疑い例と246人の死亡、ウガンダへの国際拡大、WHO事務局長派遣による高い国際的関心から、直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事にはウガンダの9症例確認も記載されているが、主な発生地域及び対象対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。2026年5月15日宣言の新規流行で、実験室検査能力の限定により流行規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。過去のアフリカ域内流行（2018-2020）での致命的転帰との比較からも重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mysterious Bat Deaths in Chhattisgarh Raise Alarm
article.articleSummary: Bat mortality event in Balod district, Dalli Rajhara, Chhattisgarh, India, with 50-70 bats found dead daily over the past several days. Authorities from forest and veterinary departments have collected samples from the carcasses and dispatched them to the ICAR-National High Security Animal Disease Laboratory in Bhopal for laboratory confirmation. Preliminary assessments point to extreme heat as a possible factor, though an infectious disease cannot be ruled out; investigation results are awaited. The situation has prompted monitoring and an alert by senior forest officials, with teams patrolling affected areas. Public guidance urges residents not to touch dead or sick bats and to report sightings to authorities to mitigate potential infection risk. No confirmed cause yet; findings from the Bhopal lab will determine if this represents a wildlife mortality event linked to heat stress or an infectious outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガルの謎のコウモリ大量死が警戒を呼び起こす
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の感染症関与の可能性を有する動物大量死イベント。原因不明で感染症を除外できず、検査結果待ちの段階であり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 動物感染症イベントで、ヒトへの直接的な深刻な影響は現段階では報告されていない。コウモリは人獣共通感染症（狂犬病、ニパウイルス等）の重要な宿主であるため、感染症関与の確認には注意が必要。ICAR-National High Security Animal Disease Laboratoryの検査結果が出た段階で再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo rules out closing schools due to Ebola epidemic
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo's eastern provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with a case fatality rate of 30–50% among confirmed cases. Since mid-May, at least five schoolchildren in Ituri have died. Health Minister Roger Kamba says schools will not be closed, prioritizing reinforced preventive measures in schools to avoid punishing children; he urged families to avoid self-medication and seek timely care. As of 2026-05-30, the WHO reports at least 134 confirmed Ebola cases in the current Congo–Uganda outbreak, with over 1,000 cumulative suspected cases since the outbreak was declared. Confirmed cases include nine in Uganda, with deaths among confirmed cases in the two countries totaling 18. Authorities continue to monitor new suspected cases across the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行により学校閉鎖を除外
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目全てに該当する：公衆衛生への深刻な影響（134確定患者、18死亡、30-50%の致命率）、異常・予想外（Bundibugyo株による大規模流行）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでも9例確認）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク。また、スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC東部州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）におけるエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダでの9例も言及されているが、記事はDRC-ウガンダ共同の流行として報告されており、主要な発生地はDRC。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行（134確定患者、1,000以上の疑似患者）、高い致命率、学校での児童死亡報告など、深刻性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: UAE urges citizens not to travel to 3 Ebola-hit countries unless necessary
article.articleSummary: UAE urges citizens not to travel to Ebola-hit Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the Republic of South Sudan, except for necessity, due to ongoing Ebola virus disease (EVD) developments. Citizens currently in these countries should exercise utmost caution, follow local health and safety instructions, and register in the 'I'm Here' service; they should contact the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs in emergencies. The advisory reflects evolving EVD activity in the three nations. The notice provides no outbreak metrics or clinical details. More updates will follow; users are advised to refresh the page for the full version. This travel advisory targets precautionary measures rather than clinical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: UAE、エボラ出血熱の感染が広がる3か国への渡航を国民に自粛するよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、複数国での発生が確認され、国際的な渡航制限・警告が発出されている。IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）に複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にはUganda、Sudan、UAEも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は『UAE市民へのDRC、Uganda、南スーダンへの渡航警告』であり、実際のエボラ発生地は3か国（DRC、Uganda、南スーダン）。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。UgandaはWPROスクリーニング基準に含まれ得るが、対象国リストに未掲載のため verified_locations には含めない。記事では具体的な症例数や重症度情報は不明だが、エボラの性質上WPRO基準の「severity」「epidemic_prone」を確実に満たす。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية يصل إلى بؤرة تفشي إيبولا بشرق الكونغو الديمقراطية - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General arrives at the Ebola outbreak epicenter in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains acute, centered in Ituri Province with Bunia as a key treatment hub. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived at the epicenter amid ongoing transmission, noting the outbreak’s spread is outpacing response capacity even as health facilities improve and aid arrives. He is to visit a treatment center in Bunia and meet local authorities, health workers, and affected families. The World Health Organization reported 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths. The current Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO previously declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, calling for a coordinated international response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ出血熱流行の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの急性流行。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による906疑い例・223死亡例を報告。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがすべて明確。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長現地訪問、PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（承認済み治療法・ワクチンなし）による急性流行。反応能力を上回る速度での拡大が報告されている。アフリカ域内における重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: le patron de l'OMS est arrivé en Ituri, épicentre de l'épidémie en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the WHO chief has arrived in Ituri, epicenter of the outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) Director‑General arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, the epicenter of a severe Ebola outbreak progressing in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The report identifies Ebola as the disease and Ituri as the focal area with ongoing transmission in the eastern DRC. No case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported or exported cases are provided in the excerpt. The piece underscores international attention to the outbreak and the ongoing impact in the region, highlighting Ituri and the eastern DRC as key focus points in the epidemic response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：WHO事務局長がイトゥリに到着、コンゴ民主共和国の流行の震源地
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際保健上の重大な脅威であり、DRCで進行中の流行が報告されている。WHO事務局長の現地到着という国際的関心の高さと、異常性・国際拡大リスク・重症度基準の複数該当により、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は重大な国際保健上の脅威として認識されている。記事からは具体的な症例数・死亡数は明記されていないが、WHO事務局長の現地訪問という事実が国際的関心度の高さを示唆している。DRCのイトゥリ州における進行中の流行と明記されており、地域検証により対象国として確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Ebola: le patron de l'OMS est arrivé en Ituri, épicentre de l'épidémie en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - Ebola: The head of the WHO has arrived in Ituri, the epicentre of the outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with Bunia as the epicentre and the outbreak progressing in the region. As of 30 May 2026, the DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak on 15 May, and the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia on 30 May 2026, landing at Bunia International Airport, which has been closed to commercial flights due to the outbreak. He said the mission is to engage with the community, understand how the response is implemented, and identify difficulties where WHO support can help. The visit underscores the international response to Ebola in eastern DRC; the article does not provide case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - エボラ：WHO事務局長がイトゥリに到着、DRCにおける流行の中心地
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤で高致死率、DRCでの新規アウトブレイク、国際的な懸念を反映してWHOが国際的懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。
triage.notes: DRCでの新規エボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）であり、WHOが国際的懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。イトゥリ州ブニアが流行の中心。WHO事務局長による実地対応視察が実施されており、国際的対応が進行中。記事からは具体的な症例数および死亡数は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ajuda global é insuficiente para conter ebola no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global aid is insufficient to contain Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has grown to the third-largest on record, with Ituri and North Kivu in the east reporting 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths, per Africa CDC. WHO fears spread within the DRC and to neighboring countries. The response is hampered by funding shortfalls after the United States left WHO, with promised support shrinking from nearly $500 million to about $290 million. Germany’s BMZ also cut contributions, though it plans roughly €160 million in development aid for 2026–2027, noting prevention funding isn’t separately allocated. NGOs CARE and Caritas urge increased investment and education, while Diakonie’s Josue Ibulungu says only ~30% of aid needs are met; hospitals are damaged and PPE is scarce. BMZ intends to send specialists to the east to train more workers, highlighting the need for stronger international action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ対策に対する国際支援は不十分
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（歴史上3番目の規模）であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。国際的な資金不足と地域的な感染拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC 内での Ebola 流行を主題としており、US と Germany への言及は国際的な支援・対応状況の文脈。疫学的な発生地は DRC の Ituri と North Kivu。対象国リストに DRC が含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙。歴史上 3 番目の大規模流行、1,077 疑似症例・246 死亡、資金不足による対応阻害が重大懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola diễn biến phức tạp, cần chuẩn bị các phương án phòng dịch từ sớm, từ xa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola’s complex progression calls for early, proactive preparation of epidemic-prevention plans.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with very high mortality risk and rapid spread. There is currently no vaccine or specific antiviral for Bundibugyo. Transmission occurs from wildlife to humans (fruit bats, porcupines, primates) and between people via direct contact with blood, secretions, body fluids, or contaminated objects. Ebola comprises six species; Bundibugyo, along with Zaire ebolavirus and Sudan ebolavirus, commonly drives outbreaks; the present cluster in Congo and Uganda is Bundibugyo-linked. As of May 27, 2026, Congo reports 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths. WHO assesses Congo’s risk as very high; regional risk (including Uganda) is high due to community transmission and cross-border movement; global risk is low. Vietnam faces a low importation risk, but authorities emphasize early detection, hospital infection control, border screening, and rapid isolation to prevent entry.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの複雑な進展状況、早期かつ先制的な疫病防止計画の準備が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。複数国での確認、高い死亡率、ワクチン・特異的治療薬なし、ヒト-ヒト感染性あり、越境移動のリスク。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模アウトブレイク。2026年5月27日時点でコンゴで疑い例1,077件、疑い死亡238件を報告。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、記事サマリーで言及されているがverified_locationsから除外。ベトナムは輸入リスク低いとされるが、防止措置強化を記述。WHOはコンゴのリスク「非常に高い」、地域リスク「高い」、世界的リスク「低い」と評価。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief tours Congo outbreak hub as Ebola cases climb and borders close - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) has reached 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, with 9 cases and 1 death reported in Uganda. The Bundibugyo virus currently has no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to inspect a treatment center and coordinate support amid rising cases and security challenges. EU aid shipments to Ituri and a US commitment of $80 million, bringing total international assistance to at least $112 million, accompany improvements in response capacity. MSF warns the outbreak is outpacing the response. Attacks on health centers tied to burial practices and rebel activity (ADF, M23) hinder efforts across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, including Goma and Bukavu. Uganda and Rwanda have closed borders; a US travel ban on recent visitors to Congo, Uganda or South Sudan was reported.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのアウトブレイク拠点を視察、エボラ症例が増加し国境閉鎖 - CNBC TV18
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。Bundibugyo型エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（906疑い例、223死亡、国際的拡大あり）であり、WHO事務局長の現地視察、国境閉鎖、米国の渡航禁止など国際的な公式対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域はDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu各州）が主要であり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダとルワンダは国境閉鎖と確定例報告があるが、サマリー上でウガンダは9例1死亡の限定的な報告であり、主たるアウトブレイク地はDRC。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。イエローフィーバーワクチン開発国との国境閉鎖、WHO最高指導者の緊急視察、$112M以上の国際援助、米国渡航禁止など、国際的関心と政治的対応が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo: la conexión con el consumo de carne silvestre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: The Link to Bushmeat Consumption
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is linked to bushmeat consumption in the Congo Basin. Since May 15, authorities report more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 220 deaths; the World Health Organization believes the true toll is higher. The current outbreak in eastern DRC is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved treatments or vaccines, worsened by armed conflict and displacement. The article emphasizes a One Health approach, noting the persistent interface among humans, wildlife, and the environment drives spillover, with fruit bats as natural reservoirs. In Kinshasa’s Masina market, vendors sell bushmeat—antelope, rodents, and snakes—though monkeys are no longer offered. Historical context includes 17 Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (~28,000 cases, ~11,300 deaths). Public health education on bushmeat risks remains crucial.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ：野生肉消費との関連性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則上の通知義務疾患であり、1,000件以上の疑い患者と220名以上の死亡、希少株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の検出、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が全て確認される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は重要な国際通知義務疾患。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）は治療法やワクチンが承認されていない希少株で懸念が高い。武装紛争と強制移動により管理困難な状況。アンゴラ・コンゴ共和国も発生地域として列挙されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主焦点のため、DRCのみverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola e 5 livelli di rischio: cosa dice la circolare del ministero della Salute per chi arriva da Congo e Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and 5 levels of risk: what the Health Ministry circular says for people arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda informs Italy’s Health Ministry circular on five risk levels for asymptomatic travelers from those countries. Very low risk entails health education and referral information; Low risk involves symptom monitoring, temperature checks, and at least one ASL verification; Moderate risk entails daily ASL surveillance through day 21 and travel notifications if leaving the region; High risk triggers quarantine and daily monitoring through day 21; Very high risk requires biocontainment transport to Rome’s Spallanzani Hospital. The circular notes that origin from an affected country alone does not define a suspected case; decisions rely on integrated clinical evaluation, travel history, areas visited, and exposures. For symptomatic arrivals, Fiumicino Airport is the permitted entry point to Italy; such passengers must alert crew, and the aircraft lands at Fiumicino for USMAF-SASN procedures. Airlines are urged to report suspicious onboard situations promptly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラと5段階のリスクレベル：コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダからの到着者に対する保健省通達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。実際のエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）がDRC・ウガンダで発生しており、複数国への入国管理体制を誘発している。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国（イタリア、ウガンダを言及）を含むが、実際の感染症イベントはDRCおよびウガンダで発生。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。イタリアはEU内での対応国であり、入国管理体制が発表されているが、発生国ではない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株の確認事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ajuda global é insuficiente para conter ebola no Congo, alertam organizações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global aid is insufficient to contain Ebola in the Congo, organizations warn.
article.articleSummary: Global aid is insufficient to contain Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, humanitarian and health organizations warn. Two weeks after the government and the World Health Organization declared the outbreak on May 15, 2026, responders say the international effort is being outpaced by the virus, which is advancing and threatening neighboring countries. Since the declaration, it has become the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The epidemic continues to grow in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu, with Africa CDC reporting 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths. The WHO fears further spread within the country and abroad, and aid groups warn that, without a more decisive response, this could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak in history. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said it will worsen before it improves.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルな援助はコンゴのエボラ対策には不十分であると組織が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5基準該当。DRCでの大規模エボラ流行で、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日の公式宣言以降、過去3番目の規模となるエボラ流行。1,077疑似症例、246疑似死亡を報告。Ituri州およびNorth Kivu州で急速に拡大中。WHO事務局長も悪化を警告。隣接国への国際的拡大リスクが明記されており、世界的規模での対応が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Шефът на СЗО пристигна в провинция Итури - епицентъра на епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief arrived in Ituri Province - epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak epicenter, on May 28, 2026. The DRC’s May 15 outbreak declaration prompted WHO to raise a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola, a highly contagious virus causing hemorrhagic fever, has been detected across three DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda. African CDC data from the DRC indicate over 1,000 presumptive cases and at least 246 deaths. Tedros stated the situation is complex but stoppable. The article notes Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past 50 years, with the deadliest Congolese outbreak (2018–2020) recording about 3,500 cases and ~2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱流行の震源地であるイトゥリ州に到着、コンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響（246人の死亡、1,000件以上の推定患者）、異常/予想外（新規流行宣言）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで既に検出）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は高い社会的・政治的関心を示唆。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行は2026年5月15日にDRCで正式宣言され、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を発令している。記事サマリーではウガンダでの検出も言及されているが、記事の主題は「DRC内のイトゥリ州の流行」であり、ウガンダは追加情報として記載されている。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしている。

article.articleHeadline: El director general de la OMS visita el epicentro del brote de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia, Ituri Province, as the epicenter. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to assess the response and engage communities; Bunia's airport is closed to commercial flights due to the epidemic. The DRC declared an outbreak on May 15, affecting a large territory. The WHO has activated an international health alert. Ebola has been detected in three Congolese provinces and in Uganda, where two new cases were confirmed on Friday, raising Uganda’s total to nine confirmed cases. In the DRC, authorities report about 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, with Ituri Province concentrating the majority of confirmed cases. International health bodies warn the true magnitude may be undercounted due to limited laboratory capacity. Africa has recorded over 15,000 Ebola deaths in the past five decades; the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak caused about 2,300 deaths from roughly 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間感染、死亡例246件、国際保健警報が発動されており、シグナルとして確実に識別される。
triage.notes: ウガンダでもエボラ確認例があるが、サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地（246死亡、約1,000疑い患者）であり、ウガンダは2次的な発生地。対象国リストでウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOが国際保健警報を発動し、DRC政府も5月15日に公式宣言している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief lands in eastern Congo's Ituri province, epicenter of Ebola, as outbreak outpaces response
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo’s Ituri province, centered on Bunia, is the epicenter of an outbreak of a rare Ebola virus disease where transmission continues to outpace the response, despite better-organized health facilities and new aid arrivals. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia on 30 May 2026 to assess the situation, visit a treatment center, and meet local authorities, health workers, and affected families. The report notes ongoing transmission in the city and underscores challenges in containing this rare form of Ebola, with no specific case counts provided. The arrival signals renewed international attention and the push to bolster outbreak response and patient care in Ituri’s Bunia as the outbreak unfolds.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部イトゥリ州のエボラ熱流行の中心地ブニアにWHO事務局長が到着、流行が対応を上回る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の継続的な人から人への感染、国際的な対応の必要性、WHOの高レベル関与によりIHR基準3つ以上に該当。WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ熱は高い致死率を持つ稀有な疾患。イトゥリ州ブニアが流行の中心地であること、伝播が対応を上回っている状況、WHO事務局長の現地訪問が報告されており、国際的な懸念は明確である。具体的な患者数は記載されていないが、継続的な伝播が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Lands In Eastern Congo's Ituri Province, Epicenter Of Ebola, As Outbreak Outpaces Response
article.articleSummary: 2026-05-30: WHO Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri Province, eastern DRC, epicenter of an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus. DRC reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; neighboring Uganda has nine cases and one death. Bundibugyo virus has no approved treatment or vaccine. Tedros urged continued, comprehensive support to bring the outbreak under control. European Union aid arrived in Ituri on Thursday, with additional shipments expected over the next eight days; the United States announced an extra $80 million, lifting total U.S. commitments to more than $112 million. Response at Bunia’s Rwampara and General hospitals appears more organized, with extra staff, protective gear and medical supplies, though patients continue arriving around the clock. Congo has faced Ebola before and aims to contain this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が東コンゴのイトゥリ州に到着、エボラ出血熱の震源地で発生状況が対応を上回る
