triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な流行であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。DRCで906疑い例、223疑い例死亡、ウガンダでも9例1例死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大、WHO最高指導部の現地訪問による高い社会政治的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州東部でのエボラ出血熱の流行を主題としている。ウガンダも影響を受けているが、対象国リストには含まれていない。米国とEUの国際支援が言及されているが、これらの国での実際の発生ではなく支援国であるため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo virus株であり、承認済みの治療法やワクチンが存在しないことが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تؤكد دعمها للكونغو مع تفشي جديد لفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization confirms its support for Congo amid a new Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, a new Ebola outbreak is unfolding in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with affected areas in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. National health authorities, with international partners, are intensifying containment efforts to curb spread. The response faces funding shortfalls and limited international support, complicating logistics and supplies. The World Health Organization has reiterated its ongoing support, including strengthening medical supplies, to prevent further deterioration of the health situation. The article does not provide case or death counts. Authorities are monitoring transmission and prepared to identify any imported or cross-border cases, underscoring the need for sustained funding and international cooperation to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの新たな流行が発生する中、世界保健機関（WHO）がコンゴへの支援を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症は高い致死率と感染性を有し、DRCの複数州での流行拡大はWPRO基準全項目も該当。国際的関心と支援の必要性が明確であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCの複数州（イトゥリ、南キブ）でのエボラ流行。記事は具体的な患者数・死亡数を記載していないが、WHOによる国際支援、資金不足、国境監視の必要性が強調されており、制御困難な状況が示唆されている。高い優先度でRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 鉴于埃博拉疫情暴发，墨西哥三航司对来自非洲中部旅客实施限制措施 -- 新京报
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In light of the Ebola outbreak, three Mexican airlines impose restrictions on passengers from Central Africa — The Beijing News
article.articleSummary: Three Mexican airlines—Aeroméxico, Viva Aerobus, and Volaris—announced on May 29, 2026 restrictions restricting entry to travelers who have stayed in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the prior 21 days, effective for 60 days amid the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa. The 2026 FIFA World Cup is scheduled June 11–July 19 in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo sending a team to play in U.S. and Mexican venues. On May 28, the United States, in coordination with Canada and Mexico, issued a joint statement to align measures for travelers from high‑risk Ebola regions, though specifics were not disclosed. The World Health Organization had previously designated the Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ongoing travel restrictions aim to protect public health during the tournament.}}{

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行に対応し、メキシコの3航空会社がアフリカ中部からの乗客に制限措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事案（PHEIC）と宣言した確認されたエボラ出血熱の流行。国際的な旅行制限と複数国の調整対応が発生している。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱の流行をアフリカ中部（特にDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での発生として報じている。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国外だが、記事の主題となっている重要な発生地。WHOがPHEICに指定済みで、2026 FIFA World Cup時期における国際的な懸念事項となっている。メキシコ、米国、カナダの3国が調整措置を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Congo : le patron de l'OMS est arrivé en Ituri, épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: the WHO chief has arrived in Ituri, the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, the epicenter of a grave Ebola outbreak progressing in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The visit, reported by AFP, underscores intensified international attention as health authorities contend with transmission in Ituri and surrounding eastern areas. The outbreak is described as severe and ongoing, with Bunia serving as a focal point of the response. The article notes the Ebola situation in the DRC, highlighting the challenging context in which responders are trying to scale up surveillance, case management, and community engagement to curb spread. The report does not specify case counts or outcomes, but emphasizes the strategic importance of the visit by the WHO chief in supporting the eastern Congo response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ: WHO事務局長がイトゥリ県に到着、流行の震源地
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルスの深刻な流行が東部コンゴで進行中。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的関心の高まりを示唆し、シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ流行が東部DRCのイトゥリ県で進行中であることを明確に述べており、WHO事務局長の現地訪問は高レベルの国際的関与を示唆している。症例数や死亡数は記載されていないが、「深刻で進行中の流行」と描写されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、検証済み地域として確認。

article.articleHeadline: El director general de la OMS visita el epicentro del brote de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General visits the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, Ituri province, epicenter of an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Bunia’s airport was closed to commercial flights due to the epidemic as he met communities and assessed response challenges. The outbreak, declared May 15, prompted WHO to activate an International Health Emergency alert. Ebola, a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever, has been detected in three DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda, where two new cases were confirmed on Friday, bringing Uganda’s confirmed total to nine. In the DRC, authorities report more than 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths (Africa CDC balance, as of the latest update). Ituri hosts most confirmed cases; authorities warn the magnitude may be underestimated due to limited laboratory capacity. The epidemic’s history includes over 15,000 African deaths in 50 years, with the 2018–2020 Congo outbreak causing about 2,300 deaths from 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的多発症例、1,000件以上の疑い患者と246人の死亡者、複数国への拡大、WHO事務局長の緊急訪問により高い政治的関心が確認される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の新規流行として2026年5月15日に宣言され、WHOが国際保健緊急警報を発令。DRC国内で3州およびウガンダで確認されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行である。ウガンダは記事中で二次的な拡大地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。実験室容量の制限による過小評価の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief rallies community in Congo's Ebola response, calls for more funding
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates, with 1,028 suspected cases recorded by Friday in Ituri province’s Bunia, a central hotspot. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to coordinate the response, urging community ownership and participation while acknowledging international support under the government’s leadership. He highlighted the need for more funding after WHO said only about one-third of its funding requirements had been met. In Kinshasa, Tedros called for expanded international backing. Médecins Sans Frontières warned the outbreak—the 17th since 1976—was spreading at an unprecedented pace, with expert responders and support still below what is needed. The response remains community-centered, focusing on local-level challenges in Ituri and surrounding areas as authorities push for faster action and resources.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ対応で地域住民を結集、さらなる資金提供を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5つすべて該当。WHO事務局長の現地訪問など国際的関心が高く、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月時点でのエボラアウトブレイク。1976年以来17番目のエボロラ発生。1,028件の疑似症例がイトゥリ州のブニアで記録されている。WHO事務局長テドロス氏が現地に駐在し対応を指揮。資金不足（要求の3分の1しか確保されていない）が懸念事項。MSFは前例のないペースでの感染拡大を警告。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Walikale : à Kibua, la crise humanitaire s'aggrave entre choléra, menace d'Ebola et afflux massif de déplacés | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Walikale: in Kibua, the humanitarian crisis is worsening amid cholera, the Ebola threat, and a massive influx of internally displaced people.
article.articleSummary: Cholera remains a critical threat in Kibua health zone, Walikale, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with over 20 deaths in the past three months and ongoing cases amid a large internally displaced persons (IDP) influx. Ntoto Centre, Kilungu-Buoye, and Langira host more than 30,000 displaced households living in precarious conditions, with limited access to potable water, sanitation, and healthcare, fueling transmission of waterborne disease. The risk of Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) is also rising, as many displaced communities lack knowledge of transmission and prevention due to insufficient information campaigns. TEDE-RDC calls on authorities and partners to intensify community awareness, distribute hygiene kits, improve water access, and strengthen health facilities to meet growing needs. WHO support is acknowledged; urgent, targeted action in Walikale’s enclaved zones is urged as of 30 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | ワリカレ：キブアにおける人道危機が悪化 - コレラ、エボラの脅威、および大量の国内避難民の流入の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コレラとエボラの同時発生、3ヶ月で20人以上の死亡、3万世帯以上の避難民が劣悪な衛生環境に置かれており、国際的拡大リスクと水際対策上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのワリカレ地区キブア保健区におけるコレラとエボラウイルス病（ブンディブギョ株）の同時危機を報告。3万世帯以上の避難民が飲料水・衛生・医療へのアクセスが制限された劣悪な環境に放置されており、ヒト-ヒト感染経路を持つエボラと水系感染経路のコレラの二重脅威が存在。WHOの関与とURGENT ACTION要請が明記されている。アンゴラはBenguela州が発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーにはアンゴラでの事例記載がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Έφτασε στο Κονγκό ο ΓΔ του ΠΟΥ για αξιολόγηση της κατάστασης με Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General Arrived in the Congo to Assess the Ebola Situation
article.articleSummary: On 30 May 2026, the World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the area hardest hit by a deadly Ebola outbreak, to assess the situation on the ground. AFP reported that Ghebreyesus had earlier announced plans to travel to Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, to 'help' and 'listen' to the people facing the outbreak. The report highlights the high-level nature of the visit and the ongoing Ebola crisis in Congo, underscoring the involvement of WHO leadership in responding to the epidemic in this region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴに到着、エボラ情勢を評価するため
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生で、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、WHO事務局長の現地訪問という国際的な高レベルの対応が行われている。深刻な感染症の流行事象として、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年5月30日のイベント（未来日時）を記述している点に注意。実際のエボラ発生状況の確認が必要。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないが、IHR基準とWPRO基準の両方で重大なシグナルであるため、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: UAE issues travel advisory amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs has issued a travel advisory urging UAE nationals to avoid non-essential travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan because of the evolving Ebola outbreak. The advisory is part of ongoing measures to safeguard citizens abroad amid the public health situation tied to Ebola. Emiratis currently in these countries are advised to remain vigilant, follow health and safety guidance issued by local authorities, and register with the Twajudi service for consular assistance. In case of an emergency, UAE nationals can contact the Ministry through its dedicated hotline at +971 80024. The guidance emphasizes precaution and preparedness for travelers amid the outbreak, with no stated requirement to depart immediately.

triage.headline_ja: UAE issues travel advisory amid Ebola outbreak
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の複数国同時発生は高優先度シグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づく地域検証：発生地域には DRC（203312）、Uganda（226074）、South Sudan（366755）、UAE（290557）が列挙されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC のみ。Uganda および South Sudan はサマリーに明示的に記載されているものの、提供された対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当していないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。エボラ出血熱は重篤度が極めて高く、複数国での発生報告、国際的な渡航勧告の発令がある点で、高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Καραγιάννης: Υπάρχουν σχέδια αντιμετώπισης αν εμφανιστεί εισαγόμενο κρούσμα Έμπολα στην Κύπρο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Karagiannis: There are contingency plans to address an imported Ebola case if it appears in Cyprus.
article.articleSummary: Cyprus has contingency plans and established protocols ready to address an imported Ebola case if one arises, said epidemiologist Petros Karagiannis. Protocols, already applied in the past, can be reactivated; updates may exist, but core measures remain: immediate isolation and strict biosafety to protect health workers and the public. The Ebola virus transmits only via very close contact with bodily fluids (saliva, tears, urine, feces, blood); advanced stages may involve hemorrhagic fever. Any non-African case would be considered imported if linked to travel from affected areas, underscoring the need for detailed travel histories to assess exposure. The current outbreak is viewed as more severe, associated with a strain linked to a more aggressive disease. There is no approved vaccine or specific antivirals for this strain; management is primarily supportive. Emphasis on prevention and public information in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, and on full PPE (gloves, masks, disposable protective suits) for clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: カラギアンニス氏：エボラ出血熱の輸入症例がキプロスで発生した場合に対応するための対応計画が存在する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の重篤性と国際的拡大リスクは明らかであるが、本記事はキプロスの「準備状況」に焦点を当てており、実際の患者発生やアウトブレイク拡大を報じたものではない。DRCとウガンダの現況について詳細が不足しているため、フルRRA前に続報を待つべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCとウガンダで現在のアウトブレイクが進行中と述べられているが、詳細な患者数、死亡数、地域的拡大状況が不明。キプロスは準備計画の有無に関する報道であり、実際の症例は報告されていない。ウガンダ（対象国外）とキプロス（対象国外）の記事源から、実際に影響を受けている対象国はDRCのみと判断。続報により詳細情報が得られれば「PICKUP」への格上げが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情肆虐 WHO 總幹事親赴疫區視察 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak ravaging the Democratic Republic of the Congo; WHO Director-General personally visits the outbreak area to inspect
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) concentrates in Ituri Province, centered on Bunia, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visiting to evaluate response. Since May 15, DRC has reported at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths; the outbreak has spread to eastern provinces and crossed into Uganda, which has nine confirmed cases and has closed its border, enforcing a 21-day quarantine for entrants. Challenges include ongoing armed conflict, scarce medical resources, and limited laboratory capacity; Médecins Sans Frontières warns that early case growth is unprecedented and staffing remains insufficient. Millions of refugees in camps with poor sanitation heighten transmission risk if the virus spreads. The Bundibugyo virus strain currently has no specific vaccine or therapy, though Africa CDC expects a vaccine by year’s end. Encouragingly, the first confirmed patient recovered and was discharged after two negative tests.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疫情が蔓延 WHO事務局長が疫区を視察
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、高い死亡率、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認される。国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙した。記事サマリーから、DRCを中心とした深刻なエボラ疫情、1,077件の疑い患者と246死亡例、医療資源の不足、ワクチンの欠如が確認される。WHO事務局長の現地訪問が報道されており、国際的な関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: PSO vadovas atvyko į Kongo DR, kur plinta Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief arrived in DR Congo, where Ebola is spreading.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo to address the Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak. He planned to visit Bunia, the Ituri provincial capital, to support response efforts and engage with affected communities. The highly contagious disease is active in three DR Congo provinces and neighboring Uganda. In Uganda, nine cases have been confirmed with one death. In DR Congo, Africa CDC reports 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The WHO emphasizes international support and the importance of community engagement, assessing the response, and identifying obstacles where aid is needed. The organization warns the true extent may be larger due to transmission before detection, and notes that eastern DR Congo’s protracted conflict limits laboratory confirmation capacity."

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国にエボラ熱感染拡大対応のため訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な感染症イベント、複数国での国際的拡大、国際支援の必要性）。エボラ出血熱は極めて高いリスク疾患であり、WHO事務局長の現地訪問による国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本イベントはエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大を報告しており、DRC東部Ituri州のBunia市が主要な発生地域。ウガンダでも確認例があるが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行対応。WHO事務局長の緊急訪問により国際的な高い関心が示されている。実験室確認能力の限定により、実際の感染規模はさらに大きい可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: مدير منظمة الصحة يصل إلى إيتوري بؤرة وباء إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director of the World Health Organization arrives in Ituri, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri, the epicenter of a speeding Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in mid-May and has spread to three Congolese provinces and neighboring Uganda, with two new confirmed cases on Friday, bringing the DRC total to nine. Across the country, 246 deaths have been recorded among more than 1,000 suspected or probable cases, per Africa CDC. Tedros arrived Thursday and will stay through Sunday to meet local leaders and address concerns, stating he will visit residents personally. Ituri accounts for the majority of confirmed cases; access is hampered by weak rural services and security risks from armed groups. WHO notes the outbreak’s true scale may be undercounted due to limited laboratory testing. On Friday, one patient recovered and left hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の中心地イトゥーリに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、PHEIC宣言済みの急速に拡大しているエボラ出血熱流行。DRC全国で246人の死亡と1,000以上の疑似例があり、ウガンダにも拡大している。
triage.notes: PHEIC宣言済みの重篤な流行。記事サマリーではウガンダへの拡大が言及されているが、確認例は記載されておらず、詳細不明のため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。アクセス困難性と実際の規模の過少計上の可能性が記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ανησυχία για τον ιό Έμπολα: Στο Κονγκό ο γενικός διευθυντής του ΠΟΥ, άγνωστες οι διαστάσεις της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern about the Ebola virus: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the WHO Director-General, the dimensions of the outbreak are unknown.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is centered in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, identified as the epicenter. The country announced on May 15 a new Ebola outbreak threatening about 100 million residents, and the World Health Organization has declared a global health emergency. The WHO Director-General, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, has arrived in the DRC and is undertaking a two-day visit to Ituri to engage with local leadership and assess the response. The article notes that the dimensions of the outbreak remain unknown. No case counts or fatalities are provided in the report. The visit underscores international concern over the outbreak's potential spread and the need for coordinated public health measures, with Ituri as the focal point of the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに関する懸念：コンゴ民主共和国の世界保健機関事務局長、流行の規模は不明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い重症度と致死率を持つ疾患であり、WHOが世界的保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。IHR基準において重大な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが認められ、3基準以上に該当する。また、WPRO基準では異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性の複数基準に該当し、国際的支援の必要性も明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州ブニアを中心に流行していることが明確に述べられている。WHOの事務局長が現地を訪問中であり、世界的保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。具体的な患者数と死亡者数が不明である点は注視が必要だが、これまでのエボラ流行の経験や現地訪問の事実から重大なシグナルと評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Στο Κονγκό ο επικεφαλής του ΠΟΥ, στο επίκεντρο της επιδημίας του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the WHO chief is at the center of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's new Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, is centered in Ituri Province, with Bunia hosting WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a two-day visit. WHO declared a global health emergency. Ituri holds the majority of cases; access to rural areas is hampered by absence of state services and armed groups. International health authorities warn that outbreak dimensions are not yet known and official tallies understate the reality, due largely to limited laboratory capacity to confirm cases. Tedros emphasised personal commitment to assist. Ebola has killed about 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years. The Congo's previous deadliest outbreak (2018-2020) in DR Congo caused about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで世界保健機関（WHO）事務局長がエボラ流行の中心地に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO事務局長による緊急対応が行われ、国際的な保健上の緊急事態宣言が出されている。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 新規エボラアウトブレイク、2026年5月15日公式宣言。WHO事務局長が直接現地視察中。国際的保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。実際の患者数がカウント不足の可能性あり（ラボ確認能力の限界）。イトゥリ州が流行の中心地で、武装勢力による医療アクセス障害の報告あり。歴史的には2018-2020年の前回アウトブレイクで2,300名死亡。

article.articleHeadline: مدير منظمة الصحة يصل إلى إيتوري بؤرة وباء إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director arrives in Ituri, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak intensifies in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri province’s Bunia as the epicenter. The mid-May surge prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The virus has been detected in three Congolese provinces and in neighboring Uganda, with two new confirmed cases on Friday bringing the national total to nine. In the DRC, 246 deaths have been recorded among over 1,000 suspected cases, according to Africa CDC. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa on Thursday and traveled to Ituri (Bunia) on Saturday, staying through Sunday; he plans to meet local leaders and address concerns. Ituri accounts for the majority of confirmed cases; rural areas lack government services, and armed groups impede access. Authorities caution that case counts may undercount due to limited testing. A patient in the DRC has recovered and been discharged.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱流行の震源地イトゥリに到着 - コンゴでの感染拡大が進行中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的流行で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の急速な流行拡大。1,000以上の疑い例、246死亡、9確認例。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な高い関心を示す。ウガンダへの波及も確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: لقاح جديد يعتمد على تقنية (mRNA) يحقق فعالية كبيرة لسلالات فيروس إيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new vaccine based on mRNA technology achieves high efficacy against Ebola virus strains - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Multistrain Ebola vaccine based on mRNA, designated GP+NP@LNP, was developed to protect against EBOV, Bundibugyo (BDBV), and Sudan (SUDV) strains. Building on the concept that existing licensed vaccines largely target Zaire ebolavirus, researchers designed an mRNA vaccine encoding three viral surface glycoproteins plus one nucleoprotein to elicit strong antibody and T cell responses. In experiments, mice challenged with EBOV achieved 100% survival with robust clearance from blood and organs (liver, spleen); BDBV viremia was reduced; and hamsters exposed to SUDV cleared viruses and maintained weight. Notably, protection persisted for about 17 months in mice. Published in PNAS, the study suggests GP+NP induces a balanced immune response and Th bias. Next steps include testing in non-human primates before human trials. The current outbreak involves Bundibugyo lineage in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with Ebola hemorrhagic fever symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: mRNA技術に基づく新しいワクチンがエボラウイルス株に対して高い有効性を達成 - ザ・セブンス・デー
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスのBundibugyo系統がDRCとウガンダで検出されているが、記事の主題はワクチン開発研究であり、現在の流行規模、患者数、重症度などの疫学情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでBundibugyo lineageの現在の流行がDRCとウガンダで確認されていると述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。記事の主題はワクチン開発の研究進捗であり、現在の疾病負荷の詳細（症例数、死亡数、伝播状況）の情報が不足しており、フルRRA実施には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits epicentre of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies as WHO chief visits Bunia, capital of Ituri province, to engage communities and assess response. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the outbreak, present in three eastern DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda, where nine confirmed infections and one death have been recorded. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been at least 1,077 suspected DRC cases and 246 deaths, with the true footprint likely wider because laboratory confirmation is limited. Uganda closed its border and ordered a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from the DRC. A patient recovered and was discharged after two negative tests—the first confirmed carrier to recover. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; a vaccine is expected to be ready by year-end, per CDC Africa. MSF warns response staffing remains insufficient amid displacement and insecurity in Ituri and other provinces.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で1,077件の疑い患者、246死亡。ウガンダでも確認され、国境閉鎖・隔離措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダでの確認患者9例と死亡1例が記載されているが、対象国リストにはUgandaが含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみを対象国として記録。Bundibugyo株は希少なエボラ株であり、ワクチン・治療法がない点が特に深刻。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な高い関心を示す。

article.articleHeadline: OMS prioriza três tratamentos para cepa Bundibugyo do ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO prioritizes three treatments for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, WHO prioritizes three treatments for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola amid an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo extending into parts of Uganda. No vaccines or therapies are approved specifically for this strain. The prioritized options are MBP134 monoclonal antibody (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), maftivimab (Regeneron), and remdesivir (Gilead). Regeneron signals immediate availability of maftivimab in the DRC for clinical use or research, and experts are considering combination regimens pairing monoclonal antibodies with remdesivir. For post-exposure prophylaxis in close contacts of confirmed cases, the oral antiviral obeldesivir (Gilead) is promising, depending on effective contact tracing. Vaccine development includes rVSV Bundibugyo (IAVI) likely not ready for trials for 7-9 months, and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute) possibly in 2-3 months; Ervebo should not be used outside research.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラのブンディブギョ株に対する3つの治療法を優先する
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の発生がDRCからウガンダへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCに隣接するザンビアは対象国として含まれる可能性があるが、記事で直接言及されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定するのが適切。修正：ザンビアは記事で直接言及されていないため、verified_locationsからは除外し、DRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: OMS descinde în Ituri, epicentrul epidemiei de Ebola din RD Congo. 246 de decese din 1.000 de cazuri suspecte * Newsweek România
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO lands in Ituri, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo. 246 deaths out of 1,000 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ituri province, with Bunia as the epicenter, reports an Ebola outbreak: 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected cases; 225 confirmed, 142 in treatment centers. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to assess the response as Bunia International Airport remains closed to commercial flights. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no specific vaccine or treatment for this strain. By contrast, most past outbreaks in the region have been linked to Zaire ebolavirus, for which a vaccine exists. International health authorities warn the true scale may be undercounted due to limited laboratory capacity in DR Congo. The outbreak has spread to several Congolese provinces and to neighboring Uganda, where nine cases have been confirmed, including two new cases recently. WHO has declared an international health alert and supports clinical trials of vaccines and treatments against Bundibugyo, aiming for progress by end-2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国の第2次エボラ出血熱流行の中心地イトゥリに派遣。疑い例1,000件のうち246人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的流行であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。死亡例が多く、複数国への拡大（ウガンダで確認）、WHO事務局長の現地訪問、国際保健警報の発令など、シグナル特性が極めて強い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確定症例225件、死亡246件、複数の州に拡大。ウガンダへの越境確認（9件中2件は新規）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Zaire株以外）であり、既存ワクチンが効果なし。WHO事務局長の直接訪問、国際保健警報発令などから、極度に優先度の高いシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, governo Meloni lancia controlli su chi arriva da Congo e Uganda: i cinque livelli di rischio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The Meloni Government Launches Checks on Arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda: The Five Levels of Risk
article.articleSummary: Facing an Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda, Italy imposes five risk levels for arrivals from Congo and Uganda in recent weeks. The Bundibugyo strain is cited; WHO has declared a public health emergency. Travelers must sign and submit a form to their local ASL within 24 hours. The five levels apply to asymptomatic individuals based on area exposure and contact with symptomatic cases: very low, low, moderate, high, very high. Very low requires education; low mandates three weeks of self-monitoring; moderate adds ASL monitoring and travel reporting; high requires 21-day quarantine; very high triggers biocontainment transport to Spallanzani in Rome. Symptoms prompting testing include fever ≥38.6°C plus at least one: severe headache, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, bleeding, organ failure; diagnosis by Spallanzani lab. If symptoms arise during flight, land at Fiumicino; at home, self-isolate and contact ASL or 112. Cases may be suspected, probable, or confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：メローニ政権がコンゴとウガンダからの到着者に対する検査を開始：5段階のリスクレベル
triage.triage_reason: イタリアはコンゴとウガンダからのエボラ到着者に対する検疫体制を発動しており、WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPRO基準でも「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴおよびウガンダからの到着者に関する検疫措置について述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。発生地域に列挙されたイタリア国内の地名（ラツィオ州、フィウミチーノ、ローマなど）は二次的な措置対象地であり、イベント自体の発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Don't travel to Uganda, Congo and South Sudan unless very urgent, UAE tells its citizens
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) triggers UAE MoFA travel advisory dated 2026-05-30, urging UAE nationals to avoid travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the Republic of South Sudan unless absolutely necessary. The notice underscores an evolving public health situation and the need to safeguard citizens abroad, advising strict adherence to local health and safety instructions. It requests registration in the Twajudi service and contact of the UAE Ministry for emergencies at +97180024 for those abroad. The guidance reflects precautionary public health measures amid EVD concerns in the region, though no case counts or outbreak details are provided in the advisory. Citizens in these countries are urged to exercise utmost caution and follow local authority guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - ウガンダ、コンゴ、南スーダンへの渡航中止を勧告、UAE市民に（本当に急務の場合を除く）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（IHR対象疾患）による複数国での公衆衛生上の懸念があり、UAE外務省が公式な渡航勧告を発表。国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限の兆候が認められ、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ、南スーダン（ウガンダ等と関連地域）への渡航勧告を記述しているが、具体的な発生確認地域について詳細が不足している。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため、最小限の確認地として含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。詳細なケース数や爆発の詳細は提供されていないため、フルRRAでさらなる情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief lands in eastern Congo's Ituri province, epicentre of Ebola, as outbreak outpaces response
article.articleSummary: May 30, 2026—In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, Ebola outbreak remains uncontrolled as the Bundibugyo virus—current Ebola strain—continues to spread; there is no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, after a meeting with Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka, said Congo has faced Ebola before and can bring this outbreak under control. European Union medical aid arrived in Ituri on Thursday, with more shipments expected over the next eight days to bolster the response. Ituri remains the outbreak's epicentre, underscoring the ongoing challenge of mounting an effective response in a resource-limited setting. The report does not provide laboratory-confirmed case counts or transmission details.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が東部コンゴのイトゥリ州に到着、エボラの中心地で、アウトブレイクが対応を上回る
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行が制御不能であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）も複たす。社会的・政治的関心も高く、WHOトップクラスの対応が必要とされている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus株）の流行が東部コンゴのイトゥリ州を中心に継続しており、治療法やワクチンがないため管理が困難な状況。WHO事務局長による現地訪問やEU医療援助など、国際的な対応が加速している。症例数や詳細な感染情報が記事に記載されていないため、フルRRAでの詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bulgaria Faces Criticism Over Lack of Ebola Preparedness Measures
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central and East Africa is driven by the Bundibugyo strain. By mid-May 2026, about 1,000 suspected infections, over 240 suspected deaths, and more than 120 confirmed cases have been reported; the outbreak is linked to an April 24 suspected infection in a healthcare worker in Mongbwalu, Ituri, DR Congo. On May 5, Congolese authorities alerted WHO to an unknown high‑mortality disease; May 15 confirmed Bundibugyo strain and Uganda reported an imported case linked to Congo. WHO declared a global health emergency on May 17. EU risk is assessed as very low; border screening, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation facilities, and international coordination are advised. In Bulgaria, responses are unclear with disputed ministerial responsibilities; travel advisories list Congo and Uganda at level 3, South Sudan level 4; MoH coordinates with WHO/EC/ECDC, awaiting further guidance. Criticism focuses on lack of defined border procedures; vaccine development may take months, underscoring need for early detection and preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: ブルガリアがエボラ準備対策の不備について批判に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO全域保健緊急事態宣言、複数国での感染確認、1,000件以上の疑い感染と240件以上の死亡報告により、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ中部・東部でのエボラ感染の関心により、ブルガリアの準備不足を論じているが、実際のイベント発生地はDRC（Ituri州Mongbwalu）とウガンダの輸入事例のみ。WHO全域保健緊急事態宣言済み（5月17日）、Bundibugyo株による大規模流行。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo neće zatvarati škole uprkos epidemiji ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo won't close schools despite the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is concentrated in three eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of Congo—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—with Bunia as Ituri’s capital; case-fatality among confirmed cases is 30–50%. In Ituri, at least five schoolchildren have died since mid-May, attributed to self-treatment and delays in seeking care. The government will not close schools, prioritizing preventive measures in schools to avoid punishing children. Health Minister Roger Kamba urged families to avoid home treatment and to promptly report suspected cases to facilities. As of May 30, 2026, WHO reports at least 134 confirmed Ebola cases in the Congo–Uganda outbreak, with over 1,000 suspected cases since the outbreak was declared. Confirmed cases include nine in Uganda, and 18 deaths across the two countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行にもかかわらずコンゴは学校を閉鎖しない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株エボラの確定症例134件、疑い症例1,000件以上の大規模流行であり、死亡率30-50%と極めて高い重症度、複数国（DRC・ウガンダ）への国際的拡大、学校閉鎖を巡る公開的議論により国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラは2026年5月時点でコンゴ・ウガンダ国境地域での大規模流行。記事サマリーにはウガンダ9件の確定症例も記載されているが、記事の主題はコンゴ政府の学校閉鎖政策決定に関するものであり、サマリー上ウガンダは副次的な言及のみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。死亡率30-50%、学童5名の死亡、疑い症例1,000件超という著しい流行規模により、IHR全4基準及びWPRO全5基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă medicală! Virusul a ajuns deja în Europa și s-au înregistrat primele cazuri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medical alert! The virus has already reached Europe and the first cases have been recorded.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Europe after exposure in Central Africa. In Milan, Italy, two patients who spent three months working in Central Africa and recently returned from Uganda are hospitalized with Ebola-like symptoms; lab results are pending. The outbreak in Uganda, in Central Africa, has caused up to 220 deaths and is linked to a rare Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine, signaling a vaccine-resistant outbreak. The two cases abroad are being monitored; officials say the immediate risk of spread is low. Bundibugyo transmits via bodily fluids. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, containment efforts have been hampered by attacks on tents housing those tested, with at least 18 people fleeing. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, and muscle pain; later, diarrhea, abdominal pain, sleep disturbances, headaches, and eye pain may occur, with severe cases involving internal or external bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 医療アラート！ウイルスはすでにヨーロッパに到達し、最初の症例が記録されました
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の疑い症例がイタリア（ヨーロッパ）で検出され、ウガンダでの流行が220人の死亡を伴うBundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクである。IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目に合致する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な感染症イベントはウガンダおよびDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク。イタリアの症例は曝露後の輸入症例である。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ワクチン無効株（Bundibugyo）であることと、DRCでの収容施設への攻撃による対策阻害が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Суд в Кении приостановил проект США по размещению пациентов с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court suspended the U.S. project to house Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's court temporarily blocked the U.S.-backed plan to house Ebola patients at a 50-bed field hospital at Laikipia Air Base, suspending the project until a substantive ruling on June 2. The Katiba Institute filed suit, citing public-health risks and procedural violations, and the court barred entry of people exposed to or infected with Ebola until a final decision. Washington planned to relocate American citizens who had contact with Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with potential transfer to European medical centers if patient conditions worsened. The proposal drew criticism from Kenyan doctors and civil society, who warned it could heighten Ebola transmission risks in a country with no officially reported cases. As of May 25, Congo reported over 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed infections; WHO cites at least 220 deaths. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed border closures are not a primary control, urging timely surveillance and regional support.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの裁判所が米国のエボラ患者受け入れプロジェクトを一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、複数国間の疾病管理の複雑性、国際的な政治・公衆衛生上の関心が高い。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、ケニアにおけるエボラ関連の国際的対応について述べている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、ウガンダは対象外だが記事の主題。ケニアも対象外だが地理的に関連。verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。本件は国境管理、患者移送、地域的流行対策に関する複雑な国際的公衆衛生危機の表現であり、フルRRA実施の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: le patron de l'OMS à Bunia en Ituri, épicentre de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the WHO chief in Bunia, Ituri, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s northeastern Ituri province is battling an Ebola outbreak with over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, Africa CDC reports. Declared by the WHO two weeks ago but circulating earlier, the outbreak centers on Bunia and surrounding rural areas where insecurity and state weakness hinder response. On May 30, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Bunia to oversee the response amid concerns about rapid community transmission and lingering denial in parts of the population. Last week saw attacks on health facilities and patients fleeing; two ministers—Health and Communications—are on the ground to bolster outreach. A first patient has recovered and been discharged from Rwampara hospital near Bunia. A durable Ebola treatment center is to be inaugurated in Bunia. Tedros, who landed in Kinshasa on May 28, urged sustained support to national authorities and will meet President Tshisekedi on June 1 before departing June 2.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱流行の震源地イツリ州ブニアへのWHO事務局長訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された流行で1,000件以上の疑い例と246名の死亡が報告され、IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）複数に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心（WHO事務局長の現地視察）が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国（特にイツリ州ブニア）で発生しているエボラ出血熱流行。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーでルワンダでの発生は述べられておらず、言及されているのはルワンダ近くのRwampara病院（ブニア近郊）のみのため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。複数の重篤基準該当および WHO事務局長の現地視察という国際的関与により、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: E alertă mondială: Kenya suspendă planul SUA pentru un centru de carantină în cazurile de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global alert: Kenya suspends the U.S. plan for a quarantine center for Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Kenya temporarily suspended a U.S. plan to set up a 50-bed Ebola quarantine unit at a Kenyan air-base to serve Americans exposed but asymptomatic, with symptomatic patients treated abroad. Kenya’s Supreme Court, Justice Patricia Nyaundi, barred admitting anyone exposed or infected under the planned agreement until a Katiba Institute challenge is resolved; the next hearing is June 2. U.S. officials say the unit would be staffed by the Public Health Service, and over 30 personnel have departed for Kenya. Kenya had given written approval but not public details. The State Department pledged $13.5 million for Kenya’s Ebola preparedness. Since the outbreak began in eastern DRC and Uganda, WHO reports more than 1,000 suspected/confirmed cases and 246 deaths, with true totals higher due to conflict and tracing challenges. Separately, an American Ebola patient treated in DRC was moved to Germany, with a seventh person sent to the Czech Republic.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的警戒：ケニアがエボラ患者用隔離センター設置の米国計画を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数国での患者報告と国際的対応の進行中、公式な隔離施設計画の遅延、WHO報告で1,000件以上の疑い患者と246人の死亡、および国際的な患者移動が報告されている。IHR基準において異常性・国際的拡大のリスク・国際対応の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC とウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれる。ケニアは対象国ではないため除外。米国、ドイツ、チェコへの患者移動は記述されているが、これらは対象国ではなく、かつ治療移送地である。エボラ出血熱は非常に高いリスク疾患であり、複数の国際的対応要素、死亡例、および進行中の流行が確認されており、シグナル判定として妥当。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Visits Epicentre Of Ebola Outbreak In DR Congo, Cases Over 1,000: Updates
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province; Bunia) surpasses 1,000 suspected cases with 246 deaths since outbreak was declared on May 15. Africa CDC reports 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths; true numbers likely higher due to testing gaps. The Bundibugyo strain drives transmission with no approved vaccine or specific treatment; a vaccine candidate may be ready by year-end. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, which has nine infections and one death, prompting a 21‑day quarantine for travellers from the DRC. A Ugandan patient recovered after testing negative twice. Conflict and insecurity across three eastern provinces hinder response; MSF says staffing is insufficient for the scale, and nearly one million people are displaced in Ituri camps, raising concerns about rapid spread. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to assess the response and emphasize community involvement for containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がDRコンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク震源地を訪問、感染者1000例超：最新情報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、複数国への国際拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）が確認されている。重症度が高く（246死亡、1000例超）、管理可能性の課題（紛争地域、資源不足）が顕著である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの二次感染（9例、1死亡）が報告されているが、発生地域はDRコンゴが主体であり、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、Bundibugyo株の確認、ワクチン候補の開発進行など高い関心が示されている。紛争による対応の困難さが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: छत्तीसगढ़ के बालोद में चमगादड़ों की रहस्यमयी मौत, जांच के लिए भोपाल भेजे गए नमूने | Mysterious mass deaths of bats spark concern in Chhattisgarh's Balod; samples sent to Bhopal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious deaths of bats in Balod, Chhattisgarh; samples sent to Bhopal for investigation.
article.articleSummary: In Balod district's Dallirajhara area, Chhattisgarh, bats are dying mysteriously with 50-70 dead daily in recent days; joint teams from the Forest Department and Veterinary Department are investigating. Bat samples have been collected and sent to the ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal for laboratory testing; results are awaited to determine the cause. Early assessment cites extreme heat as a possible contributing factor, while the possibility of infection or an outbreak has not been ruled out. Authorities emphasize caution, urging locals not to touch dead or sick bats and to report sightings to authorities. Field surveillance continues to monitor hotspots and assess the situation as investigations proceed.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州バロドのコウモリの謎の大量死、調査のため検体がボーパールに送付
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（コウモリ）の大量死という異常事象であり、感染症の可能性は除外されていないが、人間への直接的な健康影響が明示されていない。疾患が「Unknown Illness」に分類されており、情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: コウモリの大量死は動物由来感染症（zoonotic disease）の警告信号となりうるが、現段階では人間への感染確認がなく、原因も未確定。検査結果待ちの状況。感染症の可能性が完全には排除されていないため、検査結果の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Madaxa WHO oo booqanaya xudunta cudurka Ebola
article.articleSummary: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, head of the World Health Organization, travels to Ituri in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster the response to a new Ebola outbreak. The WHO notes improved lab confirmation and surveillance, but challenges persist amid insecurity, armed conflict, and mass displacement. Latest reports show 906 suspected Ebola cases in DRC, including 223 deaths under investigation. Officially confirmed Ebola cases in the country total 125, with 17 deaths, spread across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu since the outbreak began about two months ago. Uganda has recorded nine Ebola cases, three of which are linked to travelers from DRC, along with one related death. Health authorities warn that without accelerated control measures and community awareness, the virus could spread to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ対策強化のためコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州を視察
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は致死性が高く公衆衛生への深刻な影響あり、DRCでの新規発生は異常かつ予想外。国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの既に拡大）と渡航制限リスク両立。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによるとウガンダでも9例の確認例があるが、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。複数の武装勢力と治安悪化が対策実施の大きな課題として記述されている。WHO事務局長の現地視察は国際的な高い関心を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: Trump focuses on keeping Ebola out of US over fighting outbreak abroad
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda: WHO reports >1,000 suspected cases and about 250 suspected deaths; Bundibugyo strain is highly fatal (~50%) with no proven vaccines or treatments. U.S. response emphasizes preventing importation and supporting on-the-ground efforts, with over $100 million in aid (including $80 million for PPE) and CDC/State Department efforts to ensure rapid testing in Congo and Uganda. Travel bans for those previously in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan were extended to green-card holders. Plans to quarantine exposed Americans in Kenya faced a Kenyan high court block. Seven exposed Americans were flown to Europe, including a doctor with confirmed infection; another to Prague. Critics warn that border-focused policies may deter future participation in outbreak response. Background notes include 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak and U.S. dismantling of USAID; WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency two days after recognition.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領、海外の流行対策よりも米国へのエボラ流入防止に注力
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ・ウガンダでの1,000件以上の疑い例と約250人の死亡を伴うエボラ流行で、高い致死率（50%）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限等が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはプラハ、チェコなどが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ・ウガンダでの流行である。プラハはエボラ感染者が搬送された目的地であり、実際の流行地ではない。対象国リストに該当する実際の流行地はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Director de la OMS visita el epicentro del brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) on May 15, with Bunia, capital of Ituri province, as the epicenter as the epidemic advances in the east. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia on May 30 to engage communities and assess the response, as Bunia airport remains closed to commercial flights. The WHO has activated an international health alert. The outbreak has been detected in three Congolese provinces and in neighboring Uganda, where two new cases were confirmed on Friday, raising Uganda’s confirmed total to nine. In the DRC, more than 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths have been reported (Africa CDC, as of Thursday). Ituri concentrates most confirmed cases; authorities warn the true magnitude is likely underestimated due to limited laboratory capacity. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever and is highly contagious.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生的に極めて深刻で、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されており、渡航制限の実施（空港閉鎖）も確認。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確定的なアウトブレイク（5月15日宣言）。DRC内で疑い症例1,000件以上、死亡246件。ウガンダへの国際的拡大確認（9確定症例）。Bunia空港の商用便閉鎖、WHO事務局長による現地視察などの高いレベルの対応が実施中。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Em meio ao surto de Ebola no Congo, especialistas alertam para conexão de doença com consumo de animais selvagens
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, experts warn of a link between the disease and the consumption of wild animals.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the WHO in May 2026. In Congo, authorities report more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 220 deaths since the outbreak began on May 15, with the first recovery announced May 27. Transmission is linked to zoonotic spillover from wild animals, especially through handling and consumption of bushmeat; frugivorous bats are implicated, with human-to-human spread via contact with bodily fluids of the sick or deceased. Health workers face high risk without adequate PPE. Congo banned hunting of endangered wildlife but not a general bushmeat trade ban; Congo Basin bushmeat production is estimated at about 4.5 million tons annually. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak caused ~28,000 cases and >11,300 deaths. Some communities doubt the link to bushmeat; others are ignorant of the health risks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラアウトブレイク最中、専門家が野生動物の消費と疾病の関連性について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク。1,000件以上の疑似症例と220人以上の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生学的影響が極めて深刻で国際的懸念が確認されている。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月）。記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの発生を言及しているが、対象国リストはDRCのみ該当。アンゴラはサマリーに言及がないため除外。ジュネーブではなくブラジルのメディア（Globo）からの報道であることから、国際的な高い関心を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Rallies Community in Congo's Ebola Response, Calls for More Funding
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, centered on Bunia, with 1,028 suspected cases recorded by Friday as part of the ongoing 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to coordinate the response, urging community ownership and local leadership alongside international support; he noted that international involvement is underway but WHO has received only about a third of its funding needs. Tedros landed in Bunia on Thursday after arriving in Kinshasa. MSF deputy director Alan Gonzalez warned the outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented pace, with many cases occurring soon after declaration. The report also notes that the number of expert organizations and overall support on the ground remains far short of requirements, underscoring a still underfunded, ongoing response in Congo."

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ対応で地域住民に呼びかけ、更なる資金提供を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い死亡率と国際的拡大リスクを有し、DRCでの大規模流行は重大な国際保健脅威である。
triage.notes: DRCにおける17番目のエボラ流行。Ituri州のBunia周辺を中心に1,028件の疑似患者が報告されている。WHO事務局長が現地入りし、MSFも前例のない速さでの拡大を警告。国際的支援の必要性が高まっており、資金不足が明記されている。これはシグナルレベルの事象ではなくすでに確立された流行であり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Bunia, DR Congo, May 30, 2026 (AFP) - WHO chief visits epicentre of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bunia, DR Congo — On 30 May 2026, the World Health Organization chief visited the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, according to AFP. The report identifies Bunia as the outbreak’s focal point and notes international attention to the situation, but it provides no numerical data on cases or deaths. Details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, exposure dates, or whether cases are imported or exported are not included. The article does not describe vaccination campaigns or specific public health interventions. With the published date anchoring the coverage to late May 2026, the report places the Ebola outbreak response in DR Congo within the context of ongoing public health attention.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア、コンゴ民主共和国、2026年5月30日 (AFP) - WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染症発生の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染症の発生報告であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的関心）を複数満たし、WHO事務局長の視察という国際的な関心の高さが確認できる。
triage.notes: エボラ感染症は致死率が高く、国際保健上の重大な脅威。記事にはDRC内のブニアに限定された発生と記載されているが、具体的な症例数や死亡数が報告されていない。WHO事務局長の現地視察により、国際レベルでの対応と関心が確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-topman Tedros aangekomen in Congolese regio ebola-uitbraak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief Tedros arrives in the Congolese region of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, the epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak, to confer with local communities on the response. As of 30 May 2026, the deadly Ebola virus has spread rapidly in the region near the Uganda border, with some cases reported in Uganda, but the vast majority of the more than 1,000 infections occurring in Congo. The death toll stands at least 246. Doctors Without Borders notes the outbreak is evolving faster than previous ones, with unprecedented early case counts after declaration. MSF warns there are not enough medical organizations on the ground to cope with the scale of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長テドロスがコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行地域に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。1,000件以上の感染者、246人以上の死亡、国境を越えた拡大、医療資源不足など深刻な状況であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例報告も言及されているが、主要な発生地はコンゴであり圧倒的多数（1,000件以上中の大部分）がコンゴで発生。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO事務局長の現地訪問という高い政治的関心、医療組織不足という対応能力の懸念、1,000件以上の急速な拡大という異例の規模が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, pubblicata ordinanza sulle misure di sorveglianza sanitaria per chi rientra dai viaggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: ordinance on public health surveillance measures for travelers returning from trips.
article.articleSummary: Italy's Health Ministry issued an ordinance (published May 29, 2026) on public health surveillance for travelers returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda amid an ongoing Bundibugyo virus–related Ebola outbreak, which the WHO has designated a PHEIC. The measure requires anyone arriving from DRC or Uganda, or who was there within the previous 21 days, to submit within 24 hours a declaration to the local ASL prevention department. Regions must widely publicize the submission process and forms; airlines, shipping lines, airport authorities, and port authorities must provide the declaration forms to passengers before entry. A May 29 circular defines prevention measures and medical-epidemiological risk criteria. The ordinance is effective from May 29, 2026 for 120 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：旅行から帰国した人向けの公衆衛生監視措置に関する命令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOがPHEIC指定するエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス型）の継続中の流行に対応したイタリアの監視措置であり、国際的な公衆衛生の懸念を反映している。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（非対象国）はサマリーに言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。イタリアも同様に対象国外のため除外。エボラ流行の主要発生地はDRCであり、イタリアの措置は二次的な対応。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود: تفشي إيبولا في إيتوري بالكونغو مقلق جدا بسبب سرعة انتشار الإصابات - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is very alarming due to the rapid spread of cases - Shorouk Portal.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province is described as highly alarming due to rapid spread. As of May 28, 2026, official counts show 125 confirmed, 906 suspected, and 223 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The true scale remains difficult to gauge because of limited testing capacity and access challenges amid violence and displacement. MSF notes this is the fastest-spreading Ebola wave recorded in DRC, the 17th outbreak in the country. Health authorities reported rising suspected cases to 1,028 and 225 confirmed cases. The World Health Organization reports a case fatality rate among confirmed cases between 30% and 50%. Field response is hindered by security conditions, affecting contact tracing and isolation. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged stronger community engagement and increased international support during a visit to the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 国際医療団（MSF）：コンゴ民主共和国イトゥーリ州のエボラ出血熱の流行は感染の急速な拡大により極めて深刻
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（死亡223例、確定症例225例、疑い例1,028例）、30～50%の高い致命率、DRC内でも最速の拡大速度、および国際支援の必要性が明確に示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではイトゥーリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州での流行が報告されている。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはSouth Kivu Province（南キブ州）とDRCが含まれており、サマリーでも複数州での発生が確認されている。WHO事務局長による公式声明があり、国際的な関心と支援要請が明確。セキュリティ状況による対応困難が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: All pregnant women in Thailand to be tested in 16 'Zika provinces'
article.articleSummary: Thailand will test all pregnant women in 16 provinces where Zika has been detected, after two newborns were born with microcephaly linked to the virus—the first Southeast Asian cases of this outcome. The Health Ministry says Zika is present in parts of 16 provinces, and testing aims to safeguard mothers and babies, with new healthcare guidelines for affected areas. Authorities are eradicating Aedes mosquitoes and urging destruction of breeding grounds. Dengue surveillance shows 44,396 cases and 33 deaths from January–September 27, a 50.7% decline from the previous year, attributed to larval control. Aedes hotspots include religious sites (60%), schools (41%), factories (38%), and hospitals (27.6%). Since early this year, more than 300 Zika patients have been identified among about 10,000 suspected in 16 risk areas. In Lop Buri, a three-month pregnant woman suspected of Zika prompted insecticide spraying; 10 people were monitored (9 Muang, 1 Nong Moung).

triage.headline_ja: タイの16の「ジカ熱州」ですべての妊婦を検査へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：新生児小頭症、異常/予想外：東南アジア初の母子感染症例、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当。妊婦全員検査という大規模対策実施と社会的関心の高さから、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 新生児小頭症がタイで初めて確認された重要な事例。16省での検査体制構築、300人以上の患者確認、ネッタイシマカ対策実施など、大規模な公衆衛生対応が進行中。東南アジア地域への波及リスクも存在。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Chef Tedros im Zentrum des Ebola-Ausbruchs im Kongo eingetroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General Tedros Arrives at the Epicenter of the Ebola Outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), epicenter as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrives in Bunia. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri, the virus has been detected in three Congolese provinces and neighboring Uganda. In the DRC, at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths have been reported; Uganda records 9 confirmed infections and 1 death. WHO warns the true scale may be larger, noting limited laboratory capacity in the DRC. Response is hampered by weak state presence in rural areas and violence by armed groups, with millions displaced in camps where crowding and poor hygiene could fuel spread. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there is no specific treatment or licensed vaccine. Transmission is via body fluids and causes fever and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: WHOテドロス事務局長、コンゴのエボラアウトブレイク中心地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間拡大、高い死亡率、治療法・ワクチン欠如、紛争地域での対応困難性から、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（GeoNames ID 226074）も含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが対象国のため、DRCを verified_locations に列挙。記事では複数州でのケース報告とウガンダでの確認例が述べられているが、エボラウイルス病（Ebolavirus）は評価対象である。WHO事務局長の現地訪問という高政治的関心事項であり、Bundibugyo Ebola virus変種による初発アウトブレイク。国際的封じ込め困難性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Director de la OMS llega al Congo para pulsar brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General Arrives in the Congo to Monitor the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to oversee Ebola outbreak containment. He acknowledged a challenging situation, citing critical shortages of equipment and supplies, public mistrust, and armed groups complicating the response. The prolonged eastern conflict is a central barrier to control, and he urged an immediate ceasefire between the Congolese army and rebel factions to improve access and protect humanitarian workers. Mass displacement and severe food insecurity in the region further hinder epidemiological efforts, while communities’ limited understanding of the virus adds to health workers’ challenges. He plans a visit to Ituri, identified as the outbreak’s zero zone, and reaffirmed solidarity with Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, pledging ongoing WHO support.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴに到着、エボラ熱流行を監視するため
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡例・重症例想定）、国際的懸念、異常性が明らかであり、WHO事務局長の現地訪問という高い政治的・国際的関心を示している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はPHEIC該当疾患であり、WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な対応の最高レベルを示唆。装備・物資不足、公的不信、武装勢力による妨害、大規模な避難民、食糧不安など複合的な管理困難要因が存在。南キブ州、イトゥリ州、キンシャサでの確認が記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief lands in eastern Congo's Ituri province, epicentre of Ebola, as outbreak outpaces response
article.articleSummary: Ituri province’s Bunia hosts an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain, spreading faster than the response. As of May 30, 2026, DRC authorities report 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; neighboring Uganda reports nine cases and one death. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to visit a treatment centre and meet authorities, health workers, and affected families, urging continued support at the epicentre. EU aid arrived May 28, with more shipments in the next eight days; the U.S. added $80 million on May 30, bringing total to over $112 million. Response at Bunia’s Rwampara and General hospitals is more organized, with extra staff, protective gear, and supplies, though patients continue arriving around the clock. The outbreak unfolds amid distrust and insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ東部イトゥーリ州のエボラ流行の中心地に到着、流行が対応を上回るペース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する高リスク感染症イベント。エボラ出血熱（稀有なBundibugyo株）の急速な拡大、国境を越える拡大（ウガンダで確認）、治療法・ワクチンなし、国際的な支援対応の発動。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは「隣国で9例、1死亡」と記載されており、流行の主要発生地はDRC（イトゥーリ州ブニア）。ウガンダ（対象国リストに未含）での確認は限定的。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は珍しい株で承認済み治療法・ワクチンなし。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、EU・米国による大規模財政支援の発動も高い国際的関心を示している。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الاشتباه بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى أكثر من ألف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo to more than 1,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports a rise in suspected Ebola cases to 1,028, up from 906 the previous day. Laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections reach 225. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba says authorities continue investigation and contact tracing to curb transmission. The World Health Organization warns the national risk level is now very high, underscoring the urgency of intensified public health measures. The update reflects ongoing surveillance and response efforts by national authorities and partners, with no details provided on infection sources or any imported/exported cases in the report. The figures indicate the outbreak remains active, with monitoring, rapid laboratory confirmation, and case management efforts ongoing to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑い患者数が1000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模な疑い患者集団発生（1028例、確定患者225例）がDRCで継続中であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO警報（国家リスク「非常に高い」）とともに、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明白である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR指定感染症。WHO警報で国家リスク「very high」と述べられており、継続的な監視・対応体制が稼働中。接触者追跡と実験室確認が進行中。国際的支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ανησυχία για τον ιό Έμπολα-Στο Κονγκό ο γενικός διευθυντής του ΠΟΥ, άγνωστες οι διαστάσεις της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over the Ebola virus — In Congo, the WHO Director-General says the extent of the outbreak is unknown.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrives in Bunia, capital of Ituri province, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak on 15 May, with the WHO declaring a global health emergency. Ituri hosts the majority of cases; access is severely impeded by absent government services in rural areas and armed groups that kill civilians, complicating case finding and laboratory confirmation. International health authorities warn the outbreak's true scale is unknown and underreported. Ebola has killed about 15,000 people in Africa over the past 50 years; the worst DRC outbreak (2018-2020) caused around 2,300 deaths among 3,500 confirmed cases. The current outbreak's size remains uncertain due to security and diagnostic constraints.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスへの懸念——コンゴでWHO事務局長が、アウトブレイクの規模は不明だと述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイク宣言、WHO事務局長による緊急訪問、国際的な感染拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が認められる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）。WHO事務局長による現地訪問、セキュリティリスク、診断制約による実態把握の困難さが記述されている。アフリカ大陸における過去50年間の死亡者数（約15,000人）および過去最大規模の2018-2020年アウトブレイク（2,300人死亡、3,500確認症例）との比較により、重大性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits Ebola epicentre in DR Congo, as death toll rises
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to surge, with suspected cases now exceeding 1,000 as of 2026-05-30. The epicenter around Bunia sees Congolese authorities scrambling to provide protective equipment, which remains in short supply, and to build trust within communities to curb transmission. The death toll is rising alongside case numbers, underscoring the urgency of the response. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is visiting Bunia on the day of the report to assess the situation and coordinate international support. The article highlights on-the-ground PPE challenges and the need for community engagement as part of the ongoing outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行中心地を訪問、死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを示しており、WHO事務局長の現地訪問による国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク。疑い例1,000件超、死亡者数増加傾向。Bunia周辺が流行中心地。WHO事務局長による現地視察実施により、国際的関心が極めて高い。PPE不足と地域社会への信頼構築が課題として指摘されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Visits Epicentre Of Ebola Outbreak In DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has at least 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths since it was declared on May 15, with true numbers likely higher. The outbreak extends across three eastern DRC provinces, including Ituri, where Bunia is the epicenter; Uganda reports nine confirmed infections and one death. Uganda closed its border with the DRC and ordered a 21-day quarantine for arrivals. A patient confirmed Ebola recovered on Wednesday and was discharged after two negative tests—the first such recovery in this outbreak. Ebola is transmitted by close contact and bodily fluids; laboratory confirmation capacity in DRC is limited. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, though a vaccine could be ready by year-end, per CDC Africa. Displacement camps in Ituri, amid ongoing insecurity with ADF and M23, heighten spread risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ発生の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な影響：246死亡・1,077疑い例、異常性：新規ブンディブギョ株、国際拡大：ウガンダで9確認例、渡航制限：ウガンダが国境閉鎖）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。フルRRA進展が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCにおけるエボラ発生が主要な懸念。Bundibugyo型は稀で致死率が高く、限定的ワクチン対策下での大規模流行は極めて重大。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: el director general de la OMS llega a Ituri, epicentro de la epidemia de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Director-General of the WHO Arrives in Ituri, Epicenter of the Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri, the epicenter of a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak that also affects neighboring Uganda. Africa CDC reports over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths in northeastern DRC, where insecurity hampers the response; the outbreak prompted an international health emergency two weeks earlier. Tedros travels to Bunia to bolster the response, with plans to inaugurate a large masonry Ebola treatment center. A first patient has been discharged from Rwampara hospital near Bunia. Two government ministers—Health and Communications—are on site to bolster community sensitization amid attacks on health centers. He previously criticized Congo’s health system but now adopts a more conciliatory tone, calling for resources rather than border closures. He will meet President Félix Tshisekedi on June 1, 2026, and depart June 2.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: WHO事務局長がエボラ流行の震源地イトゥーリに到着
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo型エボラの国際的な拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、1000件以上の疑い例と246人の死亡者、国際保健上の緊急事態宣言から2週間で高い重症度と国際的リスク、WHO事務局長の現地訪問により社会的・政治的関心も高い。IHR基準4項目すべて該当、WPRO基準5項目すべて該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥーリ州ブニアにおけるBundibugyo型エボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているがサマリーの焦点はDRC側。対象国リストにウガンダがないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。国際保健上の緊急事態は最近宣言されており、1000件以上の疑い例と246人の死亡は重大な公衆衛生上の影響を示す。Bundibugyo型は高い致死率の病原体であり、国境を越えた拡大リスクも明確。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は高い国際的関心を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la RDC exclut de fermer les écoles malgré la progression de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the DRC rules out closing schools despite the progression of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) driven by Bundibugyo strain with a case-fatality rate of 30-50% among confirmed cases. DR Congo will not close schools, prioritizing preventive measures in schools to avoid punishing children. At least five students have died since mid-May in Ituri, due to self-medication and delays in seeking care; families urged to avoid home remedies and promptly refer suspected cases to health facilities. As of May 30, 2026, WHO reports at least 134 confirmed Ebola cases in the ongoing outbreak across DRC and Uganda, with over 1,000 suspected cases since the outbreak declaration. Among confirmed cases, nine are in Uganda and total deaths in both countries reach 18. The situation remains under monitoring with new suspected cases continuing to be recorded.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: DRCは流行の進展にもかかわらず学校閉鎖を除外
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による進行中のエボラ流行で134確認例、18死亡、1000以上の疑い例。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例報告（9確認例）がされているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行対応。Bundibugyo株は稀であり、30-50%の高い致命率を示す。学校での複数死亡報告、家庭療法による遅延対応が懸念される。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるためugandasはverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: مدير منظمة الصحة العالمية يتفقد بؤرة تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General inspects the Ebola outbreak epicenter in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the Ebola outbreak epicenter in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. He is to visit treatment centers in Bunia and meet local authorities, healthcare workers, and families affected by the infection. Speaking from Kinshasa before traveling to Ituri, he described the outbreak as highly complex but containable, and urged communities in Ituri and the neighboring North Kivu and South Kivu provinces that they are not alone. Ghebreyesus called for intensified international support to ensure frontline health workers receive the supplies and protective measures needed as the response continues.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の中心地を視察
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認流行で国際的に高い懸念があり、IHR基準3項目に該当。WHO事務局長の現地視察という外交的重要性と、国際支援強化の明示的な呼びかけを含む。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は既知の重篤感染症で『異常性』は低いが、流行の複雑性と複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）への拡がり、WHO事務局長による直接訪問と国際支援強化の明示的要請により、フルRRA対象として判定。記事はアラビア語で、2026年5月30日配信であるため現在からの時間差を考慮する必要がある場合もあるが、情報内容に基づき判定した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits Ebola epicenter in eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ituri province in eastern DR Congo is the epicenter of a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak declared May 15, with DR Congo reporting at least 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths as of May 30, 2026. Cases have also been detected in North Kivu, South Kivu, and in neighboring Uganda (nine confirmed cases, one death in Kampala). Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects; incubation can be up to 21 days. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia on May 30 to discuss the response with local communities and officials, planning to visit a treatment center and affected families. He urged international cooperation and cautioned that border closures hinder transparency; Uganda has closed its border with DRC this week. The outbreak unfolds in a war-torn northeast Congo, complicating control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ東部のエボラ流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模流行で国際的拡大と高死亡率が確認されており、WHOによる高官訪問も行われている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にDRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）がBundibugyo型エボラ流行の主要発生地として記載されている。ウガンダでも9確認例が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行。DRCの対象国リスト（GeoNames ID 203312）に含まれるため verified_locations に記載。2026年5月15日に宣言された大規模流行で、5月30日時点で1,077疑い例、246死亡が報告。治療法やワクチン未承認、戦闘地域での制御困難、国境閉鎖による透明性低下が懸念される。WHOトップの現地訪問による国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros llega a epicentro de epidemia de ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros arrives at the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak centers on Bunia, capital of Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the epicenter of an outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, affecting Ituri and two other provinces. The African Union health agency reports 246 suspected deaths in the DRC; Uganda has confirmed nine cases, including one death, linked to an imported Congolese case. The virus carries a 30-50% case-fatality rate, with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission likely began in Ituri about two months before the outbreak was declared a public health emergency of international concern. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to inspect facilities and meet local authorities and on-site WHO teams; earlier he visited Kinshasa to meet Prime Minister Judith Suminwa and UN humanitarian staff. Ongoing conflict in the area hampers response, with calls for a ceasefire.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による17番目のエボラ流行で、死亡率30-50%、複数国での確認ケース、ウガンダへの越境感染あり。WHO事務局長の現地視察という国際的高い関心も示されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの越境感染確認（9例、死亡1例）があるが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行である。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙。流行中心地はイトゥリ州ブニア市。紛争による対応阻害が複合リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: el director general de la OMS llega a Ituri, epicentro de la epidemia de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: WHO Director-General arrives in Ituri, epicenter of the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Ituri province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with more than 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, per Africa CDC. Insecurity and state absence in rural areas hinder response; the virus had circulated before the outbreak was declared, and the World Health Organization activated an international health emergency two weeks earlier. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to reinforce efforts, with a brick-built Ebola Treatment Center expected to replace tents. Attacks on health centers and patient withdrawals show ongoing community resistance, though a first patient cured has left Rwampara hospital near Bunia. Tedros will assess operations on the ground, meeting with local teams, and is scheduled to meet President Félix Tshisekedi on June 1 after talks with Prime Minister Judith Suminwa; he plans to depart Bunia within 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：WHO事務局長がエボラ流行の震源地イトゥーリに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、死亡者246名、疑い患者1,000名以上の大規模エボラアウトブレイク。WHO事務局長の現地出張と国際保健上の緊急事態宣言により、国際的に重要な感染症事象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのイトゥーリ州が主要な流行地であり、ルワンダでの確定症例報告はサマリーに明記されていないため、DRCのみを対象地域として検証。国際保健上の緊急事態宣言とWHO事務局長の現地視察により、社会的・政治的関心は最高度。セキュリティ上の課題と医療施設への攻撃により管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: الخارجية الإماراتية تُحذّر من السفر إلى ثلاث دول أفريقية بسبب 'إيبولا'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs warns against traveling to three African countries due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and the Republic of South Sudan are subject to travel advisories by the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs due to Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) developments. UAE citizens and residents are advised not to travel to these countries unless absolutely necessary. The ministry stresses strict compliance with its instructions and with local health and safety measures issued by authorities in each country. UAE nationals and residents abroad are urged to exercise heightened caution and to follow health guidelines issued by local authorities. Travelers are encouraged to register in the Tawajudi service and to use the UAE emergency contact for overseas citizens at +97180024 in emergencies. Dated 2026-05-30, the advisory underscores precautionary public-health actions without detailing specific outbreak figures or case counts.

triage.headline_ja: UAE外務省、エボラウイルス病によるアフリカ3ヶ国への渡航警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて重症度が高い一類感染症であり、複数国での発生、国際的な渡航制限勧告の発令、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されている発生国はUganda（対象国外）、DRC（対象国）、South Sudan（対象国外）。UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairsによる正式な渡航警告が発令されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。Bluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるUAEはエボラ発生地ではなく、渡航警告の発令国であるため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当し、実際のイベント発生地である。

article.articleHeadline: Khalwale: We cannot support the president when he wants to bring Ebola to Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kakamega Senator Boni Khalwale opposed plans to admit Ebola patients from the Democratic Republic of Congo into Kenya, warning the move would threaten national health. Speaking during the burial of former Bungoma Governor Wycliffe Wangamati’s father in Bungoma on May 30, 2026, he urged Parliament to block the proposal through the Senate and National Assembly, noting that neighbors have tightened borders, with Rwanda cited.
