The debate has intensified, as Nyeri Governor Mutahi Kahiga opposed an Ebola treatment and isolation centre in Laikipia County, citing cross-county trade and travel risks. Laikipia leaders demanded clarity and safety assurances. In Nairobi, the High Court issued conservatory orders temporarily blocking entry of Ebola-infected persons for isolation or treatment, while the US State Department said it is monitoring developments and engaging Kenyan authorities. Kenya’s Health Ministry says screening and preparedness remain high at entry points like Jomo Kenyatta International Airport.

triage.headline_ja: カレワレ議員：大統領がケニアにエボラ熱を持ち込もうとしている時は大統領を支持できない
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は政治的な反対声明であり、実際のエボラ熱発生イベントではなく、計画段階の議論である。DRCでのエボラ熱の実際の患者発生や死亡は記事に明記されておらず、公衆衛生への現実的な深刻な影響は不明である。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCからケニアへのエボラ患者の移送提案に対する政治的反対意見であり、実際の感染症イベントの報告ではない。DRCでのエボラ熱の患者数、死亡数、流行の詳細は記載されていない。ケニアでは実際の症例は報告されておらず、高裁の仮処分はあくまで計画段階の措置である。社会政治的関心は高いが、感染症危機管理の観点からはシグナルとして拾うべき段階にはない。

article.articleHeadline: KMPDU demands full disclosure on US Ebola deal, calls for plan to protect Kenyans from outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya's KMPDU warned that the country is ill-prepared for a potential Ebola outbreak, citing staffing shortages, inadequate critical-care facilities, and unclear emergency plans. The union demanded full disclosure of a reported agreement to establish an Ebola quarantine facility in Laikipia County for American citizens working in the Democratic Republic of Congo and pressed authorities for measures to protect Kenyans. Dr. Davji Atellah questioned whether border-region ICUs exist, healthcare workers are trained, and facilities are ready before discussing quarantines for foreigners. The union stressed that the most effective response is to reinforce containment at the outbreak source in the DRC, where Ebola continues to spread amid insecurity. A court order halted implementation pending further proceedings, while the US signaled optimism about resolving issues. The disease is described as highly contagious; Congo reports over 1,000 suspected cases and about 200 suspected deaths, with cases also reported in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: KMPDUがエボラに関する米国との合意について完全な開示を要求、ケニア国民を集団発生から保護する計画を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、貿易・渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの確認事例と複数国での広がりがあり、WPRO基準でも複数該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアの医師会（KMPDU）の声明を主題としているが、実際のエボラ集団発生の事例はDRC（1000件以上の疑い例、約200件の疑い死亡）とウガンダで報告されている。ケニアは予防的対応の議論の中心だが、確認された発生地はDRCのみ。ウガンダはサマリーに「cases also reported in Uganda」と記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, capo dell'Oms arrivato nell'epicentro Rdc dell'epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO chief arrives at the epidemic's epicenter in the DRC.

The DRC declared the outbreak on May 15, with the World Health Organization issuing an International Health Alert. triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO事務局長がDRCの流行の中心地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラ出血熱の国際的流行であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認流行。DRC内で246死亡、1,000以上の疑似症例。ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認（9症例）。WHO事務局長の現地視察により国際的高関心が示唆される。記事ではウガンダでの事例も言及されているが、主題はDRCの流行であり、ウガンダは対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros llega al epicentro de la epidemia de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros arrives at the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centers on Ituri province's Bunia and is linked to the Bundibugyo strain. Africa Union public health agency reports 246 suspected Ebola deaths in the DRC, the seventeenth outbreak since 1976. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to inspect facilities and meet local authorities and UN teams; he had earlier traveled to Kinshasa to confer with the prime minister and humanitarian staff. The conflict-affected area involves fighting between the Congolese army and rebel groups; a ceasefire was requested to facilitate the response. The outbreak has spread to neighboring Uganda, with 9 confirmed infections and one death from an imported Congolese case. Bundibugyo has a 30-50% fatality rate and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; WHO notes high risk in sub-Saharan Africa, low globally. Virus likely circulated in Ituri about two months before the outbreak was declared a PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として、既にPHEIC宣言され、隣国ウガンダへの感染拡大と高い致死率が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）での17番目のエボラ流行を報道。致死率30-50%、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。隣国ウガンダへの感染確認（9例、死亡1例）。WHO事務局長の現地視察で高い国際的関心が示されている。PHEIC既宣言。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Шефът на СЗО пристигна в епицентъра на епидемията от ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief arrived at the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak. Congo declared a new Ebola epidemic on May 15, triggering an international alert from WHO. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain—against which there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments—has been detected in three DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda. As of late May, Africa CDC reports over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths. Historically, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past 50 years; the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak recorded about 3,500 cases and roughly 2,300 deaths. Uganda has closed its border with Congo amid rising Bundibugyo cases. Early symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pain, fatigue, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding, with incubation up to 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの事務局長がエボラ流行の震央に到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的に重大な流行イベント。IHR基準の4つ全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,000+疑い例と246死亡、予想外の新規流行、DRCとウガンダでの国際的拡大確認、国境閉鎖による渡航制限発生）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、WHO事務局長訪問という高レベルの国際的関心あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダもサマリーで「隣接するウガンダでも検出」と記述されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのイツリ州ブニアでの流行が主題。ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株による新規流行で、高い懸念水準。WHO事務局長の直接訪問は国際的な優先度の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, capo dell'Oms arrivato nell'epicentro Rdc dell'epidemia | Libero Quotidiano.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, WHO chief arrives at the epicenter of the epidemic in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrives in Bunia, capital of Ituri province, the outbreak's epicenter. DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15 and the WHO activated an international health alert. The virus, a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever, has been detected in three DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda, where two new cases were confirmed, bringing Uganda's total to nine. Africa CDC reports 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected cases in the DRC. The situation underscores ongoing transmission across provinces with cross-border risk; containment and cross-border monitoring are being mobilized to address imported/exported cases and support surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国の流行中心地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的流行（DRC・ウガンダで確認）、246死亡・1000以上疑い患者、高い伝播能、国際支援動員。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2例が確認されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCの流行である。DRC は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。WHO事務局長の現地到着という政治的関心の高さも確認される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits epicenter of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), a haemorrhagic fever, centered in Ituri's Bunia, with spread to North and South Kivu; Uganda reports 9 confirmed infections including 1 death. Since May 15, 1,077 suspected DRC cases and 246 deaths have been reported Africa CDC, with WHO warning true extent may be wider due to limited testing amid conflict. Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak; no vaccine or specific treatment exists yet, though a vaccine candidate is expected by year end per CDC Africa. Uganda has closed its border with DRC and imposed a 21-day quarantine. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to engage communities and assess response; MSF says deployment of medical staff remains insufficient in insecure Ituri, nearly a million displaced, and neighboring provinces. A patient recovered on Wednesday, discharged after two negative tests—the first recovery among confirmed carriers in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ発生の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、死亡例あり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象として複数のIHR基準を満たし、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ発生の主体はDRCのイトゥリ州ブニアを中心としており、ウガンダでも9例の確認感染があるが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生である。提供されたGeoNames対象国リストにはウガンダ（226074）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOの関与、死亡例、国際的拡大、物資不足など、深刻な公衆衛生上の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Šef SZO na istoku DR Konga, u Buniji, središtu epidemije ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief in eastern DR Congo, in Bunia, at the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to back efforts against a rare Ebola virus strain in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia identified as the epidemic's epicenter. He is expected to visit a treatment center and meet local authorities, healthcare workers, and families affected by the outbreak. The World Health Organization reported 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths. Neighboring Uganda has confirmed nine cases and one death after closing its border with Congo. Doctors Without Borders warned that the response by health workers is not keeping pace with the outbreak, noting unprecedented case numbers so soon after the initial spillover. There is no specific antiviral treatment or approved vaccine for this Ebola strain.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国東部の「エボラ流行の中心地」ブニアに到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス流行で906例の疑い症例と223例の死亡が報告され、ウガンダへの国境越え感染も確認されているため、IHR基準3項目以上および複数のWPRO基準に該当。国際的に重大な感染症危機として即座のフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダが国境を閉鎖し9例と1死亡を確認」と述べられており、二次的な流出事例であり対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラは公衆衛生上の最高リスク疾患であり、WHO事務局長の現地訪問という高い社会的・政治的関心が存在。治療法やワクチンがない株による流行であることも特筆すべき深刻度。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le directeur général de l'OMS à Bunia, épicentre de l'épidémie dans l'est du pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the WHO Director-General in Bunia, epicentre of the outbreak in the east of the country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with Bunia in Ituri as the epicenter. On May 15 the government declared an outbreak; by May 30, more than 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths had been reported in DRC. At least 134 laboratory-confirmed cases have been detected across DRC and Uganda, including 9 in Uganda, with 18 confirmed deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to coordinate the response, urging strengthened coordination and engagement with communities, religious and women's groups, media, and local influencers. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% fatality rate among confirmed cases. Challenges include contact tracing, insecurity, and limited isolation and patient-care capacity. A 32-year-old technician recovered and was discharged from Rwampara Hospital in Ituri; an American physician who treated patients in DRC is hospitalized in Germany. Transmission involves Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, with cross-border spread to Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：WHO事務局長がイトゥーリ州のブニアに到着、同国東部での流行の震源地
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによる大規模流行で1,000件以上の疑いケース、246死亡、国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）を認め、WHO事務局長がコーディネーションのため現地入りするなど、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとGermanyも含まれているが、サマリーから実際の流行は主にDRCで発生しており、UgandaおよびGermanyは越境感染または医療施設での個別ケースであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo EVD（30-50%の致命率）による活発な流行が確認され、セキュリティ課題と医療体制の制限が管理可能性を脅かしている。

article.articleHeadline: Itália adota medidas preventivas contra Ebola para viajantes da RDC e de Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy adopts preventive measures against Ebola for travelers from the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, Italy's Ministry of Health imposed mandatory declaration and notification for travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda amid Ebola outbreaks. The ordinance requires any entrant by any transport to complete a signed declaration within 24 hours of arrival, using the form attached. Regions have a further 24 hours to forward declarations to the Ministry by email and to publish information publicly. Despite the precautionary approach and a stated low infection risk, the measure aims to provide regional authorities with operational guidelines for risk assessment, health information, and surveillance for Italian and foreign travelers. A five-level risk framework distinguishes high versus low exposure. Additionally, a passenger or crew member arriving from an outbreak country with Ebola symptoms may only land at Rome's Fiumicino Airport, where the prescribed protocols are applied.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア、コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダからの旅行者に対するエボラ対策を導入
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的流行に対するイタリアの公式対応措置であり、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限」に該当。WPRO基準の「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」でも懸念あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはイタリア・ラッツィオ州・ローマも含まれていますが、記事サマリーではエボラ感染の実際の発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）およびウガンダであり、イタリアはこれら地域からの旅行者に対する防除措置を講じている国です。したがって verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載しました。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。本イベントは2026年5月30日の架空シナリオですが、エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としてフルRRA進行が推奨されます。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. pumps $162m into Ebola fight as outbreak threatens Central Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompts a U.S. response totaling over $162 million to support containment, alongside $350 million through UN OCHA for relief in the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan, and $50 million to establish up to 50 Ebola response clinics. The effort, coordinated with the CDC and partners, aims to halt transmission at the source and prevent international spread. With FIFA World Cup 2026 approaching, the U.S., Canada and Mexico issued travel protocols for arrivals from high-risk African regions; entry to the United States requires designated airports with enhanced health screening, and Uganda faces renewed travel warnings and border restrictions. On the ground, PPE, disinfectants, thermometers, and screening equipment are being deployed; Samaritan’s Purse airlifted 24 tonnes for a 40-bed treatment centre. IOM supports health monitoring in eastern DRC and at airports in Uganda, Burundi and Ethiopia. Kenya’s preparedness received $13.5 million.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ対策に1億6200万ドルを投じ、中央アフリカの流行に対抗
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの複数国流行により、IHR基準2項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上（重症度、長期曝露、流行リスク）に該当。高い社会的・政治的関心を示唆する米国の大規模資金投与と国際的対応が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国を言及しているが、主要な流行発生地として明示的に特定されているのはDRC（Democratic Republic of the Congo）のみが対象国リストに含まれる。ウガンダ、南スーダン、エチオピア、ブルンジ、ケニアも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。2026年FIFA World Cup開催（米国・カナダ・メキシコ）を背景とした国際的な移動制限・渡航ガイダンスの発出が社会政治的関心を高めている。米国による$162mの直接支援とUN OCAを通じた$350mの追加支援は、外部支援の活発性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Mexico bars travelers from Central Africa over Ebola ahead of World Cup
article.articleSummary: Mexico barred air entry for travelers who have visited Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), or South Sudan within the last 21 days, as Aeromexico, Viva, and Volaris imposed 60-day bans amid an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa. The measures come ahead of the World Cup co-hosted by the US, Mexico, and Canada, which begins June 11 with Mexico facing South Africa in Mexico City. The DRC has qualified for the tournament and will play across the United States and Mexico; its team is training in Belgium and basing operations in Houston. The World Health Organization reports a sharp rise in the DRC outbreak since May 15, with suspected Ebola cases reaching 1,028, of which 225 are laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or targeted treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコがエボラの懸念でアフリカ中部からの旅行者を禁止、ワールドカップ前に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC発生国の確認感染者225名、疑い例を含む1,028名という規模、ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による急速な拡大、国際的移動制限実施により、フルRRA実施対象
triage.notes: DRCが2026年ワールドカップに参加予定であり、国際的なスポーツイベントに関連した感染症拡大リスク。メキシコとカナダも記事に言及されているが、サマリーの主題は中央アフリカのエボラ発生を受けた入国制限措置。記事に「Central Africa」の地理的範囲が明確に示されておらず、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ確実に発生地域として特定可能。

article.articleHeadline: Diretor-geral da OMS mobiliza a comunidade em apoio à resposta ao ebola na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General mobilizes the community in support of the Ebola response in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri (Bunia) with Kinshasa involved in the response, has 1,028 suspected cases reported by Friday, marking the 17th outbreak since 1976. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to coordinate the response and urged strong community involvement, saying communities understand problems and solutions better than outsiders. He emphasized the need for international support under RDC government leadership, noting WHO has received only about one-third of the required funds. In Kinshasa, Tedros called for increased aid as MSF warned the outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented rate, with case numbers rising quickly and the number of responding organizations remaining below what is needed. The situation highlights rapid transmission, funding gaps, and the critical role of community engagement in containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応を支援するため国際社会の結集を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（1,028疑い例）、国家的対応の限界、国際支援の必要性が明確。フルRRA進行すべき。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最も重篤な新興感染症の一つ。記事はDRCのイトゥリ州（ブニア）とキンシャサでの発生を明確に述べており、WHO事務局長が現地に赴任して国際支援を動員している。資金ギャップ、急速な伝播、地域社会の参加の重要性などが強調されている。この案件はEBS活動の優先度が最も高いカテゴリに該当する。

article.articleHeadline: MoFA Advises UAE Nationals Against Travel to Uganda, DRC & South Sudan Over Ebola Concerns
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued an urgent travel advisory strongly discouraging UAE nationals from traveling to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and South Sudan unless travel is absolutely necessary, due to the evolving Ebola virus disease (EVD) situation in these regions. The advisory instructs UAE citizens currently abroad in those countries to take immediate precautionary measures and to stay aligned with official travel advisories and health guidance. The MoFA plans to monitor the public health situation closely and provide updates as needed. For emergencies, UAE nationals abroad are urged to contact the MoFA emergency hotline at +971 800 24. The directive underscores safeguarding citizens' wellbeing amid EVD concerns in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エジプト外務省、エボラ懸念でウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンへの渡航をUAE国民に勧告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間への拡大リスク、渡航制限勧告の発出、国際的関心の高さから、IHR基準3項目以上該当。DRCでの確定発生に加え、ウガンダ・南スーダンへの国際的拡大が懸念される状況。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ発生に関する複数国への国際的影響。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダ、南スーダン、UAE、DRCが含まれるが、サマリーは『UAE外務省がウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンへの渡航を勧告している』という形式。DRCでの確定的な発生が主題であり、ウガンダ・南スーダンは懸念地域として言及されているが、確定発生の記述がないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。UAEは発生地ではなく、勧告発出国である。

article.articleHeadline: Eight Asiatic lion cubs die in Indian forest reserve, raising fears of disease outbreak
article.articleSummary: Eight Asiatic lion cubs died in Gir forest reserve, Gujarat, over the past week, raising concern for the world’s only wild population. Preliminary indications point to babesiosis, a tick-borne parasite that damages red blood cells and can cause weakness, fever and death; laboratory confirmation is awaited. Most deaths occurred outside the protected sanctuary, suggesting potential spread as roaming lions venture beyond boundaries. Samples have been sent to a research centre and specialist teams deployed for surveillance and containment, including isolating affected zones within a 10-km radius and large-scale deticking drives. Babesiosis contributed to a 2018 Gir outbreak that killed 11 lions and was linked to a combination of canine distemper virus and babesiosis. Recently, a tigress and four cubs died in Kanha Reserve, Madhya Pradesh, with media reports linking possible CDV; CDV is highly contagious and can spread from dogs via close contact.

triage.headline_ja: インド森林保護区でアジアライオンの子ども8頭が死亡、疾病流行の懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物におけるバベシア症の集団死亡であり、2018年の同地での流行との関連が指摘されている。国家的に重要な生物資源（世界唯一の野生アジアライオン個体群）への脅威であり、保護区境界を超えた拡大の可能性が懸念される。
triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物（ライオン）における病気流行だが、バベシア症はダニ媒介性寄生虫疾患であり、人畜共通感染症の可能性を有する。記事サマリーではGujarat州Gir森林保護区とMadhya Pradesh州Kanha保護区が具体的に名記されており、インド領域内での複数地点での発症が確認されている。2018年の同種流行との関連及び飼養犬からの犬ジステンパーウイルス(CDV)伝播の可能性についても言及されており、人への転化リスクや家畜への波及についても監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Director de la OMS llega hasta epicentro del brote de ébola en RDC tras confirmarse 18 fallecidos por esta epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General arrives at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC after 18 deaths were confirmed.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom arrived in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. He stressed the critical role of communities alongside international support under the DRC government, meeting local authorities to coordinate containment and to listen to community needs. As of May 30, 2026, the WHO reported 134 confirmed Ebola cases since May 27, with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths attributed to this new Bundibugyo strain; 18 deaths have been confirmed. Médecins Sans Frontières, deploying to assist patients and curb transmission, described the situation as deeply alarming for communities and frontline health workers two weeks into the outbreak. The visit highlights intensified efforts to curtail transmission and bolster local response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ出血熱流行の震源地にWHO事務局長が到着、18人の死亡が確認された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確認死亡18人、疑い症例906件、新規Bundibugyo株による大規模流行でWHO事務局長が現地入りするなど国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株による新規流行。5月27日以降134確認症例、906疑い症例、223疑い死亡。WHO事務局長現地訪問、MSF展開など高度な国際的対応進行中。DRCは対象国に含まれ、検証地域確認。

article.articleHeadline: In RD Congo l'epidemia di Ebola corre veloce, l'allarme di Msf: "La risposta non tiene il passo con la diffusione"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the Ebola epidemic is spreading rapidly, MSF warns: "The response cannot keep up with the spread."
article.articleSummary: Two weeks after declaring an Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, MSF reports a deeply alarming spread, with more cases in a shorter time since declaration than any prior Ebola outbreak; MSF Operations Director Alan Gonzalez in Bunia cautions that the response is not keeping pace. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments, and diagnosis is challenging due to limited testing capacity. Hundreds of samples remain untested, while border and airport closures hinder delivery of essential medical supplies, humanitarian aid, and personnel. MSF calls for immediate expansion of testing capacity and a rapid, coordinated strengthening of the overall response, backed by medical and humanitarian organizations and guaranteed, continuous access for supplies and staff. Emphasizes community engagement as essential; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is visiting Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の流行が急速に拡大、MSFが警告「対応が拡大に追いついていない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体による急速な流行拡大が報告されている。MSFによる深刻な警告と国際的支援の必要性が明記されており、シグナルとして即座にフルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）による流行であり、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。宣言後2週間で過去のエボラ流行より急速な症例増加が報告されている。検査キャパシティの不足（数百サンプルが未検査）、国境・空港閉鎖による物資・人員の移動阻害など、対応上の重大な課題が指摘されている。WHO事務局長による現地訪問も予定されており、国際的な対応強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Шеф СЗО на истоку ДР Конга, у средишту епидемије еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief in eastern DR Congo, at the center of the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: On 30 May 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the epicenter of an outbreak caused by a rare Ebola virus strain. He is expected to visit a treatment center and meet local authorities, health workers, and families affected by the outbreak. Ghebreyesus had arrived in Kinshasa a day earlier to support efforts to contain the outbreak amid equipment shortages, distrust among communities, and ongoing civil conflict. The WHO reported 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. Neighboring Uganda confirmed nine cases and one death from the same rare Ebola strain after closing its border with DRC. Médecins Sans Frontières warned that the health response is not keeping pace with the outbreak. There is no specific cure or approved vaccine for this Ebola virus strain.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、東部コンゴ民主共和国にてエボラ流行の中心地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：906疑い症例・223死亡、稀なウイルス株による異常性、国際的拡大（ウガンダで確認）、国境閉鎖による渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性、管理可能性の課題）。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での確認例も記述されているが、主要な発生地はDRCであり、サマリーの中心はDRCでのエボラ流行。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な対応の高さを示す。稀なウイルス株、ワクチンなし、社会的信頼の低さなどが対応困難性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits Bunia, epicentre of the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo’s Bunia hosts WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus as health authorities race to contain a fast-growing Ebola outbreak. As of 30 May 2026, 1,028 suspected Ebola cases and 225 laboratory-confirmed infections have been reported, marking this as the third-largest Ebola outbreak and indicating transmission is outpacing the global response. Officials emphasize the urgency of intensified surveillance, isolation, contact tracing, and vaccination campaigns in the affected area. The report does not specify the infection source or travel-related cases. The visit underscores renewed international attention and potential support to strengthen local health systems and outbreak control measures in response to the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱の震源地ブニアを訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（確定症例225、疑い例1,028）、第3位の規模の流行、ヒト-ヒト感染による国際的拡大リスク、WHOと国際社会の高い関心。
triage.notes: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、エボラ出血熱は国際保健上最高レベルの懸念疾患であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当するため、地域限定なくPICKUP判定を適用。WHO事務局長の直接訪問により国際的対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: SP investiga caso suspeito de Ebola em paciente de 37 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo investigates a suspected Ebola case in a 37-year-old patient.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo authorities identified a suspected Ebola case in a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). He is hospitalized at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas in the state capital, presenting with fever and placed under the biosafety protocol for suspected Ebola. About 10 days have elapsed since his visit to the DRC, within the incubation window. He is being tested for other diseases, including malaria, and samples are being sent for specific Ebola laboratory analysis. No confirmation has been reported yet. The São Paulo Health Secretariat recently updated guidance on the current Ebola outbreak in the DRC, detailing surveillance, case definitions, immediate notification, isolation, initial management, care pathways, and state-level laboratory investigation. Emílio Ribas previously received three suspected Ebola cases in 2014, all discarded; Instituto Adolfo Lutz will oversee the laboratory work for this case.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロが37歳患者のエボラ疑い症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の懸念があり、ブラジルとDRCの両国で確認されるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: DRCからの帰国者がブラジル（サンパウロ）でエボラ疑い症例として検出された国際的リスクイベント。潜伏期間内（10日経過）で、感染症専門病院（Emílio Ribas）に隔離・検査中。マラリアも検査対象。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク拡大の文脈での国際的な警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO u epicentru ebole: Tedros stigao u Kongo, virus se još širi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO at the epicenter of Ebola: Tedros arrived in Congo, the virus is still spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with Ituri province’s capital Bunia at the epicenter, is spreading across three Congolese provinces and into neighboring Uganda. The Ebola virus, causing a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever, has been detected in three Congolese provinces and in Uganda, where two new cases were confirmed on Friday, bringing Uganda’s total to nine. In the DRC, Africa CDC reports 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected cases; Ituri accounts for the majority of confirmed infections. Access is severely limited in rural areas; armed groups and violence hinder response, centers targeted, and community distrust grows. Millions displaced into camps risk explosive transmission due to overcrowding and poor sanitation. Laboratory capacity in the DRC to confirm transmission is limited. Uganda’s cross-border cases indicate spillover; WHO has issued an international health emergency, and Tedros arrived in Bunia as the airport is closed to commercial flights.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の中心地でWHO活動：テドロスがコンゴに到着、ウイルスはさらに広がっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に報告されている公衆衛生上の重大事象であり、複数国への拡大と国際支援の必要性が明白である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのイトゥリ州ブニアを中心とした流行が主題であり、ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ を含める。WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言とテドロス事務局長の現地到着により、国際的な高い関心が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: 陸網紅染恙蟲病猝逝！台灣今年已56例　疾管署示警：死亡率達60％ - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland Chinese influencer contracts scrub typhus and dies suddenly! Taiwan has 56 cases this year; Taiwan CDC warns that the mortality rate has reached 60%.
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi infection) caused the death of a 39-year-old Mainland Chinese influencer from Yunnan after a chigger bite, highlighting the disease's fatal potential. The Chinese case adds to the Asia-Pacific context where scrub typhus is common in grasslands and farmlands. In Taiwan, as of May 24, there have been 56 locally acquired scrub typhus cases and 1 death, with Taitung, Hualien, and Kinmen most affected. The outbreak typically rises in April–May, peaks June–July, and resurges in September–October. The incubation is about 9–12 days; early symptoms include high fever, headache, and lymphadenopathy, followed by a rash and an eschar. Mortality can reach 60% if untreated but drops below 5% with timely antibiotic therapy. Public health guidance emphasizes protective clothing and DEET/Picaridin-based repellents and prompt outdoor activity-related medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 大陸のネット红恙虫病で突然死亡！台湾今年56例　疾管署が警告：死亡率60％に達する
triage.triage_reason: 恙虫病による死亡事例と台湾での局所的流行（56例、1死亡）を報告。死亡率が最大60％に達し重症度が高く、対象国内での明確な流行シグナルを示している。IHR基準およびWPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はユンナン省の大陸網紅（インフルエンサー）の死亡事例とともに台湾での流行を報告。Bluedot APIが台湾を発生地域に含めているが、サマリーの主題は中国（ユンナン省）での死亡事例と台湾での局所流行であり、実際の流行は中国と台湾（香港・マカオと同様にChinaに含める）で発生している。検証後の verified_locations は China のみとする。恙虫病は季節的な流行パターンが明確で、公衆衛生指導が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă în Europa! Au apărut primele cazuri ale virusului mortal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Europe! The first cases of the deadly virus have appeared.
article.articleSummary: Europe alert as two people recently returned from Central Africa are being investigated in Milan for possible Ebola infection. The pair spent about three months in an area with an active outbreak and returned from Uganda; they are hospitalized after presenting symptoms compatible with Ebola. Laboratory results are not yet released, and authorities are closely monitoring the cases, given the presence of a rare Bundibugyo strain for which no effective vaccine currently exists. The outbreak has caused about 220 deaths. Bundibugyo is transmitted by direct contact with bodily fluids. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, containment efforts have been hampered by violence, with at least 18 people leaving monitoring zones after attacks on isolation tents. Ebola begins with nonspecific symptoms such as fever, fatigue, and muscle aches, progressing to diarrhea, abdominal pain, headaches, and sleep disturbances; severe disease can include internal and external bleeding and high mortality. Europe remains vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパに警戒！致命的なウイルスの最初の症例が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準3項目該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。ヨーロッパでのエボラ確認例は国際的に高い関心を集める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは中央アフリカでの発生が記載されており、DRCはエボラの発生地として明示されている。イタリア（ミラノ）での疑似症例は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダ（非対象国）での接触も記載されている。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当し、実際の発生地として確認される。

article.articleHeadline: DRC minister says people don't 'need to be in panic' over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues with Bunia, Ituri province as the epicenter. As of 30 May 2026 there are 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths in the DRC, while the WHO reports 134 confirmed cases and 18 confirmed deaths in the DRC and neighboring Uganda. About 2,635 contacts are under monitoring and 125 people are in treatment; the first recovery is a female patient discharged after two negative tests. Government aims to control the outbreak within 90–120 days, noting the outbreak was declared roughly 14 days ago. Minister Patrick Muyaya cautions against panic, highlighting experience, daily briefings, safe burials, and community engagement to counter misinformation on social media. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, not respiratory spread. Uganda has closed its borders with the DRC as a precaution, though WHO says such measures are often fear-driven; aid groups continue to bolster supplies for health workers.

triage.headline_ja: DRC大臣がエボラ出血熱の流行に対して「パニックに陥る必要はない」と述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク）。確定患者と死亡者が存在し、隣国ウガンダへの拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは確定患者がDRCとウガンダの合計として報告されており、ウガンダは接触者監視国ではなく既に確定患者が存在する。しかし記事の主要な焦点はDRCのIturi州Buniaであり、DRCでの流行制御が中心課題である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱の高い致死率と世界的な関心から、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية يدعو مواطني الكونغو لدور محوري في مواجهة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director-General of the World Health Organization calls on Congolese to play a pivotal role in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Ituri region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia, continues as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urges Congolese communities to play a pivotal role in the response. After arriving in Bunia, he stated that local communities understand the problems—and the solutions—best, emphasizing the importance of community involvement alongside government-led efforts. In Kinshasa, he called for greater international support, noting that the World Health Organization has received only about one-third of the funding needed to confront the outbreak. The remarks highlight a focus on empowering communities to aid in the fight while securing international resources to sustain containment efforts during the ongoing eastern Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関事務局長がコンゴ国民にエボラ対策での重要な役割を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大継続、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の継続中の流行であり、WHO事務局長が国際支援を求める重大事象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の継続的流行がイトゥリ地域（ブニア中心）とキンシャサで確認。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と国際資金不足への警告は、この事象が高い優先度の国際的懸念であることを示唆。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: por que o contágio é difícil e restrito?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Why is transmission difficult and restricted?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. São Paulo, Brazil, is investigating a suspected case. Despite ongoing outbreaks, the crisis is not deemed a pandemic; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says it does not meet the International Health Regulations pandemic criteria, with global risk considered low, but national and regional risk high. Ebola is not transmitted via respiratory droplets, explaining limited pandemic potential. The virus circulates mainly in animals, and human infection occurs through close contact with blood or bodily fluids of contaminated individuals; human-to-human spread, when it occurs, is via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated surfaces. The article emphasizes surveillance and containment within affected areas rather than widespread global transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：なぜ感染が困難で制限されているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、複数国での発生が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはWHOによる国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言を報告している。DRCとウガンダでの進行中の発生、ブラジルでの疑い例調査が記載されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事はポルトガル語（ブラジルメディア）だが、実際の発生国はDRCおよびブラジルで確認された疑い例。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات تحذّر مواطنيها من السفر إلى ثلاث دول إفريقية بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE warns its citizens not to travel to three African countries due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, the United Arab Emirates warns its citizens against travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan due to Ebola developments. The Foreign Ministry requests avoiding travel to the three nations unless travel is absolutely necessary. Citizens currently in those countries are urged to exercise utmost caution, comply with local health and safety guidance, and stay informed of evolving guidance. They should register in the Tawajudi service and contact the Ministry of Foreign Affairs immediately in any emergency. The advisory reflects ongoing public health considerations related to Ebola and aims to reduce exposure while providing channels for support.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦がエボラの影響を受け、市民に3つのアフリカ諸国への渡航を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での発生（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）により、IHR基準で国際的な拡大リスク（基準3）と渡航制限（基準4）の2つが該当。重大な公衆衛生への影響も明らかであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはウガンダ、南スーダン、UAEが含まれているが、記事サマリーから判断するとウガンダと南スーダンでのエボラ発生が述べられている。しかし対象国リストでの確認対象はDRCのみに限定されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを含める。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国外であることに留意。UAEは発警告を発した国であり、エボラの発生地ではない。記事の日付が2026年5月であり、未来予測シナリオの可能性があるが、記述内容に基づいてトリアージを実施した。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia says two suspected Ebola cases test negative, steps up screening
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Congolese authorities said suspected Bundibugyo Ebola cases have risen to 1,028, while Zambia reported two suspected cases cleared by laboratory tests, indicating a high border-crossing risk. Zambia’s health ministry says screening tools and protocols are in use at entry points and for people with Ebola-like symptoms. Bundibugyo, named after a Ugandan province where it was first identified nearly 20 years ago, is the rare Ebola strain for which there is no vaccine. Its extended, unnoticed spread through densely populated areas has alarmed experts due to challenges tracing and isolating contacts. The World Health Organization notes Ebola initially causes fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle pain, headache and sore throat, followed by vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding and multi-organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアが疑い例2件のエボラ検査は陰性と発表、スクリーニング強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準3つ以上該当。DRCで1,028例の疑い例が報告される中、ザンビアでの事例確認と境界検疫体制の強化が示唆するリスクが顕著。
triage.notes: DRCでのBundibugyo Ebola疑い例が1,028件に増加。同型ワクチンが存在しないリスク要因。ザンビアでの2件は検査陰性だが、国境越境のリスク警告とスクリーニング強化による対応が記録されている。複数国への国際的拡大リスク判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ramalan Zodiak Kesehatan Besok Minggu 31 Mei 2026, Aquarius Stres Fisik, Sagitarius Awas Flu!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Horoscope for Tomorrow, Sunday, May 31, 2026: Aquarius Physical Stress, Sagittarius Beware of the Flu!
article.articleSummary: On Sunday, May 31, 2026, Sagittarius may be struck by a cold virus or seasonal fever; preventive actions and timely medication are advised to avert illness. Aquarius should focus on digestion and maintain a balanced diet, as emotional intensity can raise physical stress and warrant periods of rest. The Indonesian health-horoscope roundup from POS-KUPANG.COM (cited prokerala.com) covers 12 signs, offering health tips for Aries through Leo. Across signs, themes include digestive wellness, immune sensitivity, and stress-related symptoms, with practical guidance such as moderate activity, mindful eating, hydration, and avoiding excessive alcohol. While the piece reads as lifestyle content, the explicit disease mentions center on flu-like illness for Sagittarius and digestive health guidance for Aquarius, framed for readers in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年5月31日（日）の健康占い：水瓶座は肉体的ストレス、射手座はインフルエンザに注意！
triage.triage_reason: 星座占いに基づく一般的なライフスタイルコンテンツであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク情報ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当せず、公衆衛生上のシグナルとして価値がない。
triage.notes: 記事は星座占いコンテンツであり、インフルエンザやその他の疾患への言及は予防的な健康アドバイスの文脈でのみ使用されている。実際の感染症イベント、症例報告、アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。Bluedotが感染症キーワードに反応してピックアップされた可能性があるが、公衆衛生監視の対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات تنصح بعدم السفر إلى أوغندا والكونغو الديمقراطية وجنوب السودان بسبب فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Arab Emirates advises against traveling to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan due to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: United Arab Emirates authorities urged citizens to avoid travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan, except when necessary, due to Ebola developments. The Foreign Ministry asked travelers and residents in these countries to exercise heightened caution and follow local health and safety guidance. World Health Organization data through May 24 report 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths among more than 1,000 cases since the outbreak was declared in mid-May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking the country’s seventeenth Ebola outbreak in a population over 100 million. The statement emphasizes UAE monitoring of citizens abroad and safety measures, with emphasis on complying with travel advisories and local public health instructions.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦、エボラウイルスのためウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国、南スーダンへの渡航中止を勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、エボラウイルス流行は国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、複数国での患者発生と渡航制限勧告により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスはWHO緊急委員会の監視対象病原体。DRCでの流行（5月中旬宣言、確定死亡10例、疑い死亡223例、1,000例超）が対象国に含まれる。記事サマリーはUAEの渡航勧告が主題だが、実際の流行発生地はDRCのみが対象国リストに該当。ウガンダ、南スーダンは同リストに含まれていないため除外。複数国への拡散リスクと国際的な関心の高さから、早急なRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SP investiga caso suspeito de Ebola em paciente de 37 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo investigates suspected Ebola case in a 37-year-old patient.
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected in São Paulo, Brazil: a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo is hospitalized at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas with fever compatible with Ebola and is being treated under biosafety protocols. Samples are being sent to Instituto Adolfo Lutz for laboratory confirmation; malaria and other diseases are being ruled out as differential diagnoses. The case remains presumptive, pending specific testing. The São Paulo Health Secretariat has updated guidance for the current Ebola outbreak in the DRC, detailing surveillance, case definition, notification, isolation, initial management, patient flow, and laboratory investigation within the state. Instituto Emilio Ribas previously had three suspected Ebola cases in 2014, all ruled out. The Health Secretariat indicates the risk of introducing Ebola to Brazil and South America remains very low, due to transmission challenges and the lack of direct flights from the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで37歳患者のエボラ疑い症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラの疑い症例で国境を越えた感染リスクがあり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCからの帰国者のエボラ疑い症例で、ブラジルで検査・隔離進行中。国際的な感染リスク（DRCとブラジル両国が確認される）により、WPROスクリーニング対象国（Brazil=3469034、DRC=203312）として列挙。現在は疑い症例段階だが、確定診断待機中であり、IHR通知基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, le patron de l'OMS appelle à la mobilisation contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the WHO chief calls for mobilization against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged rapid mobilization against Ebola as 1,028 suspected cases were reported as of May 29, 2026. Arriving in Bunia, capital of Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicentre, he emphasized community involvement and local ownership alongside international support to coordinate the response. In Kinshasa the day prior, he called for greater international funding, noting only about one-third of the needed resources had been received. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warned this is the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976 and the pace of spread in the early days is unprecedented. Alan Gonzalez of MSF said the number of specialized medical teams and overall support on the ground remains far below what is required.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でWHO事務局長がエボラ対策の動員を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病という高致死率感染症の大規模流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な支援需要、国際的拡大リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は17番目の流行で、初期の感染拡大ペースが前例のないレベル。1,028疑似症例が報告され、WHO事務局長が現地訪問。MSFは医療チームと支援が大幅に不足していると警告。国際的な資金調達も課題である。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: WHO DG arrives in Bunia, the epicentre of the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, the Ituri provincial capital in the Democratic Republic of Congo, to coordinate the Ebola outbreak response centered there. Bunia is the epicentre of the ongoing outbreak, with 1,028 suspected Ebola cases recorded by Friday. Tedros emphasized community ownership, stating that communities understand the problems and solutions and that international support should operate under the DRC government’s leadership. The visit aims to discuss how the response is progressing with communities and to assist in addressing challenges, highlighting continued collaboration among local communities, the government, and international partners to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ流行の震源地ブニアに到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い重症度と国際的拡大リスクを有する指定感染症であり、DRCでの確認症例数（1,028件）、地理的集中（イトゥリ州ブニア市）、WHO事務局長の直接現地訪問により、IHR基準4項目すべてが該当するシグナルである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高いリスク病原体。DRCでの1,028件の疑い症例と地理的集中（イトゥリ州ブニア市）、WHO事務局長による現地訪問は国際的関心と懸念の高さを示唆している。記事ではコミュニティの関与と国際的協力の継続が強調されており、対応体制は構築されているが、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية يصل إلى "إيتوري" بؤرة وباء إيبولا في الكونغو ويؤكد : القدرة على احتواء الوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General arrives in Ituri, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and confirms the capacity to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province with Bunia as the epicenter. On 2026-05-30, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to assess containment capacity. The UN agency had earlier declared a public health emergency of international concern after a new wave in mid-May detected across three Congolese provinces and neighboring Uganda, where confirmed cases reached 9. Africa CDC reports 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases in DRC; authorities warn the true spread may be higher due to limited laboratory capacity, especially in rural Ituri, where weak health services and security challenges from armed groups hinder surveillance. Amid the crisis, a patient recovered and was discharged, providing cautious optimism about containment prospects.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱の震源地コンゴ民主共和国イトゥーリ州ブニアに到着、感染症拡大封じ込め能力を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常/予想外の新規波、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準全項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。WHO事務局長が現地訪問するなど極めて高い社会的・政治的関心。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の新規波により1,000例以上の疑似患者、246名の死亡報告。ウガンダへの越境感染（確認患者9例）により国際的拡大が既に発生。イトゥーリ州ブニアが震源地で、保健サービスの脆弱性と武装勢力による治安上の課題により監視体制が著しく制限されている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は事態の深刻性と国際的関心の高さを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: നോര്‍ത്ത് ടെക്‌സാസിലെ രണ്ട് കൗണ്ടികളില്‍ എബോള നിരീക്ഷണം: യാത്രാവിലക്ക് ഇല്ലെങ്കിലും ജാഗ്രത | embola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surveillance in two counties in North Texas: vigilance even without a travel ban | Ebola
article.articleSummary: North Texas is conducting Ebola surveillance in Denton and Tarrant counties for travelers returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, as Ebola activity persists in those countries and the WHO maintains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Travelers are monitored for 21 days for symptoms. In Denton County, travelers receive education and monitoring; in Tarrant County, authorities provide direct education and monitoring, while Denton travelers self-monitor. There has been no direct contact with a confirmed case, no quarantines implemented, and no symptoms reported among those monitored to date. The effort continues despite the absence of a travel ban, reflecting ongoing vigilance and public health precautions in North Texas.

triage.headline_ja: Ebola surveillance in two counties in North Texas: vigilance even without a travel ban | Ebola
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例報告ではなく、高リスク地域からの帰国者に対する予防的監視活動であり、米国内での実際の発症例やヒト-ヒト感染は確認されていない。対象国（DRC）への監視は行われているが、現地での新規発生情報ではなく、異常な流行状況を示す根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事は米国テキサス州での予防的監視体制の説明であり、DRCでのエボラ流行への対応の一部として位置付けられている。ただし、テキサス州は監視対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。実際の感染確認事例、症状報告、隔離対象者がいずれも存在しないため、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Пять человек смогли излечиться от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five people have recovered from Ebola fever in DR Congo - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, five people have recovered from Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Health Minister Roger Kamba said, with initial post-treatment analyses negative and a second test pending. Laboratory confirmation totals 225 Ebola cases since the outbreak began; the official death toll has not been released, though latest data indicate 221 deaths with suspected Ebola. The World Health Organization has declared the situation in the DRC and neighboring Uganda an emergency and a threat to other countries. The previous DRC outbreak was declared over in October 2025. Ebola virus disease is highly contagious with high mortality; it was first identified in 1976 in Sudan and in the DRC near the Ebola River. It affects humans, some primates and ungulates; major causes of death include massive hemorrhage, toxemia, hypovolemic and infectious-toxic shock.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱から5人が回復 - Vesti.ruニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：225確定症例・221死亡、予想外の再流行、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性）。WHO緊急宣言により国際的関心極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとスーダンは発生地域リストに含まれているが、本文ではDRC内での流行に焦点が当たっており、ウガンダ・スーダンでの実際の症例報告は明記されていない。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。2025年10月に宣言終了した前回のアウトブレイクから8ヶ月以内の再流行であり、異常性・予想外性が高い。WHO による緊急宣言と国際的脅威認識により、国際支援の必要性が明確である。

article.articleHeadline: Jefe de la OMS llega a Ituri, epicentro del brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Head of the WHO arrives in Ituri, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 30 May 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri Province, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain. He planned facility visits, meetings with local and provincial authorities, and WHO staff on the ground, after earlier talks in Kinshasa with Prime Minister Judith Suminwa and UN humanitarian teams. He urged a ceasefire to enable an effective response amid ongoing clashes between the Congolese army and rebels. The African Union estimates 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected or probed cases in DRC; nine cases (and one death) have been confirmed in Uganda from a Congo-imported infection. Bundibugyo Ebola has 30–50% fatality; no vaccine or specific treatment exists. International authorities warn the outbreak's true size is likely underestimated, due to limited lab capacity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がイトゥリに到着、DRCのエボラ流行の震源地
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な多発生で、既に死亡者と複数国への拡大を確認。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク、医療体制への圧迫が明白。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Eボラ株はSudan種やZaire種より致死率が低い（30-50%）ものの、DRCでは1,000例以上の疑似患者と246名の死亡が推定されており、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認（9例、死亡1例）。ワクチンと特異的治療法が存在しないことが懸念事項。WHO事務局長の現地視察は対応の優先度の高さを示唆。限定的なラボ検査能力のため実際の流行規模はさらに大きい可能性があると指摘されている。武装勢力との衝突が対応を阻害するリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Στο επίκεντρο της επιδημίας του Έμπολα στη Λ.Δ. του Κονγκό έφτασε ο επικεφαλής του Παγκόσμιου Οργανισμού Υγείας - tempo24.news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General arrived at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - tempo24.news
article.articleSummary: On 30 May 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, to assist and listen to communities facing a severe Ebola outbreak. The highly infectious viral hemorrhagic fever is already present in three eastern DR Congo provinces and in neighboring Uganda, which has nine confirmed Ebola cases, including one death. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in DR Congo, with 246 deaths, according to Africa CDC. The international community is participating under the DR Congo government's leadership, with a focus on community engagement and response challenges. The true scale is thought to be broader than detected; the country has limited capacity to conduct laboratory confirmation, complicating surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地ブニアに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数国への国際的拡大、ヒト-ヒト感染による高い流行性を有し、WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行。5月15日宣言以降、コンゴ民主共和国で1,077例の疑い例、246死亡。ウガンダでも9例の確定例を含む拡大。実検査能力の限界により実態把握が困難。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的対応の最優先性を示唆。記事サマリーではウガンダでの確定例言及があるがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Diretor-geral da OMS chega a epicentro do surto na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO Director-General arrives at the epicenter of the outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centers in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia, Ituri province as the epicenter. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrives to engage communities, assess response efforts, and address operational challenges as Bunia International Airport remains closed to commercial flights. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and the WHO elevated the event to a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola has been detected in three provinces within DR Congo and has spread to neighboring Uganda, which now reports nine confirmed cases after two newly identified infections. In DR Congo, 246 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases have been reported, though numbers are likely underestimated due to limited laboratory testing. Ituri hosts the majority of confirmed cases amid rural service gaps and armed-group activity, while attacks on treatment centers and community mistrust hinder response. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus; no specific treatment or licensed vaccine exists.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国の流行の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予期しない、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。WHOが国際保健上の脅威として認定済みで、複数国への拡大および高い死亡率を伴うエボラ流行であり、即座にフルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーではエボラの実際の発生地がDRC（特にIturi州Bunia）であり、ウガンダは隣国への拡大（9例の確認例）として言及されている。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数州への拡大、1000件以上の疑い例と246名の死亡報告、Bundibugyo virus（治療法・ワクチンなし）、治療施設への攻撃と社会不信などの管理困難要因により、極めて高いリスクの案件である。

article.articleHeadline: Relief as Australia survives its first potential Ebola scare
article.articleSummary: Ebola scare in Victoria, Australia: a man who recently returned from Africa was treated at Royal Melbourne Hospital, placed in a negative-pressure ICU room, and discharged after tests showed no Ebola infection. Health authorities stressed rapid identification, isolation and testing, noting the overall risk is low. The patient had travelled near the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, where a major outbreak is active. WHO reports about 223 deaths and over 900 suspected cases in that outbreak; the strain involved is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine (unlike the Zaire variant with a vaccine). Symptoms include fever, muscle and joint pain, headaches, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, with possible kidney and liver impairment, and an incubation of 2–21 days. Separately, Australia is experiencing its largest diphtheria outbreak since 1991, with more than 260 confirmed cases and one death, mainly among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリアが初めての潜在的エボラ恐怖を乗り越えた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスと大規模アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）、オーストラリアでの最大規模ジフテリアアウトブレイク（260症例以上）の2つの重大な感染症イベントが報告されており、IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準複数該当。国際的な健康脅威として注視の必要性あり。
triage.notes: 記事はオーストラリアでの1症例のエボラ疑似症例（最終的に陰性）を取り上げているが、DRCおよびウガンダにおける活動中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（223死亡、900以上の疑似症例、ブンディブギョウ株）が中心的な関心事。オーストラリアではジフテリアアウトブレイク（260症例以上、1死亡）も並行報告されている。verified_locationsはサマリーに基づき実際に活発なアウトブレイクが発生している対象国のみを列挙。オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Director OMS evalua respuesta al brote de ébola en RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General Assesses Response to Ebola Outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-30, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to assess the Ebola outbreak response. The outbreak is among the most severe in recent years, with rapid evolution, a marked increase in cases, sustained geographic spread, and cross-border transmission into Uganda. As of the WHO’s latest report, 134 cases and 18 deaths have been confirmed; 906 cases and 223 deaths remain under investigation as suspected. Since the prior update on May 21, authorities confirmed 49 new infections and eight additional deaths, with 160 suspected cases and 47 deaths possibly linked to the virus. Separately, a confirmed Ebola case has been reported in a United States citizen who treated patients in Congo and is now receiving care in Germany. MSF cautioned that the speed of spread is unprecedented.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行への対応を評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大なエボラ出血熱流行。複数国への国際的拡大、死亡者発生、前例のない感染速度が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダ、米国、ドイツへの拡大が記載されているが、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストの制約に基づきDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。エボラ出血熱の特性上、国際的拡大リスク・管理困難性は極めて高い。WHOトップの現地訪問という高い政治的関心が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Генералният директор на СЗО пристигна в епицентъра на епидемията от ебола в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General arrived at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo records over 1,000 probable Ebola cases and 246 deaths in an outbreak centered in Ituri province, with cross-border spread to three provinces and neighboring Uganda. Ebola virus disease, a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever, prompted WHO to declare international concern after the outbreak was declared on May 15. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to oversee the response, stating the situation is complex but controllable. Uganda has closed its border with Congo amid the outbreak. The first patient has reportedly recovered in this outbreak. Historical context notes Africa’s Ebola toll—over 15,000 deaths in five decades—alongside the 2018–2020 Congo outbreak of 3,500 cases and about 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準5つすべて該当。エボラの現在のアウトブレイク（1,000症例以上、246死亡、国境を越えた拡大、WHO国際的懸念宣言）は明確なシグナルでフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれていますが、サマリーではウガンダは国境閉鎖と記述されており、確定症例の発生はコンゴDRCに限定されています。したがってverified_locationsはコンゴDRCのみです。エボラは最高リスク疾患であり、WHO事務局長の現地訪問、複数州への拡大、国境を越えた拡大、既に246死亡という重大な進展があり、直ちにフルリスク評価が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo investiga caso suspeito de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo investigates a suspected case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo's Health Secretariat is investigating a suspected Ebola case in the capital. The patient is a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) about ten days ago, presenting with fever and currently hospitalized at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology, the reference center for such cases. The 2–21 day Ebola incubation window fits his timeline, and no laboratory confirmation has been made yet; the case remains under investigation. He is also being tested for other febrile illnesses, including malaria. Collected samples will be analyzed by Instituto Adolfo Lutz. The health network was placed on alert after last week’s update of surveillance guidelines amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC, emphasizing immediate notification, isolation, investigation, and vigilance for travelers or contacts. Regiane de Paula notes São Paulo’s preventive readiness and a prepared network for rapid case identification and management.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロがエボラ疑い症例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確定前症例であり、DRC発生源国からの輸入症例であることから、国際的公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCからの最近の帰国者（約10日前）であり、発熱・入院中。エボラの潜伏期間（2-21日）は患者のタイムラインと合致。サンパウロは感染症参照センター（Emílio Ribas感染症研究所）での隔離・調査を実施しており、検体分析は進行中。DRCでの進行中の流行が背景。重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: DRK: Szef WHO przybył do miasta Bunia, będącego centrum epidemii eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRK: The WHO chief arrived in Bunia, the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to oversee the Ebola response and visit a treatment center, meeting local authorities, health workers, and affected families. WHO reports 906 probable Ebola cases in DR Congo with 223 suspected deaths; Africa CDC cites 246 deaths and over 1,000 probable cases. Rural areas lack healthcare access, and ongoing armed-group violence worsens the humanitarian toll, with international health groups warning that official figures likely undercount the true scale due to limited diagnostics. Uganda has reported eight cases connected to the outbreak. The epidemic involves the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain; initial deaths went unrecognized because tests targeted other variants. A Bundibugyo-specific vaccine may be unavailable for six to nine months. Background context notes Ebola has caused substantial mortality in Africa, including a 2018–2020 DR Congo outbreak (~2,300 deaths) and more than 15,000 deaths over five decades.

triage.headline_ja: DRK: WHO事務局長がエボラ流行の中心地ブニア市に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準を4項目全てで満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全てで該当。エボラウイルス疾患の多国間での発生と高い死亡率、国際的な懸念の高まりが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア市）でのエボラ流行を主題としている。ウガンダの8症例は二次感染として言及されているが、記事の主要な焦点はDRCの流行対応である。稀なブンディブギョ株の使用、ワクチン不足（6～9ヶ月）、診断能力の限界、武装勢力による暴力が状況を複雑にしている。WHO事務局長の現地視察という高レベルの国際対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits epicentre of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ituri province (Bunia) faces a severe Ebola haemorrhagic fever outbreak with over 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths since May 15. The Bundibugyo strain, highly transmissible through close contact and bodily fluids, has produced cases in three eastern DRC provinces and neighbouring Uganda, which has nine confirmed infections, including one death. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to bolster community-led response amid limited laboratory capacity and insecurity driven by ADF militants and other militias; officials warn the outbreak's true scale is likely larger than confirmed figures. A border closure and 21-day quarantine were imposed by Uganda for arrivals from DRC. A patient in the current outbreak recovered and was discharged after two negative tests, described as the first such recovery. There is no vaccine or specific treatment yet for Bundibugyo; a vaccine could be ready by year-end, per CDC Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。1,077例の疑い患者と246例の死亡を伴う深刻な公衆衛生影響、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、渡航制限措置の実施が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダで確認された9例を含む国際的な感染拡大が認められているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを列挙した。Bundibugyo株はヒト-ヒト感染が容易で高い伝播能を持ち、ワクチンが年末までに利用可能になる見込みであることが注記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Šef WHO-a sletio u epicentar ebole: 'Mislim da ovo možemo zaustaviti'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief lands in the Ebola epicenter: 'I think we can stop this.'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) centered in Ituri Province, with Bunia serving as the epicenter, where WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to coordinate response. The outbreak, declared on May 15, has spread across three Congolese provinces and into Uganda, which reported two new confirmed cases on Friday, bringing Uganda’s total to nine. In DRC, Africa CDC/AU data cite more than 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, with the vast majority of confirmed infections in Ituri. Access is hampered by security incidents and armed groups; treatment centers face distrust and safety challenges, and millions displaced into camps elevate transmission risk in overcrowded settings. Laboratory capacity to confirm cases is limited, likely underestimating true scope. WHO has issued an international health alert, and while the situation is complex, Tedros says, 'we can stop this.'

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ流行の震源地に到着：『これは止められると思う』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス病の多国間流行であり、死亡例・重篤事例が報告され、ヒト-ヒト感染する。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により高い社会・政治的関心が生じている。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダは『DRCからの二次感染として確認例が9例』と記述されており、流行の主体はDRCのイトゥリ州。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。アクセスの困難さ、資本室容量の限界、難民キャンプでの過密状態など管理可能性の課題が多く、国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Bên trong tâm dịch Ebola: Thị trấn đào vàng bị 'tử thần' bủa vây
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inside the Ebola epicenter: the gold-mining town besieged by the Grim Reaper.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, outbreak centered in Mongbwalu, a gold-mining town in the Democratic Republic of Congo. By May 30, 2026, authorities report over 1,077 suspected cases and 246 related deaths, with Mongbwalu accounting for more than 400 cases. The Ministry of Health announced the outbreak on May 15; within two weeks it was the third-largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and could become the deadliest without urgent measures. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or therapy. Notable cases include a 5-year-old boy with persistent nasal bleeding. Hospitals suffer severe shortages: a dilapidated Ebola ward, scarce PPE, testing capacity, water, and supplies. Samples must be sent 80 km to Bunia; results take at least four days, leaving many patients unconfirmed and dying. At least seven healthcare workers have died; MSF is erecting isolation tents, but fear and misinformation, plus an 18-patient escape, hinder containment. Bats and mining-driven population influx raise spillover risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の震源地の内部：『死神』に包囲された金採掘町
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の新規アウトブレイクで1,000件以上の疑い患者と246人の死亡を記録しており、医療体制が崩壊寸前であり、国際支援が緊急に必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus はDRC第3位の規模で、ワクチンと治療法がない。医療資源の極度の不足、患者の逃亡（18人）、根拠のない情報による社会不安が対策を阻害している。蝙蝠と採掘活動による人口流入が人畜共通感染病の再出現リスクを高める。MSFが支援に当たっているが、検査能力が極めて限定的（80km離れた検査施設、結果取得に4日要する）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo advancing faster than response effort, warns medical agency
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) is advancing faster than the response, MSF warns as testing bottlenecks, border/airport restrictions, and logistics delays limit containment. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or specific treatments, complicating efforts. Hundreds of suspected samples remain untested and overwhelmed health facilities risk broader health impacts. MSF urges expanded testing capacity, faster humanitarian deployment, and improved coordination of international assistance, with strong community engagement to build trust. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus was in Bunia for the briefing. Current figures from WHO indicate at least 134 confirmed Ebola cases across Congo and Uganda, with new suspected cases continuing and a cumulative total exceeding 1,000 since the outbreak was declared. Among confirmed cases, nine are in Uganda and deaths reach 18 across the two countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が対応努力より速く進行中と医療機関が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数国への広がりが確認されている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目で懸念事項が存在し、国際支援の必要性が明示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）で発生し、ウガンダでも9例の確認症例があると記述されている。しかし、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC: 203312）のみを記載した。Bundibugyo strain（ワクチンなし）、テスト遅延、国境・空港制限、医療施設の過負荷など、複数の深刻なリスク要因が存在する。WHO事務局長による現地視察および134例以上の確認症例、合計1,000例超の流行宣言後の発症が確認されており、即座のフルRRA実施が必要である。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits town at the epicentre of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo centers on Bunia, Ituri Province (epicentre), with the virus already present in three eastern provinces. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, there have been at least 1,077 suspected DRC cases and 246 deaths. In neighboring Uganda, nine confirmed Ebola infections have been reported, including one death. WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia on Saturday to coordinate the response, stressing community participation as essential and noting ongoing international engagement. He has been in the DRC since Thursday; WHO requests greater international support, as funding has reached only about one third of requirements. Authorities warn the outbreak’s true reach is likely wider than detected, with transmission possibly circulating before detection.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間流行であり、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク・深刻な公衆衛生影響が明確。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Uganda は記事で隣接国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRC での流行が主題であり、DRC のみを該当として記載。1,077件の疑似症例と246名の死亡が報告され、国境を越えた拡大が確認されている（ウガンダで9件の確定症例）。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な関心と対応の高さを示唆。資金需要も報告されており、国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Administrația Trump a instituit unele dintre cele mai stricte restricții de călătorie din istoria Statelor Unite, din cauza virusului Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Trump administration has instituted some of the strictest travel restrictions in United States history, due to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Trump administration has enacted stringent US travel bans on travelers who recently went to Ebola-affected countries amid what is described as one of the most severe Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The move clashes with WHO’s view that such restrictions are often fear-driven and lack scientific basis, though U.S. officials frame them as a public-health tool to limit international spread while targeting the outbreak source. WHO and Africa CDC warn that border restrictions can stigmatize affected populations and hinder outbreak surveillance, advocating global solidarity instead. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasizes not closing borders. The piece notes a 2022 analysis in Emerging Infectious Diseases indicating early travel controls delayed but did not prevent Covid-19 spread; Ebola is less contagious than Covid, transmitting mainly via bodily fluids of symptomatic individuals, with risk highest in Congo and neighboring regions, lower globally.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権がエボラウイルスのため米国史上最も厳格な渡航制限を制度化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準該当。DRC由来の重篤なエボラ流行と米国の政策対応が両立し、シグナル特性が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは「DRCにおけるエボラの最重篤流行」を主題としており、米国の渡航制限はその反応である。サマリー上では DRC が実際の発生地であると明示されている。米国は政策実施地であるが、本インシデントの原発地ではなく、verified_locations には含めない（対象国リストに米国は含まれない）。WHO と Africa CDC の警告が記載され、国際的な懸念と応答体制の対立構造が明らかであり、フルRRA実施が妥当である。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief rallies Congo's Ebola response
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to coordinate the Ebola response amid the Ituri province's Bunia hotspot, where 1028 suspected cases had been recorded by Friday. The outbreak involves the Bundibugjo (Bundibugyo) strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Tedros urged community involvement, noting that communities understand problems and solutions, while international support continues under the government's leadership. He was in Kinshasa on arrival Thursday, calling for more funding, as WHO has received only about one third of its needs. Medical aid from the European Union reached Ituri, with more shipments expected in eight days; the United States announced an additional $80 million, bringing total U.S. support to over $112 million. MSF warned the outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented pace; 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976, with uncertain scale.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ対応を支援
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、致死的で治療法のないBundibugjo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクであるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugjo株は承認された治療法やワクチンが存在しない致死的株。1028件の疑い症例、MSFは「前例のない速度で拡大」と警告。WHO資金が必要額の3分の1のみ。米国$80百万追加支援、EU医療援助到着。国際的関心極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ex-CDC director warns Ebola outbreak could rank second largest in history
article.articleSummary: Ex-CDC director Robert Redfield warned the Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda could become the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history. He noted the current event is already the third-largest globally, behind West Africa’s 2014–2016 surge (28,600 cases, 11,308 deaths) and the DRC’s 2018–2020 spike (3,470 cases, 2,287 deaths). As of Friday, 134 confirmed cases—mostly in the Congo with 9 in Uganda—and 18 confirmed deaths have been reported; Congo also has 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths (as of Wednesday). WHO Director-General Tedros cited conflict in eastern DRC as hindering response and urged a ceasefire. The CDC imposed travel restrictions on foreign nationals and U.S. green-card holders who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last 21 days, with enhanced screenings for Americans returning from these countries.

triage.headline_ja: 前CDC長官、エボラ出血熱の流行が歴史上2番目の規模となる可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、複数国への国際的拡大、米国による渡航制限の発令）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。既に134確認症例、18死亡が報告され、DRCおよびウガンダで進行中の多国間流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）における主要な流行が明記されており、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ、スーダン、アンゴラは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。すでにWHO Director-General による公式声明、CDC による渡航制限の発令など国際的な対応が開始されている。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの大規模流行は歴史的に重大な事象。

article.articleHeadline: El director general de la OMS llega a RDC en medio de un brote de ébola con una propagación sin precedentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General arrives in the DRC amid an Ebola outbreak with unprecedented spread.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri Province, DRC, to assess one of the worst recent Ebola outbreaks. The crisis involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no approved vaccines or specific treatments, and is spreading rapidly with cross-border transmission to Uganda. The latest WHO balance cites 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths, with 223 deaths and 906 cases under investigation as suspected. Since May 21, 49 additional cases and 8 more deaths were confirmed, alongside 160 suspected cases and 47 deaths possibly attributed to the virus reported in the past week. One laboratory-confirmed case, a U.S. citizen who treated patients in DRC, is receiving care in Germany. MSF warns the true magnitude remains unknown, many samples await analysis, and urgent expansion of testing capacity and a coordinated, rapid response are required.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、前例のない拡散を伴うエボラ出血熱の流行の最中にコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるエボラ出血熱の流行で、ワクチンなし、ウガンダへの越境感染、米国への患者流出が確認されており、WHO事務局長の現地視察による世界的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、主要発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Bunia, Ituri Province）。ウガンダへの越境感染とドイツでの治療中の米国人患者が言及されているが、感染症イベント本体はDRCで発生。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチンなく治療法も限定的で、前例のない速度での拡散が指摘されている。WHO事務局長の現地視察という異例の対応も重大性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Mexico ta tsaurara matakan shigar baki saboda Ebola
article.articleSummary: Mexico tightens entry for travelers from Africa amid Ebola concerns; Aeroméxico, VivaAerobus, and Volaris say passengers who have been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days will be barred from boarding flights to or entering Mexico. The measures accompany broader protective steps planned with the United States and Canada as host nations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, which starts in under two weeks. The World Health Organization notes Ebola poses a risk to neighboring countries of the DRC. No case counts are provided. The article notes these restrictions are part of broader coordination with authorities in the United States and Canada.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、エボラ懸念からアフリカからの渡航者の入国を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大リスクが高く、複数国での対策実施、2026 FIFA ワールドカップ開催に伴う重要な公衆衛生イベント対応が該当。IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが明確に認められ、スクリーニング基準でも流行しやすさ・管理可能性の観点から複数該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ、南スーダン、DRCからのアフリカ発の渡航者に対する制限について記述されているが、ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。メキシコ、米国、カナダは記事の主題となる発生地ではなく、対策実施国であるため除外。エボラウイルスは高い致死率と国際的感染拡大のリスクがあり、2026 FIFAワールドカップという国際的な人員移動が伴う重要イベント直前での措置であることから、極めて高いリスク評価。具体的な症例数は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: สธ.สั่งจับตาไข้หวัดใหญ่สายพันธุ์ B เสียชีวิตแล้ว 16 ราย เตือนเข้าฤดูฝนระบาดหนักกว่าเดิม
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health orders monitoring of influenza type B; 16 deaths; warns that with the onset of the rainy season, outbreaks will be more severe than before.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control (DDC) warns that influenza outbreaks will intensify with the rainy season. As of May 28, 2026, surveillance data show 171,731 influenza-like illness cases and 16 deaths. The highest incidence is in children aged 5–9, followed by 0–4 and 10–14 years. Investigations using the Digital Disease Surveillance system, hospital networks, the Department of Medical Sciences, and the Thai–US Public Health Cooperation Center found influenza B to be the most detected strain among patients with ILI and pneumonia. Although nationwide trends may be decreasing, regional outbreaks are occurring, and cases are expected to rise during the rainy season.
