Transmission occurs easily via coughs/sneezes and contact with contaminated droplets in crowded settings such as schools, workplaces, and transit. Preventive measures include masks, frequent hand hygiene, avoiding close contact with the ill, and annual vaccination for high-risk groups. For questions, call 1422.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がインフルエンザB型を監視、16人が死亡、雨季に流行が従来より悪化すると警告
triage.triage_reason: タイでインフルエンザB型の感染が拡大しており、171,731例の報告、16人の死亡、雨季における流行増加の予測が示されている。公式な監視体制が構築され、重症度と公衆衛生への影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はタイにおけるインフルエンザB型の流行に焦点を当てている。WPRO基準で複数の基準に該当し、政府による公式な監視・警告が発出されている。死亡数、患者数、雨季での流行懸念、学校等の集団施設での容易な感染など、流行性・長期曝露・重症度の複数の観点で危険信号を示している。

article.articleHeadline: El director de la OMS pide combatir el ébola en el epicentro ante más de 1.000 casos sospechosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General calls for combating Ebola in the epicenter amid more than 1,000 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains at the epicenter in Ituri’s Bunia, with suspected cases rising beyond 1,000. The WHO reported 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths, while Congolese authorities later announced 1,028 suspected infections; Uganda confirmed 9 cases and 1 death linked to the outbreak. Described as the fastest-spreading Ebola episode since 1976, it involves the Bundibugyo lineage, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. MSF warns resources are insufficient and calls for rapid diagnostics, faster deployment of personnel, and sustained medical supplies. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, urged community ownership and local involvement as essential to containment. Insecurity, attacks on health centers, and armed groups (ADF, M23 in North and South Kivu) impede access; border closures by Uganda and Rwanda and U.S. travel restrictions add complexity, though Tedros criticizes border blocks for hindering transparency.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に対抗するよう呼びかけるWHO事務局長、1,000件以上の疑い患者報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1,000件以上の疑い患者、223人の死亡）、1976年以降最速の拡大ペース、ウガンダへの越境感染確認、複数国による渡航制限実施。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが流行の中心地として記載。ウガンダとルワンダも言及されているが、発生地はDRC（南キブ州、イトゥリ州）。ウガンダは確認患者9例ながら、主要な流行はDRCのイトゥリ州Bunia地域。ワクチン・治療薬欠如、医療インフラの脆弱性、武装勢力による不安全状況が管理を困難にしている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と緊急対応呼びかけは社会政治的関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den Ebola salgınında alarm seviyesini yükseltti: Ölüm oranı yüzde 50'ye ulaştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raised the alarm level in the Ebola outbreak: the death rate reached 50%.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, northeast) shows a case fatality rate of 30% to 50%, per WHO. Official counts exceed 1,000 suspected and confirmed cases, with deaths rising and officials warning the toll could be higher due to underdetection in conflict zones. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine, though WHO advisory committees urge rapid clinical trials for vaccines and therapies. The epidemic is impeded by fighting that restricts access for healthcare teams. Uganda has closed its border, while WHO cautions that border closures can drive smuggling and hinder surveillance. Kenya’s high court temporarily halted a US–Kenya agreement to establish a quarantine center for infected or exposed Americans, though the US continues regional aid and personnel. Africa Union health agency expects a vaccine by year-end.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行で警戒レベルを引き上げ：死亡率が50％に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡率30～50％、1,000件以上の疑い例・確定例）、異常性（新たな流行）、国際拡大リスク（ウガンダの国境閉鎖、ケニアでの米国との隔離センター協議）、渡航制限リスクの4基準すべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（高死亡率）、流行性（ヒト-ヒト感染病原体）、管理可能性（外部支援必要）に該当。WPRO対象国（DRC）での発生確認。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUSA、Uganda、Kenyaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ流行。ウガンダ・ケニアの言及は国境対応と隔離センター協議のみで、これら国での実際の患者発生は記述されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo strainで治療法・ワクチンなし、武力紛争による対応困難という追加的リスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le ministre de la Santé confirme 225 cas d'Ebola et anticipe "au moins cinq guérisons"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Health Minister confirms 225 Ebola cases and anticipates "at least five recoveries."
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Health Minister Roger Kamba reported 225 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 1,028 suspected cases as of a May 29 press conference in Bunia, Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicenter. He cited improved laboratory capacity and projected a shift from suspected to confirmed cases starting May 30, with at least five recoveries anticipated as patients’ first tests were negative and a second confirmatory test was pending; clinical status of recovering patients appeared reassuring. Transmission has not spread to new provinces: ten health zones in Ituri, three in North Kivu, and one in South Kivu are affected. Community resistance—rooted in beliefs and fatalistic views around funerals and poison—undermines response, delaying alerts and care. The WHO Director-General, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, was in DRC and planned to visit Bunia on May 30 to assess efforts; the outbreak has caused 246 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：保健大臣がエボラ225例を確認し「少なくとも5人の回復」を予想
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも全5基準に該当。現在進行中の大規模エボラ流行であり、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 2026年5月29日時点で確定症例225例、疑い症例1,028例、死亡例246例。Ituri州Bunia市が流行の中心地。WHOの事務局長が現地視察を予定。コミュニティの抵抗と信念体系が対応を阻害している状況。

article.articleHeadline: غيبريسوس يصل إلى بؤرة تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghebreyesus arrives at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo centers on Bunia, Ituri Province, with mid-May declaring a new outbreak and WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The epicenter spans three Congolese provinces and neighboring Uganda; nine confirmed cases in DRC and 246 deaths among over 1,000 suspected cases, per Africa CDC. Uganda has confirmed infections; Zambia reports two suspected cases ruled out after testing, but border risk remains high with screening at entry points. The strain involved is Bundibugyo, a rare form with no vaccine; about 1,028 suspected Bundibugyo cases have been reported in DRC and Uganda. Symptoms begin like influenza: fever, fatigue, muscle pain, sore throat, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and organ failure. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia and will visit Ituri to meet leaders and coordinate response.

triage.headline_ja: ゲブレイエスス事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱発生の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、エボラ出血熱による国際的公衆衛生上の懸念の事態。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、複数国への拡大、死亡例・確認症例の発生により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ出血熱の発生地がコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)の東部Ituri州Buniaが震源地であり、9件の確認症例と246件の死亡（1,000件以上の疑い症例中）が報告されている。ウガンダでも確認感染があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ザンビアは疑い症例2件が検査により陰性と判定されたが、国境リスクが高いため included。稀なBundibugyo株で、ワクチンがない。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: UAE's public health situation remains 'stable' as it reviews Ebola developments
article.articleSummary: UAE public health status remains stable as it reviews Ebola developments. A meeting chaired by Ahmed Ali Al Sayegh, Minister of Health and Prevention, and the National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority assessed current epidemiological developments and the measures to safeguard the community. Authorities said the UAE's response arrangements and readiness remain active and effective. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs advised residents and UAE nationals to avoid non-essential travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan during the ongoing Ebola situation. The update underscores continued vigilance and preparedness in the UAE while monitoring Ebola-related developments in affected countries, with travel advisories in place as of 2026-05-30.

triage.headline_ja: UAEの公衆衛生状況はエボラの展開をレビューする中で「安定」を保持
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの流行）と、UAE等への越境的な懸念が存在し、複数国での発生とUAEによる渡航制限勧告がIHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Sudan、UAEが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC(203312)のみ。ウガンダとスーダンでもエボラが確認されているが、提供対象国に含まれていないため除外。エボラは極めて高い致死率と国際的拡大リスクを有するため、IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、直ちにフルRRAへ進める必要がある。UAEの渡航制限勧告は国際的な懸念の高さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Κογκό: Στο επίκεντρο της επιδημίας του Έμπολα ο επικεφαλής του ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The WHO chief at the center of the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to oversee the response to a new Ebola virus disease outbreak. The outbreak, declared May 15, is centered in Ituri, which hosts the majority of cases, amid limited state health services and armed groups that hinder access. The WHO has proclaimed a global health emergency. International health authorities warn the true scale remains unknown, due in part to low laboratory capacity to confirm cases. Ghebreyesus began a two‑day visit in Ituri to meet authorities and bolster support. The article notes Ebola has killed about 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years, and recalls the worst DRC outbreak (2018–2020) with 3,500 confirmed cases and 2,300 deaths. No infection-source details or imported/exported case information are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ流行の中心にWHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の新規発生がDRCで宣言され（5月15日）、WHOが国際的健康上の緊急事態を宣言している。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当する高リスク事象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ指定感染症。記事はWHO事務局長による現地訪問を報道しており、WHO自身が国際的健康上の緊急事態を宣言している。Ituri州での武装勢力による対応困難、低い検査能力などが対応を複雑化させている。過去最大規模のDRC発生（2018-2020、確認症例3,500件、死亡2,300件）との比較を述べており、重大性の認識が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Ebola Response Update - May 29, 2026
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to trigger a rapid, coordinated response. The Department of State, in close coordination with the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), is leading a comprehensive U.S. effort to contain transmission and support affected communities. The United States remains the largest financial contributor to the Ebola response, with Department of State funding exceeding $162 million and continuing to grow to enable implementing organizations to scale activities. The update underscores sustained collaboration across agencies and with international partners to mobilize resources, logistics, and technical assistance for outbreak control. The article does not provide case counts in this update, but highlights ongoing funding and operations in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：エボラ対応状況報告 - 2026年5月29日
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の複数国での継続的な流行であり、米国を含む国際的な対応体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているエボラ流行の発生地はDRCおよびウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。米国は対応国であり発生地ではないため除外。複数の国際機関による対応が進行中であり、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mass anti-rabies vaccination drive under way in Kodaikanal hills
article.articleSummary: In Kodaikanal hills, a mass anti-rabies vaccination drive has vaccinated 2,147 dogs and sterilised 45 under the Animal Birth Control (ABC) programme within Kodaikanal Municipality limits. The effort is led by Kodaikanal Society for Protection and Care for Animals (KSPCA) in collaboration with the municipality, Dindigul administration, and Kodaikanal Wildlife Sanctuary officials. All sterilised dogs are microchipped to aid identification and monitoring for population management. Volunteers, with Mission Rabies India and WVS Veterinary Task Force, visited distant hill settlements to promote vaccination of strays and pet dogs. The vaccination drive continues on Sunday, while the ABC sterilisation phase runs until June 5 with a target to sterilise at least 150 dogs during this phase. The initiative aims to reduce rabies risk, safeguard human and animal health, and move toward a rabies-free Kodaikanal.

triage.headline_ja: コダイカナル丘陵地帯で大規模狂犬病予防接種キャンペーン実施中
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病の予防接種キャンペーン（public health initiative）の報道であり、アウトブレイクやクラスターの報告ではない。死亡例や異常な感染増加の報告がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: コダイカナルはタミルナード州にあるインドの地域。記事は既存の予防接種プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規の疾病イベント（クラスター、アウトブレイク、死亡例の増加）の報告ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: DRC minister says people don't 'need to be in panic' over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bunia, Ituri province) continues to spread. The DRC reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; the WHO update lists 134 confirmed cases and 18 confirmed deaths in the DRC and neighboring Uganda. With 2,635 contacts under monitoring and 125 people in treatment, the government says progress is being made as the first recovery—a female patient discharged after two negative tests—offers cautious optimism. Minister Patrick Muyaya warns against panic, stressing that the outbreak is serious but manageable within a 90–120 day window and relies on ongoing community engagement and information sharing. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, not respiratory routes. Challenges include misinformation on social media; authorities are countering this with daily briefings, safe burial practices, and strengthened support for health workers and aid organizations.

triage.headline_ja: DRC大臣、エボラ感染症の発生について「パニックに陥る必要はない」とコメント
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）の4項目すべてに該当し、複数国での確認症例と死亡事例があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が主体。ウガンダも発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。確認症例134例、死亡18例、接触者監視中2,635名という活動的な流行を示している。90～120日のタイムウィンドウ内での管理可能性を政府が主張しているが、社会メディアでの不正確な情報拡散が懸念要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: WHO Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus Lands in Congo's Ituri Province As Outbreak Outpaces Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo’s Ituri Province centered on Bunia, caused by Bundibugyo virus (no approved treatment or vaccine). As of 30 May 2026, DRC reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; Uganda records 9 cases and 1 death. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to bolster response, with the agency declaring the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. EU medical aid has arrived and more shipments are expected; the U.S. pledged $80 million, bringing total U.S. support to over $112 million. Hospitals in Bunia are better supplied, but cases continue to surge; MSF warns this is among the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreaks. Attacks on health centers, burial‑practice tensions, and clashes with ADF and ethnic militias hinder response in Ituri and into North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda and Rwanda closed borders; Tedros criticizes travel/border bans as ineffective.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の大流行：テドロスWHO事務局長がコンゴのイトゥリ州に到着、大流行が対応を上回る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、WHO緊急宣言があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRC（特にイトゥリ州ブニア）の発生が中心であることが明記されている。ウガンダとルワンダについては国境閉鎖や少数の確認症例の記述があるが、主な発生地は対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみ。ただしウガンダは発生地域に含まれており、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus）は承認済み治療法やワクチンがなく、高い致死率と急速な拡大が確認されている。複数国への波及リスクと社会的・政治的関心の高さから、即座にフルRRA実施対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: diretor-geral da OMS visita epicentro da epidemia na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO Director-General visits epicenter of the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, epicenter of a grave Ebola outbreak spreading in the eastern region. He landed at Bunia International Airport, which remains closed to commercial traffic due to the epidemic, and since Thursday has been in the DRC to engage with communities, assess the response, and identify gaps in providing support. The DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15, with transmission across multiple provinces; WHO has issued an International Health Emergency alert. The Ebola virus, which causes hemorrhagic fever, has been detected in three Congolese provinces and in neighboring Uganda, where two new cases were confirmed on Friday, raising Uganda’s total confirmed cases to nine as of May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国の流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大、国際支援需要）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日にコンゴ民主共和国で新規エボラ流行が宣言され、複数州での伝播が確認されている。ウガンダでも2例の新規確定患者が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は流行の重大性を示す。国際保健上の緊急事態アラートが発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വൈറസ് വ്യാപനം: മൂന്ന് ആഫ്രിക്കൻ രാജ്യങ്ങളിലേക്ക് യാത്രാ നിയന്ത്രണം ഏർപ്പെടുത്തി യുഎഇ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus outbreak: UAE imposes travel restrictions to three African countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak prompts UAE travel restrictions, with the UAE urging citizens to avoid non-essential travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued an advisory warning UAE nationals to refrain from travel to these three African countries unless it is an emergency. For UAE residents already in these countries, the ministry calls for extreme vigilance and strict adherence to local health and safety guidance. The report does not include case counts or fatalities, but frames the situation as a spreading Ebola threat requiring precautionary measures. No laboratory confirmation details or infection sources are provided. The advisory, dated 2026-05-30, reflects UAE public health and diplomatic efforts to limit exposure and manage potential importation of infections.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染拡大：UAE、3つのアフリカ諸国への渡航制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスクが高く、複数国での流行を示唆する報告。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも流行可能性・管理可能性が明確。フルRRA実施推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）、ウガンダ、南スーダンへの渡航制限が述べられているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダとスーダンは対象外。症例数・死亡数の記載がなく重症度評価は「不明」とした。2026年5月30日という将来日付は異常だが、イベント日時として処理。

article.articleHeadline: Șeful OMS cere mai mult sprijin internațional pentru combaterea epidemiei de Ebola din Congo - HotNews.ro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief calls for more international support to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to coordinate the response to the latest Ebola outbreak. By Friday, authorities reported 1,028 suspected Ebola cases. In Bunia, Ituri province, he emphasized community involvement as essential alongside government coordination and international support. In Kinshasa, he urged stronger international backing, noting that WHO has received only about one-third of the funds required. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warned that this outbreak—the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976—is spreading at an unprecedented pace, with the number of medical organizations on the ground and overall support still far below what is needed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行対策に向けてより多くの国際支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による確認症例1,028件の大規模流行で、IHR基準3項目以上に該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO事務局長による直接的な国際支援要請と資金不足、前例のない拡大速度により緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: DRCにおける17番目のエボラ流行で、前例のない拡大速度が報告されている。WHO事務局長による現地訪問と国際支援要請、MSFによる警告から、国際的な懸念が高い。資金不足（必要額の3分の1のみ確保）により対応能力に制約がある。

article.articleHeadline: Court halts US plan for Kenya Ebola facility | Jefferson City News-Tribune
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak, centered in Ituri province, has exceeded 1,000 suspected cases with 223 deaths reported by the World Health Organization, prompting near-one-million displacement. Uganda closed its border to curb cross-border spread. In Kenya, a Kenyan high court temporarily blocked a U.S.-backed plan to establish an Ebola quarantine facility, citing lack of transparency and accountability; authorities were enjoined from admitting or transferring people exposed to Ebola under the deal, with oral arguments scheduled for June 2. The United States had proposed about $13.5 million for Kenya's Ebola preparedness and $112 million in regional bilateral assistance, with 17 isolation centers identified across Kenya. The State Department says the priority is protecting Americans while strengthening regional health security.

triage.headline_ja: 米国のケニア・エボラ施設計画を裁判所が差し止め | ジェファーソン・シティ・ニューズ・トリビューン
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが1,000疑い例以上、223死亡に達し、ウガンダの国境封鎖とケニアの法的対応を含む地域的な対応を招いており、IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）でのエボラアウトブレイク、ウガンダの国境封鎖、ケニアの法的対応が述べられている。ウガンダとケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。米国は地域的支援国として言及されているが、感染症イベントの発生地ではないため除外。1,000疑い例、223死亡、近百万人の避難、複数国の対応、米国の地域支援計画など、多次元的なシグナル要素が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Giám đốc WHO vào thẳng tâm dịch Ebola tại CHDC Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General heads straight to the Ebola epicenter in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, with over 1,000 suspected cases and hundreds of deaths reported by the government. The outbreak has spread to neighboring Uganda with 9 confirmed cases, including 1 death. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, a dangerous variant with no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy. Ituri, plus North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, are affected, amid areas controlled by the M23 group and refugee camps with poor sanitation that heighten transmission risk. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Bunia to inspect treatment centers, meet local authorities, and urge a rapid, well-resourced response at the epicenter. He stressed focusing resources there rather than border closures, noting only about one-third of needed funding has been raised, and warned that without expanded testing, faster deployment of staff, and continuous aid, the outbreak could spiral out of control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の震源地を視察
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の大規模流行（1,000以上の疑い例、数百人の死亡）でDRC及びウガンダに拡大、高い国際的リスク。WHO事務局長の現地視察により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo型はワクチンや特異的治療法がない高リスク株。M23勢力支配地域及び難民キャンプでの流行により感染制御が困難。資金不足（必要額の3分の1程度）も指摘されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: 'We are here to help': WHO chief visits epicentre of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo's Ituri Province (Bunia) linked to Bundibugyo strain. As of 30 May 2026, 1,077 suspected Ebola cases with 246 deaths in the DRC since the outbreak was declared on 15 May; Uganda reports nine confirmed infections including one death. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits Bunia to inaugurate a permanent Ebola treatment center and stresses community ownership, following meetings in Kinshasa ahead of a meeting with President Tshisekedi. Uganda has closed its border with DRC and imposed a 21‑day quarantine for arrivals. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain; a vaccine could be ready by year’s end per CDC Africa. The outbreak spans three eastern DRC provinces and Uganda; MSF warns healthcare personnel are scarce and displacement camps (nearly a million in Ituri) heighten spread risk. One patient recovered and was discharged after two negative tests.

triage.headline_ja: 「我々はここにいる」：WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国エボラ流行の震源地ブニアを視察
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（ウガンダへの確認例）、重症度（246死亡）、公開発表済みの大規模流行である。シグナルトリアージの閾値を明確に超える。
triage.notes: 2026年5月30日現在、コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州（ブニア）でBundibugyo株エボラウイルスの大規模流行が発生。DRCで1,077疑定例・246死亡、ウガンダで9確認例・1死亡が報告されている。ウガンダは国境を閉鎖し21日間の隔離措置を実施。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、恒久的なエボラ治療センターの設立など、国際的な関与が高まっている。Bundibugyo株に対する既承認ワクチンなく、リスク管理が限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Στο επίκεντρο της επιδημίας Έμπολα στο Κονγκό ο επικεφαλής του ΠΟΥ - The Press Project - Ειδήσεις, Αναλύσεις, Ραδιόφωνο, Τηλεόραση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Head of WHO at the center of the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15, with Ituri province identified as the epicenter and mounting international concern as the WHO declares a global health emergency. The WHO Director-General has been in the country since Thursday, undertaking a two-day tour to stand with residents and frontline health workers, and expressing belief the outbreak can be brought under control despite challenges. Management is hampered by chronic weaknesses of state services in remote rural areas and armed groups restricting access for teams, while limited lab capacity complicates accurate case recording. Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades. The 2018–2020 outbreak in the DRC remains the deadliest, with over 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行の中心にWHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上極めて深刻で、国際的拡大リスクが高く、WHOが世界的衛生緊急事態を宣言している。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日にDRC(イトゥリ州)で新規エボラ出血熱流行を宣言。WHOは世界的衛生緊急事態を宣言済み。武装勢力による対応活動の阻害、診断検査能力の限定、州サービスの慢性的な脆弱性が管理を複雑化。過去50年間のアフリカでの死亡者数は15,000人以上、2018-2020年のDRC流行は最も致命的で2,300人以上の死亡例あり。

article.articleHeadline: تيدروس في الكونغو الديمقراطية لمحاربة إيبولا في بؤرته
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to fight Ebola in its outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bunia in Ituri province as the epicenter. The outbreak, which has lacked a vaccine since mid-May, prompted the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Three Congolese provinces are affected, with 1,028 suspected/confirmed cases and 246 deaths; one person has recovered. Uganda reports nine total cases after two new infections yesterday. WHO cautions that exact spread is unclear due to limited laboratory capacity. President-level outreach, including Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus’ visit to Ituri, aims to bolster containment efforts. Zambia screened contacts at the border but ruled out two suspected cases. Early symptoms resemble influenza (fever, fatigue, muscle pains, headache, sore throat), potentially progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, internal/external bleeding, and multi-organ failure. Rural Congo faces weak health services and armed-group violence.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長、エボラウイルスと闘うためにコンゴ民主共和国を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。複数国での確認と高い死亡率により、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、DRC（Ituri州が中心）で1,028例・246死亡、ウガンダで9例を確認。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。ザンビアは国境での接触者スクリーニングを実施。記事言語はアラビア語。

article.articleHeadline: KMPDU raises alarm over Kenya's Ebola preparedness and health system gaps
article.articleSummary: Kenya faces Ebola spillover risk as of May 30, 2026, with the Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union (KMPDU) warning the country may not be ready. It cites weak preparedness, staffing shortages, and limited critical care capacity amid regional risks from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Porous borders and insufficient containment heighten spread risk, and gaps in surveillance and entry-point screening persist. Frontline readiness suffers from insufficient health workers and inconsistent access to specialised PPE. ICU capacity is weak across Kenya’s 47 counties, with many hospitals lacking beds and emergency equipment. The union opposes local Ebola isolation/treatment facilities, urging containment at Congo’s epicenter and calling for more resources and international support there. It demands full disclosure of preparedness plans, emergency stockpiles, and national framework. A High Court blocked local facilities pending hearings; the Ministry says surveillance is strengthening and cooperation will follow the law.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ対策態勢と保健システムの課題について警告を発するKMPDU
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目（異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当。また社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアの対策態勢の問題を論じているが、実際のエボラ発生は記事中でDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダで述べられており、ケニアはスピルオーバーリスク地域として言及されている。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC を列挙。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。シグナルの深刻性は DRC での地域流行に起因している。

article.articleHeadline: "Врачи без границ" бьют тревогу из-за беспрецедентно быстрого распространения Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warn of the unprecedentedly rapid spread of Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns of unprecedentedly rapid spread of Ebola (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with spillover into Uganda. Africa CDC reports over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths in DRC, with the virus detected in three provinces; Uganda has confirmed two additional cases, bringing total to nine. The outbreak is driven by a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no specific treatments or approved vaccines. Laboratory confirmation is limited; hundreds of samples remain untested amid overwhelmed health facilities. Borders and airport closures hinder delivery of essential medicines, humanitarian aid, and personnel. Ituri Province is the epicenter, with security and poor road networks complicating response; nearly one million displaced people live in camps, and the outbreak has spread to North and South Kivu. WHO DG Tedros visited Ituri and urged scaled-up international support; global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がアフリカでのエボラの前例のない急速な拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、複数国への波及、1,000件以上の疑い例と246人の死亡、国境・空港閉鎖による国際的影響が明らかであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株という稀な系統による大規模アウトブレイク、特異的治療法やワクチン不在、医療施設の過負荷、国際支援の遮断という複合的なリスク要因が存在。WHO事務局長の訪問と国際支援強化の呼びかけは政治的関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Суеверия и выход США из ВОЗ: эксперты -- о причинах распространения Эболы // Новости НТВ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Superstitions and the US withdrawal from the WHO: experts on the causes of the spread of Ebola // NTV News
article.articleSummary: WHO reports an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with more than 1,000 suspected cases and over 200 deaths; mortality exceeds 50%, and there is no vaccine or approved antiviral. The outbreak likely began in late March; it took two months for authorities to detect it after tests for the previous strain failed to identify Bundibugyo. Infected patients were kept in ordinary hospitals, accelerating spread, and the northeast Congo outbreak has crossed into Uganda amid a civil war that hinders access and contact tracing. The IRC warns that official counts underestimate true numbers, including deaths at home, and misinformation fuels protests and attacks on isolation wards; at least five clinicians have died, and some patients escaped after hospital looting. Internationally, Trump’s withdrawal from WHO and Musk-era funding cuts have weakened outbreak response; vaccine development has begun. WHO says cross-border risk remains low, though.

triage.headline_ja: 迷信とWHO脱退：専門家がエボラ拡大の原因を語る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡率50%超、1000件以上の疑い例、200以上の死亡）、予想外の検出遅延、国際的な国境越え拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、およびWHO脱退に関連する国際的な対応困難を示している。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国境越え波及が記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。死亡率50%超、検出遅延（3月下旬発症、5月下旬検出）、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（珍しい株）による初期対応の困難、WHO脱退に関連する国際対応への懸念が全て評価に反映されている。

article.articleHeadline: Source.ba:Kongo neće zatvarati škole uprkos epidemiji ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Source.ba: The Congo will not close schools despite the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak is concentrated in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; Ituri capital Bunia). WHO cites a case fatality rate of 30–50% among confirmed cases. Congo’s Health Minister Roger Kamba stated schools will not close, implementing preventive measures in schools to avoid punishing children twice. He noted deaths of at least five schoolchildren in Ituri due to self-treatment and delays in care, urging families to seek care promptly. WHO records at least 134 confirmed Ebola cases across Congo and Uganda in the current outbreak, with ongoing new suspected cases and a cumulative total of over 1,000 since the outbreak’s declaration. Confirmed cases include nine in Uganda, with 18 deaths across the two countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴはエボラ流行にもかかわらず学校閉鎖しない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス）の確認事例は134件、死亡18件、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での国際的拡大あり、高い致命率30-50%。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、DRCでのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行が明確に記述されている。南キブ州、イトゥリ州で確認。ウガンダでの事例（9件）も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO統計により134確認事例、18死亡、致命率30-50%と高リスク。継続的な新規疑い事例が発生中。教育機関での感染拡大リスク存在。

article.articleHeadline: Lékaři bez hranic: Nikdy dříve nebylo tak brzy po vypuknutí epidemie eboly zaznamenáno tolik případů nákazy jako nyní
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: Never before have so many Ebola infections been recorded so soon after the outbreak as now.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns that never before have so many Ebola infections been recorded so soon after the outbreak as now in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Alan Gonzalez, MSF’s deputy operations director, says the pace and scale are unprecedented for this outbreak. He notes that the number of specialized humanitarian organizations on the ground, and the level of support available, remain far below what is required to fight the epidemic. The comments highlight ongoing resource and capacity gaps amid continued Ebola transmission in eastern DRC. The remarks were reported by Reuters.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：エボラ流行発生直後の感染者数が過去最多を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Ebola）の感染が前例のないペースで拡大している状況が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、管理能力不足）および社会的関心が高く、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出現直後の感染ペースが前例がないほど急速であり、MSFが現地の資源・能力不足を指摘している。DRC東部での継続的な感染状況が報告されており、国際的支援の必要性が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo investiga caso suspeito de Ebola em homem de 37 anos - Jovem Pan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo investigates a suspected case of Ebola in a 37-year-old man - Jovem Pan.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo investigates a suspected Ebola case in a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an outbreak involving the Bundibugyo strain is reported. The patient, presenting fever and compatible symptoms, is hospitalized at the Emílio Ribas Infectology Institute. No laboratory confirmation yet; the case is under preventive investigation. The Adolfo Lutz Institute will conduct laboratory testing and differential diagnosis. The process includes isolation, immediate notification, laboratory work-up, and monitoring according to current protocols. Regiane de Paula, SES-SP disease-control coordinator, noted that guidelines for suspected Ebola cases were updated last week across the health network. The case is considered imported, with confirmation pending as surveillance continues given recent travel from an affected region.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロがエボラ疑い患者の37歳男性を調査 - Jovem Pan
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）および複数のWPRO基準に該当。DRC発生エボラウイルスの輸入症例であり、確認待ちながら国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRC由来のBundibugyo株エボラウイルス患者がサンパウロで検出された輸入症例。現時点で実験室確認待ちだが、症状・疫学的背景が強い疑い。Emílio Ribas感染症研究所で隔離・監視中。SES-SPが先週プロトコル更新し対応体制を構築。高度の警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ex-CDC director warns Ebola outbreak could rank second largest in history
article.articleSummary: Former CDC Director Robert Redfield warned that the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda could become the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history, and is already the third-largest. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo virus, with 134 confirmed cases (most in the Congo; 9 in Uganda) and 18 confirmed deaths, alongside 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths in Congo as of Wednesday. Historical context: West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak had 28,600 cases and 11,308 deaths; the DRC’s 2018–2020 outbreak caused 3,470 cases and 2,287 deaths. WHO notes conflict in the DRC hampers response, with attacks on health facilities complicating tracing. CDC imposed a 21-day travel restriction on foreign nationals and U.S. green card holders who have been in DRC, Uganda or South Sudan; affected Americans face enhanced airport screenings. Redfield cautioned the outbreak could endure for some time and potentially become the second-largest ever.

triage.headline_ja: 元CDC長官、エボラ出血熱の流行が過去2番目の規模に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い死亡率、複数国への国際的拡大、米国による渡航制限発令）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてが該当し、既に対象国DRC等で進行中のシグナル。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC、Uganda、South Sudan での発生が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC (203312) のみ。Uganda と Sudan は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo エボラウイルス (BDBV) による既知の大規模流行であり、WHO の報告と整合。東部アフリカでの公式な流行の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief rallies community in Congo's Ebola response, calls for more funding
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, outbreak: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province’s Bunia. By Friday, 1,028 suspected cases had been recorded. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to coordinate the response, stressing community involvement as pivotal to containment. In Kinshasa, he urged greater international support, noting the WHO has received only about one-third of its funding needs. The outbreak—the 17th Ebola event since 1976—continues to spread at an unprecedented pace, according to MSF deputy operations director Alan Gonzalez, who warned that the number of cases is rising rapidly with insufficient on-the-ground support. The response emphasizes community ownership, timely reporting, and scaled resources to curb transmission and deliver care.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ対応で地域社会に呼びかけ、追加資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全て該当。エボラアウトブレイクの急速な拡大と国際的支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラアウトブレイク。1976年以来17番目のイベント。イトゥリ州ブニアを中心に5月30日時点で1,028の疑い例が記録されている。WHO事務局長が現地を訪問し、資金不足（必要額の3分の1しか確保できていない）を指摘。MSFの報告によれば症例数の増加速度は急速であり、現地支援が不十分な状況。

article.articleHeadline: WHO's øverste chef besøger epicenter for ebolaudbrud i DR Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO's Director-General visits the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak centers on Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo. The World Health Organization reports over 1,000 suspected infections and at least 225 confirmed cases, with around 223 presumed deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is visiting the epicenter to discuss outbreak management with local communities and authorities and to assess whether the international community should provide additional support under the DR Congo government’s leadership. He notes that local communities understand the problems and solutions, and emphasizes ownership alongside international involvement. The visit focuses on how handling is progressing and what challenges remain, aiming to help in real-time response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者発生地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。確認症例225例、推定死亡223例の深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な支援検討、およびWHOトップによる直接的な対応が行われており、シグナル性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率と感染性を持つVHFであり、Bunia（イトゥーリ州の州都）での大規模な患者発生と死亡数の報告、WHO事務局長による現地視察、国際的支援の検討など、多面的にシグナル性が高い。記事は2026年5月30日配信で、5月15日に発生宣言が行われている現在進行中の事象。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-sjefen besøker ebolasmittens episenter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General visits the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits the epicenter of a deadly Ebola outbreak, aiming to inspect a treatment center and meet local authorities as Kinshasa seeks greater international support. WHO reports 906 suspected cases and about 223 deaths, with the Bundibugyo strain causing bleeding and organ failure and lacking an approved vaccine or treatment. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976, and MSF warnsspread is accelerating faster than in previous outbreaks, with response and funding still insufficient. International aid has risen this week, including EU shipments and a $80 million pledge from the United States, bringing total aid to just over $112 million. The article highlights ongoing efforts to contain transmission amid mounting cases and high mortality.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ流行の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 906疑似症例、223死亡（致命率約24.6%）。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療法なし。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、米国8000万ドル支援表明など国際的関心が高い。MSFは感染拡大が過去のアウトブレイクより加速していると警告。発生地域フィールドにUSAが含まれているが、記事サマリーは支援国として言及されており、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 'El detective del ébola': La historia de Peter Piot y el descubrimiento del virus más letal de África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "The Ebola Detective": The Story of Peter Piot and the Discovery of Africa's Most Deadly Virus.
article.articleSummary: Discovery of Ebola began in 1976 when a blue thermos delivered to the Antwerp Institute of Tropical Medicine contained blood from a Flemish nun in Yambuku, Zaire (now DR Congo). Peter Piot and colleagues identified a novel filovirus, initially mistaken for Marburg, later named Ebola after the nearby Ebola River. The first outbreak caused about 300 deaths; investigations showed transmission via scarce, non-sterile needles in a maternity clinic and through funeral practices. Containment included closing the hospital, teaching safe burials, and quarantining staff. The article also highlights a 2026 outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus threatening DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026; there are no vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo. It recalls the 2014–2016 Africa West Ebola epidemic: 28,610 cases and 11,308 deaths (CDC).

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラウイルス探偵」：ピーター・ピオットとアフリカで最も致命的なウイルスの発見の歴史
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。2026年のブンディブギョウイルス集団発生は WHO が PHEIC 宣言し、治療法・ワクチンなし。対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での検証済み。
triage.notes: 記事は1976年のエボラ発見の歴史を主に述べているが、サマリーは2026年に発生したブンディブギョウイルス集団発生（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで確認）を含む。WHO が 2026年5月17日に PHEIC 宣言。対象国リストではウガンダ（226074）が含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。ベルギー（記事の記述上は歴史的コンテキストのみ）は現在の実務的発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 肯尼迪機場將篩檢來自埃博拉疫情國的旅客
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: John F. Kennedy International Airport will screen travelers from Ebola-affected countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan prompts enhanced entry screening at John F. Kennedy International Airport (New York), effective May 28, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Four U.S. hubs—Dulles (DC), Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta, and George Bush Intercontinental (Houston)—will screen travelers who have traveled to Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. Screenings include health questionnaires, reporting of contact risks, temperature checks, and symptom review in designated screening areas. CDC frames entry screening as one layer of four public-health measures, alongside outbound screening, airline disease reporting, and post-arrival monitoring. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has over 300 suspected cases and 88 deaths; no vaccine exists. WHO declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. A US-Canada-Mexico joint statement seeks harmonized travel measures during the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: ケネディ国際空港がエボラ流行国からの旅客をスクリーニング予定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。WHO宣言済みの国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の事象であり、複数国での流行、高い死亡率、国際的な入国スクリーニング実施、および渡航制限に関連した社会的・政治的関心がIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ流行地域はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンの3国と記載されている。しかし、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダと南スーダンは評価対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の事象（PHEIC）として宣言済みで、米国を含む複数国での入国スクリーニングが実施されている点は高リスク指標。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade de São Paulo registra caso de suspeita de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City of São Paulo records a suspected Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil: a 37-year-old man who arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is hospitalized in isolation at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, a state reference center for suspected/confirmed cases. He presented fever, meeting the suspected-case definition; laboratory confirmation has not yet been obtained. The case is under investigation by the São Paulo State Health Secretariat, through the Coordinadoria de Controle de Doenças and the Centro de Vigilância Epidemiológica. As of May 30, 2026, there are no confirmed cases. The risk of introduction of Ebola into Brazil and South America remains very low due to the region’s lack of autochthonous transmission, no direct flights from affected areas, and Ebola’s transmission requiring direct contact with blood, secretions, bodily fluids, or tissues of symptomatic individuals. Monitoring continues; this is an imported potential case.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ市がエボラ疑い患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国からの輸入患者で高い懸念性を有し、確定診断待機中である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者がブラジルで確認された重要なシグナル。患者はコンゴ民主共和国から渡航した37歳男性で、Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas に隔離入院中。発熱等の疑い患者の定義を満たしているが、実験室確認はまだ取得されていない。ブラジルおよび南米地域へのエボラ輸入リスクは低いと評価されているが、国際的な監視と確定診断の完了が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Piala Dunia, Trio AS-Kanada-Meksiko Waspadai Virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of the World Cup, the U.S.-Canada-Mexico trio is wary of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America, the United States, Canada, and Mexico tightened health travel rules amid the Ebola outbreak in Africa. Following WHO's May 17 declaration of the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak as a public health emergency and warnings of cross-border spread, the three nations agreed on coordinated measures for travelers from high-risk African regions. The United States previously barred entry for non-U.S. nationals who recently traveled to the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan; the CDC extended the rule to green-card holders who have visited those countries in the past 21 days. Canada imposed a 90-day entry ban for travelers from the three countries and requires a 21-day quarantine for Canadians, permanent residents, and other foreign nationals arriving from affected areas without symptoms. Mexico tightened airport screening and urged postponement of travel to the DRC, advising self-quarantine for arrivals from the country.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップを控え、米国・カナダ・メキシコ三国がエボラウイルスに警戒
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR第2附則の4基準すべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、複数国での確認、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は北米三国の渡航制限措置が主題だが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンであり、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。WHOは2026年5月17日にDRCのアウトブレイクを公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言。複数国が国境を越えた感染拡大リスク認識のため、シグナルとして適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Health Minister Akandoh assesses screening protocols at airport
article.articleSummary: 30 May 2026: Ghanaian Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh assessed Ebola preparedness, focusing on Accra International Airport screening protocols and directing upgrades—advanced temperature scanners and improved passenger-flow systems—to strengthen entry-point surveillance. He distributed PPE to health personnel and urged full compliance with screening for all travelers. At Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research, Director Prof. Dorothy Yeboah-Manu said the facility is equipped with the necessary expertise, reagents, and a dedicated sample receipt centre to handle suspected cases. WHO Country Representative Dr Fiona Braka commended Ghana's readiness, stressing rapid testing with confirmed results within 24 hours. At the Ga East Infectious Disease Centre, authorities noted ongoing preparedness based on prior outbreaks. With no confirmed Ebola case, officials warned against complacency and urged adherence to preventive measures—hand hygiene, avoiding handshakes, and prompt reporting of symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：保健大臣アカンドが空港のスクリーニングプロトコルを査察
triage.triage_reason: ガーナで予防的体制強化の動きが確認されているが、現在のところ確認症例がなく、イベントの実質的な脅威は限定的。地域の準備態勢評価として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは確認症例がなく、ガーナの保健当局による予防的準備状況に関する報道。エボラの流行可能性がある地域での防疫体制強化は重要だが、現段階では実質的なイベント発生ではなく、状況監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief rallies community in Congo's Ebola response, calls for more funding
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ituri region, centered on Bunia, faces 1,028 suspected Ebola cases reported by Friday. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the DRC to coordinate the response, urging strong community ownership and local involvement alongside international support, which he noted is underfunded, with WHO having only about one-third of its funding needs. MSF deputy director Alan Gonzalez described the outbreak as the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976 and said cases are rising at an unprecedented pace, with many reported soon after declaration. The article highlights community engagement as essential and confirms Kinshasa and Bunia as key locations in the response; it provides time cues (Tedros in Kinshasa and Bunia on Thursday; 1,028 suspected cases by Friday) but does not detail laboratory confirmation, infection source, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴのエボラ対応で地域社会を結集、より多くの資金を呼びかける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ発生で、1,028例の疑い例報告、急速な症例増加、国際支援の不足など重大な懸念事項あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、本イベントはDRC（対象国リスト203312）のイトゥリ州およびキンシャサで発生している現在進行中のエボラ発生と確認。1,028例の疑い例が報告されており、前例のない速度での症例増加が指摘されている。WHO事務局長が現地入りして対応を調整中だが、資金が著しく不足している。ラボ確認例数や具体的な死亡数は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Varian Langka Mengkhawatirkan, WHO Percepat Uji Vaksin dan Obat di Afrika Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rare Ebola Variant Outbreak Alarming, WHO Accelerates Vaccine and Drug Trials in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease variant is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with cases reported in Uganda. WHO has convened international expert groups to evaluate candidate vaccines and therapies for outbreak use, underscoring that no vaccine or treatment is yet officially approved and must be studied in strict clinical trials. For lab-confirmed patients, three main therapeutics are prioritized: monoclonal antibodies MBP134 and Maftivimab, and the antiviral remdesivir, with exploration of MBP134-remdesivir combinations. For post-exposure prophylaxis, the oral antiviral obeldesivir is considered a viable candidate, dependent on effective contact tracing. In prevention, the leading vaccine candidate is a single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine developed by IAVI, expected to enter field trials only after roughly seven to nine months.

triage.headline_ja: 稀少なエボラウイルス変異株アウトブレイクが懸念、WHO がアフリカ中部でのワクチンおよび治療薬試験を加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。稀少な変異株による複数国での発生、WHO による国際的対応の開始、ワクチン・治療薬開発の急速な進展など、明らかにシグナル化すべき案件。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから DRC とウガンダでの Bundibugyo エボラウイルス病変異株の発生が確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。WHO による国際的な専門家グループ招集、ワクチン候補（rVSV Bundibugyo）および複数の治療薬候補（MBP134、Maftivimab、remdesivir、obeldesivir）の迅速な臨床試験開始が示唆されており、高度な国際的関心と対応体制の構築が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ανησυχία για τον Έμπολα: Στο Κονγκό ο επιφαλής του Παγκόσμιου Οργανισμού Υγείας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over Ebola: WHO chief in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) triggers international concern as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrives in the eastern Ituri region, with Bunia, the provincial capital, to bolster the response. The highly transmissible viral hemorrhagic fever is already present in three eastern provinces of the DRC and in neighboring Uganda, where nine confirmed cases have been reported, including one death. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, Africa CDC reports at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC, with 246 deaths. The WHO chief stressed community engagement and addressing response challenges. Laboratory confirmation remains hampered by limited testing capacity in the DRC, and officials warn the true extent of transmission may be broader than detected. The article notes the outbreak is believed to have circulated before formal detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラについての懸念：WHO事務局長がコンゴを訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラは極めて高い致死率を持つ指定感染症で、既に国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの越境）が発生し、DRC東部3州およびウガンダで確認されている。WHOが国家レベルの対応支援を実施していることから、国際的関心と支援需要が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事サマリー内で発生が確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。検査能力の制限により実際の感染規模が検出数を上回る可能性が指摘されており、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits Congo Ebola epicentre as outbreak outpaces response efforts
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, eastern Congo’s Ituri province outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola continues to outpace response efforts. The epicenter is Bunia; authorities report 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths. The disease has crossed borders, with neighbouring Uganda confirming nine cases and one death linked to the outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to visit treatment facilities and meet local authorities, health workers, and affected families, emphasizing the need for intensified support at the outbreak epicenter. Authorities say suspected cases approach 1,000, with cross-border transmission raising regional concerns.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴエボラ震源地を訪問、感染拡大が対応努力を上回る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの国際的な多地域感染拡大、高い致死率、ワクチン・治療法未承認という深刻な状況。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「neighbouring Uganda confirming nine cases」と報告されている。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。DRC（Ituri州Bunia）が主要な感染地であり、ウガンダは二次的な国際伝播例として位置づけられている。Bundibugyo株は珍しいエボラ変異株であり、医療対応能力の課題が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Ebola, Thailand Perketat Aturan Masuk untuk Pelaku Perjalanan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alert: Thailand Tightens Entry Rules for Travelers.
article.articleSummary: Thailand imposes a 21-day quarantine for travelers arriving from or transiting through the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda amid rising Ebola activity in both countries. Symptomatic travelers must quarantine at designated government hospitals; asymptomatic individuals are held in dedicated entry-point facilities. No Ebola cases among arrivals have been reported in Thailand. The eastern DRC remains the outbreak epicenter, with WHO warnings of international concern. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, the DRC has recorded 204 deaths and 867 suspected cases; Uganda has 1 death and 6 infections. WHO notes 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 220 suspected deaths in the DRC since mid-May 2026, plus 900 suspected cases overall. The policy underscores ongoing risk amid high global mobility.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：タイがエボラウイルス流行地からの旅行者に対する入国規制を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性・対応困難性が明確。タイを含む複数国での確認と国際的対応措置があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも含まれているが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは東部が流行中心で死亡204件・疑い症例867件、ウガンダ1件・6感染、タイからの到着者では未確認だがWHOが国際的懸念を警告。タイの21日検疫措置は国境での流行対策を示唆。2026年5月15日の流行宣言から急速に拡大している状況を示す極めて重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Viajeros a Estados Unidos del Congo, Uganda y Sudán para el Mundial estarán bajo vigilancia sanitaria por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travelers to the United States from the Congo, Uganda, and Sudan for the World Cup will be under health surveillance due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Due to an Ebola alert amid World Cup 2026 preparations, the United States has declared a health emergency and will place travelers who have recently been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan under heightened surveillance. Entry for U.S. citizens and permanent residents who have visited these countries within the last 21 days is restricted to three airports: Washington Dulles (Virginia), Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (Georgia), and George Bush Intercontinental Airport (Houston). All such passengers will undergo heightened screening upon arrival. The Department of State spokesperson noted the restrictions apply to citizens and residents alike. Mexico and Canada are coordinating with the U.S. on public health measures for the World Cup; Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum announced a health protocol, while U.S. Ambassador Ronald Johnson highlighted cross-border cooperation. General travel-security reminders were also issued, including passport/visa validity and stadium security, with drones prohibited.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ウガンダ、スーダンからワールドカップのためアメリカへ渡航する者はエボラのため健康監視下に置かれる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラの検出と複数国からの渡航者に対する制限措置が取られており、国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ2026）に関連する公式な健康上の警告である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラアラートに基づき、コンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンから米国への渡航者に対する監視措置を記述しています。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当します。ウガンダは検出されていますが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。スーダンも同様に対象国リストにないため除外。メキシコ・カナダはコーディネーション国として言及されているのみで、イベント発生地ではありません。

article.articleHeadline: MSF alerta sobre la "profundamente alarmante" situación del ébola en el este de la RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF warns about the "deeply alarming" Ebola situation in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is deeply alarming two weeks after declaration, with 246 deaths and 1,077 suspected cases reported by the African Union’s public health agency. MSF deputy operations director Alan González warns of rapid spread and that hundreds of samples remain untested, while border and airport closures hinder delivery of medical supplies and personnel. The current strain is Bundibugyo, with a 30–50% case fatality rate and no approved vaccine or specific treatment, per WHO; the virus likely circulated in Ituri about two months before declaration. Response gaps include limited testing capacity, few specialized organizations, and overwhelmed clinics. Calls for immediate expansion of testing, a faster, coordinated global response, sustained access for supplies and personnel, and community-centered engagement to build trust and encourage care.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、コンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ出血熱の「極めて深刻な」状況について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（246死亡、1,077疑い例）、急速な感染拡大、国際的支援の必要性、ワクチンなし。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の重大なアウトブレイク。死亡数246名、疑い例1,077名と高い疾病負荷。検査能力不足、医療物資・人員の国境閉鎖による制限、ワクチン未承認など対応上の課題あり。MSFからの国際的警告レベルは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Шефът на СЗО отиде в епицентъра на епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго | Новини.бг
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The head of the WHO went to the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in northeastern DR Congo, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak. DR Congo authorities declared a new Ebola epidemic on May 15, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The highly contagious hemorrhagic fever has been detected in three DR Congo provinces and in neighboring Uganda. African CDC data from DR Congo report over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths. Tedros said the situation is complex but containment is possible, underscoring international concern and ongoing containment efforts amid the region’s sustained outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダで検出されたと述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。5月15日にエボラ流行宣言、WHO PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）指定済み。疑い患者1,000人以上、死亡者246人と報告されており、重症度は極めて高い。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は高い政治的・国際的関心を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Serukan Pendanaan Lebih Banyak untuk untuk Merespons Wabah Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO calls for more funding to respond to the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO appeals for increased funding and stronger community engagement to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province’s Bunia. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived on May 28, 2026, to coordinate the response as authorities report 1,028 suspected cases. The outbreak marks the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976. WHO says only about one-third of the needed funding has been received and calls for intensified international support. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the spread is accelerating faster than in any previous outbreak after declaration, highlighting gaps in on-the-ground staffing. Emphasis is placed on community ownership and dialogue with residents to improve response effectiveness, with no laboratory-confirmed case counts or deaths provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行対応のための資金増加を呼び掛け
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という高い危機性、国際的支援ニーズ、WHO事務局長の現地派遣など複数の重大シグナルが存在。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患。Ituri州Bunia地区で発生中。1,028例の疑似患者数報告。MSF警告で拡大速度が過去最速と報告。WHO事務局長のDRC訪問確認（2026年5月28日）、国際資金の1/3のみ確保状況。DRCは対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）に該当。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: La postura de EEUU con sus ciudadanos expuestos al brote de ébola en África genera serias dudas: 'Podría empeorar las cosas'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The U.S. stance on its citizens exposed to the Ebola outbreak in Africa raises serious doubts: "Could make things worse."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has persisted since May 15, 2026, marking the 17th outbreak in the country’s history. Authorities report more than 1,000 infections and at least 238 deaths. The virus has crossed borders to neighboring Uganda, prompting heightened international concern. The World Health Organization has classified the situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, aiming to mobilize resources and coordinate response. Fatality rates vary by variant, ranging roughly from 25% to 90%, with the Zaire strain being the deadliest and the only one with approved vaccines and treatments. In the United States, criticism has focused on plans to quarantine and treat suspected cases rather than repatriate infected citizens, a stance challenged by groups like the Katiba Institute and by experts warning such policies could hinder containment.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ流行に対する米国の市民対応姿勢が深刻な疑問を生起：「状況を悪化させる可能性がある」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern認定、17年ぶりの大規模爆発的流行で死亡率25-90%、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境についても言及されているがサマリーの主焦点はDRCである。米国はDRCでの市民対応に関する政治的問題の文脈のみ記載されており、米国での発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHO PHEIC認定により国際的リスク対応が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Visits Bunia -- Epicenter Of Africa's Ebola Outbreak (Live Updates)
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, Africa CDC confirms an Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo strain (no vaccine). WHO designates the event an extraordinary public-health risk. The outbreak has sickened 246 people and killed 65. Americans exposed, including Dr. Peter Stafford who was treated in Germany and another American evacuated to Prague; several others evacuated. The first death outside Congo occurred in Uganda, which has reported five cases, including a driver who carried the first victim, a healthcare worker, and a Congolese woman entering Uganda with symptoms. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or therapy; care is supportive. The 2007 Bundibugyo outbreak showed ~32% fatality. Merck’s Ervebo (Zaire strain) vaccine is being considered for use with limited cross-protection evidence; Oxford is developing a vaccine. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行の中心地であるブニアを訪問（ライブアップデート）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱（ワクチンなし株）による多くの死亡例、国際的な拡大、WHOによる緊急指定があり、シグナルとして即座にフルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはチェコ（Prague）やドイツが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC の Ituri 州における Bundibugyo エボラ出血熱の流行である。ウガンダでの事例も記載されているが、記事の焦点は DRC が中心であり、verified_locations は DRC のみとした。米国人の避難者や海外での治療は発生地域ではなく影響対象者である。国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン未開発株、高い致死率、WHO による extraordinary public-health risk 指定が全て該当する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de São Paulo investiga caso suspeito de ebola em paciente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo state government investigates a suspected Ebola case in a patient.
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola virus disease case is in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology in São Paulo state, Brazil, a reference facility for suspected or confirmed cases, with biosafety protocols in place. No laboratory confirmation yet; investigators began a preventive inquiry after clinical and epidemiological criteria aligned with national and state protocols. Suspected cases in the state must be reported to municipal and state epidemiological surveillance. In 2014, three suspected cases were monitored and later discarded. Officials say the risk of introducing Ebola into Brazil remains very low, given no historical autochthonous transmission in South America, no direct flights from the affected region, and that transmission requires direct contact with blood, secretions, or bodily fluids of symptomatic patients. Globally, aid to contain Ebola in Congo is deemed insufficient, with WHO warning the virus could spread. Congo declared an Ebola outbreak on May 15; Ituri and North Kivu in eastern DRC continue to report growth, with 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths (Africa CDC).

triage.headline_ja: São Paulo州政府がエボラ疑い患者を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定症例ではないが、DRC（対象国）での継続的な流行（1,077疑い症例、246疑い死亡）と、疑い患者がブラジル（対象国）で検出された点から、異常性と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC（Ituri/North Kivu）での活発なエボラ流行継続と、ブラジル（São Paulo）での疑い患者検出の両方が確認される。DRCでの死亡率の高さ、WHOによる国際支援不足の警告、ブラジルでの検出による南米への拡大リスク顕在化により、複数のIHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たす。本件は確定症例ではなく疑い例だが、国際的なシグナルとして重要。

article.articleHeadline: Miedo y negación en el corazón de la epidemia de ébola en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear and denial at the heart of the Ebola epidemic in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri with Mongbwalu and Bunia as key sites, is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain—the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. The World Health Organization estimates about 220 deaths, 10 confirmed, and more than 900 suspected cases. The outbreak has spread to nearby provinces and into Uganda, prompting the WHO to declare an international emergency. Healthcare response is strained: local hospital uses chlorine for disinfection, masks and protective gear are worn, and MSF has deployed tents to isolate patients. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs through close contact or bodily fluids. The initial suspect case was identified in Bunia; after the infected body was transported to Mongbwalu, samples reached Kinshasa nearly 1,800 kilometers away for confirmation, delaying containment. Community distrust toward authorities and belief that the disease is not real hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の中心における恐怖と否定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大（ウガンダ）、WHO国際緊急事態宣言）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が記載されているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のIturi地域の流行である。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株、220人の死亡、900人以上の疑い患者、WHO国際緊急事態宣言、ワクチン・治療法なし、コミュニティの信頼欠如により対応が阻害されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo : le chef de l'OMS à Bunia en Ituri, épicentre de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the WHO chief in Bunia, Ituri, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri Province, epicenter of an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo that is also affecting Uganda. As of May 29, the outbreakRecord features 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths, with 134 confirmed cases (including 9 in Uganda) and 18 confirmed deaths. Since May 21, there have been 49 additional confirmed cases, eight more deaths, 160 suspected cases, and 47 suspected deaths. Ituri accounts for 88% of confirmed cases (110), led by Bunia (37), Rwampara (33), Mongbwalu (20), and Nyankunde (10). By May 27, 774 samples were collected; 648 analyzed (84%), with 125 positives (19.2% positivity). The WHO notes likely underestimation due to pending analyses and 2,635 contacts in Ituri and North Kivu. Security incidents and community resistance complicate the response; Tedros underscores health-system strengthening, community engagement, risk-behavior adaptation, and continued government-partner cooperation to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：WHOトップがイトゥリ州ブニアのエボラ流行の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、進行中のエボラ流行として国際的な懸念と支援体制が確立されている重大なシグナル。WHOトップの現地訪問は対応の重大性を示す。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州ブニアでのエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダへの波及（9例確認）も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ルワンダはキガリ県の地域記述が含まれるが、サマリーでは流行の主題ではなく除外。2026年5月時点での進行中の流行として、906疑い例、223死亡、134確認例という重大な規模の事象。

article.articleHeadline: SP investiga caso suspeito de Ebola: vigilância alerta em todo o estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP investigates suspected Ebola case: surveillance alert across the state.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease case investigated in São Paulo, Brazil, on 30 May 2026. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo, who recently traveled from an area with transmission, presents with fever and meets the clinical-epidemiological criteria for a suspected case. He is isolated at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas; laboratory confirmation is pending. The investigation is precautionary, coordinated by SES-SP’s CCD and CVE-SP, with immediate notification and diagnostic testing by Instituto Adolfo Lutz. An updated Informative Note 01/2026 reinforces surveillance, case definition, isolation, and lab workflows. The risk of introduction into Brazil and South America remains very low due to no endemic transmission and lack of direct flights; transmission requires direct contact with blood, secretions, or fluids of symptomatic cases. Incubation 2–21 days; exposed asymptomatic contacts should be monitored for 21 days. No licensed vaccines or therapies exist for Bundibugyo Ebola; vaccines/therapies for Zaire strain are not proven for this variant.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロがエボラ疑い患者を調査：州全体で監視警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者がブラジル（対象国）で確認され、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」と「国際拡大リスク」に該当。確定前ながら適切な検査・隔離対応が実施されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」でも該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCから渡航した37歳男性で、発熱と臨床疫学的基準を満たす疑い患者。Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribasにて隔離中で、検査はInstituto Adolfo Lutzで実施予定。ブラジルでのエボラ伝播リスクは低いと評価されているが、DRC由来の患者検出は国際公衆衛生上の関心事項。州全体での監視強化が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Grupy zbrojne utrudniają walkę z ebolą w Afryce. "Sytuacja jest trudna"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Armed groups hinder the fight against Ebola in Africa. "The situation is difficult."
article.articleSummary: Armed groups in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) are hampering Ebola response efforts, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressing the need for full support at the outbreak's epicenter and continued aid. In the DRC, WHO reports 906 probable Ebola infections and 223 deaths; Africa CDC data released on Thursday indicate over 1,000 probable infections and 246 deaths. Rural areas lack healthcare access, and armed groups' attacks exacerbate the humanitarian crisis, with international health organizations warning the true scale is likely higher due to limited diagnostics. Africa CDC also reported eight Ebola cases in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak in the DRC involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, which was initially missed because tests targeted a more common strain; WHO says a vaccine for Bundibugyo may be unavailable for six to nine months. Ebola has killed over 15,000 in Africa in 50 years; the 2018-2020 DR Congo outbreak killed 2,300.

triage.headline_ja: 武装勢力がアフリカでのエボラ対策を阻害。「状況は困難である」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。致命的な既知病原体による多数死亡の急性アウトブレイク、国境を越えた拡大、医療対応の著しい阻害が認識される。
triage.notes: ウガンダについては記事サマリーで「8例」報告とのみ述べられており、主要なアウトブレイクの焦点はDRC内。DRC内での武装勢力による対応阻害は対策可能性を著しく低下させ、リスク評価上重要な増悪因子。Bundibugyo株（稀有株）の同定遅延と6-9ヶ月のワクチン開発遅延も懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ заявил о нехватке средств для борьбы со вспышкой Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief says there is a shortage of funds to combat the Ebola outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says only about one-third of the funding needed to fight the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has been secured as of May 30, 2026. He described the response as fraught with difficulties in containing a very complex outbreak, noting that the requested support has not yet been delivered. The appeal, relayed by Reuters via Report, calls on the international community to increase financial and material assistance, including for frontline healthcare workers. Specific needs include essential supplies and personal protective equipment to protect staff and sustain operations in both affected countries, underscoring ongoing funding gaps that hinder containment and control efforts in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、アフリカのエボラ流行対策の資金不足を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラの確認された流行（DRC・ウガンダ）であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的な資金支援要請があり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラの主要な発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダ（1694008）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO事務局長の公式声明であり、資金不足により対応が困難な状況が明示されており、シグナルとしての重要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO's øverste chef besøger epicenter for ebolaudbrud i DR Co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO's Director-General visits epicenter of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, the Ebola outbreak epicenter in the Democratic Republic of Congo received a visit by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Reuters reports. During the visit, he is to speak with local communities about how the response to the Ebola outbreak is progressing and about local conditions related to the outbreak. The article highlights the international engagement surrounding the outbreak and the ongoing efforts to manage transmission. No specific case or death counts are provided in this brief. The visit reflects continued WHO involvement in assessing response efforts and communicating with affected communities to support containment measures. Details on the outbreak's status remain limited in this brief.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの最高責任者がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラはIHR基準を満たす指定疾患であり、DRCでの流行は国際的な関心と対応が必要。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的関与と管理可能性における外部支援の必要性を示唆している。
triage.notes: エボラはIHR附属書2の指定疾患。DRCでの流行はハイリスク。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により、国際的関与と対応状況の管理が進行中。詳細な症例数・死亡数は記事サマリーで提供されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Riposte contre la 17ème épidémie de la maladie à virus Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Response to the 17th outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, Kalemie in Tanganyika hosts the 11th Expo Beton RDC (27–30 May 2026), the region’s premier trade show for construction, infrastructure, and mining. The theme, “Kalemie, capital of lithium and crossroads at the heart of African corridors,” aims to link provincial networks to continental transport routes and attract investment. President of the Senate, Sama Lukonde, representing the head of state, praised Expo Beton for advancing sustainable, planned infrastructure and environmentally responsible urbanization, highlighting Kalemie’s lithium resources as a development catalyst. The program covers three topics: (1) the Ebola virus disease outbreak response in the DRC (the 17th outbreak); (2) security crisis in Kivu tied to non-application of Swiss-brokered protocols in Doha; (3) controversy over constitutional reform. Panelists include journalist Nicaise Kibel’Bel Oka, Adrien Zawadi, and Anna Sylvestre (joining from Paris).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：第17回エボラウイルス病流行への対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重大な感染症であり、DRCでの17番目の流行という重要な疾患イベント。IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはKalemieの貿易展示会の情報が主体だが、プログラムの一部としてDRCの第17回エボラウイルス病流行対応が明示的に言及されている。Doha（カタール）とParis（フランス）の言及はイベントのパネリスト参加地点であり、エボラウイルス病の発生地ではないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。記事から具体的な症例数や死亡者数等の詳細は不明だが、エボラウイルス病の本質的な重症性と国際的関心の高さから、フルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Chinese Scientists Develop Broad-Spectrum Ebola Vaccine | Sada Elbalad
article.articleSummary: Chinese scientists have developed a broad-spectrum Ebola vaccine using mRNA technology, named GPs+NP@LNP, aiming to protect against multiple Ebola variants beyond the Zaire strain. As of 2026-05-30, the multivalent vaccine combines three surface glycoproteins from Ebola, Sudan and Bundibugyo viruses with a conserved nucleoprotein. The approach mirrors COVID-19 vaccine platforms and uses non-replicating mRNA, delivering instructions to induce protective antibodies against the glycoproteins and robust T-cell responses via the nucleoprotein. Ebola virus disease, transmitted through direct contact with infected blood or fluids, causes fever, vomiting, internal bleeding and organ failure, with fatality rates around 50% in many outbreaks. Current WHO assessments note limited tools and two licensed vaccines that predominantly target the Zaire strain, leaving gaps against other variants, including Bundibugyo linked outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の科学者がブロードスペクトラムエボラワクチンを開発 | Sada Elbalad
triage.triage_reason: エボラワクチン開発は公衆衛生上の関心があるが、記事の主題は研究成果の発表であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。DRC/ウガンダでのBundibugyo株の言及は背景情報で、現在の有効なシグナルとしては不十分。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は中国によるワクチン開発という研究成果の発表であり、進行中のエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク自体ではない。DRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo株言及は文脈上の背景情報であり、現在の流行を示すものではない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Diretor-geral da OMS visita epicentro do surto de ebola na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of a severe Ebola outbreak. Ghebreyesus, who has been in the country since Thursday, landed at Bunia International Airport, which remained closed to commercial flights due to the epidemic, an AFP journalist observed. The article notes the location and the airport closure linked to the outbreak but does not provide case or death figures. The visit signals ongoing international attention to the Ebola crisis in the DRC and WHO's involvement in the response. The visit underscores international commitment to outbreak response measures.
