triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高病原性で国際的な公衆衛生危機の可能性が高く、IHR基準2つ以上該当。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の「重度な」アウトブレイクが明記されており、商業便の運休、WHO事務局長の現地視察という国際的対応レベルの高さから、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への移行が強く推奨される。具体的な症例数・死亡数の報告は本記事サマリーに含まれていないため、続報による追加情報収集が重要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO's øverste chef besøger epicenter for ebolaudbrud i DR Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO's top official visits the epicenter of an Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri province (northeastern DR Congo). As of 30 May 2026, there are over 1,000 suspected infections and at least 225 laboratory-confirmed cases, with at least 223 presumed deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. The Bundibugyo virus variant is involved, with historical fatality around 30–50%. Early symptoms resemble flu (fever, headache, fatigue) progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and sometimes bleeding. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the epicenter to engage communities, stressing local ownership and international support; WHO has received about a third of the needed funding. Uganda has reported cases as well, including at least one death, and closed its border with DR Congo to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの最高責任者がDR コンゴのエボラ発生の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルス病で致死率30～50%、1,000件以上の疑い患者と223人以上の死亡が報告されており、ウガンダへも拡大している。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例報告があるが、記事の主題はDR コンゴでのエボラ発生。Bundibugyo virus variant（ブンディブギョウイルス株）が関与。資金不足（必要額の3分の1のみ受領）が問題。WHO事務局長による現地訪問により国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Šéf WHO v KDR vyzval komunity, aby sa zapojili do boja proti ebole - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief in the Democratic Republic of the Congo urged communities to join the fight against Ebola - World SME.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo to coordinate the Ebola response, with Bunia in Ituri province as the outbreak epicenter. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, at least 1,028 probable Ebola cases have been reported across three provinces in the DRC, with the virus spreading to neighboring Uganda, where nine confirmed cases and one death have been recorded. Medecins Sans Frontières warns the outbreak—the 17th since 1976—is spreading at an unprecedented pace and response capacity remains insufficient. Tedros urged local communities to take ownership of measures, alongside international support. Uganda and Rwanda closed borders; the United States imposed airport screening and entry limits for travelers who have recently been in Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days. WHO notes only about one third of needed funding has been received.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ対策に地域社会の参加を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認、死亡例、国際的な渡航制限措置、公衆衛生への重大な影響、および国際支援の必要性が複数の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（9確認例、1死亡）とルワンダ国境閉鎖、米国の渡航制限など国際的な対応が実施されているが、記事サマリーの主な焦点はDRCにおける発生。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。資金不足（必要資金の3分の1未満）も課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Į KDR Ebolos protrūkio epicentrą atvyko PSO vadovas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General arrived at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to support and listen to communities affected by a highly transmissible Ebola outbreak. The hemorrhagic fever is already spreading across three eastern DRC provinces and neighboring Uganda, with nine laboratory-confirmed infections in Uganda, including one fatality. Since May 15, when the outbreak was declared, the DRC has reported at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases, including 246 deaths, according to Africa CDC. WHO notes that the international community is engaging, but community involvement is crucial. The true scale in the DRC is likely much larger, as there is limited capacity for laboratory confirmation in the unstable, conflict-affected region. The Bunia visit aims to assess response progress and identify challenges where support is needed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地ブニアに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生上の最高レベルの脅威であり、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダへの確認例）、死亡例を含む重症事例、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確に存在する。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境確認例（9例、死亡1例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内での確認例は1,077件超（疑い例含む）で実数はさらに多い可能性。不安定・紛争地帯での限定的な検査能力が被害規模把握の課題。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な関心と対応の深刻性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Director de la OMS arriba a Ituri epicentro del brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO director-general arrives in Ituri, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak centered in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), involving the Bundibugyo strain with a reported case-fatality rate of 30–50% and no vaccine or specific treatment. As of May 28, there were over 1,000 cases and about 246 suspected deaths in the DRC, marking the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976. Neighboring Uganda has nine confirmed infections, including one death from an imported Congolese case. WHO warns of high regional risk but low global risk, with the virus likely circulating in Ituri about two months before the outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The response is hampered by ongoing conflict between the Congolese army and rebel groups. On May 29, Tedros traveled to Kinshasa to meet Prime Minister Judith Suminwa and UN teams to assess response and obstacles, including calls for a ceasefire to facilitate operations.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱の中心地イツリに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という極めて深刻な病原体による国際的な多国家流行。DRC及びウガンダでの確定症例、高い致死率、WHO公式な国際的関心の表明により、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ(226074)も記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは9例の輸入症例のみで、主な流行地はDRCのイツリ州。WHO事務局長の訪問、1,000例以上の報告、高い致死率(30-50%)、ワクチンと特異的治療がない点、武力紛争による対応阻害など、全ての深刻性指標が満たされている。

article.articleHeadline: Nikdy v minulosti nezaznamenali tak skoro po vypuknutí epidémie eboly toľko prípadov nákazy ako dnes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Never before in history have so many Ebola infections been recorded so soon after the outbreak of the Ebola epidemic as today.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Ebola infections in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, are at unprecedented levels, with MSF warning that cases are accumulating quickly just two weeks after the outbreak was declared. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to support health teams, stressing that local communities play a crucial role in response. Africa CDC declared the Ituri outbreak on May 15, and the disease has spread to neighboring Uganda. There were 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths reported as of May 29. The current outbreak is the seventeenth since 1976; the worst occurred in December 2013 in West Africa, with over 11,000 deaths. The article underlines urgency and ongoing international engagement, with continued transmission and community-led solutions highlighted.

triage.headline_ja: 過去に例のないほどの速さ：エボラ流行宣言からわずか2週間で膨大な感染者数を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新規流行でIHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCからウガンダへの国際的な拡大を既に確認し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（906疑い患者、223疑い死亡）、異常性（2週間での急速な症例増加）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCのイツリ州での流行が主題であり、既にウガンダへの拡大も報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Africa CDC宣言（5月15日）、WHO事務局長の現地訪問、MSF警告など、高度な国際的関与と緊急性が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de Ebola é internado em SP | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola is hospitalized in São Paulo | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease case in São Paulo, Brazil: a 37-year-old man is in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectious Diseases while laboratory confirmation is pending. State health authorities (CCD and CVE-SP) are investigating after the patient, who had travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, presented fever and symptoms compatible with Ebola. The investigation follows clinical and epidemiological criteria with isolation, immediate notification, laboratory testing, and monitoring per protocols. The case involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, previously linked to two outbreaks: 2012 in the DRC (38 laboratory-confirmed cases, 13 deaths) and 2007 at the DRC–Uganda border (131 cases, 42 deaths). By comparison, Zaire ebolavirus caused the West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak (about 11,000 deaths) and the 2018–2020 DRC outbreaks (over 3,000 deaths). A vaccine, Ervebo, developed for Zaire ebolavirus, was FDA-approved in 2019 and authorized in Europe and Africa, but not for other Ebola types.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者がサンパウロで入院 | CNNブラジル
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疑い例が高リスク国ブラジルで検出され、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。コンゴでの流行株と関連し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: コンゴからの渡航歴を持つ患者がブラジルで検出された初のエボラ疑い例。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で、致死率の低いタイプだが、ブラジルでの確定例は公衆衛生上の重大事象。検査確認待機中。国家レベルの対応と国際的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SP investiga caso suspeito de ebola em homem que viajou à República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sao Paulo investigates a suspected Ebola case in a man who traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, São Paulo, Brazil is investigating a suspected Ebola virus disease case in a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo who recently traveled there. He presented fever and compatible clinical-epidemiological criteria and is in isolation at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas under strict biosafety protocols; no laboratory confirmation has been reported yet. The investigation is led by São Paulo’s Coordenadoria de Controle de Doenças (CCD) and Centro de Vigilância Epidemiológica (CVE-SP), with immediate notification, laboratory testing, and monitoring per national/state protocols. The case follows updated guidance on the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the DRC issued by CCD/CVE-SP and Instituto Adolfo Lutz. Ebola symptoms may include fever, severe headache, myalgias, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and in severe cases hemorrhage, shock, and multi-organ failure; incubation 2–21 days. There are no licensed vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo; Zaire-directed vaccines are not proven effective for this strain. The exposure is travel-related from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州がコンゴ民主共和国への渡航歴がある男性のエボラ疑い患者を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者が検出され、IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。DRCの感染症流行地域からの輸入症例であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 輸入症例であり、DRC発症の患者がブラジル（サンパウロ州）で検出された。未確認症例だが、Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン・治療法がなく、公式な疫学的監視体制が発動されている。迅速な検査確定が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza avança no País; uso precoce do Tamiflu pode reduzir internações e mortes - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza advances across the country; early use of Tamiflu may reduce hospitalizations and deaths - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports over 8,000 influenza-associated Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases through May 16, 2026, about 70% higher than the same period in 2025. A total of 31,775 SRAG hospitalizations with identified respiratory viruses occurred, with Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) causing 43%, influenza 23%, and rhinovirus 21%. Among 1,210 deaths linked to respiratory viruses, 57% were associated with influenza. Virtually all Brazilian states face alert, risk, or high-risk SRAG levels, except Rondônia; 20 states show a long-term rising trend. Hospitalizations due to influenza remain elevated in the South and in São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Roraima, and Tocantins. The Ministry of Health and clinicians advocate early oseltamivir (Tamiflu) use, ideally within 48 hours of symptom onset, as it can shorten illness by about one day, reduce complications (40–50% in adults for mild cases; 28% in high-risk groups), and lower hospitalizations (about 52%) and elderly mortality (up to 18%), with reduced benefits if treatment is delayed.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザが全国で進行；タミフルの早期使用は入院と死亡を減らす可能性 - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのインフルエンザ・RSV流行により、IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：8000例以上のSRAG関連入院、57%の死亡がインフルエンザ関連）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす（異常/予想外：2025年同期比70%増加、重症度：1210人の死亡、流行しやすさ：ほぼ全州に警報レベル）。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ブラジル全土でのインフルエンザ・RSVによるSRAG流行が確認される。2025年同期比で70%の増加、ほぼ全州での警報レベル、20州での長期的上昇傾向、1210人の死亡（インフルエンザ関連57%）が報告されている。早期治療による合併症・入院・死亡低減の医学的エビデンスも記載されており、公衆衛生対応の要性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Estado acende alerta para Ebola após suposto caso na Capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State raises Ebola alert after suspected case in the capital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo capital, Brazil. A 37-year-old man with recent travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo is hospitalized in isolation at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas (West Zone). Laboratory confirmation has not yet been obtained. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat says the investigation began after identifying clinical and epidemiological criteria. The case is considered imported, pending confirmatory tests. Ebola symptoms include high fever, severe headache, muscle pains, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain; in severe cases, hemorrhage and multi-organ failure may occur. Health authorities are conducting exposure assessments and maintaining isolation while awaiting results. Published 2026-05-30.

triage.headline_ja: 州がエボラ出血熱の警戒を発令 首都での疑い症例後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の輸入疑い症例は高リスク病原体であり、確定診断待ちの段階でもシグナル認識が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。患者はコンゴ民主共和国からの最近の渡航歴あり。現在隔離中で検査結果待ち。確定診断前の段階であっても、疑い症例の報告時点でPickupレベル。DRCはエボラ流行地域。

article.articleHeadline: Generálny riaditeľ WHO navštívil východokonžskú provinciu najviac zasiahnutú ebolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General visited the eastern Congo province hardest hit by Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ituri province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is the epicenter of the latest Ebola outbreak, a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever now detected across three eastern provinces and in neighbouring Uganda. Uganda has nine confirmed Ebola cases, including one death. Africa CDC reports that since May 15, when authorities officially declared the outbreak, at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases have been recorded, with 246 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to assess the response and emphasize the need for community engagement. The epidemic’s most severe prior outbreak, in 2018–2020, caused nearly 2,300 deaths from about 3,500 cases. International support is ongoing, but local community cooperation is highlighted as essential for effective containment and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が、エボラで最も大きな被害を受けたコンゴ東部州を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、重篤な出血熱（エボラ）の多国間拡大が確認されています。1,077例の疑い例と246死亡という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認例あり）、および国際支援体制の整備が認められます。
triage.notes: Uganda (隣国)は記事内で確認例1例を含む9症例が報告されていますが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていません。記事サマリーより、主要な発生地はIturi州（DRC東部）で、DRCおよび東部3州での拡大が確認されています。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的な関心が高いことが示唆されます。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: por que o contágio é difícil e restrito?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Why is transmission difficult and restricted?
article.articleSummary: May 30, 2026: The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency (PHEIC) over Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. São Paulo is investigating a suspected Ebola case. The situation is not expected to become a pandemic; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated it does not meet pandemic criteria. WHO assesses national and regional risk as high, but global risk as low, with the main concern being how quickly the virus could spread within affected areas. Ebola transmission is limited and not airborne; human infection occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated surfaces, especially in health-care settings and during unsafe burial practices. The virus circulates mainly among animals, and human-to-human spread requires close contact with infected materials. Infectious-disease expert Leonardo Weissmann (Hospital Regional Jorge Rossmann, USP) notes the transmission constraints relative to influenza or SARS-CoV-2.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：なぜ感染が困難で限定的なのか？
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラ出血熱の国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの流行に対応。ブラジル（サンパウロ）で疑似症例の調査中。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言は極めて高いエスカレーション。DRCとウガンダでの流行が確認され、ブラジルで疑似症例が報告されている点が国際的拡大の懸念を示唆。ただし記事ではサンパウロの調査段階であり確認例ではない。WHOは全体的なリスクは低いと評価しているが、PHEIC宣言と矛盾しないようにバランスの取れた対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Médicos Sin Fronteras califica como "profundamente alarmante" situación del ébola en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders calls the Ebola situation in the DRC "deeply alarming".
article.articleSummary: East of the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province, the Ebola outbreak is described as 'deeply alarming' two weeks after its initial declaration. The Africa Union's health agency reports 246 deaths among 1,077 suspected cases. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with a case fatality rate of roughly 30–50%; there is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. The WHO notes the virus likely began circulating in Ituri about two months before the PHEIC declaration. Diagnostic capacity is limited and hundreds of samples remain unanalyzed. Border and airport closures are delaying medical supplies, humanitarian aid, and specialized personnel. MSF calls for immediate expansion of testing, a faster, more coordinated global response, and sustained access to supplies and staff, stressing community engagement to address fear, misinformation, and to build trust in seeking care.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ情勢を「深刻な懸念」と評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、エボラウイルス病の公衆衛生的重大性（246死亡、CFR 30-50%）、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限措置が明確である。WPRO基準も複数該当し、国際的支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）によるアウトブレイクで、ワクチン・特異的治療がなく、診断能力が限定的。国境・空港閉鎖により医療物資と人員配置に支障が出ている。MSFが世界的な緊急対応の加速を求めており、政府・国際機関の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo: Ebola-Epidemie führt zu Angst, Verzweiflung und Gewalt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kongo: Ebola epidemic leads to fear, despair and violence.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri province hardest hit. The outbreak disrupts daily life and traditional burial rites as the virus intrudes into communities; a newborn died days after birth, infected in utero. Burial practices like washing the dead remain dangerous and require strict protective measures. Misinformation—fears of airborne transmission or that Ebola is a hoax—further complicates response, prompting Red Cross teams to educate door-to-door while facing distrust and hostility. Attacks on treatment centers and emergency tents hinder containment, reflecting long-standing skepticism toward authorities and international aid in conflict-affected areas. Ituri’s volatile backdrop, marked by poverty and violence, challenges access and protection for both residents and aid workers. International aid has begun, with cargo planes delivering protective gear, medicines, and tents; about 100 tonnes of additional aid are expected in coming days, underscoring a race against time to contain the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ: エボラ流行が恐怖、絶望、暴力をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の流行は公衆衛生に深刻な影響を与え、異常な状況であり、国際的な拡大リスク及び渡航制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は新生児を含む人的損失が確認されており、埋葬慣行に関連した感染拡大リスクが高い。医療施設への攻撃、偽情報、コミュニティの不信感が対応を複雑化させている。国際的な支援物資の搬入が開始されており、紛争地域での対応の困難さが明記されている。CEPR EBS活動の優先度が高い案件。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo investiga caso suspeito de Ebola, diz Secretaria de Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo investigates a suspected Ebola case, says Health Department.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil – The São Paulo State Health Secretariat is investigating a suspected Ebola case in a 37-year-old man who recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He arrived with fever and is hospitalized in isolation at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas. Ebola has not yet been laboratory-confirmed; measures include isolation, immediate notification, laboratory testing, and monitoring per protocol. Context: the World Health Organization reports the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak is expanding in the Congo and Uganda. As of May 27, Congo recorded 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths; by May 29, 134 cases had been confirmed, including nine in Uganda, with 18 deaths across both countries.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロがエボラウイルス感染が疑われる症例を調査中と保健局が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国際的移入事例であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているように、ブラジル（サンパウロ州）にてDRC由来の患者における疑い症例が確認されている。DRCでの流行状況（906疑い症例、223死亡）も報道されており、国際的なエボラウイルス拡大の文脈における重要なシグナル。ウガンダはサマリーで流行状況の文脈のみであり、患者発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めず。

article.articleHeadline: Public health alert as influenza cases surge in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports surge in influenza with co-circulation of Influenza A (subtypes H3N2 and H1N1) and Influenza B, alongside RSV and COVID-19. As of May 2026, 941 influenza-related cases and nine deaths have been recorded in the state, with 457 cases and five deaths in May alone. Symptoms overlap across influenza, RSV, and COVID-19, making clinical differentiation difficult without testing. Influenza A, driven by antigenic drift and shift, poses ongoing pandemic risk and underscores the need for updated vaccines and robust surveillance. Elderly individuals and pregnant women, as well as the immunocompromised, are at higher risk of severe disease; those over 70 are particularly vulnerable. Early treatment with antivirals like Oseltamivir is advised. The health department follows integrated ILI/COVID-19 guidelines, with testing and treatment for high-risk groups. Preventive measures—masking, reduced crowding, and cough hygiene—are emphasized to avert healthcare overload amid dengue season.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ患者急増により公衆衛生警報が発令 - ケーラム州
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーラム州で複数の呼吸器系ウイルス（インフルエンザA H3N2/H1N1、インフルエンザB、RSV、COVID-19）の同時流行が報告され、2026年5月単月で457例・5死亡を記録。IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・流行しやすさが顕著。社会的関心も高く、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ケーラム州での複数ウイルス同時流行（インフルエンザA、B、RSV、COVID-19）は公衆衛生上の懸念。死亡例（9例）と高齢者・妊婦・免疫低下者における高リスク特性が報告されている。インフルエンザAの抗原性ドリフト・シフト、パンデミックリスク、ワクチン更新の必要性が指摘されている。デング熱流行との時間的重複が医療負荷の懸念を増加させている。

article.articleHeadline: 红十字国际委员会：在刚果（金）就抗击埃博拉疫情关键领域紧急行动-中新网视频
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International Committee of the Red Cross: Emergency actions in key areas of the Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — China News Service Video
article.articleSummary: Video message released May 29, 2026, shows emergency actions in northeastern Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak since mid-May has strained a fragile health system. The ICRC, with national health authorities and within the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, is conducting priority-response activities. In hospitals, trained clinicians and volunteers in PPE employ disinfection measures, safeguard the dignity of the deceased, support families, and conduct dignified burials for suspected Ebola deaths to reduce community transmission. In internally displaced person camps, volunteers educate residents about Ebola transmission, prevention, and the importance of promptly reporting suspected cases. In crowded communities, outreach workers conduct street- and door-to-door campaigns to quickly inform residents about transmission and protective actions. Video source: International Committee of the Red Cross.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字国際委員会：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染症対策の重要分野での緊急対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の発生、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は対象国DRC内での新規発生であり、国際支援が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月下旬のDRC・イトゥリ州におけるエボラ出血熱の新規発生事例。赤十字国際委員会（ICRC）による緊急対応が既に展開されており、国際的な関心が高い。医療体制が脆弱な地域での発生で、国内避難民キャンプなどでの拡散リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от Бундибуджо: Защо тестовете и ваксините срещу Ебола се оказаха безполезни срещу редкия щам?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Bundibugyo outbreak: Why tests and vaccines against Ebola proved useless against the rare strain?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare Ebola strain, drives a new outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. As of the latest data, at least 906 suspected cases, 112 confirmed infections, 223 suspected deaths, and 11 confirmed deaths have been reported. Authorities declared the outbreak on May 15, but experts say transmission likely occurred weeks earlier, delaying detection. Uganda closed its border with the Congo on May 28 in response. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, especially with injured skin or unprotected mucous membranes, making widespread spread less likely but with severe consequences in fragile health systems and conflict zones due to tracing and isolation challenges. Among six Ebola viruses, major outbreaks are Zaire and Sudan; Bundibugyo is rare and currently lacks an approved targeted vaccine or specific treatment. Diagnostics are challenging because not all Ebola tests detect Bundibugyo; early symptoms include non-bloody diarrhea, headache, fever, and fatigue.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョアウトブレイク：エボラ検査とワクチンが希少株に対して無効だった理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予期しない希少株の出現、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準4つ以上該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし、サマリーではウガンダでも確認されており、国境封鎖実施など国際的な対応が生じている重要なシグナル。Bundibugyo株は希少で、既存のエボラワクチンや診断検査では検出困難という点が重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: UAE's public health situation remains 'stable' as it reviews Ebola developments
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-30, the UAE's public health situation remains stable as authorities review Ebola developments. A meeting chaired by Ahmed Ali Al Sayegh, Minister of Health and Prevention, and the National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority assessed current epidemiological developments and the UAE's measures to safeguard the community. Officials stressed that response arrangements and readiness remain active and effective. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs advised residents and UAE nationals to avoid non-essential travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan during the ongoing Ebola situation. The release provides no specific case numbers or laboratory confirmation in the UAE.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の状況を検討する中、UAEの公衆衛生情況は「安定」している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体であり国際的関心が高いが、記事サマリーではUAEでの確認症例が明記されておらず、同国での実際の発生状況が不明。DRC等での発生は確認されるが、対象国のうち検証可能なのはDRCのみである。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUganda、South Sudan、UAEが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地として言及され、UAEは「検討中」「実施中の対策」という段階で確定症例は記載されていない。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであり、UgandaとSouth Sudanは対象国に含まれていない。エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当するが、UA内での発生確認がないため直ちにはPICKUPとせず、より詳細な情報を待つ段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: UAE issues travel advisory amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-30, the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a travel advisory urging UAE nationals and residents to avoid non-essential travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan amid an evolving Ebola outbreak. The measure aims to safeguard citizens abroad and reflects ongoing public health concerns and proactive risk management. Emiratis currently in these countries should remain vigilant, follow health and safety guidance issued by local authorities, and register with the Twajudi service. In case of emergency, UAE nationals can contact the Ministry via hotline +971 80024. The advisory emphasizes avoiding travel, maintaining vigilance on health guidance, and registering for consular support.

article.articleHeadline: International Aid Cuts Complicate Congo's Ebola Epidemic
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri and North Kivu provinces has surpassed 900 suspected cases with 220 deaths. WHO warns the epidemic will worsen and seeks rapid on-the-ground support, including equipment and experts, but funding is constrained after the United States’ withdrawal. Germany’s BMZ has cut back aid; about €160 million is earmarked for 2026–2027, less than in prior years, and officials warn prevention funding cuts will hinder outbreak response. Aid groups CARE and Caritas urge a broader funding increase. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain dominates eastern DRC and currently has no vaccine or cure; rapid testing and labs are acutely scarce, and vaccine development would take at least nine months. Diakonie reports only ~30% of demand met amid damaged hospitals and ongoing conflict; BMZ aims to dispatch a group of experts to eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 国際援助削減がコンゴのエボラ流行を複雑にする
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行（900例以上、220死亡）で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的な支援の必要性が高く、公衆衛生への重大な影響が明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国とドイツを発生地域に含めているが、これらは支援国としてのコンテキストであり、実際の流行はDRC(Ituri/North Kivu州)に限定される。ワクチン不在、資金不足、治療能力の欠落が重大な懸念。Bundibugyo株の優位性も特記すべき特性。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epedemie: Ärzte ohne Grenzen - riskante Hilfe im Krisengebiet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic: Doctors Without Borders - Risky Aid in the Crisis Zone.
article.articleSummary: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) plans to establish Ebola treatment centers in the conflict zone of the Democratic Republic of Congo, aiming to operate in Goma or Mweso, as cases surge and the outbreak potentially becomes the worst yet, according to ZDFheute. Project lead Theresa Berthold explains MSF must rapidly secure locations, personnel, supplies, and safe transport through checkpoints, while cooperating with the Congolese health ministry and local authorities. The operation faces persistent armed clashes in the east, around Goma, and acceptance issues from communities. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant currently lacks licensed vaccines; patients can only be treated symptomatically, e.g., fever reduction and stabilization. CFR for this variant is reported as 25–40%, a notably high mortality. The region hosts around five million internally displaced people in North and South Kivu, under cramped conditions, compounding transmission risk. Enhanced diagnostics and faster lab results are essential to targeted response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の流行：国境なき医師団 - 危機地域での危険な援助活動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度CFR 25-40%、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。エボラ出血熱は優先的にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant with CFR 25-40%, currently without licensed vaccines. Approximately 5 million internally displaced persons in North and South Kivu regions increase transmission risk. Armed conflict in eastern DRC complicates response operations. MSF establishment of treatment centers indicates international engagement. All IHR criteria and all WPRO criteria met - high priority signal requiring immediate full RRA.

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية يدعو مواطني الكونغو لدور محوري في مواجهة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director of Global Health calls on Congolese citizens to play a pivotal role in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged Congolese communities in Ituri Province's Bunia to take a pivotal role in combating the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Arriving to coordinate response efforts, he said 1,028 suspected Ebola cases had been registered as of Friday. He emphasized that local communities understand problems and solutions and stressed ownership of the response alongside government leadership and international support. After arriving in Kinshasa, he called for increased international funding, noting WHO has received only about one-third of the needed resources. Médecins Sans Frontières–France warned the outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented pace; this is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak since 1976. Alan Gonzalez, MSF deputy operations director, said the number of specialized organizations and the level of support remain far below what is required.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関事務局長、コンゴ国民にエボラ対策での中核的役割を呼びかける
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ指定感染症であり、DRCで1,028例の疑い患者が報告されている。IHR基準3項目に該当し（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数項目に該当する。WHO事務局長が直接訪問・対応を強化していることから、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（特にイトゥリ州ブニア）での17番目のエボラアウトブレイクを報告。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、1,028例の疑い患者、資金不足、MSFの懸念表明など複数の深刻な指標が確認される。フランスはメディア配信地であり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Diretor-geral da OMS visita epicentro do surto de ebola na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centers in Ituri province's Bunia, with the World Health Organization director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visiting the epicenter on May 30, 2026. The DRC declared a new outbreak on May 15, and the WHO has activated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The virus has been detected in three Congolese provinces and neighboring Uganda, which reported two new cases on Friday, elevating Uganda’s confirmed total to nine. In the DRC, there are over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, with Ituri housing the majority of confirmed infections. International health authorities warn the outbreak’s true scale is likely underestimated due to limited laboratory testing capacity. Context notes Ebola’s history in Africa: over 15,000 deaths in 50 years, and the 2018–2020 RDC outbreak caused about 2,300 deaths and 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が既に宣言されている。深刻な死亡率、複数国への地域的拡大、国際的支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内でのイツゥリ州での集中的な発生と246名の死亡が確認されており、WHOがPHEICを宣言済み。検査能力の限定により実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Überzogener Ebola-Schutz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overzealous Ebola Protection
article.articleSummary: Border closures by the United States, Canada, and Mexico to travelers from three African countries accompany the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). DR Congo players face three weeks in isolation ahead of the World Cup. The piece argues that Ebola has no pandemic potential: it is deadly but slow and largely containable with targeted isolation of symptomatic individuals. The epidemic is regional—only certain provinces in the DRC are affected, while large areas are not. It calls for mobilizing regional containment in Central and East Africa, noting funding gaps and access difficulties due to conflict, which sustain rising case numbers including undetected infections. The 17th outbreak in the DRC is highlighted. It urges strengthened UN and AU support, improved diagnostics, therapies, and vaccines, and criticizes the 'save yourself' mentality exemplified by the Kenya quarantine center for US patients.

triage.headline_ja: 過度なエボラ対策
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の発生は本質的に高リスク疾患であり、複数国間の国境閉鎖措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRCのエボラ発生を主題としており、米国・カナダ・メキシコの対応は二次的内容。対象国リストではDRCのみが主要な発生地として該当。ケニアは患者受け入れセンターとして言及されるが、発生地ではないため除外。17回目のアウトブレイク、複数州への拡大、未検出感染を含む継続的な症例増加が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : une maladie à haut risque pour le personnel soignant
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a high-risk disease for healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, six healthcare workers have died since the Ebola outbreak response began, announced by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba at a Bunia press briefing on May 28, 2026. This toll underscores Ebola’s ongoing danger to frontline staff, who are disproportionately women due to their dominance in health and caregiving roles. Ebola, first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the DRC, causes severe hemorrhagic fever with mortality that can reach about 50% or higher in outbreaks. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected patients or the deceased. While personal protective equipment reduces risk, errors, delays in diagnosis, or accidental exposure can be fatal. Past outbreaks in North Kivu and Ituri (2018–2020) infected hundreds of health workers and killed dozens, highlighting the need for community trust and rapid case reporting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：医療従事者にとって高リスク疾患
triage.triage_reason: DRCのイトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱の流行。医療従事者6人の死亡報告があり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）の複数項目に該当。スクリーニング基準でも重症度・管理可能性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCのイトゥリ州での活動中のエボラ流行が確認されている。医療従事者の高い死亡率、過去の大規模アウトブレイク経験、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、及び国レベルの対応状況の言及から、全てのスクリーニング基準に該当。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: Tâm dịch Ebola ở Congo: Hơn 1.000 ca nghi nhiễm chỉ sau hai tuần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epicenter in Congo: More than 1,000 suspected cases in just two weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak centered in Mongbwalu, a gold-mining town in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, began May 15, 2026. Within two weeks it surpassed 1,000 suspected cases, with the health ministry reporting by May 30: 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths, Mongbwalu accounting for over 400. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Testing capacity is severely limited: samples must be sent 80 km to Bunia and results take at least four days, leaving many patients dead before confirmation. MSF is establishing an isolation and decontamination site, but healthcare workers are stretched; at least seven staff have died, and PPE shortages persist. Community distrust and violence complicate response, including an isolation area being burned and 18 suspected patients escaping, as a priest died from the disease. The WHO notes vaccines could take 6 to 9 months to develop, while there are rare hopeful signs like a recovering 5-year-old, Emmanuel Cyrille.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の震源地：2週間でしか1,000件以上の疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大で高い社会的・政治的関心が期待される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で高い致死性（246死亡/1,077疑い例、約23%）。ワクチン・治療法なし。検査能力の制限（4日待機中に患者死亡）、医療従事者7名死亡、コミュニティ不信と暴力により対応困難な状況。WHOへの即時通知が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола распространяется в ДР Конго беспрецедентно быстро, утверждают "Врачи без границ"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the DRC at an unprecedented pace, say Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is unfolding at an unprecedented pace, according to MSF deputy operations director Alan Gonzalez on May 30, 2026. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or proven treatment, and diagnosis is especially difficult. Daily reports of new suspected cases are emerging, while hundreds of tests remain unprocessed. Airport and border closures hinder delivery of essential medical supplies, humanitarian aid, and expert personnel, with on-the-ground capacity severely limited. MSF calls for immediate expansion of testing and intensified international support to enable access for specialists. The WHO designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16. As of May 27 in DRC, 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths; an estimated 223 additional deaths and 906 additional infections may have occurred. Russia asserts low domestic risk due to its sanitary shield.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国で前例のない速度で拡大している、国境なき医師団が主張
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4/4該当、WPRO基準5/5該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）による急速な流行、国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み、国境・空港閉鎖によるサプライチェーン混乱、国際的支援の緊急需要が確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にロシア連邦が記載されているが、記事サマリーではロシアは国内リスクが低いと主張しているのみで、実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）のみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus変異体（ザイールエボラではない）で、ワクチンなし・治療法なし・診断困難という重大な特性を持つ。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）指定済み（2026年5月16日）。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits Ebola epicentre as outbreak worsens
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared May 15. As of 2026-05-30, >1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths reported in the DRC; three eastern provinces affected, with spillover into Uganda where nine confirmed infections and one death recorded. WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the Ebola epicentre in Bunia, Ituri province, emphasizing community ownership and international support. The DRC faces limited laboratory capacity, with likely under-ascertainment and warnings that the outbreak may predate detection. Uganda has closed its border and imposed a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from DRC. A patient in the current outbreak recovered and was discharged after two negative tests, described by WHO as the first confirmed recovery in this outbreak. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids; Ebola is highly contagious with significant fatality risk; ongoing cross-border concerns.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ流行の震源地を訪問、流行が悪化する中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は重度の感染症であり、DRCとウガンダにまたがる多国間流行で国際支援が必要。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダにも9件の確認症例と1件の死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主たる発生地であり、国際的な懸念の焦点。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、限定的な検査能力による過小評価の懸念、国境措置の実施などから緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Tinjau Langsung Pusat Wabah Ebola di Kongo Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Inspects the Ebola Outbreak Center in East Kongo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) centers on Bunia, Ituri, as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits May 30, 2026. The outbreak has spread across eastern provinces and into Uganda, which has nine confirmed cases and one death. Africa CDC reports 1,077 suspected Ebola cases in DRC since May 15, with 246 fatalities; officials warn the true toll is higher due to limited facilities and lab capacity amid ongoing conflict. Uganda has closed its border and imposed a 21-day quarantine for entrants from the DRC. A recovery: one patient was discharged May 27 after two negative tests, the first confirmed recovery in this outbreak. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo, though Africa CDC expects a vaccine before year-end. MSF warns of rapid spread and scarce medical staff; crowded camps in Ituri raise transmission risk amidst displacement, with ADF and M23 active.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ東部のエボラ流行中心地を直接査察
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（DRC＋ウガンダ）、高い死亡率、国境閉鎖など深刻な状況が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（1606373）はAPI発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに未登録のため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事サマリーで「ウガンダは9例の確定患者と1死亡」と明記されており、国際的拡大が確認される重大事態。DRCが対象国に含まれるため、シグナル判定に影響なし。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo種）、高い死亡率（246/1,077=22.8%）、治療法不在、ワクチン開発中、紛争地域での発生など複数の懸念要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief arrives at epicentre of DRC's Ebola outbreak - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: Ebola haemorrhagic fever is spreading from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) into three eastern provinces and neighboring Uganda, where nine confirmed infections and one death have been reported. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the DRC has recorded at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths, according to the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, capital of Ituri province, to help and listen to affected communities as the response unfolds. International effort is led by the DRC government, with emphasis on community ownership. The true reach of the outbreak is believed to be wider than confirmed cases, and the DRC’s capacity to conduct laboratory tests is limited, complicating confirmation and containment. The background notes decades of conflict in eastern DRC that challenge outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、DRCのエボラ出血熱の中心地に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の多国間拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、死亡例（246例以上）、国際的な対応活動が報道されている。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。シグナルとして確実にピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主な発生国であり、ウガンダでの確定例（9例）も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC内ではIturi州（Bunia）が主な流行地と特定されている。1,077例の疑い例と246例の死亡、WHO事務局長現地到着など、極めて高いシグナルレベル。

article.articleHeadline: EBOLA: Bunagana businesses pushed into crisis over border closure
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Eastern DR Congo prompts temporary Uganda–DRC Bunagana border closure in Kisoro District as of May 27, 2026. The National Task Force on Ebola Response, chaired by Vice President Jessica Alupo, says border shutdown aims to halt transmission amid confirmed Ebola cases in DRC and Uganda. Security heightened; weekly markets suspended; hundreds of Congolese nationals reportedly crossed porous borders to buy goods. The closure has devastated cross-border trade; traders report steep declines in customers and income, calling for maintained movement under strict SOPs. Some residents urge continued crossings with enforcement of hand-washing and distancing, to avoid economic collapse. Ismail Ndayambaje defends the closure as essential to public health; authorities urge SOP compliance and installation of hand-washing facilities. The outbreak has killed several in DR Congo and is confirmed in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: EBOLA: ブナガナのビジネス、国境閉鎖により危機的状況に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の確認事例がDRC・ウガンダで報告されており、国境封鎖措置が講じられている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーはDRC東部でのエボラ発生を主題としており、DRCは対象国（ID:203312）に該当。国防衛生当局の関与、死亡事例の報告、国境封鎖措置の実施により、WPROスクリーニング基準全5項目に該当する重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo rules out school closures despite Ebola deaths
article.articleSummary: DR Congo will keep schools open in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu despite an Ebola outbreak, implementing preventive measures in classrooms rather than shutting educational facilities after at least five student deaths since mid-May. Health Minister Roger Kamba said the decision aims to safeguard education while reducing transmission, noting deaths were linked to home treatment and delays in seeking professional care. The Bundibugyo strain circulating in the eastern provinces carries a fatality rate of 30–50% among confirmed cases, according to the WHO. WHO records show at least 134 confirmed Ebola cases across DR Congo and Uganda since the outbreak began, with nine infections and 18 deaths in Uganda. Congolese authorities report over 1,000 suspected cases, with new reports continuing from the affected eastern regions. Kamba urged parents to refer suspected cases immediately to health facilities rather than attempt home treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死亡にもかかわらず学校閉鎖を除外
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo株による確定症例134件、死亡18件、複数国での確認、30-50%の致命率、学校教育への影響が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の確定症例が複数地域で報告されており、致命率30-50%と高い。学生を含む死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認される。Uganda（対象国外）での患者報告もあるが、verified_locationsはサマリー上で主題となっているDRCのみを含めた。発生地域フィールドにUgandaが含まれているものの、サマリーではDRCの状況が主軸であり、Ugandaの患者数は限定的である。

article.articleHeadline: Zorgen om kinderen in landen waar ebola is
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns for Children in Countries Where Ebola Is Present
article.articleSummary: As of May 2026, Ebola is circulating in several African countries, with transmission through close contact with infected individuals. In response, authorities have imposed measures such as social distancing, including on school grounds in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Congo faces war, displacement, and poverty, complicating outbreak control. About 1,000 people are ill across Africa, with roughly 250 deaths attributed to Ebola. Some schools lack basic water for handwashing, hindering hygiene efforts. Nonetheless, many children receive education about the disease to learn how to protect themselves and others. Aid organizations are delivering water, food, and medical teams with medicines to the region to help combat the virus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが存在する国の子どもたちへの懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ以上満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラの流行は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、重症度（死亡例あり）が認められ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドには「Africa（大陸）」も含まれているが、記事サマリーにおいて具体的に言及されている国はDRCのみであり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCである。約1,000人の患者と250人の死亡が報告されており、複数アフリカ諸国での流行を示唆するが、具体名で対象国に該当するのはDRCのみ。教育支援と人道支援組織の活動が記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Директор ВОЗ заявил о нехватке средств для борьбы со вспышкой Эболы - Minval Politika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General says there is a funding shortfall to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports that only about one-third of the funding necessary to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has been received. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that numerous challenges remain in containment and appealed for increased international support, including supplies and personal protective equipment for frontline health workers. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya added that Africa needs nearly $319 million to respond to the current Ebola outbreak. The funding gap highlights ongoing difficulties in operationalizing the response across affected regions. These appeals come as authorities strive to curb transmission and ensure adequate protective resources. Published 2026-05-30.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱の流行に対抗するための資金不足を表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中の流行であり、IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、国際的な資金支援の呼びかけと継続的な伝播リスクが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国が言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。資金不足の指摘とWHO・Africa CDCの国際的な支援呼びかけは、流行の深刻性と管理の困難さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : la faible desserte en eau, un défi dans la lutte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Inadequate water supply, a challenge in the fight against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, faces an inadequate potable-water supply during Ebola outbreaks, hindering response in a city described by ACP as an obstacle. An actor from civil society notes that despite Ebola’s recurrence (the 17th outbreak with Beni as a focus), water points are not refilled daily, creating crowded fountains and increased contamination risk. With Ebola transmission both driven by and potentially mitigated by water, residents urge the state to earmark funds for water in affected zones; displaced people from conflict areas intensify demand at taps. Crowds of women and girls gather at water points, raising interhuman transmission risk, while a 20-liter water container has risen from 100 to 200 francs. Calls for large chlorinated basins at hot spots. Beni’s water system includes Regideso, gravity-fed reservoirs, and boreholes. Five Ebola cases confirmed, three deaths, two patients escaped.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラとの戦いにおける水供給の不十分さが課題 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定患者5名（死亡3名）が報告されており、IHR基準「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」に該当。水供給不足によるヒト-ヒト感染リスク上昇がWPRO基準「流行しやすさ」に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ベニにおけるエボラ16回目の集中爆発（過去17回目）に関するもの。水インフラ不足が感染拡大要因となっており、避難民の流入による需要増加と相まって、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが懸念されている。確定患者5名、死亡3名、逃亡患者2名が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : les habitants d'Oïcha appelés à renforcer les pratiques d'hygiènes. - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: the inhabitants of Oïcha urged to reinforce hygiene practices.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been recorded in Oïcha, the head town of Beni territory in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, with one death, one active case still under management, and one case listed as an escape as of May 29, 2026. On May 29–30, 2026, Oïcha mayor Eugénie Mwenye called for reinforced hygiene practices as a frontline defense against the 17th Ebola outbreak currently affecting the country. She urged merchants to install handwashing stations outside shops and religious leaders to place basins at church and mosque entrances, while households were asked to consistently wash hands with clean water and soap, avoid contact with people with suspected symptoms, and report any suspected cases promptly to health facilities. Oïcha’s experience with Ebola dates back to the 10th epidemic (2018–2020), and vigilance remains essential to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 北キヴ州のエボラ：オイチャの住民に衛生慣行の強化を促す
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例2件（死亡1件）がコンゴ民主共和国北キヴ州で記録され、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外性」「国際的拡大リスク」の3基準に該当。WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月現在の17番目のエボラ流行。オイチャで2件の確認症例（死亡1件、活動中1件、逃亡者1件）が記録。2018-2020年の10番目の流行時にもオイチャで経験あり。地方自治体が積極的に衛生対策を呼びかけており、管理下での対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Burundi bénéficie d'un appui de 11 millions dollars du CDC Afrique pour la prévention et la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Burundi receives $11 million in support from Africa CDC for prevention and response.
article.articleSummary: Burundi receives $11 million from Africa CDC to reinforce Ebola prevention and response efforts. Funds were mobilized after a fundraising appeal by Burundi’s Ministry of Public Health to prevent Ebola introduction and bolster preparedness. Burundi’s preparedness and response plan, valued at about $15 million, will begin actions soon, announced during a visit by Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya, who signed the handover with Burundi Health Minister Fidèle Nkezabahizi. Separately, Africa CDC reported that suspected Ebola cases linked to a new outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda exceeded 1,000 since the DRC declared the outbreak on May 15. The African Union health agency warned 11 other countries at high risk, including South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, and Somalia.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ブルンジがアフリカCDCから1,100万ドルの予防・対応支援を受ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の新規流行が報告され、DRC・ウガンダで疑い患者が1,000件超となり、11カ国が高リスクと警告されている。国際的拡大リスク、重症度、流行感受性が高く、複数のWPRO基準に該当。
triage.notes: エボラの新規流行は2026年5月15日にDRCで宣言され、ウガンダでも確認されている。Africa CDCが11カ国に警告を発出しており、ブルンジに対して予防対応のための1,100万ドルの支援が決定された。記事サマリーで明示的に発生が報告されている国はDRC、ウガンダ（対象国外）、ブルンジ（高リスク国として警告対象）。対象国リストの中で実際に発生地として言及されているのはDRCであり、高リスク国として明示されているのはZambiaである。Ghanaは発生地域リストに含まれていないため除外。ただし、アフリカ全域での急速な流行拡大が懸念されているため、複数国での同時シグナルとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri :l'OMS mise sur l'appropriation communautaire pour renforcer la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: WHO relies on community ownership to strengthen the response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province (north-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo) hinges on community ownership to end it, according to WHO. In Bunia on May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged local communities to lead the response, stating that engaging communities, evaluating interventions, and identifying challenges will inform appropriate international support. He said success depends on active population involvement and that the mission seeks to hear concerns and proposals to tailor aid to ground realities. He reaffirmed the international community's commitment to backing efforts coordinated by the Congolese government to contain Ebola transmission. The visit takes place amid strengthened surveillance, diagnostics, awareness-raising, and patient care efforts by health authorities and partners in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリでのエボラ：WHOはコミュニティ主導の対応強化に期待 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行であり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の事象に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で該当し、国際支援（WHO現地訪問）が必要な状況。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR 2005 Annex2で必須通知対象疾患である。DRC イトゥリ州での現在の流行について、WHO事務局長が現地訪問し、地域主導の対応強化を呼びかけている。記事は2026年5月30日付けで、進行中の流行対応を伝えている。国際的なサポート体制が構築されている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros llega al corazón de la epidemia de ébola en el Congo: "Aunque la situación es compleja, podemos detener esto"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros arrives at the heart of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: "Although the situation is complex, we can stop this".
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centers on Bunia, Ituri Province, with a new outbreak declared on May 15 and the WHO activating an international health alert. The Ebola virus, causing hemorrhagic fever, has been detected in three Congolese provinces and in neighboring Uganda, where two new confirmed cases were reported, bringing Uganda’s total to nine. In the DRC, Africa CDC reports 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected cases as of Thursday. On May 30, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to engage with communities, assess the response, and identify challenges for support. The situation is complex, but officials say it is stoppable through coordinated public health measures and cross-border collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行中心地に到着：「状況は複雑だが、これを止めることができる」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大の実績（ウガンダでも確認）、流行性疾患の特性から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2例の確認症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず、DRCのみを記載。WHO事務局長が現地到着したことから国際的関心と対応の高まりが明確。1,000件超の疑い患者と246人の死亡例は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: El director de la OMS visita el Congo y reclama más recursos tras un brote que ya supera la capacidad de respuesta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General visits the Congo and calls for more resources after an outbreak that has already overwhelmed the response capacity.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo centers on Ituri's Bunia, caused by Bundibugyo virus with no approved treatment or vaccine. By Friday authorities reported 1,028 suspected cases; the WHO counted 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths, while Uganda reported 9 infections and 1 death. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to coordinate the response, urging stronger international funding and active community engagement as cases surge. The EU delivered aid to Ituri and the United States added $80 million, bringing U.S. support to over $112 million. Hospitals in Bunia show improved organization, but patient influx remains high. MSF warns the outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented pace and calls for rapid testing, faster aid deployment, and sustained supply access. Attacks on health centers and fighting in North and South Kivu, with M23 involvement, hinder response; Uganda and Rwanda closed borders, while Tedros condemns travel bans as ineffective.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴを訪問し、対応能力を超えた流行発生後のより多くのリソースを要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の大規模流行であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準の5項目すべてに該当する。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、国際的な支援強化、及び死亡例を含む急速な感染拡大が報告されており、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRC（特にIturi州のBunia）でのエボラ流行を記述。ウガンダとルワンダは国境閉鎖で対応しているが、実際の発生地はDRCであると記事から明確。Bundibugyo型ウイルスはワクチン・承認治療法がなく、MSFが前例のない速度での拡大を警告。WHO事務局長の現地訪問とUS$80百万の追加支援はシグナルの緊急性を強調。

article.articleHeadline: Současná epidemie eboly má podle MSF více brzkých případů nákazy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola outbreak has more early infection cases, according to MSF.
article.articleSummary: Two weeks after authorities declared an Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, MSF reports unusually early infections, signaling a rapidly expanding transmission. WHO data through May 30 list 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths; the outbreak was declared in Ituri on May 15 by the CDC and has since spread to Uganda. Ebola spreads by contact with infected people or contaminated materials, with symptoms including fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and bleeding. The Bundibugyo variant currently circulating in DRC and neighboring Uganda has no vaccine or proven effective treatment. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak since 1976. The worst occurred in 2013–2014 in West Africa with more than 11,000 deaths; Congo’s 2018–2020 outbreak claimed about 2,300. WHO Director-General Tedros visited Bunia to bolster response; community involvement is stressed.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱の流行はMSFによると初期感染例が多いという
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、国際的なスプレッド、高い重症度・死亡率があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高いリスク病原体。Bundibugyo変異型の出現、ワクチンなし、急速な感染拡大、ウガンダへのスプレッド、WHO事務局長の現地訪問など、すべてが深刻な危機を示唆。フルRRA実施が必須。発生地域にAngola・Ugandaが含まれるが、サマリー上DRCが主要な発生地で、Ugandaは「spread to Uganda」と記述（確認程度）のため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイク、1,028症例を記録...世界保健機関がコミュニティの中心的役割を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラは指定感染症で、1,028症例、複数地域への拡大、資金不足による対応能力の不足など、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致命率と国際的脅威を有する。DRC内のイトゥリ地域（ブニアが中心）及びキンシャサでの発生が確認される。WHO事務局長による現地視察と資金確保への強い訴えが報道されており、国際的関心が高い。1,028症例という相当規模の患者数及びMSFによる「前例のない拡大」警告から、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Shefi i OBSH-së vizitë në Kongo, shkon në epiqendrën e epidemisë së Ebolës: Mund ta kishim parandaluar!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief visits Congo, goes to the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic: We could have prevented it!
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centers in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia as its epicenter. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern as the outbreak, identified on May 15, threatens about 100 million people in the country. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia for a two-day visit to meet regional leaders and hear concerns, aiming to assist. Health services are weak in rural areas and armed groups complicate access to communities. Laboratory confirmation capacity is low, contributing to uncertainty about the outbreak’s true scale. Ebola has killed about 15,000 people in Africa over five decades; the most deadly recent outbreak in DRC was 2018–2020, with 3,500 cases and 2,300 deaths. Current outbreak dimensions remain unclear.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴを訪問、エボラ流行の震源地へ：防げたはずだ！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）宣言された大規模流行で、WHO事務局長の現地訪問も報じられており、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に確認されたエボラ流行。Ituri州Buniaが震源地。WHOは公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言。約100万人に影響の可能性（記事では「100 million」と述べられているが、DRC人口文脈では異常値のため100万人と解釈）。保健サービスの脆弱性、武装勢力による アクセス困難、検査確認能力の低さが課題。WHO事務局長Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesusの2日間の現地訪問が報じられており、最高レベルの関心を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa identifica baixa prevalência do Vírus Linfotrópico T Humano em doadores de sangue de Mato Grosso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study Identifies Low Prevalence of Human T-Lymphotropic Virus in Blood Donors from Mato Grosso
article.articleSummary: Low prevalence of Human T-lymphotropic virus types I/II (HTLV-I/II) detected among blood donors at Mato Grosso’s state hemocenter. Analysis of 60,568 donor samples from 2018–2021 yielded 63 HTLV-I/II-positive cases, a prevalence of 0.10%, similar to Southeast Brazilian hemocenters. The study aims to assess proviral load in samples analyzed between 2024–2026 to improve molecular detection, in partnership with Lacen-MT and Hospital Universitário Júlio Müller (HUJM). HTLV is a retrovirus infecting T lymphocytes; most infections are asymptomatic but can progress to Tropical Spastic Paraparesis or Adult T-cell Leukemia/Lymphoma, with possible ocular inflammation and dermatitis. The highest annual positivity occurred in 2020 (0.16%). Positive donors were more often women aged 31–45, of mixed race, with high school education, employed in the private sector, and coinfections with hepatitis B, HIV, hepatitis C, or syphilis were noted. Screening has been mandatory in Brazilian blood banks since 1993, aiding transfusion safety and follow-up through SUS.

triage.headline_ja: 研究がマット・グロッソ州の献血者における人T細胞リンパ向性ウイルスの低い有病率を特定
triage.triage_reason: 低い有病率（0.10%）の定型的な献血スクリーニング研究であり、異常な発生、重症度の高い事例、または国際的拡大のリスクを示す証拠がない。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、管理上の懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は献血安全強化に関する学術研究報告であり、HTLV-I/IIおよび関連感染症（HBV、HCV、HIV、梅毒）の共感染が指摘されているが、これらは既知の流行状況の確認であり、新規の感染症危機を示唆するものではない。1993年より義務化されているスクリーニング制度の有効性を示す研究である。

article.articleHeadline: SP investiga caso suspeito de ebola em paciente vindo do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP investigates a suspected Ebola case in a patient coming from Congo.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil: A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is hospitalized in isolation at Instituto Emílio Ribas pending laboratory confirmation after developing fever during travel to his country of origin. A preventive epidemiological investigation has been launched; municipal surveillance and the state center have been notified. No laboratory confirmation yet. Brazil previously monitored three suspected Ebola cases in 2014, all later discarded. The risk of introducing Ebola to Brazil remains very low, given no autochthonous transmission in South America, no direct flights from the region, and transmission requiring close contact with blood, secretions, or bodily fluids of symptomatic individuals. Internationally, the Congo outbreak is under scrutiny. It was declared May 15 and is expanding in Ituri and North Kivu in eastern DRC, with 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths reported by Africa CDC. WHO is deploying equipment and personnel; funding remains strained following the United States’ withdrawal, with Africa CDC noting pledged contributions falling from nearly $500 million to about $290 million.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロがコンゴ発症者のエボラ疑い例を調査
triage.triage_reason: コンゴにおけるエボラアウトブレイク（1,077疑い例、246疑い死亡）が進行中であり、国際的に懸念される状況下で、ブラジルに患者が流入した国際的広がりのリスク事例。IHR基準3つ該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。
triage.notes: コンゴにおけるアウトブレイクは2026年5月15日宣言済み。ブラジル患者は現時点で検査未確認だが、流行地からの流入例としてハイリスク。ブラジルへのリスク自体は低評価（自動感染なし、直行便なし）だが、国際的監視対象。米国の資金撤退に伴いWHOの対応能力が低下している点も懸念。

article.articleHeadline: عودة: أول حالة شفاء من إيبولا بالكونغو مؤشر على فعالية التشخيص المبكر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Return: The first recovery from Ebola in Congo is an indicator of the effectiveness of early diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the first recovery from Ebola after quarantine, underscoring early diagnosis as a key to control. Dr. Fouad Ouda, president of the European–Middle East Medical Association, notes a new Ebola variant with milder symptoms and says antiviral drugs exist even though no vaccine is available yet. The recovered patient was diagnosed early, enabling symptom control and preventing progression to severe disease. Early detection helps avoid late manifestations such as internal and external bleeding, which can be life-threatening in up to 60% of cases. The incubation period varies by age and health status, typically two to twenty-one days. The report urges continued strengthening of diagnostic capacity to manage Ebola outbreaks more effectively.

triage.headline_ja: 返信: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の初回回復は早期診断の有効性を示す指標
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規亜型の報告および初回回復事例は異常かつ予想外であり、IHR基準および WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たす。DRC での継続的な感染症動向監視の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 新規エボラ亜型の報告により、症状がより軽微であるとの指摘がある。ただしワクチンはまだ利用できない状況。早期診断と抗ウイルス薬の利用可能性が強調されている。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念を喚起し、アフリカ地域での感染拡大リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ заявил о нехватке средств для борьбы со вспышкой Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General said there is a shortage of funds to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said only about one-third of the funds needed to counter the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have been secured, with Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya citing a near $319 million requirement for Africa’s response. A new Ebola outbreak in southern Congo provinces was confirmed on May 15. By May 25, over 900 suspected Ebola cases were reported, including 101 laboratory-confirmed; the epicenter is Ituri province, home to about 5 million people, with roughly a quarter in humanitarian need. On May 27, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor announced intensified sanitary-quarantine checks at borders for travelers from high-risk areas, deploying a Bundibugyo virus test system and Perimeter AIS for risk assessment as part of Sanitary Shield. The agency is aiding Africa by deploying Ugandan teams, coordinating with Congo and Burundi, and operating two joint research centers and mobile laboratories.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ熱アウトブレイク対策の資金不足を述べた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の確認症例および疑い症例が急速に増加（5月25日時点で900以上）し、IHR基準2つ以上に該当するとともに、資金不足という重大な管理上の課題が識別された。国際的な対応調整も進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、アウトブレイクの主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州であることが明確。ウガンダは隣接国として言及されているが、サマリーでは「確認症例」の主な報告はコンゴ。ロシアの防疫措置とアフリカ支援の記述は、国際的な関心と対応の高さを示唆。対象国リストにおいてDRCのみ該当確認。

article.articleHeadline: Médicos sin Fronteras alerta sobre la "profundamente alarmante" situación del ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warns about the "deeply alarming" Ebola situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo (Ituri) is deeply alarming two weeks after declaration, according to MSF. The AU health agency reports 246 deaths and 1,077 suspected cases. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% case-fatality rate; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. MSF warns thousands of samples remain unanalyzed, testing capacity is limited, and border and airport closures delay delivery of essential supplies and personnel. Urgent, sustained, community-centered action is needed, including expanded testing and faster global coordination with guaranteed access to supplies. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to visit facilities, after meetings in Kinshasa, amid ongoing conflict that complicates response and calls for a ceasefire. Uganda reports 9 cases, including 1 death, linked to cross-border spread from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の「極めて深刻な」状況について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、高い致死率（30-50%）、246人の死亡、検査体制の不備、国際調整の必要性が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告（9例、1死亡）があるが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生であり、ウガンダは「対象国リスト」に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため記載。MSF、WHO事務局長による現地視察など、国際的な対応レベルが高く、早期警報の重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Santé : Les États-Unis deviennent le premier bailleur de la riposte contre Ebola en RDC et en Ouganda, dépassant le seuil de 162 millions de dollars - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: The United States has become the leading donor to the Ebola response in the DRC and Uganda, surpassing the $162 million threshold - LePotentiel.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, drive a major international response. The United States announces it has exceeded $162 million in Ebola aid, with an additional $350 million channelled through UN humanitarian funds to DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and $50 million to rapidly establish up to 50 treatment centers in high-risk zones. Kenya readiness funds of $13.5 million aim to bolster surveillance, medical supplies, and emergency response, though a Kenyan quarantine project faces judicial suspension. On the ground, IOM fields PPE, infrared thermometers, and diagnostic gear; Samaritan's Purse operates a 40-bed treatment center in Bunia after airlifts, while FHI 360 and International Medical Corps support screening and care in Beni, Bunia, and Goma. WHO cites over 1,000 suspected/confirmed cases with 30–50% fatality; border controls tightened. US pledges ongoing support as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 保健：米国がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ対策の主要ドナーとなり、1億6,200万ドルの閾値を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定・疑似症例1,000件以上、30～50%の致命率、複数国での発生、国際的な大規模な支援体制が既に稼働しており、IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ケニアへの言及があるが、対象国リスト内で検証済みの実発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。北キヴ州のゴマ、ブニアで実際に患者が発生・治療中。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク、1,000件以上の疑似/確定症例、30～50%の致命率という極めて深刻な公衆衛生影響。複数国への国際的拡大リスク、米国が1億6,200万ドルを超える支援を実施するなど、既に高レベルの国際対応が展開中。

article.articleHeadline: SP investiga caso suspeito de Ebola - 30/05/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Investigates Suspected Ebola Case - 30 May 2026
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil, is investigating a suspected Ebola virus disease case in a 37-year-old man who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where transmission occurs. He recently traveled to the country and presented fever, a warning symptom. A suspected case requires fever plus a 21-day history of origin or residence in an area with transmission and contact with blood or bodily fluids of a suspected or confirmed case. The patient is isolated at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology; laboratory confirmation is pending. The health secretariat says the risk of introduction to Brazil and South America is very low; no internal transmission and no direct flights connect Africa to the affected territory. Health services should stay vigilant for fever in travelers and assess direct fluid contact with suspected cases. No licensed vaccines or therapies exist for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; Zaire-based vaccines/treatments have no proven efficacy for the current outbreak variant.

triage.headline_ja: São Paulo(サンパウロ)がエボラウイルス病の疑い症例を調査中 - 2026年5月30日
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際輸入症例（DRC→Brazil）であり、IHR基準3項目該当。高い国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生的影響が認められ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでの流行地からBrazilへの入国者による輸入症例。記事では「南米への導入リスクは極めて低い」と評価されているが、エボラウイルス病の国際輸入症例は常に高い社会的・政治的関心を呼び、国際公衆衛生上の懸念となる。検査確認待機中。

article.articleHeadline: Virus- ébola: les chats, les chiens ne peuvent pas développer la maladie ( Un médecin vétérinaire) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: Cats and dogs cannot develop the disease (A veterinarian) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease cannot develop in domestic cats and dogs, according to a Kinshasa-based veterinarian in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Dr. Venance Tshikomba states that exposed cats and dogs remain asymptomatic and human transmission has not been proven to date. Bats are highlighted as natural reservoirs for many emerging zoonoses and are implicated in Ebola and other viral infections. Veterinary surveillance focuses on community education, adherence to barrier measures, avoiding contact with dead animals or their excretions, timely testing, and reporting suspected cases. Clinicians and veterinarians collaborate in a One Health approach to protect communities, with veterinarians playing a crucial frontline role in animal public health. He also advises communities to keep away from dead animals and, when burial is necessary, to surround the area with disinfectants and avoid touching the carcass.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：猫と犬は疾病を発症できない（獣医師）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ関連の報道だが、本記事は獣医師による教育的声明であり、新規の流行発生やリスク上昇を示す具体的な疫学データを含まない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのキンシャサに拠点を置く獣医師によるエボラウイルスに関する教育的声明。新規流行の発生報告ではなく、既知の疾病特性（猫・犬への非感染性、コウモリが自然宿主）の確認に関する内容。One Health アプローチ推奨など公衆衛生メッセージは含まれるが、具体的な患者数、死亡数、急速な拡大、新規地域への拡大などを示す疫学情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : cinq pièces herbergement disponibles au centre de traitement d'Ebola (CTE) à Beni . - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: five accommodation rooms available at the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) in Beni.
article.articleSummary: Five accommodation rooms at the Ebola Treatment Center in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, are now available to house new suspected cases, contacts, and potential Ebola-confirmed patients for the 17th Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Dr. Guy Kabongo, spokesperson for the North Kivu provincial health division, said the facility supports targeted case management by local health entities to improve treatment effectiveness in contamination zones. A partners’ meeting is planned to decide whether to reorganize or expand sites to host more patients if needed. In the Beni health zone, as of Saturday, five cases were confirmed with three deaths; two active cases and two evaded contacts were reported. Provincial health authorities urged community cooperation to report suspected cases to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニのエボラ治療センター（ETC）で5室の収容施設が利用可能に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。活動中のエボラ患者が確認され、治療施設の拡充が急務となっている。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラアウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株）において、ベニ保健地区で確認症例5件、死亡3件が報告されている。治療施設の収容能力強化が進行中であり、パートナー会合で必要に応じた施設の再編成・拡張が検討されている。コミュニティの協力と接触者追跡が重視されている。

article.articleHeadline: Șeful OMS vizitează epicentrul focarului de Ebola din estul Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief visits the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri's Bunia. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus plans to visit a treatment center and meet local authorities, health workers, and affected families. Officially reported: 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. Neighboring Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. Bundibugyo virus is the current Ebola strain and has no approved treatment or vaccine. European Union medical aid arrived in Ituri with more shipments expected; the United States announced an additional $80 million, bringing total commitments to over $112 million. Interventions at Rwampara and Bunia General Hospitals appear more organized with extra staff, PPE, and medical supplies, though patients continue arriving nonstop. Doctors Without Borders warns the response is not keeping pace with one of the fastest epidemics on record. As of 30 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が東部コンゴのエボラ感染症アウトブレイク中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、隣国ウガンダへの国際的拡大、医療体制への影響による渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス疾患（Bundibugyo株）は最高レベルの感染症脅威であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Kigali Province（ルワンダ）およびウガンダの記載があるが、サマリーの主題は東部DRCのイトゥリ州Buniaに集中している。DRCで906例の疑い例・223例の死亡が公式報告されており、隣国ウガンダで9例・1死亡が確認されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で有効なワクチン/治療法がなく、医学的な予防可能性が低い。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心・政府対応が顕著。記事日付は2026年5月30日（将来日付）であることを注記。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo investiga caso de ebola em homem de 37 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo investigates a case of Ebola in a 37-year-old man.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case under investigation in São Paulo, Brazil, as of 30 May 2026. A 37-year-old man who recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo is hospitalized at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas with fever and symptoms compatible with Ebola. He returned from Congo about 10 days ago, within the virus incubation window; no laboratory confirmation yet. The patient is undergoing tests to rule out other febrile illnesses, including malaria; samples are sent to Instituto Adolfo Lutz for specialized analysis. The investigation is conducted under updated surveillance protocols for the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, including notification, isolation, patient care, and epidemiological tracing. The health department says the risk of the disease reaching Brazil and South America remains very low due to the virus's low transmission and the absence of direct flights from the affected region to the continent.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ、37歳男性のエボラ疑似症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴからの帰国者による疑似エボラ症例であり、国際的な移動と関連しており、シグナルとして適切に追跡する必要がある。
