triage.headline_ja: タンジュンピナン保健局：麻疹ワクチンは病気の蔓延予防に有効
triage.triage_reason: 記事は麻疹ワクチンプログラムの有効性を強調する予防医療の好事例報道であり、異常事態や緊急の公衆衛生危機を示唆していない。2026年の26例の疑似症例報告も「監視継続中」という日常的な疾病サーベイランスの範囲内であり、IHR基準またはスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はワクチン接種プログラムの広報であり、感染症危機ではなく通常の公衆衛生活動。複数ワクチンの言及（麻疹、風疹、B型肝炎、ポリオ、百日咳）は定期予防接種スケジュール解説であり、アウトブレイク警告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brotes de ébola en el Congo: OMS advierte sobre respuesta lenta y desafíos sanitarios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreaks in Congo: WHO warns of slow response and health challenges.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Bunia, in Ituri Province, centers a Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak, where the virus is spreading faster than the response despite better-equipped facilities and new aid. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to bolster support; officials urge sustained assistance to combat the epicenter. Official figures report 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, with Uganda confirming 9 cases and 1 death. Bundibugyo Ebola virus has no approved treatment or vaccine. EU aid arrived in Ituri on Thursday, and the United States announced an additional $80 million, totaling over $112 million in commitments. Response in Rwampara and Bunia General hospitals appears more organized, with more staff, PPE, and supplies, though patients arrive around the clock. MSF warns the outbreak is among the fastest-growing, with unknown true magnitude. Attacks on health centers by locals and fighting in Ituri (ADF, M23 activities) hinder efforts. Uganda and Rwanda closed borders; the U.S. travel ban for recent visitors from Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan was criticized as ineffective for preventing spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症発生：WHOが緩慢な対応と衛生上の課題に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認（DRC、ウガンダ）、高い死亡率、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限実施など、明確な国際保健上の脅威であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのブニア（イトゥリ州）がエボラ発生の中心地と明記。ウガンダでの9例確認も記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCの発生が中心。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ルワンダについても同様。米国、スーダンは記事で支援国・隣接国として言及されているが、発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus の高い増殖率、死亡率（223例の死亡報告）、国境閉鎖、米国による渡航禁止措置の実施などから、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準両方で高度のリスク評価が該当。

article.articleHeadline: O que é o Ebola e por que autoridades monitoram viajantes vindos da África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Ebola and why are authorities monitoring travelers arriving from Africa?
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case under investigation in São Paulo, Brazil, highlighting a disease that is rare outside Africa but among the deadliest viral infections. Ebola can cause high fever, severe headache, muscle pains, fatigue, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea; in severe cases it progresses to hemorrhage, organ failure and shock. The incubation period is 2–21 days after exposure, and transmission occurs only after symptoms appear, mainly via direct contact with blood, secretions, and other body fluids. The international monitoring is focused on an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, linked to the Bundibugyo strain. Vaccines currently licensed target the Zaire strain, and there are no licensed vaccines or proven treatments for Bundibugyo. Overall risk to Brazil remains extremely low, but surveillance protocols are ready. Healthcare workers should evaluate fever in travelers from affected regions or with contact with infected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとは何か、そしてなぜ当局はアフリカから到着する旅行者を監視しているのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者がブラジルで調査中であり、アフリカでの流行（DRC、Bundibugyo株）との関連が指摘されている。IHR基準の「異常・予想外」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、ブラジルのサンパウロで疑い患者が調査中であり、DRCでの進行中の流行（Bundibugyo株）と関連がある。Bundibugyo株に対する現在の認可ワクチンは有効でないという重要な公衆衛生上の課題がある。ブラジルへのリスク評価は「極めて低い」とされているが、国際監視体制が稼働している。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra caso suspeito de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reports a suspected case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo's State Health Secretariat is monitoring a suspected Ebola case in the capital. The patient is a 37-year-old man, a native of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, who recently visited Brazil, and is hospitalized in grave condition under isolation at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas. Diagnosis is pending laboratory confirmation, with genetic sequencing potentially taking up to two weeks. Malaria and other tropical diseases are tested in parallel while Ebola-specific results are awaited. Symptoms include high fever, fatigue, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Authorities warn the highest risk is direct contact with bodily fluids, especially in advanced disease. The update notes the Bundibugyo strain circulating in Africa and updated isolation guidance in São Paulo. WHO data show 134 confirmed Ebola cases and 18 deaths in DRC/Uganda, with 906 cases and 223 deaths under investigation (13% mortality). No autochthonous transmissions in South America since 2014.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロがエボラの疑い患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。医療施設での隔離下にあるが、エボラ出血熱の疑い患者は国際的懸念が高く、確認検査結果待機中。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC出身で最近ブラジルを訪問し、サンパウロで隔離治療中。検査は進行中で確定診断待機。DRCとウガンダでの現在の流行背景あり。南米での自動伝播は2014年以降ない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya court suspends U.S. plan for Ebola quarantine facility | Times News Online
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court in Nairobi on 2026-05-30 suspended a U.S. plan to establish an Ebola quarantine facility for Americans exposed to a rare Ebola virus spreading in northeastern Congo, pending petitions heard on Tuesday. The Congolese government reports more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 220 deaths since declaring the outbreak on May 15. The U.S. plan would have housed exposed nationals at Laikipia Air Base in Kenya with about 50 quarantine beds, instead of repatriating them, and Washington pledged roughly $13.5 million for Kenya’s Ebola preparedness. Kenya said it was in talks with the U.S. on preparedness but did not confirm a treatment facility. The challenge by Katiba Institute and the Kenya Law Society cited public health risks and lack of public participation, prompting the court to halt the deal pending further review.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所、エボラ出血熱隔離施設に関する米国の計画を差し止め | タイムズ・ニューズ・オンライン
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで1,000件以上の疑い症例と220人以上の死亡を伴うエボラ出血熱の流行が報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生への深刻な影響とアメリカの国際的対応が確認される。IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴでのエボラ流行を報じており、ケニアおよび米国は流行対応・隔離施設計画の地域として言及されている。しかし評価対象国リストにはコンゴのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはコンゴのみとなる。コンゴは対象国リストに含まれているため、本シグナルはピックアップ対象。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade de São Paulo registra caso suspeito de Ebola - Ser Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City of São Paulo reports a suspected Ebola case - Ser Saúde.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil: a 37-year-old man who recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo is hospitalized in isolation at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, with laboratory confirmation still pending as of May 30, 2026. Health authorities are monitoring the patient under biosafety protocols; multiple tests are ongoing to confirm infection. Ebola is a severe, often fatal hemorrhagic fever. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with bodily fluids of symptomatic people, contaminated objects or surfaces, and via exposure to infected wild animals. The World Health Organization notes Ebola outbreaks in sub-Saharan Africa, with 18 deaths and 134 confirmed cases in Uganda and the DRC. On May 26, Brazil’s Ministry of Health activated the National Contingency Plan for Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers to keep the crisis away from the country. Early symptoms include fever, extreme weakness, muscle pains, headache, and sore throat.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ市がエボラの疑い例を報告 - Ser Saúde
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の出来事、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスは重篤な感染症であり、国際的移動との関連がある。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国への最近の渡航歴があり、ブラジルで疑い例として報告されている。ブラジル保健省は5月26日に全国ウイルス性出血熱対応計画を発動。実験室確認は未了（5月30日時点）。エボラの国際的拡大リスク、致死的な病原体としての特性、複数国への関連性から高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga un posible caso de ébola en un hombre que viajó a África - Proceso Digital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates a possible case of Ebola in a man who traveled to Africa - Proceso Digital
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s São Paulo state health authorities are investigating a possible Ebola case in a man who recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (RDC). He presents fever and Ebola-like symptoms and is hospitalized in isolation at the Emilio Ribas Institute in São Paulo; laboratory confirmation is not yet available, with a preventive investigation underway including isolation, immediate notification, laboratory testing, and monitoring. The risk to Brazil is deemed very low due to no local transmission and no direct flights to the affected region; health services are advised to monitor fever and RDC-travelers and to assess contacts of the initial case. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain (case fatality 30–50%, no licensed vaccine). The African Union health agency reports 246 deaths among over 1,000 suspected RDC cases; Uganda reports nine infections, including one death. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting; transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがアフリカへの渡航者の男性における可能性のあるエボラ症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（DRCでの大規模流行と複数国での症例確認）、予想外の国（ブラジル）での疑い症例発生、および重篤な公衆衛生上の潜在的影響を考慮し、IHR基準3項目該当でWHO通知レベルに相当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、DRCでの活発なエボラ流行（1,000例以上の疑い例、246死亡）とウガンダでの9症例が報告されており、ブラジルの症例はDRC渡航者からの輸入症例の可能性。ブラジルへの直行便がないため地域への直接的な拡大リスクは低いと評価されているが、国際的な移動と複数国での確認により監視対象。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, scattano le misure per chi arriva da Congo e Uganda: obbligo di dichiarazione, cinque i livelli di rischio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: measures kick in for arrivals from Congo and Uganda; declaration required, five levels of risk.
article.articleSummary: Italy requires travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to declare their origin within 24 hours if they spent time there in the preceding 21 days, amid an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo variant. The two countries report at least 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths. Italy will regulate risk with five levels from molto basso to molto alto, based on exposure and symptoms, guiding monitoring and restrictions. Asymptomatic arrivals with no exposure fall into very low; high-risk exposure triggers quarantine for next levels, while the top level requires biocontainment transport for the most exposed. Inbound flights with at-risk passengers will land at Rome’s Fiumicino hub; regional reference centers for infectious diseases are designated, with Spallanzani in Rome as the national center. EU contemplates coordinated actions; vaccines and treatments are in early development, with WHO aiming to strengthen health systems in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴとウガンダからの渡航者に措置が実施、宣言義務、5段階のリスクレベル
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの流行、イタリアでの渡航者スクリーニング実施）が確認され、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限に該当。感染者数・死亡数の報告があり重症度も確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでのエボラ流行も記述しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはリストに含まれるため含める。イタリアはイベント発生国ではなく対応国であるため含めない。1,077の疑似症例と246人の死亡が報告されており、重症度および公衆衛生への影響は深刻。イタリアを含むEU各国での渡航・貿易制限措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情爆發後 數萬中國人經「灰色暗道」逃離回國？(圖) - 觀點評析 -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the Ebola outbreak, tens of thousands of Chinese people flee back to China through "gray back channels" (Photos) - Opinion and Analysis -
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province’s Mongbwalu area, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of May 29, WHO reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, with rapid regional spread including confirmed Uganda cases and a U.S. doctor infected in Congo and receiving treatment in Germany. The index case was reported April 24 by a healthcare worker, with ongoing transmission among medical staff. This strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, and WHO has declared the event a PHEIC due to high international risk and difficult containment. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids; symptoms include vomiting, diarrhea, fever, rash/bleeding, and potential death, with case fatality varying by setting. China’s public health channel notes 21-day self-monitoring for entrants from risk areas (DRC, Uganda). The article also references unverified reports of thousands of Chinese miners fleeing back to China through ‘gray channels.’

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情の爆発後、数万人の中国人が「グレーチャネル」を通じて国に逃げ戻る？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイク、複数国での確認例、高い死亡率、WHO PHEIC宣言、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクを満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州モンブワル地域が震源。確認例はウガンダ、米国医師がコンゴで感染してドイツで治療中。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。5月29日時点で疑い例906件、疑い死亡223件（致命率24.6%）。ワクチンなし、治療法不明。中国からの大量流出は未検証情報だが、公衆衛生への関心は極めて高い。対象国外（ウガンダ、米国、ドイツ）での発生も記載されているが、verified_locationsはサマリーの主題から対象国に限定。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo tủ lạnh bẩn hơn nhà tắm: Nguy cơ vi khuẩn cho sức khỏe gia đình
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: A fridge dirtier than a bathroom — a bacterial risk to your family's health.
article.articleSummary: Fridges in Vietnamese homes harbor substantial bacterial contamination, turning summer storage into a health risk. A 2023 Sichuan Public Health survey in Chengdu found an average bacterial load of 2.9 × 10^4 CFU/cm^2 in fridge compartments, comparable to Beijing (2018) and Nanjing (2019) data, and higher than standards for public spaces and even toilets. Salmonella (common in eggs, milk, meat) can be suppressed but not eradicated by cold; Listeria can persist in frozen storage for months, threatening pregnant women and the immunocompromised. Staphylococcus aureus and Yersinia are also concerns—Yersinia accounts for about 2% of patients in hospital gastro clinics annually. Cold temperatures slow growth but don’t kill it. A three-step regimen—unplug and discard spoiled foods; wash shelves with mild soap; thoroughly disinfect hidden areas like drainage, door seals, and egg trays—followed by weekly to biweekly cleaning in summer. Keep 0–4°C and separate raw/cooked foods; adhere to storage durations.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：冷蔵庫はトイレより汚い――家族の健康への細菌リスク
triage.triage_reason: 食品媒介感染症（チフス、パラチフス、リステリア）に関連する環境汚染の警告記事だが、具体的な患者発生やアウトブレークの報告ではなく、一般的な衛生啓発の性質が強い。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は冷蔵庫環境における細菌汚染リスクの一般向け啓発記事であり、確定的なアウトブレーク報告ではない。四川省成都（2023年調査）、北京（2018年）、南京（2019年）での環境検査データと、ベトナム家庭の冷蔵庫汚染について述べている。患者数、死亡、確定診断事例の記載なし。WPROスクリーニング基準では長期曝露と流行しやすさが該当するが、公衆衛生危機の明確な証拠に欠ける。

article.articleHeadline: مدير منظمة الصحة العالمية يصل إلى بؤرة تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية - قناة المنار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director-General of the World Health Organization arrives at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Al-Manar Channel
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo centers on Bunia, Ituri Province, with WHO Director-General Tedros arriving to coordinate response as Bunia airport remains closed to international flights. Since the May 15 outbreak declaration and WHO’s PHEIC, the virus has been detected in three DRC provinces and neighboring Uganda, which reported two new cases, bringing Uganda’s confirmed total to nine. In the DRC, 225 infections have been confirmed since the start, with over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths; 142 people are currently in treatment, and one patient has recovered. No approved vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain; the Zaire strain vaccine had been licensed for past outbreaks. A Bundibugyo vaccine could be ready by year-end, with trials urged. Access challenges from armed groups, crowded displacement camps, and limited lab capacity complicate response, while neighboring-country risk remains high and global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の震源地に到着 - アルマナルチャンネル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：225例確認・246死亡、異常・予想外：新しいBundibugyo株、国際的拡大：ウガンダで確認、渡航制限：ブニア空港閉鎖）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5つ該当。WHO総長の現地対応およびPHEIC宣言により、直ちにフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づく検証：ウガンダについて「隣国ウガンダで新規症例2例、確認計9例」と記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみがサマリーの主題であり、対象国リストに該当する。Bundibugyo株は承認されたワクチンがなく、年末までに候補ワクチンの準備が期待される状況。武装勢力による治安不安定、過密な避難キャンプ、検査機能の限定が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ada 906 Kasus Suspek Strain Bundibugyo Ebola di RD Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 906 Suspected Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain cases in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of May 29–30, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 906 suspected Bundibugyo ebolavirus cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 223 suspected deaths under investigation. In DRC, 125 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, including 17 confirmed deaths, across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Uganda has seven confirmed Ebola cases, three imported from the DRC, with one death; Uganda’s health ministry later reported nine confirmed cases. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola strain with no vaccine. The outbreak in eastern DRC is ongoing, and there are concerns about spread in densely populated areas making tracing and isolation difficult. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Among confirmed cases, fatality is 30–50%. Testing capacity is being expanded; most pending samples from suspected cases are expected to be processed soon; no community transmission is reported yet.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョエボラウイルス株の疑い患者906例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当、WPRO基準も全項目該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した致命的なエボラウイルス（希少な株、ワクチンなし）の多数例報告。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラは希少株でワクチンが利用できず、確認例の致命率30-50%。既に国際的に拡大（ウガンダで確認例7-9例）。WHOが正式にPHEIC宣言済み。東部DRCの人口密集地での拡大懸念あり。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに未収載のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de Ebola é internado em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola is hospitalized in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil, as of May 30, 2026. A 37-year-old man, who recently traveled through the Democratic Republic of Congo, is hospitalized in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology. He has fever and compatible symptoms; laboratory confirmation is pending. The São Paulo health authorities (CCD and CVE-SP) initiated a preventive investigation following national and state protocols, including isolation, immediate notification, laboratory testing, and close monitoring. The case is being evaluated for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, historically linked to DR Congo outbreaks (2012: 38 cases, 13 deaths) and the Congo-Uganda border (2007: 131 cases, 42 deaths). The more widespread Zaire strain caused major outbreaks such as West Africa (2014–2016, ~11,000 deaths) and DRC (2018–2020, >3,000 deaths). A vaccine (Ervebo), developed for a specific form of Ebola, was approved by the FDA in 2019, but the current case is under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの疑いのある患者がサンパウロに入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブラジルでのエボラ疑い患者は対象地域における極めて重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国から最近渡航。症状は確認されているが検査確認は保留中。国際的な懸念が高い。DRCはエボラ発生の歴史的な震源地。対象国のブラジルにおけるエボラ疑い患者は国内初とみられ、グローバルな公衆衛生上の脅威として評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Врачи предупредили о беспрецедентных темпах распространения Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warned of unprecedented pace of Ebola spread.
article.articleSummary: Unprecedented Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo spreads at record pace. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus drives the outbreak, with Ituri province at the epicenter and cases also reported in North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak was declared May 15. By May 30, authorities reported more than 1,000 suspected cases and about 240 suspected deaths. MSF deputy operations director Alan Gonzalez warned that infections are rising rapidly two weeks after the declaration, with hundreds of samples awaiting lab confirmation. Cross-border and airport restrictions hinder delivery of medicines, humanitarian aid, and medical staff. MSF called for expanded testing, increased humanitarian support, and unimpeded access to affected areas to accelerate response.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らがエボラウイルスの前例のない拡大速度について警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）のアウトブレイクがDRCで5月15日に宣言され、2週間で1,000件以上の疑似患者および約240件の死亡が報告されている。IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi、South Kivu、North Kivu各州でBundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属）によるアウトブレイクが発生。宣言後わずか15日で1,000件以上の疑似患者が報告され、急速な感染拡大が進行中。国境検問所と空港の制限により医療支援・スタッフの派遣が阻害されている状況。MSFが包括的な対応強化を訴えている。国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo investiga caso suspeito de Ebola em paciente vindo do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo investigates a suspected Ebola case in a patient from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola suspected case is under investigation in São Paulo, Brazil, involving a 37-year-old man who recently arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, currently isolated at Instituto Emílio Ribas. He presented fever and meets clinical/epidemiological criteria; laboratories are testing, with Instituto Adolfo Lutz performing differential diagnosis to rule out other diseases. The investigation is led by CCD and CVE-SP. Measures include isolation, immediate notification, and laboratory analysis per national traveler protocols for regions with viral circulation. The identification was precautionary. Last week, São Paulo updated hospital guidance regarding the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in Congo. Brazil’s risk remains very low given no local transmission in South America, no direct flights from affected regions, and transmission requiring contact with blood or bodily fluids. A 2014 episode in São Paulo involved three suspected cases later discarded.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロがコンゴからの患者におけるエボラ疑いケースを調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（DRC→Brazil）と異常性により IHR基準2つ以上に該当。スクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の4基準に該当。政府レベルの対応が実施されており、国際感染症監視の対象として適切。
triage.notes: DRCでのBundibugyo株アウトブレイク背景における、ブラジルへの輸入症例の疑いケース。患者は隔離されており、検査機関による鑑別診断が進行中。南米での局所伝播リスクは低いと評価されているが、国際的警戒体制として監視継続が必要。過去2014年の同様事例との対比も記事で言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: JFK joins growing list of US airports to screen passengers for Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri) and Uganda prompts JFK to begin enhanced screening on May 30, 2026. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 15; as of May 30, there are 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. The United States reroutes travelers from Congo, South Sudan and Uganda to select airports for screening; JFK is the fourth major hub after Dulles, Atlanta, and Houston. A rule now suspends entry into the United States for lawful permanent residents who have been in DRC, Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days. Screening includes a travel history questionnaire, non-contact temperature checks, and CDC observation; travelers should monitor symptoms for 21 days after leaving affected countries. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, weakness, diarrhea, vomiting, stomach pain, and unexplained bleeding; mortality 30-50%. The CDC lists immediate risk as low and will reassess.

triage.headline_ja: JFK空港が乗客のエボラ出血熱スクリーニングを開始する米国空港リストに加わる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施中）。WHO PHEIC宣言、223死亡例、30-50%の致命率、複数国への拡大が確認されており、フルRRA進行の対象
triage.notes: 記事ではDRC（Ituri州）とウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクについて記述。米国内のGeorgia、Virginia、New York、Texasへの言及は空港スクリーニング実施地点の記載であり、実際の発生地ではない。ウガンダ・スーダンはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言（5月15日）、致死率30-50%、複数国での確認、国際的渡航制限実施により、緊急性の高いシグナル

article.articleHeadline: "بؤرة تفشي إيبولا".. مدير منظمة الصحة العالمية يتفقد شرق جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola outbreak" ... Director-General of the World Health Organization inspects eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits Bunia. Declared a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 15, 2026, the outbreak is driven by one of Ebola’s rarest and deadliest strains, with no approved vaccine or treatment yet; most past outbreaks involved Zaire ebolavirus, which has a vaccine. In the DRC, 225 laboratory-confirmed cases, 142 in treatment, and one recovered; deaths exceed 246 among more than 1,000 suspected cases. Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. International aid includes EU medical supplies to Ituri and over $112 million from the United States. MSF warns the response lags behind spread. Security risks and burial-practice tensions impede containment; armed groups attack health centers. Uganda and Rwanda have closed borders; the United States has travel restrictions for those who recently visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. Neighboring-country risk is high; global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラウイルス流行」...世界保健機関事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国東部を視察
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常/予想外、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限実施済み）。WHO緊急事態宣言済みの稀有で致命的なエボラ株（Bundibugyo）による大規模流行。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月15日）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀有な株、ワクチン・治療薬なし）。DRC 225確定例・246死亡、Uganda 9確定例・1死亡。複数国による国境閉鎖と渡航制限実施。米国から1億1200万ドル以上の支援。武装勢力による保健施設への攻撃など安全保障上の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情爆发后 数万中国人经"灰色暗道"逃离回国？(图) - 观点评析 -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the Ebola outbreak, tens of thousands of Chinese people flee back to China through "gray secret tunnels" (Photo) - Opinion Analysis -
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri’s Mongbwalu area. By May 29, 2026, WHO reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. First reported April 24 by a health worker, the outbreak has spread among health workers and communities; transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms including nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, fever, bleeding, and organ failure. Case fatality historically ranges 25–90%. WHO designates the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting no approved vaccine or specific treatment, and warnings of a slow global response. Uganda has confirmed cases; a U.S. clinician infected is treated in Germany. Separately, rumors claim tens of thousands of Chinese miners are fleeing Ituri via a gray tunnel route to China, via Dubai and disguising origin in Guangzhou/Nanning. China CDC requires 21 days of self-monitoring for returnees from risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行後、数万人の中国人が「灰色の裏ルート」を通じて中国に逃げ帰る？（写真） - 見方・分析 -
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス病はWHOがPHEICを宣言し、複数国での確認例と国際的な人口流動による感染リスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）はDRCのイトゥリ州モンブワルで流行中。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダでの確認例、米国の臨床医の感染、ドイツでの治療報告あり。記事ではDRCからの逃亡ルート（ドバイ経由で広東省・南寧への潜在的な感染リスク）について言及。中国CDCが危険地域からの帰国者に21日間の自己監視を要求しており、政府当局の関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Msf: "La risposta non sta tenendo il passo con la diffusione dell'epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, MSF: "The response is not keeping pace with the spread of the epidemic."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered on Bunia, is outpacing the response. Two weeks after the epidemic’s declaration, MSF and WHO warn the situation is deeply alarming, with rapid case growth unseen in prior outbreaks. The strain involved is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccines or specific treatments exist, and diagnosis is hindered by limited testing capacity. New suspected cases are reported daily, but hundreds of samples remain unanalyzed. Border and airport closures are delaying vital medical supplies, humanitarian aid, and expert personnel. Ground healthcare capacity is severely constrained; an immediate expansion of testing and a coordinated, enhanced response is essential, backed by medical and humanitarian organizations and guaranteed access for supplies and staff. Community engagement must be central to address fear, disinformation, and to encourage care-seeking.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、MSF：「対応が流行の拡大ペースに追いついていない」
triage.triage_reason: DRC(Ituri州Bunia)でのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の急速な拡大、治療法やワクチンの不在、越境感染リスク、国際的な対応支援の必要性など、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当する高リスク事象。即座にフルRRAを実施すべき。
triage.notes: 記事本文がないため詳細な情報は限定的だが、サマリーから以下の重大要素が確認される：(1)Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・特異的治療薬なし）、(2)急速な症例増加、(3)検査容量不足（数百検体未分析）、(4)国境空港閉鎖による医療物資・専門家アクセス遅延、(5)MSF・WHO両機関による警告。DRCはWHO AFRO地域だが、シグナル強度からピックアップ推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de São Paulo investiga caso suspeito de ebola em paciente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo government investigates a suspected case of Ebola in a patient.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil. A 37-year-old man, native of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and who recently visited the DRC where Ebola circulates, is in grave condition and isolated at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas while laboratory tests to confirm or exclude Ebola are underway (results may take up to two weeks). Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, bodily fluids or tissues of symptomatic individuals, with contagiousness in the acute phase. São Paulo’s CCD and CVE-SP are monitoring the case; suspected cases should be reported to municipal surveillance and CVE. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pain, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. Sequencing is being performed to confirm infection and exclude other diseases. The article notes the current WHO-reported Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda: 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths; 223 more deaths and 906 cases under investigation; 13% mortality, referencing the Bundibugyo strain, and recalls that Ebola reached São Paulo in 2014 but without autochthonous transmission in South America.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州政府、患者のエボラ疑い症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の疑い症例が南米で報告され、DRC発症者の海外移動による国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: DRC発症患者がブラジル・サンパウロに移動し、疑い症例として報告。DRC及びウガンダでのWHO公式発症報告が背景にあり（134確定例、18死亡、死亡率13%）、ヒト-ヒト感染可能な高危険病原体の国際移動であるため、IHR通知基準を満たす。確認検査結果待機中であり、速やかなフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: " Vous n'êtes pas seuls " : le patron de l'OMS au coeur de l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "You Are Not Alone": The WHO Head at the Heart of the Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts a high-level response as WHO Director-General travels on Saturday to Bunia to demonstrate solidarity with affected communities. The piece centers on the slogan 'You Are Not Alone' and places the WHO leader at the heart of the Ebola response in the DRC. The visit underscores international attention to the outbreak as frontline responders work to contain transmission in Bunia and surrounding areas. The excerpt does not provide figures on cases or deaths, laboratory-confirmation details, or source of infection. The focus remains on leadership and moral support from the World Health Organization during this health crisis in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 「あなたたちは一人ではない」：WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の中心に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）の複数該当に加え、WHO事務局長の現地視察という国際的高官対応により社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは具体的な患者数や死亡数を提供していないため重症度の詳細評価は不可。ただしエボラ出血熱の特性、WHO事務局長による現地視察、国際的対応体制の整備により、深刻な感染症事象として確実にシグナル要件を満たす。東部DRCのブニアを中心とした流行継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se espalha na RDC de forma alarmante, alerta ONG durante visita da OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading alarmingly in the DRC, NGO warns during WHO visit.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri, is labeled alarming by MSF. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with an estimated case fatality of about one third and no specific vaccine available. Suspected infections exceed 1,000 with at least 246 deaths; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits Ituri to monitor containment and logistical challenges amid border and airport restrictions and ongoing conflict that hinder surveillance and supply transport. A laboratory at the National Institute for Biomedical Research in Bunia now delivers results within 24 hours, accelerating case identification, contact tracing, and patient isolation. Previously samples traveled more than 1,500 km to Kinshasa. Experts note possible animal origin in addition to human transmission. Situation remains under close watch by WHO and humanitarian partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で警報的に拡大、WHO訪問中にNGOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。ウガンダでの国境を越えた確認症例、高い致死率（約33%）、既に246死亡例を記録。フルリスク評価（RRA）へ即座に進むべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、Kinshasa）が主発生地で、ウガンダは国境を越えた二次発生地として言及されている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。Bundibugyo株による流行、高い致死率、ワクチン未有、紛争による管理困難が重大リスク要因。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は事態の深刻さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Urges DRC Communities to Take Lead Role in Containing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) accelerates, with suspected cases exceeding 1,000 and 246 deaths reported in the DRC as of Thursday. Three provinces are affected, and Ituri Province’s Bunia is the main epicenter. The outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, and the WHO has issued a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to urge local communities to take a leading role, emphasizing community ownership and tailored responses, with the international effort under the DRC government’s leadership. The outbreak has also spread to neighboring Uganda, where two new confirmed cases were reported on Friday, bringing Uganda’s total to nine. In the DRC, most confirmed cases remain in Ituri; MSF warns the outbreak is advancing rapidly and current response levels are below needs. This event follows a history of Ebola waves in Africa, including 2018–2020.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ封じ込めにおけるコンゴ民主共和国のコミュニティの主導的役割を促促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてが該当。エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクは公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、および国際的関心を伴う。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、ウガンダでも2例の新規確定例が報告されたと述べられていますが、ウガンダは提供されたスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めました。WHOがPHEICを宣言した確実なシグナルであり、即座のフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spread in DR Congo 'alarming', charity warns, as WHO chief visits worst-hit area
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) is described as deeply alarming by MSF as the WHO chief Tedros visits the worst-hit area. There are more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths; neighbouring Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death. Two weeks after the outbreak was declared, the pace of transmission has been rapid, with daily new suspected cases and many samples still untested. Containment and aid deliveries are hindered by border and airport closures and ongoing conflict in DR Congo. The current outbreak involves a Bundibugyo Ebola strain with no proven vaccine and a case-fatality around one third. Laboratory capacity improved in Bunia, where the National Institute for Biomedical Research can return results within 24 hours, after samples previously traveled up to 1,500 km to Kinshasa. Ebola typically originates from animals, especially fruit bats, with human outbreaks linked to handling or consuming infected animals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の拡大は「悚然とさせるほど懸念される」と慈善団体が警告、WHO事務局長が最悪の被災地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な伝播、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。またWPRO基準全5項目該当。アフリカ地域での広域流行の重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: DRCの東部（イトゥリ州）で発生しているエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の急速な拡大事例。1,000件以上の疑い例、246名以上の死亡が確認されており、隣国ウガンダへの波及（9確定例、1死亡）も報告されている。紛争・インフラの制限により封じ込めが困難な状況。WHO事務局長が直接現地視察に赴いた重大事態。ワクチン未開発の株による高致死率（約33%）が懸念材料。フルRRA実施必須。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για τον ιό Έμπολα: Ο γενικός διευθυντής του ΠΟΥ μετέβη στο Κονγκό - "Πιστεύω μπορούμε να το σταματήσουμε"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over the Ebola virus: WHO Director-General travels to Congo — 'I believe we can stop it'
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15, threatening about 100 million residents, with the World Health Organization declaring a global health emergency. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Congo and is spending two days in Ituri Province, centering on Bunia, to meet local leaders and address concerns as Ebola spreads in the eastern part of the country. The majority of cases are in Ituri; access is hampered by absent state services in rural areas and armed groups that kill civilians, complicating surveillance and laboratory confirmation. WHO notes that official counts may underestimate true scale due to limited testing capacity. Tedros insisted, 'I believe we can stop it.' Ebola has killed about 15,000 Africans in the last 50 years; the largest DRC outbreak (2018–2020) caused 2,300 deaths among about 3,500 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス警報：WHO事務局長がコンゴを訪問 — 「これを止められると信じている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の新規流行（DRC）、WHO緊急宣言、国際的なスプレッド懸念、深刻な公衆衛生影響。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。
triage.notes: 新規流行宣言（2026年5月15日）。約1億人が脅かされ、WHO緊急事態宣言発令。イトゥリ州ブニアを中心に東部で急速拡大。武装勢力やサービス欠如により監視と確定診断が困難。推定患者数は公式統計を上回る可能性。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は高度な国際的関心を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: El director general de la OMS llega al epicentro de la epidemia de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Director-General of the WHO arrives at the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-30, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri Province, DRC, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Ituri is among three affected provinces as conflict between the Congolese army and armed groups complicates the response; Tedros urged a ceasefire to facilitate operations. He also traveled to Kinshasa to meet Prime Minister Judith Suminwa and UN humanitarian teams. The AU health agency reports about 246 suspected Ebola deaths in the DRC, the seventeenth outbreak since 1976. The virus has crossed into Uganda, with nine confirmed cases and one death from a Congolese import. The Bundibugyo strain has a case fatality rate of roughly 30-50%, and there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The outbreak likely began circulating in Ituri about two months before the PHEIC declaration.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地に到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境確認）、深刻な死亡率（30-50%）、国家間紛争による対応困難により、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダへの患者輸入（9確定例、1死亡）が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主たる発生地域であり、WHO事務局長の現地訪問はシグナルの重大性を示す。Bundibugyo株による第17次アウトブレイク、有効なワクチン・治療なし、紛争による対応困難など複合リスク要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra caso suspeito de ebola em paciente internado em estado grave | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records a suspected case of Ebola in a patient hospitalized in critical condition | A TARDE
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old man in São Paulo, Brazil, is hospitalized in critical condition under investigation for suspected Ebola virus disease. He is a native of the Democratic Republic of Congo and recently traveled there, where Ebola remains circulating. No laboratory confirmation yet; results may take up to two weeks. He is isolated at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, with the São Paulo Health Secretariat monitoring via CCD and CVE-SP. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood, secretions, or other bodily fluids of symptomatic patients, during the symptomatic phase. Symptoms include high fever, muscle pains, severe headache, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. The case is treated as imported; Ebola testing is ongoing alongside other febrile illnesses. Immediate isolation of suspected cases is advised under updated Bundibugyo-strain guidelines, with reporting to local surveillance and CVE. Global outbreak data: Congo and Uganda show 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths, 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが重篤な患者のエボラ疑い例を報告—Democratic Republic of Congoからの渡航者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴでのエボラ流行地域からの渡航者による重篤な疑い例であり、即座のRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは背景情報の全体統計（134確認例、18死亡）に言及されているのみで、本件疑い例はブラジル・サンパウロで発生し、感染源地がコンゴである。したがってverified_locationsはブラジルとコンゴのみ。患者はコンゴからの最近の渡航者で、現在サンパウロで重篤症状で隔離中。検査確認待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde de SP Investiga Caso Suspeito de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo State Health Department Investigates Suspected Ebola Case.
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo is under investigation for a suspected Ebola infection in São Paulo, Brazil. He is hospitalized in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Infectology Institute, Brazil's state reference facility for suspected or confirmed Ebola cases, with no laboratory confirmation yet. The investigation began based on clinical and epidemiological criteria compatible with a suspected case; measures include isolation, immediate notification, laboratory testing, and monitoring per current protocols. The case underscores concerns about the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, a rare variant for which there is no vaccine. DRC authorities reported a surge in suspected Ebola cases to 1,028, with 225 confirmed. Uganda has also confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases. As of May 30, 2026, health authorities are maintaining containment and monitoring activities.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州保健局がエボラウイルス感染の疑い例を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス確定例の国際的拡大リスク、コンゴ民主共和国での流行状況（確定例225件、疑い例1,028件）、ブンディブギョ株（ワクチン未開発）の懸念により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。公開ソース報道で社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 37歳コンゴ民主共和国出身者のサンパウロでのエボラ疑い例は、ブラジルでの初めての可能性が高い国際的なシグナル。DRC内での流行拡大（確定225件、疑い1,028件）とブンディブギョ株のワクチン非存在は重大なリスク。ウガンダでの確定例も報告されており、多国間での感染拡大懸念が存在。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga un posible caso de ébola en un hombre que viajó a África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates a possible case of Ebola in a man who traveled to Africa.
article.articleSummary: Possible Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil: a man who recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo presents fever and is hospitalized in isolation at the Emilio Ribas Institute in São Paulo. Laboratory tests have not yet confirmed Ebola; authorities launched a preventive investigation with isolation, rapid notification, laboratory testing, and monitoring. Brazil's Secretariat of Health said the risk of national introduction remains very low due to no evidence of local transmission and no direct flights with the outbreak region. Health services are advised to monitor febrile travelers from the DRC and those in contact with the initial cases. The Bundibugyo strain has a case-fatality rate of 30-50% and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. In DRC, over 1,000 suspected cases have yielded 246 deaths; Uganda has nine cases and one death. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting; transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが、アフリカに旅行した男性のエボラの可能性のある症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の可能性のある症例が報告され、IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、旅行制限リスク）に該当。また対象国（DRC、Brazil）での発生確認とWPRO基準複数項目に合致。
triage.notes: DRCでの流行規模は1,000件以上の疑い症例、246名死亡。ウガンダでも9症例1死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株の致死率30-50%。São PauloからのDRC渡航者が隔離中で検査進行中。ブラジル当局は国内導入リスクは低いと評価するも、早期検出と対応体制が整備されている点は肯定的。フルRRA実施を推奨。
